tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen ra
ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen ra

tei:div.tei:p: ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can las/ chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /gnas mchog gze rgyal gter byon ye shes kyi/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de'ang gu rus zhal nas/ snying thig yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba'i seng gdong ḍākki'i sgrub thabs 'di: khungs btsun zhing byin rlabs che ba'i rgyu gang zhe na: thog mar khungs btsun pa ni: ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: dbyings phyug gsang ba ḍākkis gu ru la snyan brgyud du gnang ba'i phyir: brgyud pa nye ba dang : gu rus rtags ldan mi brjed pa'i shog ser la btab ste de phan sbas te: gang la ma spel bas bsre bslad ma zhugs pas khungs btsun pa dang : slar gter 'di bzhes pa'i tshe: mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ma nor ba de bzhin la: klung 'khor dmar nag rakta 'khrugs pa'i mtsho nas kun gyis mthong bar gdan drangs dgos pa ni yid ches pa'i dgos pa yod zhes dang*/ yang byin rlabs che ba'i rgyu gang zhe na: seng gdong dmar mo ni 'jig rten la gnas pa sha gzugs tshul te: 'jig rten las 'das rtags ni seng zhal sngo ba tsam las med pa dang : 'khor rnams kyang phra men sha zas bskor bas: des na 'di nyid chos kyi dbyings mtshon pa'i kha dog mthing ka gzhi ma bcos pa'i dngos rtags mthun te: dbyings dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa ni mkha' 'gro ma/ stong nyid kyi rang rtsal snying rje'i rang sgra ldir ba'i brdar seng zhal dang ldan pa de'ang mkha' 'gro gzhan las thun mong ma yin par mtshon la: 'khor rnams kyang ye shes dbyings kyi ḍakki ma dang shugs kyi rang rtsal rnams kyang snying rje'i cho 'phrul du gnas: rtsa ba gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir rigs bdag gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs spyi bor brgyan pa 'di:

byin rlabs gzhan las khyad par 'phags so: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan rnams la: rtag tu mkha' 'gro 'du zhing gsang ba'i lung bstan 'byung : kun gyi gtso mo che yin pas 'gro ba dbang du 'du: yang dag don gyi sgrub pa yin pas mchog gi dngos grub thob: lus med ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin pas: tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub: mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam yin pas bgrod 'gyu mi dgos par zhing khams mthong : mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig kun gyi srog la gnas pas: log lta can la dmigs gtad kyis mthu ma btang kyang : bka' chad kyis sgrol nus: mkha' 'gro 'di dbang sdud kun gyi gtso mo yin pas: longs spyod mi 'dod kyang char bzhin du 'bebs: bsnyen sgrub phran bu las ma thon kyang : mkha' 'gro'i gsung shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin pas 'grub rtags myur: 'di rang byung lhan skyes kyi mkha' 'gro yin pas sgrub sla la mkhu ldog mi 'byung : 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo yin pas rtsa rlung dang lus stobs rgyas shing khams dang bkrag mdangs 'phel: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i rang bzhin du gnas pas mkhyen gnyis kyi rig pa ma sbyangs kyang lhums su zhugs: dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso mo shes rab yum yin pas: 'di nyid bsgrubs pas gzhan thams cad gcig 'dus su 'gro: dbang bzhi gtso bo shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin pas: dbang bskur thams cad yongs rdzogs su 'gro: phar phyin drug gi sdong po shes rab phar phyin yin pas: bslab pa thams cad rang rdzogs su 'gro: pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis yang : shes rab ma rgyud don gyi theg pa yin pas: rgyud sde kun gyi gtso bor 'jug: bskyed rdzogs gnyis yang gtso bo shes rab rdzogs rim yin te: 'di rdzogs rim du 'jug: de bas skal ldan las can gyis: 'di nyid sgom sgrub bgyis la nyams su len par bya'o: zhes bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad pa'i ye shes kyi 'kha' 'gro ma bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong can gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs lag tu ma son la khyad par rgyud dang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gtum mo'i gzhung khrid sogs rdzogs rim skor slar mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod du bsdus par mngon la/
da lam thor bu rigs gang rnyed kyi them byang 'god pa la gsum/ rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor/ chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor/ yan lag kha skong gi skor ro/ ༈

dang po rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor la/ ka) smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa dbang mchog ind+ra nī la'i mchod sdong 'ja' tshon drwa ba/ kha) rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i rtsa ba 'phrul gyi me long las: bdud 'dul drag mo'i gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel mu tig phreng ba/ ga) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can las: sngon 'gro dkar gtor/ nga) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can las: phrin las sgrub pa gnam lcags thog mda' dmar po/ ca) yang gsang thugs kyi ti ka dmar po khro chu'i bang mdzod las: mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i las byang dregs pa tshar gcod/ cha) mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: srung bzlog rgyun khyer ngag 'don/ ja) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong ma las: mtshan med srung bzlog gnam lcags ur mo/ nya) drag mo bdud 'dul ḍākki'i thun gtor 'bul ba/ ta) zangs btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i gsol mchod phrin las kun 'grub/ tha) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo las: mkha' 'gro 'bum bskang dngos grub rgya mtsho/ da) drag mo seng gdong las tshogs me 'khor nag po las: bstod bskul khrag mtsho khol ma/ na) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: smad las bsad pa zangs sgrom dmar po/ pa) bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: yang bzlog thog mda' dgu skor/ pha) bdud 'dul drag mo'i 'phang ba zor bzlog dug gi spu gri/ ba) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las: drag po me'i las mtha' spu gri dmar po zab rgya can/ ma) ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong can ma las: mtshan bcas srung bzlog rdo rje'i go khrab/ tsa) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las: gza' srung rdo rje'i go cha rdzas srung lcags mchu nag po zab rgya can/ tsha) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las:

za yig bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho nyes pa zhi bar byed pa/ dza) mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo las: them med las tshogs kha bsgyur/ wa) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las: bza' btung gnad kyi them yig sdig pa snying 'dzin/ zha) lam yig gsal ba'i sgron me mthong ba don ldan/ za) yon tan tsā ri'i lam yig gsal ba'i sgron me/ ༈ gnyis pa chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor/ 'a) bdud rtsi lag mchod kun blo'i mdzad pa/ ya) bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bsnyen dmigs/ ra) mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong las byang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi tshogs mchod/ la) ye shes ḍākki seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog chog bsgrigs su bkod pa gnam lcags spu gri byad ma snying 'byin/ sha) bzlog byang bsdus pa/ sa) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong can las: 'phen pa zor las lhan thabs dang bcas dkyus gcig tu bkod pa rdo rje'i thog mda' nag po/ ha)rtsang bzlog a) bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro drag mo seng gdong las/ gser skyems gling bzhi sgo 'byed gnam sprul gsum pas chog bsgrigs mdzad pa/ ki) yang phur nas za lam khol phyung*/ khi) bka' brgyad nas sku glud khol phyung*/ gi) bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje 'chang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma'i me mchod bsdus pa/ ngi) ye shes bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog gi zin bris rong smyon gyis mdzad pa/ ci) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong can gyi bsnyen sgrub dmigs pa'i zin bris rong smyon gsung*/ ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub kun 'dus kyi cha lag byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi skor la/ chi) bdud 'dul drag mo'i brgyud 'debs bsdus pa/ ji) ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi cha lag /gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo'i phrin las snying por dril ba/ nyi) lha mo khro gnyer can gyi byad khrol gser gyi lde mig rgyun gyi nyams len dril sgrub/

ti) khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi/ bum sgrub khrus kyi rdzing bu/ thi) gter gsar byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun/ di) byad khrol gser gyi lde mig bcas chog nag po phyag len 'gro shes su bkod pa thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal lung*/ ni) byad khrol bca' sham kong smyon gsung*/ pi) byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi lag len zin bris rong smyon gsung*/ bcas re zhig rdzogs so/ slar smras pa/ bdud sde wa skyes dpung gi tshogs/ /thos pa tsam gyis klad 'gems pa'i/ /rigs sngags gzir 'debs 'phrog byed zhal/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal khyod min su/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga yi grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) ༄༅/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: dbang mchog ind+ra nī la'i mchod sdong 'ja' tshon drwa ba bzhugs so: ma cig yum chen ḍākki'i tshogs la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma: mkhas mchog yon tan rgya mtsho spobs pa can: gang la brjod du 'gran zla ma mchis shing : sangs rgyas kun dngos gcig 'tshogs rgya gar pa: kho bo bdag 'dra mtsho skyes rdo rje yis: zab yangs 'od stong 'khyil ba'i klong chen nas : man ngag thig le'i rgyun bzang mngon mdzod bstan:

snyems ma rab 'dzum mtsho rgyal ḍakkis zungs: blo gsal 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen bstan dang 'gro'i: ma 'ongs don phyir gsang gsum rdo rje'i gar: rgyal ba'i spyi dpal rtsa gsum gling la sprod: kun gyis dga' ba gzhon nus brda 'di srungs: rlung gter khyab 'jug rba klong-i atsha rgya: de'ang mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur bgyis pa ni: thog mar dkyil 'khor cha tshang gzhung bzhin la: dbang rdzas dang ni mkho ba'i yo byad bsags: phyi nang 'byor ldan mchod tshogs legs par bsham: sngon 'gro dbang sgrub la sogs spyi ltar bya: maṇḍal me tog bca' gzhi tshang bar bkod: rgyas pa rnams ni 'di ru ma smos so: sa ma ya: de nas slob mar khrus bstsal gral du 'khod: bgegs bskrad chab chu sbyin nas maṇḍal phul: rgyu 'bras lo rgyus khrid dag sngon du btang : de nas dngos bzhi dbang la 'jug pa ni: slob mas: kyai: dpa' bo rdo rje rigs kyi bdag: yang dag ye shes sa mkhan gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag cag la: 'ja' lus ye shes mkha' 'gro yi: dkyil 'khor 'jug cing dbang bskur stsol: slob dpon gyis: kyai ho skal ldan las can nyon: 'di ni ḍākki ye shes la: snod ldan rnams kyi spyod yul mchog: skal med tshogs ni phyir dengs shig: om̐ ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐: glags lta'i bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni : hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: ma bsrung las kyi mkha' 'gro yis: na raka ltung ba'i bka' chad 'bebs: de bas dam tshig chu 'di 'thung : om̐ sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: dam chu sbyin zhing manḍal phul: de nas rgyud ma dag pa rnams slar sbyang ba'i phyir: bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: bsang chu 'thor zhing : om̐ badzra a mri ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ: om̐ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e chos 'byung mthing nag zur gsum pa: gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs shing :

rtse mo phra ba mthur du zug pa'i dbus su: pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma a las zla ba: de yi steng du bam ro smug nag gi snying khar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las: ma cig yum chen dbyings phyug seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa: gru mor kha ṭwāṃ brten cing : dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa: rngam pa khros pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: de yi spyi bor gu ru saiṅge sgra sgrogs mthing nag sdigs mdzub mdzad nas bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma sde bzhi ni: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs te: thams cad kyang rang mdog rgyan dang ldan pa'o: de'i phyi mtshams sgo skyong bzhi: gzhan yang ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro thams cad sprin bzhin du gtibs pa'o: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams mchog nas: ma sring ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig: om̐ badzra dzñā na ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi: dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ sa ma ya a be sha ya a tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes slob ma dang dbyer med du thim par bsgoms la: gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod: hūm̐: bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed do: ḍākki rgya mtsho dbyings nas gshegs: rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: ma chags padma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: dkyil 'khor gsang bar rje yi rang : bla med chos 'khor dam pa bskor: 'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal: yang dag ye shes chen por bsngo:

de nas maṇḍal phul zhing gus pas phyag thal sbyar dang bcas nas: thog mar sku yi ngo sprod bya zhing bum pa thogs: hūm̐: bum pa dbyings phyug rdo rje'i mkha': bdud rtsi ye shes ḍākki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku yi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: manḍal phul zhing bkra shis me tog 'thor: bhandha thogs la ngo sprod cing : hūm̐: bhandha chos dbyings skye med klong : bdud rtsi ye shes ḍākki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsung gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ dzñā na ḍā'akki ha ri ni sa wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor thogs shing ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba gsum gyi ngang : maṇḍal ye shes ḍākki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: thugs kyi pho brang yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs te ngo sprod cing : hūm̐: gtor ma rmad byung bla med rdzas: ngo bo ye shes ḍākki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa gu na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje rgya gram thogs shing ngo sprod bya: hūm̐: m-i 'gyur ting 'dzin yang dag rgya: phyag mtshan ye shes ḍākki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rigs bdag thogs te: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin sku dngos mchog: gti mug rgol ba rab 'joms pa: dpa' bau seṅge'i sgra dang ldan: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru siṃ ha so swā ra gaṇḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan thogs la: hūm̐: gri gug 'bar bas bdud dpung gcod: bhandha 'byung po'-i klad khrag rol: kha ṭwāṃ dug lnga dbyings su sgrol:

skal ldan bu la phyag mtshan sbyin: om̐ ka ri ti ka bhandha tri shu la ka la dhā ra satwaṃ: de nas dpal chas thogs la: hūm̐: prog zhu glang ko zhing gi pags: thod phreng rus rgyan stag sham sbrul: me long cod pan khrag zhag tshom: dur khrod chas sogs dbang bskur ro: om̐ sha ma sha na arba sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: zhe sdang rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhi ba'i las kun yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ badzra ḍākki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: padma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'dod chags rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dbang sdud phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ padma ḍākki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: gt-i mug rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yang dag bde chen yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ buddha ḍākki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: nga rgyal rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rgyas pa'i phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ratna ḍākki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: phrag dog rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: drag po'i mngon spyod yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ karma ḍākki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shar gyi sgo ma thogs la: hūm̐: byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid: rtag par lta ba rnam dag ma: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: tshogs lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ ha badzra aṅku sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lho'i sgo ma thogs la: hūm̐: snying po tshad med ngo bo nyid: chad par lta ba rnam dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sbyor lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog:

om̐ ri ratna pa shaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nub kyi sgo ma thogs la: hūm̐: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid: dngos por lta ba rnam dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: mthong lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ ni padma spho ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: byang gi sgo ma thogs la: hūm̐: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid: bdag tu lta ba rnam dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sgom lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ sa karma ghaṇḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bum gsang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gcig tu bskur ba n-i: thams cad bum pa sbyin te: hūm̐: bskyed rim sprul sku bum pa gzhal yas khang : 'byin 'jug gsang dbang ā li kā li'i sgra: shes rab gnas lugs gsal ba shel gyi mdog: ye shes chen po rdzogs rim dri ma med: 'od zer ngang la dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs pas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: brda sprod gcig la dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs shog: om̐ dzñā na tsakra maṇḍal hūm̐: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas bkra shis brjod

: ho: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i yum: ye shes mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i 'od: rab dga'i mdangs ldan g.yo ba mo: seng gdong ḍākki'i bkra shis shog: ho: de ltar rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gro gsang ba ḍākki'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi legs par thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad sgom sgrub las mtha' phyi nang gi bya ba thams cad byed du rung : mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig lnga mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung dgos so: lnga gang zhe na: sku'i yi dam tshig bskyed rim mi spangs: gsung gi dam tshig la sgrub pa mi g.yel: thugs kyi dam tshig la dbyings phyug gsang ba ye shes la rgyun du gnas: yon tan gyi dam tshig la tshogs gtor skong bshags dang dus kyi mchod pa mi bcag: phrin las kyi dam tshig las bzhi'i bya ba brtson pa'i ngang nas mtha' ru phyin par bya: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i dam tshig ni bud med rnams la smad par mi bya: skyon du mi blta: sdang bar mi bgyi: 'bu shu mi bskul: rtsa khams bde ba chen po'i zag med la rab tu gnas par bya: khyad par gyi dam tshig ni: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa grol nas: zhag bdun gyi bar mal stan mgo mjug mi ldog: 'og rta mo rigs mi zhon: bud med kyi grib mar mi 'gom: tha na phran tshig tsam yang spang : dbyangs snyan pa'i bye'u ku dir mi bya: gos hrul po mi gyon: ci'i phyir zhe na: thog mar phrin las lnga yi dam tshig dang mi ldan na: ye shes lnga dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor rten ma mchis: bar du gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams na: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro mi gzugs su mchis pas phrag dog skyes phyir sgrub grogs mi byed: ye shes mkha' 'gro bsgrub na phyi thag ring : khyad par gyi dam tshig dang 'gal na rten 'brel nyams pa ste: phyin chad sgrub pa'i 'phro mi gcod: khyad par du tshe 'di nyid la grub pa thob kyang : pho nya'i gsang lam mi rnyed: ci ste rnyed kyang bdud dbang gi skyon can no:

de bas mkha' 'gro'i phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig la mi 'gal ba bya'o: rjes su byin brlab bka' bsgo ba'i rim pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rje btsun dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru padma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma: chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma: longs sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sprul sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dbyings phyug ḍākki seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku sprul rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: gsung sprul padma mkha' 'gro ma: thugs sprul sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: yon tan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: phrin las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rnam thar bzhi yi mkha' 'gro ma: khyad par ma sring ḍākki bye ba 'bum gyis skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di la: sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol: steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa: 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa: bar gdon btsan dang the'u rang gi gnod pa la sogs mi mthun pa'i bgegs rkyen thams cad zhi zhing byang bar gyur cig: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur rjes: gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa: sogs brjod: bkra shis me tog bcas bgyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya : gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: thim rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa phag lor jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing*/ sbas yul du shog ser nas dag par zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // kha) rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i rtsa ba 'phrul gyi me long las: bdud 'dul drag mo'i gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel mu tig phreng ba bzhugs so: bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog ma hā gu ru'i sku la 'dud: bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mo'i gsol 'debs nyer bsdus ni:

gsol 'debs skyabs yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs la: e ma hoḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: rnam dag bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs sku yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i pho brang nas: dbang gi mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: thor cog can gyi pho brang dgu ldan du: gsang sngags rig 'dzin ind+ra bo dhi la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: siṅga sku la rdzogs pa'i gnas mchog tu: sku yi rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bal yul lhun grub brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: gsung gi rig 'dzin nā gardzu na la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog tu: thugs kyi rig 'dzin hūm̐ chen ka ra la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas mchog tu: yon tan rig 'dzin bī ma mi tra la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: za hor laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: phrin las rig 'dzin pra bha hastī la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: singha gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog tu: rbod gtong rig 'dzin dha na saṃ skṛ la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: o rgyan padma brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: tshe dbang rig 'dzin padma saṃ bha la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: kha che he chen brdal ba'i gnas mchog tu: mchod bstod rig 'dzin rombu gu hya la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: li yul gnam lcags 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog tu: drag sngags rig 'dzin shāntiṃ garbha la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: phyogs mtshams rab tu rgyu ba'i gnas mchog tu:

yongs rdzogs bka' bab padma 'byung gnas la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum gnas mchog tu: lung bstan bu dgu bod kyi rig 'dzin la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: dkyil 'khor thams cad bum pa gcig tu bsdus: bde chen gzungs ma ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: gnas chen yang rdzong shel brag gnas mchog tu: 'jam dpal bka' bab sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: las rlung dhū tir dag pa'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: gter rgya lung rdzogs 'gro 'dul pho brang nas/ /bstan pa'i srog 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: 'gro don nam mkha'i mtha' klas pho brang nas/ /grub pa mchog brnyes rig 'dzin rnam bzhi la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: thugs rje phyogs lhung med pa'i pho brang nas/ rtsa brgyud drin can bla ma thams cad la/ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol/ shlau ka gnyis gu hyas kha bskong zhus/ bde chen gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong lha tshogs la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: lha gnas chen po jo bo gze rgyal nas: gsang mdzod rgyud kyi kha byang bsnyen 'bum la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: me rlung stobs ldan g.yo ba'i gnas mchog nas: zhing skyong mgon po ma gza' rdor rje legs: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: rgyud lung man ngag rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas: bka' yi 'dus sde dkyil 'khor ma lus la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: snga 'gyur rgyal bstan snying po'i ring lugs kyi: phrin las nyin mor byed pa'i gzi byin ltar: 'phel zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas pa dang : gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur khyab gyur cig:

ces rgyal ba kun 'dus rol pa snga 'gyur gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bla ma'i brgyud 'debs bar chad lam sel ma zhes bya ba sgrub pa po gang zhig lam du zhugs pa'i gegs sel ba'i cha lag go: 'di nyid nyin re ma chag na: dus ma yin pa'i bar chod nges par sel: dus la bab pa'i bar chad yin gyur kyang : lo gsum bar du bsring bar the tshom med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ga) bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can las sngon 'gro dkar gtor bzhugs so: de nas dkar gtor bsngo ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran byin gyis brlab: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod rgu'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa kun tu zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo? sogs lan gsum: hūm̐: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rkang gnyis gtso: bden gnyis dkon mchog rtsa gsum bka' la nyon: gling bzhir mi gnas chu la mi 'thung med: srog la mi 'dzems lus la mi phangs med: khrims la mi 'jigs bden pas mi 'dul med: lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po bka' la nyon: bzang ngan las byed phrin las bcol ba'i phyir: 'dod yon lnga ldan rin chen gser skyems 'bul: hūm̐: slob dpon padma'i bka' dang dam gnas pa: dpal mgon bdun cu dregs pa sde brgyad dang : sde dpon sum cu yang 'khor sprul pa 'bum: sngags bdag bco brgyad bka' yi las mkhan bcas: yul gyi zhing skyong gnas kyi mkha' 'gro dang : lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad gnod sbyin brgyad: dbang phyug nyer brgyad phyogs skyong yang 'khor bcas:

skyes lha yul lha dgra lha zo dor dang : khyad par bka' srung gter srung drag rtsal can: yul ris gzhi bdag dben gnas skyong ba'i lha: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma 'bul: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las gang bcol yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: dmag jag 'khrug rtsod nad yams zhi ba dang : zab chos bstan pa rgyas pa'i mthun rkyen grogs: yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par spel: slob dpon padma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul zhing gong du phrin las bcol: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyis phag lor gdan drangs// // nga) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can las: phrin las sgrub pa gnam lcags thog mda' dmar po bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so: ma gcig yum chen ḍākki'i tshogs la 'dud: e maḥ rgya gar mkhan po paṇa chen bdag 'dra yis: dbyings phyug lha mo dgyes pa'i rang sgra can: snang srid gtso mos seṅge'i nga ro 'byin: ye shes dpal la bzhengs pa'i rab dga' mo: sgrub pa'i las byang gnam lcags thog mda' bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal brda yi ri mor gzugs: rin chen sgrom du bskyil nas gter du sbos: 'bar ba rdo rje sgeg pa'i dpa' bor bcol: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas ye shes rnam par 'phrul: las can thugs sras de dang 'phrad par shog: gze rgyal gangs mgul rakta'i mtsho mor rgya: rgya rgya rgya: ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i: phrin las bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni: rngam zhing lhun chags drag po'i gnas: tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i g.ya' gang mgul: dben zhing yid mthun gnas dag tu: ḍākki gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: mchod rdzas spyi mthun gang 'byor bsham: sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyang gzugs: bag dro lhun chags bde gnas ngang :

'jug pa'i rim pa 'di ltar brtsam: sa ma ya: dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: byin rlabs ngo bo pad 'byung thugs rje'i bdag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal ḍākki sku dngos mchog: brtse chen ye nas 'bral med skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ na mo: dbyings rig ngo bo ma bcos lhun grub las: gcig tu 'gags med shar ba snying rje'i yul: 'khor 'das ci snang ma gyur sangs rgyas zhing : gdod nas 'khor gsum yongs dag sems bskyed do: dkar gtor bya/ gsum pa bgegs 'gugs pa ni: byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐: bdag nyid yum chen drag mor gsal ba yi: ye shes thugs las sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs: 'od zer 'gengs ba 'khor yug khyab par 'phros: phyi nang 'tshe ba'i bgegs tshogs kun bsdus nas: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis par gyur: om̐ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bsngo zhing bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong : snang srid dbang sdud ma gcig bdud 'dul ma: nga yi bka' la bgegs tshogs kun gyis nyon: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang 'byung po'i rigs: 'dod yon glud gtor mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: mi bzad mtshon cha drag po rab 'bebs te: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum phye mar bcom: de bas bka' las ma 'da' phyir byol cig: om̐ badzra kro ti ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhū ta rā dza u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: thugs las spros pa'i phyag mtshan 'bar ba'i me: steng 'og bar mtshams med pa dum gcig ngang : rab tu 'khrigs pa'i gur khang cher gyur nas: nam yang glags lta 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra dzwa la karma raṃ raṃ tsakra hūm̐ rakṣa ye swā hā:

drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'dzam gling khyon ltar rab tu 'geng ba yi: phyi mchod sprin spro lha mo sna tshogs kyis: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas thogs nas: byin gyis brlabs te dpag med spel bar gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: bdun pa nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bhandha dum gcig lcang lo 'khyil ba'i dbus: dug lnga rnam dag sha lnga sku lnga'i rdzas: sman mchod dri bzang mdangs ldan gtams pa'i tshogs: bla med dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ brgyad pa gsang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: dung zhal bde ba chen po'i snod kyi nang : a haṃ zung 'jug gar gyis sbyor ba yi: srub skyed mkha' nas ye shes bdud rtsi babs: bcud g.yo 'khyil ba'i bla med rten rdzas gyur: om̐ sarba a haṃ dharma pū dza āḥhūm̐: dgu pa gtor mchod rakta spyan gzigs sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bde chen rang byung mtshan ldan snod mchog tu: bha ling gtor ma sha khrag ri ltar spungs: spyan gzigs du ma bkod legs mdzes pa'i tshogs: bla med dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba na ṭa ā wa lo ki sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐:

bcu pa byin 'bebs pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos kyi pho brang nas: kun bzang chos skus byin phob cig: 'od lnga ye shes pho brang nas: rdor sems longs skus byin phob cig: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: pad 'byung sprul skus byin phob cig: ke'u ri gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas: ḍākki rgya mtshos byin phob cig: yang rdzong rdo rje'i gsang phug nas/ /gnubs chen dzñā na'i byin phob cig /rdzu 'phrul brtul zhugs pho brang nas/ /gnam lcags gter chen byin phob cig /lung bstan chos kyi pho brang nas/ /cho bdag rgyud 'dzin byin phob cig: mkha' dbyings chos 'byung dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug seng gdong byin phob cig: phrin las bzhi ldan pho brang nas: ḍākki 'bum gyis byin phob cig: bka' bzhin bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i: dam can rgya mtshos byin phob cig: dbyings dang rang rtsal ji bzhin pa: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs byin phob cig: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ dang po sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe ḍākki thugs dang rang sems gcig: bar du 'gyu ba tsam gyis so sor phyes: da ni dbyer med kun tu rtogs pa'i phyir: dran rig thig le nyag gcig 'char sgo phyes: om̐ badzra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ gnyis pa lha zhal mjal zhing klong bshags ni: hūm̐: ye nas rmongs bral shes rab gsal ba'i 'od: kun tu lta ba'i klong yangs de bzhin gyis: cho 'phrul sna tshogs rtsal gyi bye brag nyid: gang la mi gnas ye shes der ston gsal: om̐ sa ma ya shuddhe pra dzñā dharma dzñā na hūm̐: gsum pa dkyil 'khor bzung ba ni: hūm̐: lhan skyes gnyug ma'i sbubs su rtsa gsum gyi: rang bzhin ye shes 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nyid: ye nas yin shes lta ba de bzhin gyis: ye bzhugs gdod ma'i srog thig mi gtong bzung : om̐ badzra tsitta dzñā na sarba gharbha dha ra hūm̐: bzhi pa mkha' dang klong du bstan pa ni: hūm̐:

ma ltar gnas pa'i dbyings rig yum chen mkha': de yi rang bzhin zab gsal klong chen las: rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'od zer rtsal dag gis: kun byed mtshon pa'i brda las kun ston to: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ga ga mi ti hūm̐: dang po ngo bo nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: gdod ma'i gshis lugs ma bcos gnyug ma'i gzhi: ka dag ngang la bya rtsol lhun gyis rdzogs: gang du mi dmigs mkha' ltar rab gnas pa: dbyings phyug bde chen dpa' mos de ltar smra: om̐ dharma pra dzñā gu hya tsitta hūm̐: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni: āḥ khyab brdal chen po'i rang rtsal las: ma 'gags zer gyi 'phro 'du'i ngang : brtse ba'i snying rjes kun la khyab: gsang ba mkha' 'gros de ltar smra: om̐ dzñā na dharma shū n+ya ta garbha hūm̐: gsum pa bskyed pa rgyu'i sa bon ni: om̐: kun tu snying po'i rang rtsal las: bdag med mkha' yi yi ge hūm̐: sa bon lugs 'byung rdo rjer shar: drag mo ḍākkis de ltar smra: om̐ dharma dzñā na hūm̐ badzra la bhrūm̐: bzhi pa bskyed pa'i 'byung rim ni: hūm̐: snang srid snod du gyur pa'i tshogs: klong lnga'i rang bzhin rtsal chen las: grub pa'i yig 'bru so sor shar: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: de las gzhal yas gdan bcas gyur: om̐ bhrūm̐ dzñā na padma maṇḍal satwaṃ: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ru tra tri tri ti ra baṃ: lnga pa sa bon bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung gdan gyi lte ba'i steng : bde stong wal gyis dpa' mor shar: srog yig gnas dang sngags phreng 'khor: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul bcas gsal: om̐ badzra bha ra hi badzra ḍākki nī singha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ drug pa spro zhing bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' chos 'byung dbyings: yam̐ las rlung gi ha ri ta: ram̐ las dzwa la tsakra mched: kham̐ las chu yi sa mu tra: sum̐ las mi shigs ga la ste: de dbus rdo rje'i rgya gram steng :

rang byung bhrūm̐ yig gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dang : drwa ba shar bu mda' yab mdzes: ka bzhi bcu drug gdung ma bres: dral lcam thigs tshags thog steng khyab: rta babs chos 'khor za ra tshags: nyi zla dang ni nor bus brgyan: dbus su gnam lcags rdo rje'i tog: thog steng rgyan kun drag po'i chas: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa dang : me ri gur chen khor yug 'khrigs: rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas khang : hūm̐: de dbus khrag zhag bam gyi steng : rdo rje hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: dbyings phyug khro mo seṅge'i gdong : g.yu ral thod skam lan tshar brgyan: mthing nag khros pa'i seng zhal can: phyag mtshan gri gug thod khrag dang : kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum mchan du bcug: sku la dur khrod rgyan gyis spras: brkyang bskum me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: gtso mo'i spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng : mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub can: seng lpags stag sham rgyan gyis spras: brkyang bskum seṅge sgra sgrogs gsal: hūm̐: phyogs bzhir padma 'dab bzhi'i steng : ha ri ni sa yongs gyur nyid: rdo rje rin chen padma las: dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'gro bzhi: khro 'dzum gri thod kha ṭwāṃ thogs: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gar: mi bzad me dpung 'khrigs dbus gsal: hūm̐: pho brang sgo bzhi rim pa bzhin: ti ra bam gyi gdan steng du: las byed phra men shugs 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag khro: g.yas pas rang rtags phyag mtshan 'dzin: g.yon pas bhan dmar zhal du gsol: brkyang bskum me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: zhing skyong phra men sha za ma: mtshan mo rab rgyu la sogs pa: gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur bskyed: om̐ muṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ om̐ badzra ratna padma karma ḍākki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ bhyoḥ om̐ dzñā na pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs dbang bskur dri ma dag chu yi lhag ma yar lud pas rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ gu hyas bsab/ om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra singha me gha swa ra mu ku ṭa dha ri ta swā hā: dang po spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod rang byung gdod ma'i klong : chos dbyings drag po e yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: bla med dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: ā gatstsha hūm̐ dza swā hā: gnyis pa bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: dur khrod chos 'byung nyi zla ti ra baṃ: mi bzad me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus nyid du: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: byams gdung bu la dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhugs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: padma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag sku gsum rang bzhin can: snying rje dgyes pa'i dpa' bo rngam pa'i zhal: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas la: mi 'bral yid kyi gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dang po phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūm̐: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim sogs: ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa yi: phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : nang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dug lnga ma spangs ye shes lnga: nyon mongs rang grol chags med rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub nang mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : sman mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi bhandha ru: sha lnga pañtsa rdzas kyis gtams: zag med bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gtor mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang : rmad byung dpal chen bshos bu btsugs:

sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : rakta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dung zhal bde ba chen po'i nang : mdangs ldan dmar chen 'od du 'bar: sna tshogs rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyag rgya gar mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde ba yab la stong pa yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : glu'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: glu dbyangs len pa'i gar mo'i tshogs: chags pa'i brda skad lhang lhang sgrog: dga' bzhi bskul ba'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : sbyor ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba ḍākki rig ma'i tshogs: gar sgyur bde ba'i mkha' lam du: rlung gis bskyod pa'i rdo rjes bsrubs: mnyes phyir yid kyi chu gter 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : bsgral mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: ru tra bsgral ba'i thod pa ru: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dbang po spungs: bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : don gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: ye nas rmad byung ngo bo'i rdzas: rang byung ma 'gags ye shes kyis: dmigs med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyi nang mnyes pa'i rten rdzas mchog: me long mda' dar bla 'khor sogs: spyan gzigs du ma'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma hā mu dra lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti āḥhūm̐: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa gu hya ḍākki badzra ka ma la a ling ga matstsha na dā shra ma ye pū dza ye hūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bha lingta ru tra ma ra ṇi dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi:

om̐ dharma dzñā na sa ma ya shū n+ya ta ātma ko3 haṃḥ lnga pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐ maḥ dbus phyogs mkha' dbyings chos 'byung klong : thod pa dmar nag brtsegs pa'i mkhar: rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po der: ti ra baṃ gyi gdan steng du: yum chen khro mo seng gdong ma: sku mdog mthing 'od rtse re re: chos dbyings don dang ldan pa yi: skye med rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: yum chen ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: stong nyid snying rje'i nga ro 'byin: thugs rje khros pa'i zhal ldan ma: dgyes pa'i gad mo sgrog pa yis: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yum chen ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: gri gug gdengs nas bhandha stob: dug gsum gcod pa'i kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: thabs shes mnyam sbyor bde stong can: gnas lugs rang mdangs rtsal chen gyi: phrin las gang 'dul mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: yum chen ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan: me long la sogs cod pan mdzes: phyag rgya drug gi 'khrul 'khor can: stobs bcus 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dren: snying rje'i 'od zer ldan pa yi: mkha' dbyings gsang ba mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: yum chen ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: brkyang bskum gar ldan bam ro brdzis: 'khyil ba'i me chen zil 'od 'khrugs: ye shes thugs rje'i nus rtsal gyis: srid pa gsum yang 'gengs nus shing : 'khor 'das kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i: zab spyod bde stong mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: yum chen ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nyi zla 'bar ba'i gdan steng bzhugs: dpa' mo chen mo'i rigs kyi bdag: mu stegs rgol ba 'joms pa'i tshe: drag sngags seṅge'i sgra chen sgrog: dbyings phyug ma yi bde skyed tshul: rdo rje sdigs mdzub phyag rgya can:

seng lpags stod g.yogs stag sham dkris: gyad 'gros gar gyis sa gsum gnon: 'jigs tshul dpa' bar bzhad pa yi: rig 'dzin grub thob 'bum gyis bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i mkha' 'gro yi: gtso bo seng sgrog la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: shar phyogs gtum drag dur khrod nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro klong yangs ma: dkar mo khros pa'i bzhad tshul can: dur khrod chas kun rab rdzogs ma: mkha' la gar stabs khyug khyug 'greng : mi bzod bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor can: zhi ba'i las mdzad mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: rdo rje dpa' mor phyag 'tshal bstod: lho phyogs gad rgyangs dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro lhun chags ma: ser mo khros pa'i sgeg tshul can: dur khrod chas kun rab rdzogs ma: mkha' la gar stabs lam lam 'gyu: 'khor lo g.yo ba'i phyag rgya can: rgyas pa'i las mdzad mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: rin chen dpa' mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nub phyogs dur khrod padma 'khyil: padma mkha' 'gro bzhin legs ma: dmar mo khros pa'i chags tshul can: dur khrod chas kun rab rdzogs ma: mkha' la gar stabs lang ling 'phar: mu kha spyod pa'i tshul 'chang can: dbang gi las mdzad mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: padma dpa' mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byang phyogs kī la'i dur khrod nas: brtul zhugs las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ljang mo khros pa'i rngam tshul can: dur khrod chas kun rab rdzogs ma: mkha' la gar stabs shig shig po: drug ldan 'dzin pa'i lta stangs can: drag po'i las mdzad mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: las mdzad dpa' mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: shar lho rab rgyu dur khrod nas: rdo rje shugs 'gro myur mgyogs ma: lho nub gtum pa'i dur khrod nas: rin chen shugs 'gro rdzu 'phrul ma: nub byang he chen dur khrod nas: padma shugs 'gro mi pham ma:

byang shar laṅka'i dur khrod nas: las kyi shugs 'gro nus 'byin ma: rigs bzhi sgo ma chen mo'i tshogs: chas rnams rab rdzogs dur khrod rgyan: 'phyang ba'i g.yang gzhi na ra ra: sdud pa'i mtha' bzhi'i las mdzad ma: yang 'khor sprul pa'i mkha' 'gros bskor: brda skad sgrog pa'i ḍākki 'bum: sgo skyong tshogs la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: 'khor lo'i pho brang chen po ru: gnas pa'i ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs: snang glu brda gar shigs se shig: gdod nas gnyug ma'i rang bzhin skyong : las dang ye shes der grub pa'i: yang 'khor tshogs la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: bskul lo ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: gsang ba ḍākki khyod nyid dang : mi 'bral rtse gcig khyed bsten pas: 'dzum pa'i zhal ras bu la ston: ma yi byams pas snying ltar brtse: rtsa rlung bde ba'i bcud kyang spel: dngos grub sna tshogs deng 'dir stsol: yum chen grogs su deng mchis gyur: (ka)bsnyen dmigs zur gsal ltar bya/ phyi sgrub gtso bo la brten pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ mūm̐ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ (kha) nang sgrub rigs bdag la brten pa'i sgrub pa ni/

om̐ gu ru singha swa ra gaṇḍe hūm̐: (ga) gsang sgrub gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs la brten pa'i sgrub pa ni/ om̐ badzra ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ ratna ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ padma ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ karma ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ bi shwa ḍākki tsa tur baṃ hūm̐: dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes rtsa sngags srog sgrub bya na 'di'i yan dang : las sgrub drag sngags ltar na: (nga)aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags gang 'os rang rang skabs kyi sgrub pa dang bstun: dmigs pa spro bsdu sogs ni gzhung ltar bya'o: bsnyen pa phyi sgrub la bye ba: gsang sgrub la 'bum tsho: nang sgrub la stong tsho re: phyi sgrub bzlas pa gtsor bton pa dang : gsang sgrub bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dang : nang sgrub ting 'dzin yid bzlas byed tshul lo: de yang mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma 'di nyid: sgrub rtags nye zhing byin rlabs che ba: ye shes mkha' 'gro kho na yin pas: mkha' spyod la 'dren pa'i grogs kyang 'di kho na'o: de bas yid la bzung zhing sgrub pa la brtson par bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas kyis chad lhag skong*/ mchod bstod ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ drag mo seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka bha ling gtor ma 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa'i tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i sgra snyan 'bul: oṃ badzra arghaṃ? shabda rū pa gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: dpal ldan rdo rje lha mo ni: drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can: ye shes me yi 'od zer 'phro: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: sa ma ya: de nas phrin las kyi kha skong tshogs gtor la 'bung ba ni: mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs par bsham la: chu gtsang gis bran zhing : ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlab:

dang po: hūm̐: 'khor 'das chos dbyings rol pa'i ngang : du ma ro gcig lta ba yis: gtsang sme'i sgrib pa ka nas dag: ye nas rang byung mchod pa'o: om̐ sarba dharma dhā tu dzñā na ātma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa sbyang ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid yi dam lha gsal thugs ka nas: dngos 'dzin sbyang phyir ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros: tshogs kyi nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs shing spros: byin gyis brlab phyir om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros: rdzas la phog pas bskyed cing spel ba yis: zag med bdud rtsi'i ro mchog dpag med gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐: gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ maḥ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i: dbus phyogs sangs rgyas rigs kyi bdag: dpa' bo seṅge sgra sgrogs la: rig 'dzin grub thob 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ yum chen thugs kyi rnam sprul ma: ma gcig drag mo seṅge'i gdong : mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar: dkar mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro mar: ser mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ nub phyogs padma mkha' 'gro mar: dmar mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro mar: ljang mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ sgo skyong shugs 'gro phra men mar: rang 'dra ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ ye shes dang ni las grub pa'i: zhing skyong gnas nyul la sogs par: sna tshogs ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

hūm̐ maḥ bka' bzhin phrin las bstan skyong ba'i: dam can gter bdag rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ maḥ dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: tshogs gtor 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ bzhi pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ maḥ mchod pa'i lha mo gar sgyur mo: yid 'ong lang ling mdzes ma 'phro: phyag na rin chen gzhong pa bsnams: zhal zas longs spyod tshogs kyis bkang : dgyes pa'i 'khrul 'khor gar bsgyur nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : chos skyong gter bdag dam can la: 'bul lo mchog gi dgyes pa bskyed: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba ḍākki nī sarba sa ma ya ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: lnga pa bskang ba ni: spro na 'bum bskang sbyar/ hūm̐: snang srid khyon ltar rab tu 'geng ba yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla med rdzas: spyan gzigs la sogs kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: rigs bdag seṅge sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong thugs dam bskang : ye shes mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong shugs 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang :

bka' gter skyong ba rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : las byed sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing dgongs pa dgyes gyur nas: nyams chag sor chud mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: hūm̐: khyad par mnyes shing mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dur khrod pho brang rgyan spyod bkod pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: thod pa ltag sprod zhing lpags g.yogs pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: mchog chen gri rkang gling bu'i dbyangs ring 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhandha lcang lo rakta rnam lnga'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: sha chen tshil chen dri gsur ngad ldan 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dmar chen dbal ldan dar nag ba dan can: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dgra bgegs sha khrag ri ltar spungs pa'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: zhing lpags rgyal mtshan dar nag g.yab mo phyar: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: phyag mtshan rnon po mtshon cha 'khor lo'i rtsibs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: ging pa dpa' bo dpa' mo gar bsgyur tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gnas nyul dus mtshan ma mo gcer bu 'bum: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes pa'i phud: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: 'bod pa'i gdangs chen 'brug ltar ldir ba bcas: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas sna tshogs kyis: dbyings phyug bdud 'dul drag mo'i thugs dam bskang : rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong thugs dam bskang : padma mkha' 'gro stag gdong thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phag gdong thugs dam bskang : rin chen mkha' 'gro dom gdong thugs dam bskang :

phrin las mkha' 'gro spyang gdong thugs dam bskang : las byed lcags gdong nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : ltas ngan mtshan mo sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul srin mo stong sde'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam dngos grub stsol: bhyoḥ ma sring ḍākki rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du: mchod pa lo zlar 'das pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs dang bskang mchod chag pa mthol lo bshags: sbyor sgrol gnad du ma khel mthol lo bshags: dus drug dus gsum 'das pa mthol lo bshags: dus min las la sbyor ba mthol lo bshags: bcu nya stong bzhi chag pa mthol lo bshags: rten 'brel sna tshogs chad pa mthol lo bshags: thabs shes kha 'gal spyod pa mthol lo bshags: bde stong zung du ma 'jug mthol lo bshags: dam tshig spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje'i sngags la 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol ba ni: 'gyod tshangs dam tshig chen po la gnas shog: oṃ ḍākki sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pa la ya: ḍākki sa twa ti no pa: sogs? ḍākki ma men mun tsa: ḍākki bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ drug pa bshags pa ni: (kha) hoḥ dgongs shig ma sring ḍākki bye ba 'bum: bdag cag ma rig rmongs pa'i shes sgrib kyis: phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i dam dang 'gal mchis rnams: 'gyod bshags 'di yis tshangs par mdzad nas su: don gnyis 'bras bu lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: oṃ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: oṃ ḍākki sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya sogs gang rung gis kha skong bya: bdun pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mdun du tha ma tshogs kyi liṅga la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po myur du khug: lha dang phyes shig bdud dang sprad nas su: bsgral zhing gtub pa'i phrin las dus la bab: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri dzaḥ brgyad pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: sras mchog gyad kyi phur bu kī la ya:

gdeng zhing 'dril nas gzir 'debs dus la bab: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: auṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad bhyo bhyoḥ dgu pa gtubs te 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dam nyams dgra bgegs ru tra bsgral ba yi: sha khrag don snying dbang po sna tshogs 'di: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas nam yang bgegs srin mi ldang mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bcu pa tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: sogs?: de nas lhag ma gtong ba ni: hūm̐ maḥ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong ma'i: rnam sprul ye shes las grub pa: dbus nas sngon mo bye ba 'bum: shar nas dkar mo bye 'bum: lho nas ser mo bye ba 'bum: nub nas dmar mo bye ba 'bum: byang nas ljang mo bye ba 'bum: mtshams nas sna tshogs bye ba 'bum: so so'i bran g.yog bgrang las 'das: la la ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: la la 'jig rten shugs 'gro ma: la la sha za gnas nyul ma: sku mdog ma nges cir yang ston: rdzu 'phrul bsgyur zhing mkha' la 'gro: mtshan mo rab rgyu dur khrod nyul: rnal 'byor shan 'byed drod tshad brtag: rngam pa'i bshugs sgra tser tser 'don: tshogs khang dur khrod mtha' la gnas: dam tshig can gyi grogs mor mdzad: sgrub pa'i phrin las rogs dan sgrub: lhag nyul ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: snying thig chos 'di'i mel tshe mdzod: bcol ba'i las 'di sgrub tu gsol: om̐ bha ka si bhakṣa si bha lingta kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon ka dag lhun grub 'og min zhing : gsang ba e yi dbyings nyid klong dkyil nas: rigs kyi bdag po gu ru seṅge'i sgra: dbyings phyug khros pa drag mo seng gdong ma:

mkha' 'gro sde bzhi shugs 'gro phra men tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhengs: da lta snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus mtha' 'dir: brtse bar dgongs te phrin las dus la bab: ma rungs bdud rigs 'byung po sna tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan la gdug rtsub sdang ba dang : sgrub la 'tshe zhing g.yo ba'i log 'dren tshogs: ḍākki ye shes srung mas sgrol bar mdzod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mthu rtsal dus la bab bo sa ma ya: om̐ ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta khā hi: dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e sa bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: gnyis pa chad mdo gtong ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min dbyings phyug mkha' klong du: chos sku'i bdag nyid yum chen phar phyin dang : longs sku'i rtsal snang dbang phyug ḍākki 'bum: sprul sku'i bdag nyid lha mo seṅge'i gdong : sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo che rnams kyis: gsang mdzod zab brgya'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi las byed ḍākki thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su: rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas dang : ḍākki'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: slob ma'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsang rgya mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhi gtad nas kyang : padma gter bdag gling par lung bstan te: brda rtags kha byang la sogs gnang ba'i tshe: dregs pa'i sde dpon dam can rgya mtsho yis: so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: mdo smad dbus kyi lte ba gze rgyal gangs:

yon tan tsā ri'i gnas mchog kha ba can: dmar nag rakta 'khrigs pa'i mtsho chen nas: sprul pa'i skyes mchog gter bdag gling pa yis: lhun grub gter gyi sgrom bu gdan drangs tshe: gter srung so so'i gzugs mchog bstan nas kyang : tha tshig bka' bzhin dam bca' ci bzhin du: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ kro ta kro ti rā hu la ma tri shu la tsa tri nā ga ti pa ra tsa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs: gnas nyul las kyi ma mo bcu gnyis ni: zhi dang dgyes dang sgeg pa'i cha lugs can: lhab lhub rgyan ldan g.yer kha si li li: dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: rin chen rgyan ldan thor tsugs lcang lo can: glu len gdangs glu'i bshugs sgra tse re re: so so'i bran g.yog sman phran bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe ru: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le tring tring spreng spreng kha kha khā hi: lnga pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐ maḥ yum chen dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rang byung ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum: e yi chos 'byung dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje bskor 'gros bro brdungs pas: dug lnga nyon mongs ka nas dag: bde stong ye shes lhun gyis grub: hūm̐ maḥ kun gzhi lhun grub dkyil 'khor du: phrin las gang 'dul brda 'gros yis: so so'i gar gyis bro brdungs pas: nga bdag mtshan ma'i ru tra bcom: gnyis med ye shes lhun gyis grub: hūm̐ḥ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa yis: phyag rgya rnam bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: lug rgyud sbrel te bro brdungs pas: ma bsgoms ting 'dzin lhun gyis grub: ka dag gnyug ma'i ngang gnas gyur: om̐ nan:
āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: ru tra nan: mā ra ya nan: laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan:

de nas gtor snod kha gyen du phyogs la: mchod pa gang rung gis rgyas gdab: drug pa dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: spyi bo bde chen pho brang dbus: dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal yum ma: ma gcig drag mo seṅge'i gdong : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: mi mngon mkha' spyod dbyings nas bzhengs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: hrīḥmaḥ mchog gi dbang bskur sems la stsol: seṅge sgra sgrogs gtsug tu thim: om̐ḥ sku yi dbang bskur lus la stsol: rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpral bar thim: āḥ gsung gi dbang bskur ngag la stsol: padma mkha' 'gro mgrin par thim: hūm̐ḥ thugs kyi dbang bskur yid la stsol: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro snying khar thim: swāḥ yon tan dbang bskur sgo gsum stsol: rin chen mkha' 'gro lte bar thim: hāḥ phrin las dbang bskur brtan par stsol: las kyi mkha' 'gro gsang bar thim: hūm̐ḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: ḍākki gsang ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: snyan grags dbang thang dngos grub stsol: 'jam phrug gos kyi dngos grub stsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: deng 'dir bdag gis thob gyur cig: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wākka tsitta gu hya ghu na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes chog mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes sku lnga'i rdzas: khams gsum yongs sgrol bla med mchod pa 'di: ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: thugs dam bskang zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dzaḥ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ?shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sna tshogs sku bzhi lhun grub ngang nyid las: bde chen yongs rdzogs spros bral brda yi sku:

gsang ba ḍākki ye shes lha tshogs la: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os p sogs: lhag chad bzod gsol ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang dang : ma 'byor dam nyams 'di phyi'i sgrib g.yogs rnams: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzla: brtan bzhugs bya: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: dkyil 'khor ngo bo 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ yig gyen ldog mi dmigs chos skur āḥ gsal stong gdod ma'i dbyings phyug mngon 'gyur shog: a a āḥ bsngo ba ni: hoḥ ma sring mkha' 'gro gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: bskyed rdzogs phyi nang dge bcu nyams len gyi: brtson 'grus zab mos lhur blang bgyis pa'i tshogs: ma gyur srid pa'i 'gro sgrol ched du bsngo: smon lam ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: ma sring ḍākki srog ltar bsgrubs pa yis: dam tshig g.yel ba med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du: zab lam rjes bzung mchog gi dga' ston gyi: 'bras bu smin nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: bkra shis ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis yum chen pha rol phyin: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon gyur bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis ḍākki dbyings phyug ma: cir snang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis ḍākki seng gdaung ma: 'bras bu kun kyang lhun grub bkra shis shog: gang 'dul bkra shis mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs: lam bzhi mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog: sna tshogs bkra shis ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma sring 'khor tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis jo bo gze rgyal gangs: byin chags dge legs 'tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis lha btsan rdo rje 'bar: zab chos mel tshe 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog:

nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis shog: dus drug rtag tu dge legs rgyas par shog: ces bsngo smon gyis legs par rgyas gdab nas 'khor gsum mi dmigs ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la rab tu gnas par bya'o: sa ma ya: de'ang ḍākki gsang ba'i sgrub pa thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud: gu ru thugs kyi ti ka yin te: byin rlabs dang nus pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags: ci'i phyir zhe na: seng gdong ma phal cher rnams byad zlog dang las chas yin te: sgrub pa'i thun mong dag gi dngos grub sna re tsam rnyed kyang 'khu ldog che: seng gdong las chas ma ni: ḍākki srog gzan ma'i rgyud yin no: phal cher ni: so so'i rang 'dod kyis dkrug cing bslad nas gsar rnying gang la'ang cha bzhag med pa: gzhung tshig rnying ma 'dra yang cha ma tshang zhing kha gsar ma nas sab pa: yang na rang 'dod kyis gter rnying nas bsdus pa sogs kho na ma 'ongs par de 'dra 'byung : zhes lung bstan pa dang : bka' ma'i seng gdong ma rnams ni thog mar lha lha ltar du yin kyang : bar du lo tsā chags sdang can: rdo rje theg pa la dgra gshed du gyur pa rnams kyis: smon lam ngan pas 'brel nas byin rlabs mi 'byung : ci'i phyir zhe na: dam tshig la sel zhugs pa yin: des na ma 'ongs pa'i gter chos rnams kyang brtag gzhig gis rgyab skyor dgos pa ci zhe na: gter chen rgyal ba'i rnam sprul skye ba brtsegs mar dran nas mi brjed pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po'i gzungs dang ldan pa rnams: gu ru'i lung bstan kha byang dang : rang re bag chags sad pa'i mtshams sbyor nyi ma me shel lta bu ste: 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'o: deng sang gi sbyangs pa can yin zer ba dang : mnyam par mi rigs gong du 'dud: gter ston gyi mtshan gang zhe na: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo sgo mi phyed pa rnams ni: gter ston du yang btags par mi 'os: gter rnying rnams slar spel ba ni bka' ma lta bu yin ste:

gab pa rim bzhin mngon du phyung zin: de'ang gter chen dang gter phran zhes bya'i ming tsam lung du grags pa ni: gter khog che chung tsam gyis khyad las: sna re re sbas pa ni: chos la mgo mjug cha ma tshang ba'am: dgos pa'i don bzhi mi gnas pa'am: skyon can du gyur nas gter phran zer ba ma yin no: ci phyir dum pa chad lhag mtshang can yod pa rnams: gter du 'dog na tshwa khang zhig po'i nang du yod pa'i dpe 'khyams dum pa yang gter yin pa mi khegs sam: de phyir ma 'ongs pa ru gter ston yin zer nas: chos dkrug bslad dum pa re dang : zog po g.yo khram can gyi gtam las: gter ma thon zer ba sogs rang mtshang sba ba'i tshig sna tshogs sgrog pa ni: gter min zhes ming btags pa ni de la zer ba yin no: de phyir bla ma gu ru rin po che'i lung las: nga yi gter ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gzhal ba'i yul las 'das: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don du sbas pa ni: cha tshang don dril zab brgya khyad par 'phags: gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos mang du yod: ma 'ongs skal ldan gter la spyod pa'i tshe: ting 'dzin go cha gsum gyi rgyud ldan nas: shes rab dbang pos brda lung rtsal ston tshe: gter khog re re'i chos kyang brjod mi lang : de bas gter gyi mtshan nyid nam mkha'o: zhes gsungs so: des na rje btsun gu ru rin po che'i sku snang stong ye shes kyi rol pa brdzus skyes yin pas skye 'chi dang bgres rgud med: gsung grags stong gi sdeb sbyor drug cu ḍākki'i dbyangs ring yin pas: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo dang mnyam: thugs skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba ka dag 'od gsal snying po kun mkhyen ye shes yin pas: dgongs pa kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang mnyam: gter la chad lhag dang ma dag pa'i rtags mtshan yod pa gzhi la yang ma grub: phrin las 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul yon tan gyi bkod pa lung rigs phyi nang tshogs pa'i rgyud sde kun klong la gab pa'i sgrom bu yin pas:

gter gyi chos la mgo mthud stod nas len: smad sham mtha' nas btsal dgos pa'i khungs med pa zhig ma yin: phrin las 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi gnyen por ston pa'i: drang srong mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta bstan pa'i sgron me chen po yin pas: gter gyi chos tshan gzungs dang blo yis dpag tu med: ci'i phyir zhe na: nga pha rgan padma 'byung gnas ni de ltar lags pas: rmongs pa'i 'os su mi 'jug: gang phyir ma 'ongs pa ru bsre bslad sgro skur can gyi chos sam: byin rlabs yal ba rgyud dang bka' lung chad pa'am: ma tshang ba gter nas chad 'dug zer ba'am: sgra ma dag pa sogs slob dpon gyi gsung yin zer ba'am: dkrugs shing spel ba lung bstan yin zer ba'am: sgra tshig nyams pa ring thung sogs brtag pa mi bzod ba rnams shog ser la 'dug zer ba sogs: gu ru rje'i mi dgongs shing : mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod la med pa: shog ser la gang min nor 'khrul sogs 'dug skad kyi tshig gtong ba ni: rdo rje theg pa'i rkang 'dren pa yin: des na phyis 'byung gter ston rnams kyang rtags shog ser dang bstun: tshad rig pas zungs: don gnas lugs kyi gzhi tshugs: gang gis mthong yang yid ches shing khungs btsun pa de gang zhe na: phyi nang gsang gsum gyi don ldan zhing : cha tshang la gting don dril ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang ma nor ba de byed pa yin: des phyis 'byung rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma brtag pa dang : gter gyi nyams len byed pa rnams kyis don 'di gtso bor dgos pas ma nor ba'i brtag gzhig kyang 'tshal: tshig de don gyi brda ci bzhin bkrol ba'i dgos chad ni: snying thig yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba'i seng gdong ḍākki'i sgrub thabs 'di: khungs btsun zhing byin rlabs che ba'i rgyu gang zhe na: thog mar khungs btsun pa ni: ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: dbyings phyug gsang ba ḍākkis gu ru la snyan brgyud du gnang ba'i phyir:

brgyud pa nye ba dang : gu rus rtags ldan mi brjed pa'i shog ser la btab ste gang la ma spel bas bsre bslad ma zhugs pas khungs btsun pa dang : slar gter 'di bzhes pa'i tshe: mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ma nor ba de bzhin la: rlung 'khor dmar nag rakta 'khrugs pa'i mtsho nas kun gyis mthong bar gdan drangs pas yid ches pa dang : byin rlabs che ba'i rgyu gang zhe na: seng gdong dmar mo ni 'jig rten la gnas pa sha gzugs tshul te: 'jig rten las 'das rtags ni seng zhal sngo ba tsam las med pa dang : 'khor rnams kyang phra men sha zas bskor bas: des na 'di nyid chos dbyings mthing ka gzhi ma bcos pa'i dngos rtags mthun te: dbyings phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro ma snying rje'i rang sgra che ba'i brdar: seng zhal dang ldan pa de'ang mkha' 'gro gzhan las thun mong ma yin par mtshon pa 'khor rnams kyang ye shes kyi ḍakki ma dang shugs kyi rang rtsal rnams kyang snying rje'i cho 'phrul du gnas: rtsa gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir: rigs bdag gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs spyi bor brgyan pa 'di: byin rlabs gzhan las khyad par 'phags so: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan rnams la: rtag tu mkha' 'gro 'du zhing gsang ba'i lung bstan 'byung : kun gyi gtso mo che yin pas 'gro ba dbang du 'du: yang dag don gyi sgrub pa yin pas mchog gi dngos grub thob: lus med ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin pas: tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub: mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam yin pas bgrod 'gyu mi dgos par zhing khams mthong : mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig kun gyi srog la gnas pas: log lta can la dmigs gtad kyis mthu ma btang kyang : bka' chad kyis sgrol nus: mkha' 'gro 'di dbang sdud kun gyi gtso mo yin pas: longs spyod mi 'dod kyang char bzhin du 'bebs: bsnyen sgrub phran bu las ma thon kyang : mkha' 'gro'i gsung shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin pas 'grub rtags myur:

'di rang byung lhan skyes kyi mkha' 'gro yin pas sgrub sla la mkhu ldog mi 'byung : 'byung ba lnga'i bdag mo yin pas rtsa rlung dang lus stobs rgyas shing khams dang bkrag mdangs 'phel: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i rang bzhin du gnas pas mkhyen gnyis kyi rig pa ma sbyangs kyang lhums su zhugs: dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso mo shes rab yum yin pas: 'di nyid bsgrubs pas gzhan thams cad gcig 'dus su 'gro: dbang bzhi gtso bo shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin pas: dbang bskur thams cad yongs rdzogs su 'gro: phar phyin drug gi sdong po shes rab phar phyin yin pas: bslab pa thams cad rang rdzogs su 'gro: pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis yang : shes rab ma rgyud don gyi theg pa yin pas: rgyud sde kun gyi gtso bor 'jug: bskyed rdzogs gnyis yang gtso bo rdzogs rim yin te: 'di rdzogs rim du 'jug: de bas skal ldan las can gyis: 'di nyid sgom sgrub bgyis la nyams su len par bya'o: de'ang ḍākki'i sgrub khog chen mo brjod kyis mi lang ba'i chos ka 'dug cing 'di nyid med du mi rung ba'i las byang dgos chad can: khol du phyung nas rgyun khyer du bzhag pa yin: gong du sgrub tshul phran bur chos nyid kyis rnam dbye phye ba de: kho bos las gzhung 'di kho na bstod phyir bsngags pa ma lags te: gang zhig spyi'i mtshan nyid yin pas: tha snyad rtog ge ba gcig gi mtshang du phog nas: mi 'os pa'i tant+ra du ming 'dogs par bzhed: sa ma ya: e maḥ rgya gar mkhas mchog padma 'byung gnas ngas: ma 'ongs skal ldan don du legs bkod pa'i: yang snying thig le gsang ba ḍākki'i chos: 'brel tshad don ldan lta ba'i me long la: shes rab 'od kyi drwa ba rab 'khyil 'di: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas ye shes rnam sprul nyid: ci bzhin ma nor thugs sras de la sprod: bka' yi rgya 'di zhing skyong mgon pos srungs: bdud rigs dam sri lag tu ma shor rgya:

dmar nag rakta rlung 'khoṛ atsha bstim: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa phag lor jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod/ dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing sbas yul du shog ser las zhal bshus so/ bstan dgra 'dul ba'i gnyen por shog /sgo sprul gu hyas zhu dag byas la mchod phreng sogs bar skabs yig chung gsal byed 'ga' zhig gsar du btab pa la mi nor ba'i yig shad brgyab yod// // ca) yang gsang thugs kyi ti ka dmar po khro chu'i bang mdzod las: mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i las byang dregs pa tshar gcod bzhugs so: ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul tshogs la 'dud: mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrom me dpung las tshogs 'di: phyi rabs ma 'ongs rjes 'jug bu yi don: dus kyi 'pho 'chug bskal pa'i drag spyod la: phan phyir padma bdag gis yi ger bris: las can mkha' 'gro gsang ba seng gdong gis: bka' yis rgyas thob gnod sbyin bzhi la bcol: ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar mgo tshugs tshe: las can thugs sras hūm̐ dang 'phrad par shog: mkha' 'gro seng gdong me yi spu gri yi: phyi nang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor zab gnad bstan: 'byung lnga'i chos 'byung rang byung phar phyin te: me long mda' dar mkha' 'gro'i srog yig dang : gnam lcags rdo rje bhandha mtshan ldan bcas: zhing lpags thog tu dkyil 'khor bris byas nas: sngon 'gro mtshams gcod phrin las gzhung bsrangs nas: byang shar kha bstan bde ba'i gdan la 'god: rang byung 'dzin med ngang nas 'di ltar bsgom:

sa ma ya: dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: byin rlabs ngo bo pad 'byung thugs rje'i bdag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal ḍākki sku dngos mchog: brtse chen ye nas 'bral med skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ na mo: dbyings rig ngo bo ma bcos lhun grub las: gcig tu 'gags med shar ba snying rje'i yul: 'khor 'das ci snang ma gyur sangs rgyas zhing : gdod nas 'khor gsum yongs dag sems bskyed do: dkar gtor bya/ gsum pa bgegs 'gugs pa ni: byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐: bdag nyid yum chen drag mor gsal ba yi: ye shes thugs las sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs: 'od zer 'gengs ba 'khor yug khyab par 'phros: phyi nang 'tshe ba'i bgegs tshogs kun bsdus nas: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis par gyur: om̐ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bsngo zhing bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong : snang srid dbang sdud ma gcig bdud 'dul ma: nga yi bka' la bgegs tshogs kun gyis nyon: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang 'byung po'i rigs: 'dod yon glud gtor mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: mi bzad mtshon cha drag po rab 'bebs te: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum phye mar bcom: de bas bka' las ma 'da' phyir byol cig: om̐ badzra kro ti ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhū ta rā dza u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: thugs las spros pa'i phyag mtshan 'bar ba'i me: steng 'og bar mtshams med pa dum gcig ngang : rab tu 'khrigs pa'i gur khang cher gyur nas: nam yang glags lta 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra dzwa la karma raṃ raṃ tsakra hūm̐ rakṣa ye swā hā: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni:

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'dzam gling khyon ltar rab tu 'geng ba yi: phyi mchod sprin spro lha mo sna tshogs kyis: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas thogs nas: byin gyis brlabs te dpag med spel bar gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: bdun pa nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bhandha dum gcig lcang lo 'khyil ba'i dbus: dug lnga rnam dag sha lnga sku lnga'i rdzas: sman mchod dri bzang mdangs ldan gtams pa'i tshogs: bla med dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ brgyad pa gsang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: dung zhal bde ba chen po'i snod kyi nang : a haṃ zung 'jug gar gyis sbyor ba yi: srub skyed mkha' nas ye shes bdud rtsi babs: bcud g.yo 'khyil ba'i bla med rten rdzas gyur: om̐ sarba a haṃ dharma pū dza āḥhūm̐: dgu pa gtor mchod rakta spyan gzigs sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bde chen rang byung mtshan ldan snod mchog tu: bha ling gtor ma sha khrag ri ltar spungs: spyan gzigs du ma bkod legs mdzes pa'i tshogs: bla med dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba na ṭa ā wa lo ki sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: bcu pa byin 'bebs pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos kyi pho brang nas: kun bzang chos skus byin phob cig: 'od lnga ye shes pho brang nas: rdor sems longs skus byin phob cig: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: pad 'byung sprul skus byin phob cig: ke'u ri gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas: ḍākki rgya mtshos byin phob cig: yang rdzong rdo rje'i gsang phug nas/ /gnubs chen dzñā na'i byin phob cig /rdzu 'phrul brtul zhugs pho brang nas/ /gnam lcags gter chen byin phob cig

/lung bstan chos kyi pho brang nas/ /cho bdag rgyud 'dzin byin phob cig: mkha' dbyings chos 'byung dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug seng gdong byin phob cig: phrin las bzhi ldan pho brang nas: ḍākki 'bum gyis byin phob cig: bka' bzhin bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i: dam can rgya mtshos byin phob cig: dbyings dang rang rtsal ji bzhin pa: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs byin phob cig: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ dang po sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe ḍākki thugs dang rang sems gcig: bar du 'gyu ba tsam gyis so sor phyes: da ni dbyer med kun tu rtogs pa'i phyir: dran rig thig le nyag gcig 'char sgo phyes: om̐ badzra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ gnyis pa lha zhal mjal zhing klong bshags ni: hūm̐: ye nas rmongs bral shes rab gsal ba'i 'od: kun tu lta ba'i klong yangs de bzhin gyis: cho 'phrul sna tshogs rtsal gyi bye brag nyid: gang la mi gnas ye shes der ston gsal: om̐ sa ma ya shuddhe pra dzñā dharma dzñā na hūm̐: gsum pa dkyil 'khor bzung ba ni: hūm̐: lhan skyes gnyug ma'i sbubs su rtsa gsum gyi: rang bzhin ye shes 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nyid: ye nas yin shes lta ba de bzhin gyis: ye bzhugs gdod ma'i srog thig mi gtong bzung : om̐ badzra tsitta dzñā na sarba gharbha dha ra hūm̐: bzhi pa mkha' dang klong du bstan pa ni: hūm̐: ma ltar gnas pa'i dbyings rig yum chen mkha': de yi rang bzhin zab gsal klong chen las: rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'od zer rtsal dag gis: kun byed mtshon pa'i brda las kun ston to: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ga ga mi ti hūm̐: dang po ngo bo nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: gdod ma'i gshis lugs ma bcos gnyug ma'i gzhi: ka dag ngang la bya rtsol lhun gyis rdzogs: gang du mi dmigs mkha' ltar rab gnas pa: dbyings phyug bde chen dpa' mos de ltar smra: om̐ dharma pra dzñā gu hya tsitta hūm̐:

gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni: āḥ khyab brdal chen po'i rang rtsal las: ma 'gags zer gyi 'phro 'du'i ngang : brtse ba'i snying rjes kun la khyab: gsang ba mkha' 'gros de ltar smra: om̐ dzñā na dharma shū n+ya ta garbha hūm̐: gsum pa bskyed pa rgyu'i sa bon ni: om̐: kun tu snying po'i rang rtsal las: bdag med mkha' yi yi ge hūm̐: sa bon lugs 'byung rdo rjer shar: drag mo ḍākkis de ltar smra: om̐ dharma dzñā na hūm̐ badzra la bhrūm̐: bzhi pa bskyed pa'i 'byung rim ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ snang srid snod bcud chos 'byung e yi mkha': 'byung ba rim brtsegs ma bcos pho brang ni: tsha grang snang srid dkar dmar brtsegs pa yi: shin tu rab 'jigs dur khrod me rlung dbus: mu stegs bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i baṃ gdan steng : rang nyid hūm̐ las drag mo bdud 'dul sku: ma bcos lhun grub sku mdog mthing nag 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis seng gdong dmar nag rngam: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan gsum khrag ltar g.yo: dbu skra smin mas khro chu thog ser 'bebs: thod skam dbu rgyan dar nag cod pan 'phur: phyag g.yas gri gug bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pas bhan dmar dgra bgegs klad khrag gsol: gdug pa'i ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag sham brgyan: me long rus rgyan thod rlon do shal phreng : khrag zhag thig le thal tshon sbrul chun 'phyangs: ma rungs tshar gcod kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum drag rtsal khro mo'i gar: 'gying bag stobs ldan me rlung dmar nag 'bar: dam sri baṃ chen gdan la rol stabs 'gying : hūm̐: shar du stag gdong dkar mo rdzu 'phrul ldan: lho ru phag gdong ser mo myur mgyogs stobs: nub tu dom gdong dmar mo rngam zhing brjid: byang du spyang gdong sngon mo drag rtsal shugs: bzhi ka phyogs mthun rang rtags gtso mo bzhin: khro mo'i chas rdzogs me dpung klong na 'gying :

gtso mo'i mdun du thugs sprul khrag ral ma: sku mdog dmar nag ral pa kham nag 'bar: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs: phyag g.yas khram shing g.yon pas nad rkyal thogs: nu 'bur rgyas pas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: mu kha rab bsgrad dgra la dmar yams gtong : mchong rtsal phung stag srog gzan dmar po zhon: khrag zhag klong nas dug rlangs sprin ltar gtibs: gtso 'khor bstan srung tshul du gsal bar bskyed: bdag nyid gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi: hūm̐ gi lcags kyu phyogs mtshams kun tu 'phros: rang rang gnas nas skad cig spyan drangs gyur: om̐ ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byang shar dur khrod u tsa la yi gnas: kī li kī la sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: bdud 'dul ye shes seng gdong gshegs su gsol: shar phyogs rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rlung nag 'tshub rgyas dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro phag gdong gshegs su gsol: nub phyogs bde chen rab rgyas dur khrod nas: padma mkha' 'gro dom gdong gshegs su gsol: byang phyogs ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro spyang gdong gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag dug rlangs 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod nas: bka' skyong las kyi ma mo gshegs su gsol: phyogs mtshams dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dur khrod nas: ye shes 'jig rten sha za mkha' 'gro dang : ma lus yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: sgyu ma chu zla bzhin du gnas 'dir gshegs: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du: byad ma ru tra bsnol ba'i baṃ brtsegs la: bdud 'dul ye shes ḍākki gtso dang 'khor: mi g.yo dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: badzra sa ma yā tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni:
