hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sna tshogs sku bzhi lhun grub ngang nyid las: bde chen yongs rdzogs spros bral brda yi sku: gsang ba ye shes ḍākki'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: badzra sa ma ya: a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes sku lnga'i rdzas: khams gsum yongs sgrol bla med mchod pa 'di: ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: thugs dam bskang zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dza i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: badzra arghaṃ pa dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i rtsub 'gyur tshal: mi bzad bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta bu: dmar nag sngo dmar 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil nas: shin tu mi bzad thod mkhar dbus nyid du: dmar chen baṃ ro nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong : drag mo bdud 'dul snang srid bdag mo ni: sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid skye med gzugs: rnam rtog gzhom phyir seng zhal gnam du gdangs: snang srid zil gnon g.yu ral sprin ltar gtibs: dug lnga rtsad gcod thod skam dbu la brgyan: gdug pa'i g.yul zlog seng chung sprul pa 'gyed: sku dbang rdzogs phyir spyi bor zil gnon rtsal: bdud 'dul khro mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: log 'dren 'dul phyir sdang mig phyogs bcur 'khyil: mu stegs 'dul phyir shangs las dug rlangs 'thul: dregs pa tshar gcod smin ma me ltar 'bar: smyo 'bog 'dul phyir zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: rgyal 'gong 'dul phyir hūm̐ phaṭ 'brug ltar sgrog: g.yul las rnam rgyal snyan cha nor bus brgyan: gsung dbang rdzogs phyir ha ri ni sa'i sgra: bdud 'dul drag mo'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs mchog mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das:

zhe sdang 'dul phyir phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams: gti mug tshogs 'joms glang chen ko rlon gsol: nga rgyal gzhom phyir zhing lpags sked la dkris: phrag dog 'dul phyir stag gi sham thabs gsol: klu nad gzhom phyir sbrul rigs yan lag brgyan: 'khor ba skem phyir m-i mgo'i phreng bas brgyan: nga bdag rtsad gcod thod khrag zhal du gsol: mtshan 'dzin rang grol rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten: 'khor ba skem phyir mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan: dur khrod chas rdzogs dpal gyi chas bcu rdzogs: bdud 'dul zil gnon me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: gsang ba'i mtshan gsol me long 'od gsal brgyan: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol stabs bdud dpung 'dul: thugs dbang rdzogs phyir gar gyi nyams dgu ldan: bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong thugs la bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi drag rtsal las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: stag gdong drag byed mu stegs dmag tshogs 'joms: phag gdong rgyas byed snang srid dregs can 'dul: dom gdong rngam byed mi nor dbang du sdud: spyang gdong za byed bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol: las byed sde bzhi dpa' brjid rol stabs 'gying : zhal gdangs ljags 'dril nyams pa'i snying khrag 'thung : gri thod rus rgyan cod pan kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: dur khrod chas rdzogs sha za las dbang mo: yon tan dbang rdzogs sangs rgyas bstan pa srung : bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dmar nag rba klong 'khrugs pa khrag gi mtsho: nad zhags dug rlangs 'tshub ma'i dbus nyid du: ma bdud srin mo khrag mdog sha za dang : sku mdog dmar nag nyams pa'i snying khrag 'thung : dmar nag ral bsigs dgra la dar yams 'bebs: sngo nag thod skam thog ser bu yug 'tshubs: spyan gsum khrag mdog g.yo zhing byad ma sgrol: zhal nas dmar nag khrag mtsho dgra la byo: phyag g.yas khram shing byad ma dgra la 'debs:

g.yon pas nad rkyal dgra yul dmar nad gtong : nu 'bur 'khrugs pas khrag gi ser sgong 'dril: mtshan ma yang bsgrad dgra yul than gyis 'gengs: zhabs gnyis dor stabs gling bzh-i lte bar bcug: srog la rngam byed phung stag mgo dgu chibs: phrin las dbang rdzogs las byed pho nyas bskor: bdud 'dul las kyi ma mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bskul lo mkha' 'gro ma sring gdong can tshogs: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul mdzad sprul pa'i lha: gdod ma ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: bdag gis khyod la mchod bstod phrin las bcol: ma ltar bu la brtse ba'i sems bzhin du: thugs rje rab 'byams klong yangs shugs phyungs kyis: byin rlabs nus rtsal mchog thun dngos grub rnams: 'bad med lhun grub sku bzhi'i ngang nyid du: bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen grogs: sku bzhi lha mo khyod kyis ston nus pas: ye shes las la grub pa'i rab dga' mo: grol lam pho nya mchog gi dga' bzhi stsol: bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod sgyu ma'i ngang nyid las: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo ḍākki'i tshogs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bzlas dmigs ni/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ru/ /nyi steng thugs srog hūm̐ mthing 'bar/ /tha mar sngags phreng g.yon bskor du/ /shugs drag 'khor lo rdo rje dang*/ /me yi tshwa tshwa bar med 'phros/ /lus gang nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs/ /lus kun lcags bsregs zhun ma ltar/ /'bar zhing tshwa tshwa 'phro ba yis/ /snang srid byad phur gzhob tu bsregs/ /sde brgyad ma mo las la btsud/ /dam sri dgra bgegs tshar thag bcad/ /dug lnga nyon mongs ka nas dag /snod bcud snang grags chos thams cad/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs/ /lha sngags ye shes rol par blta/

rong smyon bsnyen sgrub yi ge las phyung ba'o/ rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ mūm̐ ḍākki singha mu kha dzaḥdzaḥ sgrub sngags/ om̐ baṃ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha ma ma siddhi dza dzaḥ badzra ratna padma karma ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ las sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces sngags gang 'os rang rang skabs phyi sgrub dang bstun: thun mthar mchod bstod dang*/ dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po zhabs btags ma tshar gsum re thun gtor dang bcas te/ bstod bskul dang thal brdeb bya/ sa ma ya: e ma gsang sgrom snying thig 'di: kho bo padma bdag gis bshad: mkha' 'gro las can mtsho rgyal mas: gsang ba brda yi yi ger thob: bka' srung gnod sbyin bzhi la bcol: ma 'ongs sum cu mgo tshugs tshe: rtsod ldan bdud 'dul gnyen po ru: dpal gyi ye shes skyes mtha' mchog: hūm̐ bdag sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis jo bo gze rgyal nas srod 'khor ḍākki dus gdan drangs shing shog ser las phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // cha) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: srung bzlog rgyun khyer ngag 'don bzhugs so: ༅ྂ: mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i srung bzlog rgyun khyer ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: 'khor ba dong sprugs sems bskyed do: snang srid ye stong rdzogs pa che: de'i ngang chos 'byung gzhal yas khang : me long thog ser 'khrugs pa'i dbus: pad nyi baṃ steng rang gi sems: skad cig dran rdzogs mkha' 'gro ma: mthing nag seṅge'i gdong pa can: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad: ljags bskyod g.yu ral nam mkhar gzengs:

skam rlon thod pa'i dbu rgyan dang : do shal dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang gsol: gru mor kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum bcug: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs 'gying : thugs kar nyi steng bhyo mthing las: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur: phyi nang gsang mchod bstod par bgyi: thugs ka'i bhyo mthar sngags g.yon 'khor: de 'og me rlung thog mtshon 'khrugs: phyi nang ban bon byad ma yi: sngags zor rbod gtong ngan pa kun: bsad bcad brlag gtor phyir bzlogs nas: tshur 'dus mtshon cha sna tshogs gyur: me dpung 'bar bas bskor bar gyur: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ badzra tu ra na ma swā hā: e sa bhyo zlog: e ka ya ma du tri rbad: ces bskyed rim gsal ba'i ngang la ci nus bzla: thun mthar mkha' 'gro seng gdong hūm̐ du gyur nas nam mkhar thim: snang srid brda mtshon gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang la nyal: de ni rgyun khyer srung bzlog go: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྀatsha rgya: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal nas gdan drangs nas shog ser las zhal bshus so// // ja) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong ma las: mtshan med srung bzlog gnam lcags ur mo bzhugs so: ḍākki seng gdong drag mor 'dud: sa ma ya: hoḥ rang nyid skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong pa can sku mdog sngon mo dbu la thod skam gyi rigs lnga gsol zhing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyangs pa dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod pa: g.yon pas bhandhar nyon mongs kyi snying khrag zhal du gsol ba: mchan du mkhar phur rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa: spyi gtsug tu gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs sku yi gnas lngar gdong can rigs lnga:

yan lag lhu tshigs bzhir shugs 'gro ma mo: ba spu'i bu gar yang sprul grangs med spros pa: sku la ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su gsal ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje'i lte bar zla nyi'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gis klad skor nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma: ha khog tu bsrung bya pho mo: 'og tu rta phyugs la sogs gsal ba'i ngang la srung sngags bzlas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sna tshogs grangs med 'phros pas: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung gter bdag rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus rtsal thams cad bsdus nas: bdag dang bsrung bya la thim pas cis kyang mi shigs pa rdo rje'i go cha ru grub par bsam mo: hūm̐ bhyoḥ skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas: 'gags med hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: 'khrul med dran rtog chos nyid ngang : gnyis med bhyo dang phaiṃ ka ra'i: rang bzhin me dpung tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs srung 'khor gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ om̐ mūṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ nṛ bhrūm̐: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces brgya phrag bdun gsum lnga bdun gang 'byor dal brel dang bstun/ mthar rten 'brel snying po yang bzla'o/ sa ma yaḥ gnyis pa bzlog pa bya ba ni: bdag nyid drag mor gsal ba yi: sku las spros pa'i khro mo dang : yang sprul khro tshogs dpag med kyis: dgra bgegs bdud sde'i tshogs rnams la: sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char phab ste: dgra sde dpung bcas rdul du rlog: rnam shes chos nyid zhing du spar: dmigs med chos sku'i klong du zlog: phaṭaḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ

e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces bdun gsum nyer gcig tu bzla zhing dmod bcol thal mo brdab: dmigs pa ni: rang nyid drag mor gsal ba'i lag g.yas pa zla ba chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po: g.yon pa nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gsal ba'i bar pha rol ban bon byad ma dgra bgegs lha srung dang bcas sbrang ma mes tshig pa ltar ram thal mo'i bar du bcar ba ltar gnam sa nyi zla cha lang brdabs pas ming med du brlags par bsam mo: kho'i tshe dang bsod nams bkrag mdangs gzi byin thams cad tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas gzi brjid cher 'bar te che btsan kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam: lnga bsdus phung po sha khrag rus pa nang rol rnams ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis zhal du gsol bas: dug lnga dug gsum gyi bag sgrib dbyings su dag nas rnam smin las sgrib byang ste: dgra bgegs de dag thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa chos sku yum chen mo'i go 'phang thob ste rgyal yum gyi sras su skye bar bsam mo: slar yang phyir mi ldog pa'i bro bor smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo: sa ma ya: e maḥ ye shes seng gdong drag mo yi: srung bzlog man ngag khyad par can: phyi rabs bu yi don slad du: ma hā gu ru'i bka' gnang bzhin: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: bka' srung seng gdong drag mor bcol: sangs rgyas ye shes skyes mtha' ni: hūm̐ gi ming dang 'phrad par shog: dam med lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs mgul dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // nya) drag mo bdud 'dul ḍākki'i thun gtor 'bul ba ni: na mo: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong pa can 'khor dang bcas pas:

gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dang bcas pa thams cad dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: lan gsum: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: om̐ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta āḥhūm̐ kha kha khā hi: om̐ badzra singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dzaḥ i daṃ bha lingta khā hi: lan gsum: dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma skyes rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: 'gro ba'i don mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: nam mkha'i mdog can dbu ni seṅge'i gdong : ye shes me ris ma rig mun pa gsal: thugs rje'i me yis srid gsum ma lus sreg: 'jigs byed chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsgral ba'i phung po lhag med zhal du gsol: dug gsum sha khrag sku gsum klong du rol: sgo gsum mi mthun bar chad med par mdzod: stong nyid bya bral gnyug ma'i ye shes che: mtha' bral ro gcig phyag rgya chen po'i ngang : ka dag 'od gsal chos sku 'du 'bral med: mnyam rjes dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig: ces 'dod gsol gang la 'os pa bya: them med u pa dāe sha'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sarba maṅga laṃ// // ta) zangs btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i gsol mchod: phrin las kun 'grub bzhugs so: rigs kun khyab bdag gar gyi dbang phyug badzra thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: shamabanyyanyyanyyaḥ e ma kho mo bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gu ru rje yi bka' gnang legs bkod de: gangs can sa skyong mgul lha srid pa'i lung : ci bzhin so mar ma bcos thogs med bstan: bstan dgra rbad tsam sgrol ba 'di lta bur: sngon tshe gsang bdag he ru ka pa yis: sde brgyad dam btags ma mo'i sa gnad dang :

bar du rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru yis: brag dmar mchims phu sgrub pa'i ke'u tshang du: zla gzugs snod kyi sde brgyad 'byung po rnams: rtag chad ris su mi dmigs ting 'dzin gyis: shugs la bsdus dril btul ba'i dus skabs su: bas mthar srin mo so bdun bros pa las: ma hā gu ru drag po'i skur bzhengs nas: dam tshig rdo rje'i mtshon char phab pa'i tshe: 'brog srin ya ma lho yi tshwa khar thim: brag srin rgyal ba she ne'i brag la thim: rkong srin sman mo shar gyi klong du thim: gri srin ya ma byang shar gtsang por thim: shanta pu ri nub kyi brag la thim: g.yung drung pyi mthing byang gi brag la thim: btsan srin shwa na byang shar ri la thim: de tshe bden bzhi rdo rje'i rtsal shugs kyis: srin mo tshogs kun dbang du bsdus nas kyang : she ne ru ni ke ta'i lung du sbas: drag sngags rdo rje phur pa'i snying gzer btab: las kyi me btsan dang bcas dpang por gzugs: chos 'byung logs gsum gshin rje'i kha thim brgyan: bro bor bgyis sogs rgyas pa gzhan du gsal: lus kyang mdo khams srin mo rdzong du grags: gling yang bkod tshul zangs brag khrag mtsho ldan: de phyir sa rtags rgyud dang legs mthun zhing : byin gyis brlabs nas gter kha mang tsam sbas: gter bdag btsan gyi rgyal po me 'od gdong : gter srung khyab 'jug shan pa spun bdun dang : gter rgya dbang mo klu mo 'od ldan ma: bka' srung sde tshogs bcas la gnyer gtad cing : dur sa 'di phyogs ched du gnas chen bzhag: gter gyi rgya sogs skal ldan don du bskos: dus la bab tshe las can de yis 'byin: smon lam shugs kyis mtshan phyir 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: ma 'ongs snyigs blo rtsod ldan yang mtha' dus: gnas kyi sgo 'byed gter dang spyod pa'i tshe: skal ldan sbrul gyi lo dang sprel gyi lo: rta dang lug sogs 'byung ba rgod kyi mchog: zla ba'i rgya 'dzin bya dang stag gi lo:

khyi dang byi ba legs 'byung gzungs kyi thag: chu bhe dri'am na dmar ka re tra: gnam lo sa stag de bzhin shar ba'i tshe: 'jam dpal bka' bab gnubs lo'i rnam sprul nyid: dmar 'od zhags myur 'bebs bzhin gnas de nyul: btsan rgod 'bar ba stag dang bya dmar stag: btsan bshos mkhar thab btsan chas du mas mchod: gza' bdud rgyal po 'brug dang chu srin mchod: shan pa spun la sprel dang bya dmar mchod: klu mo nor bu klu bshos bya sngon mchod: gzhan yang gser skyems phud dang mnyes pa'i rdzas: phun sum tshogs ldan mchod 'os bkram pa bsham: rten 'brel lung bzhin bgyis pas smon lam 'grub: sa ma ya: de'ang mdo khams gnas kyi bdag po: btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje'i tshogs la: gsol mchod bgyis pa ni: gong gi lung byang bzhin: mchod pa 'byor ldan bsgrig: dar dmar ru mtshon bcas gzeng zhing mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab: rngam gdangs zangs ri dgu brtsegs dang bcas pas 'di skad do: hūm̐: tsā ri rgya gar byang shar mtshams: sham bha la yi nyer gcig cha: zangs gling 'od ldan ma ru tse: khrag mtsho lbu ba lang ling phyur: zangs brag rngam gzengs dbyings su bsnyegs: zangs lam klu mo 'khyugs la 'dud: g.ya' spang rang byung zangs mtsho 'bar: de dbus zangs mkhar rtse dgu pa: phyi nang gru chad thog so mdzes: ba gam mgo phreng tshal du bsgrigs: mi lpags rgyal mtshan mi skra'i thod: gri rgod snying gi tog bcas 'khrol: dar dmar ru mtshon rnga thug sogs: mi bzad rgyan 'phyangs du mas spras: zangs mkhar de yi nang shed na: dgra bgegs mi rta'i ro brtsegs steng : srog bdag chen po mi bsrun pa: shan pa byang gi rtse ber can: mdog dmar mche gtsigs me 'od gdong : rmod phor dar dmar ru dar 'phur: phyag na btsan mdung zhags pa 'khyugs: stag ral gzig shubs shang lang brgyan: btsan rta myur mgyogs dmar zhur chibs: thog char me rlung 'tshubs dbus gsal: hūm̐:

g.yas phyogs bdud bgegs ru tra dang : 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa'i steng : snang srid thabs shes 'dus pa'i gzugs: rlung lnga'i dbang phyug sde dpon pa: dbyings kyi khyab 'jug rā hu la: ki kang dud kha mgo dgu pa: phyag gnyis nyi zla cha lang rdeb: ro stod srin gzugs ro smad sbrul: srid pa'i 'brug mo mgo dgu zhon: khu rlangs mun pa'i klong du gsal: hūm̐: g.yon phyogs rgya mtsho mer ba'i nang : g.yu 'od mthing gi dal dbus su: dgos 'dod bcud kyi khri 'phang steng : klu yi dbang mo 'od ldan ma: sngon mo nor bu mda' dar 'dzin: le brgan mdzes pa'i go zus brgyan: chibs su chu rta sprin shugs chibs: yid 'ong gter gyi gnyer du gsal: hūm̐: phyi rol sprul pa'i las byed pa: za byed btsan gyi skyes bu drug: dgra srog har len dmag chas can: gtso bo'i chas ldan pho nyar 'gyu: yang 'khor srog gzan stag gzig dang : gcan spyang dur bya sprin ltar gtibs: gzhan yang sprul 'khor bye ba 'bum: rdzu 'phrul du ma'i shugs 'chang ba: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: 'gugs pa'i dzaḥyig 'od kyis bsdu: hūm̐ gis rten bskyed gdan la bzhugs: baṃ gyis dam tshig thugs dam bskang : ho yis dgyes bskyed khyod la bstod: om̐ badzra dzwa la shu ra tsa ya tri hriṃ rā hu la nā ga ra tsa iṣṭa ni dhi pa ti ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma yaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ: om̐ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hiḥ

de nas phud rgod rakta mchod: hoḥ sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i bka' btags dam la gnas shing tha tshig tu 'du ba'i dregs chen 'bar ba btsan gyi rgyal po zangs btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkha' yi bdag po khyab 'jug ki kang rā hu la chen po'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: khyad par klu'i dbang mo gter bdag chen mo gsang ba 'od ldan gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul pa btsan gyi pho nya dus drug gi bdag mo'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: yang sprul gcan spyang bya tshogs srog la rngam byed rnams kyi zhal du gsol lo mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: slar yang lo zla dus kyi sa 'dzin dregs pa sde brgyad bye ba 'bum gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: ched du ming nas ma smos pa: sa yul 'dir 'khor ba'i glo bur du lhags pa'i btsan 'khor pho nya las byed rnams kyi zhal du gsol lo mchod do om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes kha bsngos gang mos drag gsol skabs 'dir sbyar rung : de nas bskul zhing bstod de gtor ma dang btsan chas sogs thams cad lha khang khar ram gtor stegs kyi steng du 'bul bar bya'o: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil dbus: zangs mkhar rtse dgu'i nang shed nas: srog bdag rdo rje 'bar ba bzhengs: dbyings kyi dug rlangs sprin gling nas: 'chi bdag gza' mchog nag po bzhengs: rgya mtsho mer ba'i nang shed nas: khyab byed klu yi bdag mo bzhengs: las bskul me rlung 'tshub dkyil nas: dregs sde pho nya myur mgyogs bzhengs: bzhengs shig bskul lo phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: myur mgyogs sde dpon 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni: btsan mkhar dar dmar ru mtshon 'bul: mtshal stag bya dmar btsan chas 'bul: 'brug dang chu srin rgyal mtshan 'bul: gri snying spel mar sna tshogs 'bul: nor bu klu bshos gser skyems 'bul:

mnyes pa'i mthun rdzas du ma 'bul: dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: rin chen gter gyi las bcol cig: 'dod yon longs spyod char bzhin phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: las kyi sde dpon dmag la chos: srog bdag nyi khri rlung ltar 'tshubs: zangs btsan shan pa dgra la bhyoḥ smyo 'bog steng grib chu ltar khol: gza' bdud nag po dgra la bhyoḥ mdze nad lhog yams mun ltar 'tshubs: klu yi bu mo dgra la bhyoḥ shan pa dmag tshogs nyi li li: yang 'khor sprul pa dgra la bhyoḥ mi sdug ltas ngan char ltar phob: bya gcan stong sde dgra la bhyoḥ sangs rgyas bstan dgra rtsad nas chod: dkon mchog spyi dgra rdul du rlog: rnal 'byor sgos dgra cham la phob: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: lo zla zhag dus ma bzhag par: sha khrag thun gtor 'di nyid dang : dbyer med mnyam par bzhes byas te: lhag ma ming shul med par mdzod: om̐ shu la ra tsa ki kang tri tri nā ga ti pa ra tsa tsa tri sa ma du ru ya dgra bo la zlog zlog: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing dgra bo'i yul du chas nas dgra bo ming shul tsam yang med par bsam: zhes pa btsan rgod 'bar ba'i gsol mchod 'di gang gis brtsams pa'i skal ldan la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par 'byung zhing : 'di ni gsol mchod yul gru gang du brtson pa'i phyogs su sad ser nad yams zhi zhing : dgra yi dmag chen mi 'byung ste lo legs bkra shis 'phel bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: e ma thun mong ma yin pa'i: yang zab btsan rgod gsol mchod 'di: ma 'ongs skal ldan gter 'byin dang : yul srung sa gnas bstan skyong phyir: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: btsan rgod zla skyong khyod la bcol: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes khams srin mo rdzong rtse nas gdan drangs shing chu yos lor shog ser las zhal bshus pa'o//

// sarba maṅga laṃ// // tha) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo las: mkha' 'gro 'bum bskang dngos grub rgya mtsho bzhugs so: ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul tshogs la 'dud: mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrom me dpung las tshogs nyid: phyi rabs ma 'ongs rjes 'jug bu yi don: dus kyi 'pho 'phyugs bskal pa'i drag spyod la: phan phyir padma bdag gis yi ger bris: las kyi mkha' 'gro gsang ba seng gdong gis: bka' yis rgyas thob mkha' 'gro bzhi la bcol: ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar mgo tshugs tshe: las can thugs sras hūm̐ dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: mkha' 'gro seng gdong me'i spu gri'i phyi nang las sbyor 'bum bskang zab gnad rang byung 'dzin med ngang la snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do: hūm̐ maḥ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i: dbus phyogs sangs rgyas rigs kyi bdag: dpa' bo seṅge sgra sgrogs la: rig 'dzin grub thob 'bum gyis bskor: ḍākki ma sring rgya mtsho rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ maḥ yum chen thugs kyi rnam sprul ma: ma gcig drag mo seṅge'i gdong :

mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: ḍākki ma sring rgya mtsho rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ ma: shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar: dkar mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: mkha' 'gro ma sring rgya mtsho rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang :

thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ maḥ lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro mar: ser mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: mkha' 'gro ma sring rgya mtsho rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ ma: nub phyogs padma mkha' 'gro mar: dmar mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: mkha' 'gro ma sring rgya mtsho rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la:

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ maḥ byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro mar: ljang mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ ma: sgo skyong shugs 'gro phra men mar: rang 'dra'i ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: ma sring mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams:

dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ maḥ ye shes dang ni las grub pa'i: zhing skyong gnas nyul la sogs par: sna tshogs ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor: ma sring mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon: mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: hūm̐ ma: bka' bzhin phrin las bstan skyong ma: bstan srung khrag ral mkha' 'gro 'bum: ḍākki ma sring rgya mtsho rnams: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: gdangs dbyangs mgur ma 'u ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: mchod pa'i phyag rgya lam se lam: zhabs kyis 'khrul 'khor ldems se ldem: dpa' bos bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: mchod rdzas 'di la bcud chen spel: dkyil 'khor 'di la mdangs bzang thon:

mda' dar 'di la srung du 'dzugs: mar me 'di la mdangs shig phyungs: maṇḍal 'di la rten bzang phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol: brda bskang rin chen khol phyung ni: hūm̐ ma: khyad par mnyes pa'i dam rdzas ni: dur khrod pho brang rgyan spyod 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: thod pa ltag sprod zhing lpags g.yogs: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: mchog chen gri rkang dbyangs ring 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: bhandha rakta rnam lnga'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: sha tshil dri gsur ngad ldan 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: dmar chen dar nag ba dan can: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: dgra bgegs sha khrag ri ltar spungs: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: zhing lpags rgyal mtshan dar nag g.yabs: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: phyag mtshan rno mtshon 'khor lo'i rtsibs: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: ging pa pho mo gar bsgyur tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: dus mtshan ma mo gcer bu 'bum: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes pa'i phud: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: 'bod pa'i gdangs chen 'brug ltar ldir: ma sring mkha' 'gror bskang rdzas 'bul: mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas kyis: rdo rje seng gdong thugs dam bskang : padma stag gdong thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas phag gdong thugs dam bskang : rin chen dom gdong thugs dam bskang : phrin las spyang gdong thugs dam bskang : las byed lcags gdong thugs dam bskang : mtshan mo sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : ma mo mched gsum thugs dam bskang : srin mo stong sde'i thugs dam bskang :

thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ bde ba yab la stong pa yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ glu dbyangs len pa'i gar mo'i tshogs: chags pa'i brda skad lhang lhang sgrog: dga' bzhi bskul ba'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim sogs: ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa yi: phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ dug lnga ma spangs ye shes ngang : nyon mongs rang grol chags med rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub nang mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ gsang ba ḍākki rig ma'i tshogs: gar sgyur bde ba'i mkha' lam du: rlung gis bskyod pa'i rdo rjes bsrubs: mnyes phyir yid kyi chu gter 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ lcang lo can gyi bhandha ru: sha lnga pañtsa rdzas kyis gtams: zag med bdud rtsi'i sman mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ rin chen sna tshogs yangs pa'i nang : rmad byung dpal chen bshos bu btsugs: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ dung zhal bde ba chen po'i nang : mdangs ldan dmar chen 'od du 'bar: sna tshogs rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ ru tra bsgral ba'i thod pa ru: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dbang po spungs: bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang :

thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ ye nas rmad byung ngo bo'i rdzas: rang byung ma 'gags ye shes kyis: dmigs med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam stsol: hūm̐ maḥ phyi nang mnyes pa'i rten rdzas mchog: me long mda' dar bla 'khor sogs: spyan gzigs du ma'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe ba ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

bshags pa ni: hūm̐ maḥ ma sring ḍākki rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du: mchod pa lo zlar 'das pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs dang bskang mchod chag pa mthol lo bshags: sbyor sgrol gnad du ma khel mthol lo bshags: dus drug dus gsum 'das pa mthol lo bshags: dus min las la sbyor ba mthol lo bshags: bcu nya stong bzhi chag pa mthol lo bshags: rten 'brel sna tshogs chags pa mthol lo bshags: thabs shes kha 'gal spyod pa mthol lo bshags: bde stong zung du ma 'jug mthol lo bshags: dam tshig spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje sngags la 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol ba ni: 'gyod tshangs dam tshig chen po la gnas shog: om̐ badzra sa tw sogs/ zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang zhing sgo gsum 'dun pa mi phyed drag pos bshags: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: ྀatsha: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel gling pas jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal rgyas pa'o// // sarba maṅga laṃ// // da) drag mo seng gdong las tshogs me 'khor nag po las: bstod bskul khrag mtsho khol ma bzhugs so: ḍākki bdud 'dul drag mor 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zor gtor la rakta bran zhing rnga brdung dung bus sha chen gsur btang rngam stabs kyis 'di skad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: aiḥ chos dbyings rnam dag khro chu khol ma'i klong : ye shes las grub ma gcig seng gdong ma: bdud 'dul drag mo'i tshul gyis skur bzhengs shig: khrag zhag rba klong 'khyil ba'i dbus nyid nas: sha za mkha' 'gro sde lnga skur bzhengs shig: dug rlangs rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i nang shed nas: srog gcod ma mo dmar nag skur bzhengs shig: phyogs mtshams drag rtsal rngam brjid dur khrod nas: zhing skyong las kyi ma mo skur bzhengs shig: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong nas bzhengs:

gti mug mun rum 'thibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: nga rgyal ri rgod nyil ba'i klong nas bzhengs: phrag dog spu gri brtsegs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: gdug rtsub char sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: ki kang mkha' la rgyu bzhin myur du bzhengs: gnam lcags thog 'bebs ji bzhin myur du bzhengs: drag mo las la bskul bzhin bzhengs pa'i tshe: chos nyid bde stong khro mo sha ra ra: gsal stong drag mo'i dmag tshogs thibs se thib: bde stong bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro nyi li li: snang stong las kyi ma mo spungs se spung : rig stong sha za khro mo khro lo lo: shes rab mtshon cha'i dbal kha si li li: stong nyid seṅge'i nga ro 'u ru ru: tshogs drug bdud bcom nyams dbyangs khra la la: shar grol me yi tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: shes rig mkha' la gar stabs khyugs se khyug: rang byung srid pa'i rgyal mo yams se yam: las la thogs med chos dbyings mkha' 'gro ma: rdzu 'phrul gnas lugs rtsal ston ma tshogs rnams: de ring skye med drag mo'i skur bzhengs shig: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: dug lnga log par 'dren pa'i dgra bo 'di: mtshan ma rang grol ngang nas myur du sgrol: ma dag log lta 'chang ba'i skal ngan tshogs: chos nyid ting 'dzin bden pas myur du sgrol: nga bdag 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyal 'gong rigs: ye shes rang rtsal rig pas myur du sgrol: 'khrul snang log 'dren dgra bo byad ma rnams: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis myur du sgrol: dkar po dge ba'i bar chad lha yi bdud: 'khrul med mi g.yo rdo rjes myur du sgrol: nag po kha 'byams slu 'brid 'khrul pa'i bdud: shes rab mi g.yo ral gris myur du sgrol: slu 'brid nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra bo 'di: ngo bo gang shar rig pas myur du sgrol: rnam g.yeng 'khrul ngor shar ba'i dgra bo 'di: skad cig drag rtsal khro mos myur du sgrol:

ma dag log lta pha rol byad ma'i tshogs: bla mar smad cing sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig: dam 'gal 'gras ya byed cing slob dpon dkrugs: sde dgon gtor zhing dben ri gnyan po bcom: sngags 'chang bdag la sdang zhing dgra ru langs: gsang sngags bstan pa bshig cing sdang ba yi: dmag jag chom po dar zhing dgrar langs pa'i: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di: bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mos myur du sgrol: ma dad log par 'dren pa'i dgra bo 'di: stag gdong drag mo'i tshogs kyis myur du sgrol: dam sri gsang sngags bsnubs pa'i byad ma 'di: phag gdong srog gcod mkha' 'gros myur du sgrol: rdo rje slob dpon bdag la sdang ba rnams: dom gdong snang srid bdag mos myur du sgrol: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: spyang gdong sha za mkha' 'gros myur du sgrol: bka' gsang zab gter 'di la gnod byed rnams: bka' srung khrag ral ma mos myur du sgrol: byad ma log par lta ba'i dgra bo 'di: bstan srung ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis sgrol: stobs ldan bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro las la chos: sha za snang srid bdag mo las la chos: sprul pa'i las byed ma sring bstan srung rnams: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: ma rungs log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs rnams: khyod kyi khong nas nad rlangs dug phyungs la: 'du ba rnam bzhi'i dbugs thag chod la shog: pho gdon mo gdon rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog rnams: sha zo khrag 'thung dbugs longs mtshan ma stong : 'dre rgod dal yams phung thab sna dgu rnam: pha rol byad ma log lta'i steng du bhyoḥ ma rungs gdug pa'i mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs rnams: bzlog bsgyur phrin las drag rtsal sa ma ya: gling bzhi'i mi kha rgyangs glu ltas ngan rnams: pha rol g.yul ngo byad ma'i steng du bhyoḥ snang srid bka' yi las byed ma mo'i tshogs: sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i bka' ma bcag: skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dam ma bkral:

sngon sbyangs las stobs smon lam tha ma gnyer: da lta sngags 'chang bskul ba don ma chung : dam tshig rdo rje'i mna' la bka' ma 'da': de bas ma sring ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs rje thogs med dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma thogs da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzod: phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma'i sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: rus la rbad rbad: tsitta la rbad rbad: myog myog thum ril rbad rbad ha tri nag po dgra bo byad ma la bhyo bhyoḥ ru tri nag po dgra bo byad ma la bhyo bhyoḥ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa nṛ tri trig nan nan: e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: oṃ baṃ ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa raksha kro ti dgra bo byad ma'i don snying la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes thal mo brdab cing gtor ma 'phang : byad ma lha srung bcas pa rnams thal zhag rlung gis g.yeng ba bzhin: ri rab lcags ri'i phyi ru gtor: byad ma'i tshe bsod nus mthu rnams: tshur 'dus khro mo'i sku la thim: mi shigs rdo rje'i sku ru bsgom: skye med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: zhabs kyu ha khog zla tshes dang : nā da stong nyid mi dmigs ngang : sgyu ma 'ja' tshon chu zla'o: snang stong dmigs med sa ma ya: e ma gsang sgrom snying thig 'di: kho bo padma bdag gis bzhag: mkha' 'gro las can mtsho rgyal ma: gsang ba brda yi yi ger thob: bka' srung gnod sbyin bzhi la bcol: ma 'ongs sum cu mgo tshugs tshe: rtsod ldan bdud 'dul gnyen po ru: dpal gyi ye shes skyes mtha' mchog: hūm̐ nag sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis jo bo gze rgyal nas srod 'khor ḍākki rgyu dus gdan drangs shing shog ser las phab pa'o/

sarba maṅga laṃ// // na) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: smad las bsad pa zangs sgrom dmar po bzhugs so: ḍākki bdud 'dul drag mor 'dud: de'ang ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su steng 'og bar gsum 'khrugs pa'i nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa dar: de'i tshe dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las rim bsad pa spu gri dmar po'i las byang 'di: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas: bstan dgra bsgral ba'i sems bskyed go gyon te: mngon spyod dmod pa drag po'i chas su zhugs: mdun du gnam lcags las grub hoṃ khung nang : ma rungs byad ma bdud sde dpung tshogs dang : rgyab rten bla dwags ming rus ldan pa'am: zor las dmod pa'i zhal bstab tsam la ni: zan ling khrag gis sbrus pa zhig gis 'thus: dar nag ber nag mun pa nag pos bkab: mtha' bskor phur yungs la sogs thun rdzas dang : bya 'ug sgro sogs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas: gri gug ral gri la sogs mtshon chas bskor: mngon spyod drag po'i thun rdzas ma lus bsags: lta ba gyad dang gnyen po ye shes lha: sprul pa las byed lha yi go cha ni: phaṭaḥ rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma drag tu khros pa bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong pa can: shin tu gtum pa dur khrod chas brgyad dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas srog gcod las kyi gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing : g.yon pas kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum thog ltar 'bebs pa: zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs can: chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus su gnas pa: mdun du phrin las kyi sprul pa drag mo spyang gdong ma nag mo gcer mo mi lpags g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon nas nu ma gyen mthur du 'khyil ba: phyag g.yas spu gri dang g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa: dgra bgegs kyi srog la dbang ba'i rnam par gsal: ma mo gsod byed ma'i g.yas g.yon du bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong can: dgra bgegs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas thun nag po thogs pa mdun du bla 'gugs las kyi ma mo srog 'phrog gsum ni:

dmar mo seng gdong can: sngon mo chu yi mdog can: nag mo mun pa'i mdog can: thams cad lag tu bla 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu: bla 'ching ba'i zhags pa: bla 'dzin pa'i drwa ba: bla dwags kyi ring cha: bla 'bod kyi gri rkang : g.yab mo 'debs pa'i rnga ma dmar nag bcas thogs nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can 'gugs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'o: bhyo baṃ singha ḍākki kro ti ka li ma ma bhyo bhyoḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ma tri ma thun ma bhyo trag rakmo bhyoḥ kha la rakmo e ka tsa ti bhyoḥ khā kha hu lu ma mo bhyoḥ tri dza tri dza baṃ shag shante bhyo bhyoḥ ma mo tri rakmo dza tri ma bhyo bhyoḥ thun thun bhyo bhyoḥ drag sngags bzlas shing gzi byin bskyed nas: gser skyems gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku: snang srid 'di ru gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral: nga nyid drag po khros pa seṅge'i gdong : nga las che ba med do kun gyis nyon: maḥ nga nyid pho brang gnas chen u tsa la: dur khrod chen po rngam chen 'bar ba'i rong : ri bo rus pa 'bab chu khrag dang zhag: rtsi shing thams cad mda' mdung mtshon cha gzengs: sgra skad thams cad rgyob sod 'brug ltar sgrog: ro langs keng rus gcan spyang nyi li li: ngan sngags 'brug sgra gnam lcags sha ra ra: sha za srog gcod dbugs len rongs se rong : 'chi bdag phra men srog len zhungs se zhung : me 'bar mun rab sprin nag 'u ru ru: sprin gseb gnas nyul ma mo glog ltar myur: srid pa'i ri rab yom yom shig shig 'gul: de 'dra'i gnas nas bzhengs pa'i dbang mo che: che ba lha rnams thams cad nga yi 'khor: chung ba dregs pa sde brgyad nga yi bran: srid pa 'dir gnas nga yi las mkhan te: nga yis dmod pa'i las 'di gnyer ba'i phyir: phyi nang lha dang srung ma sku bskyod 'tshal: dbyings la gnas shing 'gyu ba'i lha tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la:

kun kyang bdag nyid las bcol dpung la bzhengs: dmigs pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces phyogs bcur mchod nas brub khung dmigs bya bskyed pa ni: mdun du gnam lcags las grub hoṃ khung nag po zur gsum kha dog la mthil yangs pa bang rim dgu kha khyer gsum dang ldan pa: kha khyer dang po la sgrol byed shan pa nag mo glog ltar 'khyugs pa: gnyis par lha bdud nag mos gshin skad 'o dod drag tu 'bod pa: gsum par bla 'gugs dus kyi pho mo srid gsum gling bzhi yud kyis bskor zhing dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes skad cig la 'gugs pa: las kyi brub khung chen po de la mngon spyod kyi rtags kun tshang ba gshin rje'i bsad khang bdud kyi bsha' ra: sde brgyad kyi 'du sa: pho nya'i 'gyu lam: klu bdud kyi gre ba: gza' bdud kyi lto ba: srog gcod nyi khri dgu 'bum 'tshogs pa'i gling chen po: gshin yul zangs thang dmar po'i rnam par mngon sum du bkod pa'i mthil du: nṛ tri dmar nag gnyis las bskyed pa'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs: byad ma sdig can de nyid lus sngo zhing ham pa mig shi mig can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzags pa: yan lag mya ngan gyi cha byad can la lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bsdams pa: gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas phyur ba la grang dmyal brgyad kyi ngad dang ldan pas rab tu gzir nas smre sngags kyi skeg bu 'don pa'i dbyibs su bskyed pa'o: bsad khang nag po de'i nang las kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru 'tshubs pa: phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: nang na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba: bar du gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa: logs na phra dog gi thog dang ser ba'i bu yug 'tshubs pa: las kyi bdud mo dam sri ma dang dus mtshan ma mtshan mo rgyu ba: srod la nyul ba sreg ma 'phrog ma skem byed ma bcas bdud mo thams cad cho nge lhang lhang byed pa ste: las kyi pho nya rnams kyis bzung nas thar pa med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur:

bka' bden pa'i stobs kyis 'gugs shing dmigs pa'i rten la dbab pa ni: na moḥ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags gsar rnying rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par nyi ma nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can rigs lnga: u tsa la'i dur khrod chen po nas sku sprul seṅge'i gdong pa can: gsung sprul stag gi gdong pa can: thugs sprul phag gi gdong pa can: yon tan gyi sprul pa dom gyi gdong pa can: phrin las kyi sprul pa spyang ki'i gdong pa can: sgrol byed nag mo lcags kyi gdong pa can: phra men ma bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong pa can: dus kyi pho nya mo dmar mo srog gcod btsan gyi bu mo: sngon mo dbugs len klu yi bu mo: bla 'gugs nag mo bdud kyi bu mo: lo zla zhag dus za ma chu tshod dus kyi pho nya mo: drug cu rtsa bzhi: srid pa'i nag mo shwa thogs rgyan thogs khram thogs rtsis thogs bdud mo bcu gnyis: skye 'gro gling bzhi'i srog bdag mo srin mo khrag gi ral pa can brgyad: ma bhyo dzaḥgasum las 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag ma mo gsum: ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i phra men ma bcu gnyis: dgra lha'i rmu tsa mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad: gzhan yang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro srid pa'i ma mo dus bdag ma gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa dmod pa'i rig sngags drag po 'di la brten nas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma ming nas smos te 'gugs pa'i las su bcol ba ni: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa:

dge 'dun gyi chos sde bcom pa: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i dben ri gnyan po gtor ba: khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag bstan pa'i bdag po rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyi brgyud 'dzin: dpal ldan rnying ma'i chos grwas mtshon pas 'dus sde rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: tshad btsugs pa ya bor bzung ba: do bsdo ba: phod btsugs pa: 'gran btsal ba: 'gras 'tshol ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: chos skyong srung ma'i nus pa gshe ba: gzhan yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: tshe srog la bar du gcod pa: mtho dogs dma' dga' byed pa: sngon 'gugs rgyab 'ded byed pa: shag ngan gyi sna 'dren byed pa: ngos bstod lkog nas smad pa: kha dkar zhing khog nag pa: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: dgra kha dang mi kha zug pa: nad kha dang yams kha 'tshubs pa: ri rgya dang rlung rgya bshig pa: gdan sa mchod zhing 'phrog mi: khyad par du'ang dgra sgo dang gyod sgo 'byed pa: che sri dang chung sri dar sri god sri langs pa: ban byed bon byed skye bo'i mda' zor bud med dmod zor: yugs sa'i thal zor: rig sngags kyi thun zor: zhang zhung gi mthu zor: la sogs pa bdag cag sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum khyim sgo lam gsum: gzhi lam byis gsum thams cad du gnod cing sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi mi rabs bdun rgyud dang bcas pa thams cad: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gling phran gling bar mun bar ban bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga la bkod pa: bla shog bu la bris pa: rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ

zhes rol mo drag rdung dang bcas nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: dza bhyoḥ snang srid ma mo srog bdag har len ma: pho nya mi bsrun bdud kyi dbang mo che: nag mo srod la nyul byed dus la bab: dam nyams byad ma'i bla srog khug la shog: keng keng me 'bar gseb nas rgyug byed ma: dmar mo zangs 'phar gdong can dus la bab: byad ma'i bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: sngo dmar rlabs phyur 'phyo ma mun par gtibs: gcan spyang lag ring gdong can dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dgra bo bla 'khyams khug la shog: bhyoḥ bla 'dzin lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: bla 'ching zhags pa nag pos sdoms la shog: bla 'dzin drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: bla 'ded bya gcan rnams kyis chum la shog: dgra bo'i bla dwags ming byang 'di la phob: byad ma gdug pa'i bla tshe rten dang phrol: gzugs byang 'di la khug cig mā ra ya: tri tri nṛ tri aṅku sha ya dzaḥ thun thun ma tri ma tri dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti thun dza dzaḥ zhes rol mo drag rdung dang bcas nas khug rtags ma byung bar bkug: gu gul yungs dkar thang phrom sha chen bsreg: bya rog 'ug pa'i dang rus lha dang dbye: bhyo dzaḥ mun pa nag po khā kha mu kha ma: dgra bgegs ban bon byad ma lha dang phyes: sdig can brnag pa'i dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha skyes lha phyes: dgra lha srung skyob ban bon rnams dang phyes: bhyoḥ hu lu nag mo dug 'debs 'ug gdong ma: ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra bgegs bdud dang sprod: dmigs pa'i byad ma 'chi bdag bdud dang sprod: dmod pa'i dgra bo srog bdag bdud dang sprod: byad ma sdig can phung bdud nag por sprod: satwar thogs bdud kyi bu mo'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs lha dbye bdud sprad dus la bab: mngon spyod mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: bhyo bhyo khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: tri tri nṛ tri dgra bo shag phyes:

bsad sngags bzla zhing thun gyis gzir ba ni: dzaḥ las byed chen po'i dus la bab: dgra bo phung po bshig pa'i phyir: dmod pa nag po'i thun gyis gdab: dzaḥ yungs thun drag sngags dmod pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: rdo thun rbab rgod hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: dug thun smyo 'bog thibs se thib: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: chu thun sbos 'gas 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: khrag thun nad rlangs chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mtshon thun rno ngar zengs se zeng : dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mda' thun thog rgod sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: gnam lcags phur thun hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ thun bhyo bhyoḥ rig sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs dang ldan pas: gri gug gam ni mkhar phur thogs la: hūm̐ bhyo dzaḥ las la khros pa'i sha za mo: phra men nag mo lcags gdong can: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba bsnams: yar rtse rdo rje rtse lnga yis: ye shes mkha' 'gro las la bskul: 'chang bzung zlum skor chu srin kha: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas: dbal so zangs gri 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bo'i sgo dgur dzaḥkhram ya: phyag g.yon gnam lcags mkhar phur bsnams: mar rtses dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: 'chang bzung gza' bdud pho nya 'gyu: chu srin mtshon cha'i zi ra khol: zur gsum gnam lcags thog rgod 'bebs: srog bdag ma gsum dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can gyi: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chod kyi: dbang po sgo dgur kī la ya: rtsa mdud lnga la kī la ya: dbang po drug la kī la ya: rnam shes brgyad la kī la ya: 'byung bdud gzugs la kī la ya:

pho rgyud mo rgyud kī la ya: rigs rgyud bcas par kī la ya: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: srog gcod dbugs sdud phung po shig: mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra lokka ma tri ya sarba ka ra ti ka ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: badzra kī li kī la ya tri shu la dgra bo'i snying rtsa myog myog mā ra ya phaṭaḥ ces gri gug snying khar btab nas gnas spar ba ni: hoḥ rnam shes ngo bo āḥdakar de: phung po bshig nas klong du thim: phaṭaḥ spu gri chu gri ral gri sogs gang rung thogs la: bhyoḥ gdug pa'i dgra bo byad ma la: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha char pa phob: ming shul tsam yang med par gyis: gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: lha'am 'os kyang brlag par byed: gcod cing gtub pa'i dus la bab: gtubs nas rdo rjes gtun du brdung : rig sngags dmod pa'i byad ma rnams: phye mar shig cig mā ra ya: om̐ badzra ka ra ti ka dgra bo gtub gtub: kha ra ka dgra bo shig shig: a yu dha dgra bo myog myog: badzra kī li kī la ya byad ma bhyo bhyoḥ rbad rbad nan nan chod chod bhandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dum bur gtubs nas sman raka bran la: hūm̐: bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: gnam sa'i zhal gdongs gangs ri'i dbal mche gtsigs: dgra bo byad ma'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rnams: lhag med zhal du bzhes la ming med mdzod: om̐ ḍākki singha mu kha baṃ ha ri ni sa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dbang po lnga dang bcas pa la kha kha khā hi: zhes lhag med bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs par bsam: e ma yang zab spu gri dmar po'i skor: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: dgra bgegs 'byung po rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i tshe: dam nyams bdud rigs bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes gdan drangs pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // pa) bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las:

yang bzlog thog mda' dgu skor bzhugs so: ḍākki seng gdong drag mor 'dud: sa ma ya: yang bzlog bya ba'i las rim la: 'bru nag gtor ma dmar nag liṅgas brgyan: drag mo'i lha tshogs las la rngam par bsam: pha rol g.yul bzlog rngam pa'i dpa' chas gsol: drag po'i rnga rol 'bir zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: bzhengs shig ma sring dbyings nas bzhengs: bdud 'dul drag mo dbyings nas bzhengs: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men stag gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men phag gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men dom gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men spyang gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: bka' skyong khrag ral dbyings nas bzhengs: dbang mo nyer brgyad dbyings nas bzhengs: gnas nyul mkha' 'gro dbyings nas bzhengs: bzhengs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mu stegs 'dul ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: dam sri bsgral ba'i mtshon cha thogs: mtshon cha rdo rje mda' thogs la: 'bar ba rtse gsum thogs pa mo: g.yul las rgyal ba'i gri thod 'dzin: dur khrod rus rgyan g.yang gzhi thogs: khro gnyer mche gtsigs zhal gdang ma: ma mo'i lus la gzi brjid 'phro: mo ni srid gsum g.yo ba mo: dug mtshon me chu'i byad kyis ni: 'jigs par mi nus gtum pa mo: nyid kyi sprul pa'i rol rtsal las: bka' sdod dbang mo nyer brgyad ma: gnas nyul phra men srin mo'i gzugs: lha mo khrag ral mthu mo che: yang 'khor sde brgyad las la 'phyo: srod la rgyu zhing sha la za: mu stegs khrag la dgyes pa mo: dzaḥ phra men chen mo'i dus bab: srid pa'i ma mo glog ma sprin: dza mun gshin rje'i las byed ma: gsod la dga' zhing gcod la rngam: phyag na gnam lcags thog mda' bsnams: byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags yang :

bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: ban de sngags pa'i hoṃ sbar yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mu stegs rnams kyi ngan sngags yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sde brgyad dregs pa'i rbad 'dre rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: lha srin yongs kyi rbod gtong rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: drang srong rnams kyi dmod pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: nag po klu la gtad pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sa bdag gnyan la bcol ba rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: rigs sngags zor kha 'debs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sa nas dug mda' g.yos pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: phyogs nas dmag chen langs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dam sris phyi nang dkrugs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: phung sris gyod kha 'phen pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: 'gong po rbad 'dre thams cad rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur:

lo dang gza' skar mi mthun rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gshed bzhis dur kha 'debs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gzugs med gshin skad 'don pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dur nas bla 'bod byed pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: srid kyi phywa g.yang nyams pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dbul sri phugs su tshud pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: 'byung pos mgo skor byed pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: than dang cho 'phrul 'gyed pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: srung rta'i rgya ma chag pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sme ba rlung rta nyams pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: pho skag mo la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mo skag pho la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: che skag chung la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: chung skag che la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sgas skag gzhon la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gzhon skag sgas la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur:

nor skag mi la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mi skag nor la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: rgyal skag blon la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: blon skag rgyal la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: rje skag 'bangs la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: 'bangs skag rje la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dus skag na skag 'chi skag yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: tshe zad za 'grang thebs pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: brgya dang gos grangs them pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dar sri god sri thams cad yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: pha rol byad ma sdig can gyi: rang mthu rang nus steng du zlog: dgra bo'i lha srung gshed du phob:

sde brgyad za kha dgra la ston: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e ka du na e sa bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e ka du ru bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ma tri ya tri re ma ti bhyo zlog: na sha tsa tu du ma ya aḥ trig khroṃ bhyo zlog: ma ṇi ma ra bhyo bzlog: mā ra ya du bhyo zlog: rbad sa ma ya bhyo zlog: ha la ha la hal ta hal ta bhyo zlog: sarba ka khor dha mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces lag rdeb bya zhing dgra bgegs byad ma'i phyogs su 'phang ngo : dmigs pa ni: gtor ma gnam lcags kyi ri rab zur gsum pa rno dbal dug mtshon 'debs pa'i shugs ldan gyis ri rab mgo mjug log pa ltar 'phangs pas: pha rol byad ma'i yul zhing srung skyob ban bon mkhar khang dang bcas pa mgo mjug ldog nas thal me'i 'obs su chu blugs pa ltar phyur zhing ming shul tsam yang med par bsgom: sa ma ya: yang bzlog man ngag khyad par can: phyi rabs bu yi don slad du: ma hā gu ru'i bka' gnang bzhin: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: bka' srung tsa ti drag mor bcol: sangs rgyas ye shes skyes mtha' nyid: hūm̐ gi ming dang 'phrad par shog: dam med lag tu ma shor rgya:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs mgul dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus pa dge legs 'phel lo// // pha) bdud 'dul drag mo'i 'phang ba zor bzlog dug gi spu gri bzhugs so: bdud 'dul chen mo singha mu khar 'dud: drag mo seng gdong ma'i las bskul 'phang ba zor ltar rdzongs pa'i lag len ni: lcags snod drag po'i nang ngam gang rung du: 'bru nag dag la dmar gyi gtor ma ni: che ba gcig la 'khor dgus bskor bar bya: kong zor dang ni de mthar rtsang gis brgyan: khrag kyu sha dum rgyan dang mchod rdzas sogs: mkho ba'i rdzas rnams phun sum tshogs par bsham: gzhan yang gtso bo dmar gtor che dag gi: zur gsum ri rab lta bu'i logs gsum la: khram shing dang ni nad rkyal nam rgyangs gzugs: de nas gong gi las rim grub rjes su: rol mo brjid ldan bag dro lhun chags ngang : dang po 'di skad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na: u tsa la yi dur khrod nas: me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil du: ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri: rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung : 'bab chu khrag rnag dmar chen 'khyil: sgra skad hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong ldir: khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing : rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas skyi g.ya' ba: phyag na rdo rje 'jigs pa'i sa: rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas: yum chen phar phyin gshegs su gsol: rdo rje phag mo gshegs su gsol: bdud 'dul drag mo gshegs su gsol: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi gshegs su gsol: bka' skyong ma mo gshegs su gsol: gter srung klu bdud gshegs su gsol: yang 'khor gnas nyul gshegs su gsol: om̐ baṃ singha ḍākki badzra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa dzaḥ rakṣi ta na ga phe sha dza dzaḥ

dgra bo byad ma'i sha khrag la kha kha khā hi: zhes rtsa sngags la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de nas raktas bran zhing gtor ma 'degs: dpal 'bar sgron nas 'cham stabs kyi zor bcas 'phang ste bzlog pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod u tsa la: rab 'jigs me rlung 'khrugs pa e yi klong : shin tu ya nga sha za'i gnas mchog nas: bdud 'dul snang srid bdag mo dbyings nas bzhengs: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: ye shes sgrib cing dug lnga sdang ba'i rlung : gzi brjid mdangs chen g.yo ba'i stobs kyis zlog: ye shes dbyings kyi ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha dmod tshig rkyen ngan dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: seng gdong dmar mo 'jigs pa'i sgra chen sgrog: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: pho rgyud khro bo'i byad dang skag chen rnams: rab 'jigs bskul ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'jigs byed srog bdag ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dbu skra dmar nag dbyings khyab thod brgyan mas: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: mo rgyud ma mo'i dal yams cho 'phrul rnams: dpa' gtum gshe ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: drag rtsal dbugs sdud ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phyag g.yas gri gug dug lnga rtsad gcod mas: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i byad: rngam byed gzhom pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: sha za gnas nyul ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur:

thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: g.yon pas thod khrag gdug pa'i snying 'byin mas: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: pha rol ban byad bon byad mnan bsregs rnams: gtum drag tshar gcod stobs ky-is bzlog tu gsol: khrag 'thung zhing skyong ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rus rgyan kha ṭwāṃ me long rgyan ldan mas: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'd-i bzhes la: sngon las 'phral rkyen byad zor phur kha rnams: 'gying rtsal 'khril ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: las byed khram thogs ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: thal tshon khrag zhag zhing glang rgyan ldan mas: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nad mug mtshon kha dal yams than ltas rnams: khro 'gying zil gnon stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: las byed gnas nyul ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dar dpyangs thod phreng stag sham rol stabs can: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: gtad ser ngag mnan phung shing rdzas sbyor rnams: drag cing gzir ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'gyu byed sman btsan ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: pad nyi ro gdan me dpung rab 'khrigs mas: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: snga dgra phyi dgra sgos dgra chom rkun rnams: drag rtsal gshe ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol:

las byed ma mo yang sprul dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bhyo bhyo zlog zlog byad ma sna dgu zlog: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas gdong bzhi pa'i zor bzlog thogs nas: hūm̐: shar phyogs stag gdong sku sprul bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: shar phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: rtsa sngags kyis: hūm̐: lho phyogs yon tan phag gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: lho phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: nub phyogs gsung sprul dom gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : pha rol mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: nub phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: byang phyogs phrin las spyang gdong bye ba 'bum:

dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: byang phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: rtsa sngags kyis 'phang : de nas khrag ral ma'i bskul zor thogs la: hūm̐ bhyoḥ rakta'i rba rlabs 'phyo zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus: gtso mo'i thugs sprul srog bdag srin gzugs ma: dmar nag khrag gi mdog can skur bzhengs shig: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: dkon mchog bka' chad sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: snga dgra phyi dgra 'chang zhing gdug rtsub can: slob ma dam log yon bdag gzhungs ngan dang : dam tshig bka' bcag nyan thos snying ngan can: rkun 'phrog bcom zhing g.yab dar shag 'debs rnams: lo zla zhag dang za ma chu tshod la: ring par ma bzhag srog rtsa chod la shog: snying khrag rngubs shig 'dus byas sdus la shog: rnam shes srog dbugs rten dang phrol la shog: bskul lo bka' skyong ma mo mthu ma chung : dug zor nag po zhe sdang ru tra'i snying : dbal zor dmar po myur mgyogs khro mo'i rdzas: rngam 'debs nag po srog bdud zhags pa 'khyugs: bzlog zor dmar po ma mo'i khrag nad zor: dam nyams dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing la: btab bo klu bdud nag po'i mdze nad bzhin: dgra la skar stong bye ba bdun brgyar thob: rtsad chod yul 'joms lhag rjes med par thongs: rag mo du ling nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ har ling kaṅka ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mu kha mi bdud nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ e ka ru lu nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ ru ra li shi nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la dmar nag snying gzer khrag bshal ya:

'go nad rgyug 'gyel sha khul 'dar ling ya: sbos 'gas rlangs 'thab dug mda' rgyug 'gyel ya: chos chos zor zor ma mo mthu ma chung : dgra bo gnam sa go ldog 'gyu bzhin du: nad rlangs dug dang dbyer med phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma mo rakmo raksha tri tri sha ru tra ma waka tsi nṛ tri chod chod: rbad tsitta snying la bhyo bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas zor chen thogs la: hūm̐ bhyoḥ bzhengs shig mi mngon chos sku'i klong nas bzhengs: brgyud ldan rig 'dzin grub thob dbyings nas bzhengs: bdud 'dul gtso mchog seng gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: srog gcod ma mo mched bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: myur mgyogs khrag ral bdud sman dbyings nas bzhengs: bskal pa'i me 'bar dug mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs: dug rlangs bu yug 'tshub ma'i klong nas bzhengs: srog len mun ltar gtibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: sngags 'chang bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig cing rtsad nas bcad: dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad cing kha yog bkal: dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i thugs dkrugs dbyen phyung brtson: dge bcu khyad gsod mi dge dwang du blangs: mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: chos skyong sngags kyi srung mar do bsdo ba'i: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams sdig can 'dis: steng nas gza' nad char ltar 'bebs su chug: bar nas btsan gzer rlung ltar 'tshub tu chug: 'og nas rlung nad mun ltar gtib tu chug: bskul lo rbad do mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : g.yab bo chos shig sha za rtsal ma zhan: nyes can bstan pa'i ru tra nag po 'di: lo zla zhag dang za dus 'da' ma byed: da lta skad cig bla srog chod la shog: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha zo khrag la 'thung : mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal skom skye rgyud chod: mthun grogs yul khyim rten gnas chags yul rnams: gnam lcags thog gis ri rab bshig pa ltar:

thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ baṃ singha ḍākki bai ro tsa na badzra bha ra hi kro ti ka li ha ri ni sa ma mo raksha kha kha mu kha ru lu mu kha nag mo bhe tri nag mo dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e sa bhyo zlog: ces zlog sngags dang bcas dgra phyogs su 'phang : dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing dang bcas pa rdul du brlag par the tshom med: de nas rta bro bya zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu: hoḥ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i yo byad ma tshang dang : ma 'byor dam nyams 'di phyi'i sgrib g.yogs rnams: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags: dkyil 'khor ngo bo 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ yig gyen ldog mi dmigs chos skur āḥ gsal stong gdod ma'i dbyings phyug mngon gyur shog: a a āḥ zhes skye med ngang la ci gnas bzhag: e ma kho bo pad 'byung ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: zor bzlog dug gi 'khor lo bzhag: phyi nang rkyen bzlog phrin las myur: 'di nyid rbad bskul drag bcol bas: tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yul yang 'joms: rkyen ngan dgra sogs lta ci smos: yang bzlog spu gri nag po 'di: ma 'ongs sum cu'i yang mtha' la: bar chod sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: snying thig ma mo khrag ral mas: ma yi brda 'di thub par srungs: da lta'i dpal chen ye shes 'di: ma 'ongs las 'brel gling zhes grags: gsang mtshan hūm̐ gi mtshan can la: sprod cig sngags bdag lcam gcig mas: dam nyams byad ma'i snying khrag 'thung : 'gong po'i lag tu ma shor rgya: drag mo brda skyong tha tshig rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bka' rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: ྀatsha: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel gling pas kun ldan sa phag lor jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas dag par bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o// // ba) ༈ ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las:

drag po me'i las mtha' spu gri dmar po zab rgya can bzhugs so: ḍākki seng gdong drag mor 'dud: sa ma ya: gang zhig mu stegs ban bon dang : sbyor ngan 'chang ba'i dgra bo'i rigs: myur du gsod pa'i spu gri'i mtshon: drag po me yi las mtha' bstan: sa ma ya: rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can gsal ba'i mdun du: lcags zangs kyi snod sogs gang rung du me khrol blugs la bzhag: thod ting ngam zangs lcags kyi theb kyi nang du nyungs dkar bshams la: me dang nyungs dkar chu gtsang gis bran la: na mo: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang : ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pas gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dang bcas pa thams cad yungs dkar 'di la khug cig: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig gis 'gug gzhug byas la bstim: oṃ bi shwa ḍākki nī hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las me khrol mi dmigs pa drag po'i thab khung gru gsum kha khyer la ral gris mtshan pa: bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su: hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las: me lha seng gdong ma sku mdog mthing nag phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag kha ṭwām̐ bsnams nas gar stabs su rol ba: de las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs shing gnyis su med par gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

de nas yungs dkar 'bru re re mtheb srin gyi bar du bzung la me khrol khar bskor zhing : a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces yungs dkar bye ma dngos su bsam pa de: seng zhal gnam sa tsam gdangs par me 'bar ba'i nang du 'phang bar dmigs: grangs brgya rtsa song nas: badzra ḍākki singha mu kha arghaṃ sogs ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta oṃ āḥhūm̐ kha kha khā hi khā hi: bhyoḥ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs: drag mo khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: nam mkha'i mdog can me 'od can: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: mthar me 'od du zhu nas rang gi snying gar thim par dmigs: stong nyid kyi rgyas gdab par bya'o: bdun brgya dgu stong sogs man ngag las byung ba ltar gnad du bsnun pa zhal shes so: sa ma ya: mthar gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub nas 'byung ba ltar: 'byung ba go ldog dang yang zlog go ldog sogs bzla zhing : dmigs pa'ang de bzhin bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ sreg pa me yi spu gri 'di: myur du gsod pa'i mtshon cha yin: man ngag snying gi dug mda' yin: hūm̐ gi ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྀatsha: bka' rgya can no: maṅga laṃ// // ma) ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong can ma las: mtshan bcas srung bzlog rdo rje'i go khrab bzhugs so: ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mor 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma seng gdong drag mo yi: mtshan bcas srung bzlog 'khor lo bstan: dang po srung ba'i 'khor lo ni: dar dkar ram ni shog bu la: dri bzang sman chus byugs byas la: rang nyid shar du kha gyu shing : ngag tu yi ge bcu bzhi bzla: ye shes spyan drangs yang yang bstim: 'khor lo mu khyud bdun bskor ba'i: lte bar rdo rje rgya gram dbus: hūm̐ mthar rigs bdag rtsa sngags dgod: sbrul 'khyil ltar ram 'don thabs bya: oṃ gu ru singha swa ra gaṇḍe hūm̐: hūm̐ nṛ bhrūm̐: badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ
