de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ mūm̐ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ hūm̐ nṛ bhrūm̐: sprin chen 'bub pa ltar bya na: bdag cag dpon slob? sogs dang rang srung kho nar ming spel 'bri: gzhan srung dag la: gang gi tshe la'ang : bdag 'chang ba po la deng 'dir pha rol kyi byad khram gtad mnan phur kha rbod gtong ngan pa dang : rno ba'i dbal: sbyor ba'i dug gang gis kyang mi tshugs par srungs shig: ma mā ka wa tsi sogs rang srung dang : da na pa ti sogs gzhan srung kha bsgyur shes par bya'o: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: shar gyi dang po dbu steng na: oṃ badzra ḍākki bam̐ hūm̐: de bzhin g.yas lhor: oṃ ratna ḍākki bam̐ hūm̐: 'og nub tu: oṃ padma ḍākki bam̐ hūm̐: g.yon byang du: oṃ karma ḍākki bam̐ hūm̐: rtsibs mchan du: dzaḥbadzra tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐: hūm̐ ratna tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐: bam̐ padma tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐: hoḥkarma tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐: bar khyams sbrul 'khyil nang du: oṃ bi shwa ḍākki tsa tur bam̐ hūm̐ tsakra rakṣa: tshar bzhi dang : de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ deng 'dir 'chang ba po? sogs mi bsgyur ba gong dang 'dra ba'i sham bur: yi dam lha'i bka' chad: mkha' 'gro khros pa'i bar chad: chos srung 'khu ba'i gdug rtsub: lha srin sde brgyad yongs kyi byad kha: ban bon sngags pa yongs kyi byad phur: gtad khram ngag mnan dbye sprad mdo brub skye bo'i mda' zor bud med kyi thal zor byis pa'i rdo zor drang srong dmod zor rno ba'i dbal: sbyor ba'i dug thams cad kyis mi tshugs par srungs shig: de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la: dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po'i mthar: gong gi sham bu'i mjug tu: bkra mi shis pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig: su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: phyogs bzhir rdo rje rgya gram bzhi: mtshams bzhir phyag mtshan gri gug bzhi:

phyi rol me ri 'bar bas bskor: mdzes tshon dag gis mdog kyang bsgyur: rang sngags khri yis rab gnas dang : rten 'brel snying po'i mtha' brten bya: byad khrol dag gi rdzas kyang byug: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ gnyis pa bzlog pa'i 'khor lo ni: mu khyud rim pa bdun bskor bas: lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus: hūm̐: zur gsum du: e yam̐ ram̐: zur gsum du: bam̐ lam̐ kham̐: zur drug mchan du: bhyoḥ drug: oṃ bam̐ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ ha li ka la na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: tsa ti ma tri dgra la bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ badzra ḍākki bam̐ bhyo zlog: oṃ ratna ḍākki bam̐ bhyo zlog: oṃ padma ḍākki bam̐ bhyo zlog: oṃ karma ḍākki bam̐ bhyo zlog: rtsibs mchan bzhi la: shar phyogs lha 'dre mi gsum gyi byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la zlog: de bzhin du lho nub byang sogs rim par dgod: gong bzhin sbrul 'khyil du: oṃ bi shwa ḍākki tsa tur bam̐ bhyoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shar lho lho nub nub byang byang shar gyi lha 'dre mi gsum gyi byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la zlog: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: las sngags bcu bzhi'i mthar sham bu gong gi srung ba ltar la: dgra bo kho rang gi steng du bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka aḥ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma'i sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: tsitta la rbad rbad: myog myog thum ril rbad: ha tri nag po dgra bo byad ma'i steng du bhyoḥ du tri nag po dgra bo byad ma'i steng du bhyoḥ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa nṛ tri trig nan nan: e hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad rbad: bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog:

ces 'bri: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: mtshon cha sna tshogs phyir bstan 'bri: de'i phyir me rlung 'tshub ma 'bri: dug khrag nyungs dkar gu gul dang : thang phrom re lcag thog gran dang : gri sha la sogs rdzas kyis byug: 'bri tshe go ldog sngags kyang brjod: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug pa: yang zab rdo rje'i go khrab 'di: phyi rabs skal ldan bu yi don: rgyun du spros med mi 'byor cing : rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi le lo'i dbang : song na bar chod sdang gyur na: de phyir srung bzlog zab mo'i chos: sprin chen ltar ram lus la 'ching : bsam gtan nyal chog gdams pa 'di: kun la ma spel snying la chongs: kho mo mtsho rgyal dgongs pa'i bcud: zhing skyong dbang pos thub par srungs: dam med lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang gnam lcags badzra rtsal gyis jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs mgul/ dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // tsa) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las: gza' srung rdo rje'i go cha rdzas srung lcags mchu nag po zab rgya can bzhugs so: bdud 'dul ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong las: gza' srung rdo rje'i go khrab ni: dang po 'bri ba: gnyis pa rab tu gnas pa: gsum pa 'dogs shing 'ching ba'o: dang po 'bri ba ni: rgya shog dar ras shing shog gang rung la: rgya snag nang du rin chen brdar phye bsres: phyag na rdo rje sdigs mdzub can 'bri: dbus su mu khyud kyis bskor la re'u mig gsum du gcod: dbus kyi re'u mig la: oṃ badzra mi ki dza la tshu lu rakṣa rakṣa: g.yas su: oṃ rakṣa gheṃ dhe hu lu hu lu swā hā: g.yon du: oṃ badzra ratna ka ra hu la mu lu mu swā hā: de rgyab kyi mu khyud la: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de rgyab kyi rtsibs bzhir 'bri: rtsibs bzhi'i shar nas brtsam ste rim bzhin du: oṃ badzra rag se rakmo swā hā: lhor: oṃ badzra rakmo rakmo mu lu swā hā: nub tu: oṃ badzra rakmo rakmo bde me swā hā: byang du: oṃ badzra rakmo rakmo mi me swā hā: zhes 'bri: de rgyab kyi rtsibs brgyad la shar nas rim bzhin 'di ltar dgod: oṃ badzra sha sha ram̐ dha ra dha ra swā hā: shar lhor: oṃ badzra me me ram̐ ram̐ dhu ru dhu ru swā hā: lhor: oṃ badzra bha dha re dha re swā hā: lho nub tu: oṃ badzra sham sham dha ro dha ro swā hā: nub tu: oṃ badzra kham̐ kham̐ kha dha swā hā: nub byang du: oṃ badzra sam̐ sa sam̐ sa dha sa dha swā hā: byang du: oṃ badzra du shan ti du na ma gha na swā hā: oṃ ma sham lhang lhang tsher tsher bag ti ban swā hā: byang shar du 'god do: des rgyab kyi mu khyud la: oṃ badzra srin srin mu sha ma nyya na ma shu ka ha ru mu ru su ra bhu dha swā hā: oṃ badzra tri sham haṃ tri su tri su tri ru ma: gza' kha tra ru tra ye swā hā: oṃ badzra na ma yaksha badzra tsaṇḍa kro ta hu lu hu lu: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha: bhandha bhandha: ha na ha na: a mṛ ta hūm̐ dzaḥ rakṣa rakṣa: de rgyab mu khyud gsum bskor la: dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po 'bri: de rgyab rdor phreng me ris bskor: yi ge bcu bzhis rab tu gnas: ༈ gnyis pa 'khor lo'i rab gnas ni: tsakra maṇḍal kha ru bsham: spos thun bgegs bskrad stong par sbyang : rang nyid dpal chen phyag rdor bsgom: stong pa'i ngang las tsakra hūm̐ du bsgom: 'od zer 'phros pas lus rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsgom: yang 'od zer 'phros pas dpal chen phyag rdor gsal: 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams su gza' brgyad: lte bar rā hu la yab yum sras gsum: rgyu skar la sogs gza' thams cad gsal: 'khor lo'i lte bar lha'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu bsgom: ye shes pa'i lha tshogs phyag na rdo rje la gza'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs:

'khor lo lha dang gnyis med bstim: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho sa brtan par bya: mchod pas mchod: yi ge bcu bzhi pa rang sngags stong rtsas rab gnas me tog 'thor: rjes su rang sngags rten 'brel snying po dang phyag rdor rtsa sngags kyis brlab: dmigs su gtad pa drag po bya: ྀatsha: gsum pa rjes su gdags pa ni: yab kyi srung ba zangs rdo: yum gyi srung ba bya'i klad pa: rā hu la'i srung ba gri khrag gsum: 'khor lo'i nang du btsud nas tshon skud kyis bcings: thum dmar nag gam: ra'i pags pas dril nas btags pas rab rdzas srung ngam rdzas bdug dang bcas pa ni rdo rje'i go char gyur te/ gza'i gnod pa'i rigs mtha' dag gis gnod pa thams cad srung ngo : na ba smyo ba la 'dogs na nad las grol nges so: mi bzlog mi srid do: 'di dpal phyag na rdo rje la gza' yab yum sras gsum: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad gza' brgyad rigs lnga gdong mo bzhi bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu: ye 'drog gza'i gdon lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyi srog snying phul ba'i srog sngags 'di yin pas: yi ge 'di rnams yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa'i sham du bzlas na drang srong gza' las rgyal bar 'gyur ro: sngags chu bya na nad las dgrol lo: khrus bya na grib 'dag: rdzas srung ril bu 'dogs na rdo rje pha lam du 'gyur ro: pha rol gyi nus pa phyag na rdo rje lta bu'i rbod gtong la 'gran kyang tshul mi ldog: gzhan la phan thogs bla na med pa'i gdams pa zab mo yin no: dpal phyag na rdo rjes bdag padma 'byung gnas la dur khrod gsang chen rol du gnang ba yin no: padma'i thugs kyi man ngag 'di gar thod du ma spel cig: snying 'dra'i bu gcig brgyud du gtod cig: bka' rgya: ྀatsha: gu hya: rdzas srung ni: gza' nad kyis zin pa la: gza' bsad cing gso ba'i man ngag zab mo ni: bong nga nag po: gu gul nag po: mu zi nag po: gla rtsi nag po: shu dag nag po:

shing kun: sgog pa: sre mong gi sha: ti lo'i sha: spyang brun: phag khrag: byi la nag po'i brun: khyi nag gi brun: phag brun: bya pho mtshal lus spu gzhob: rta dmar po'i rnga rngog gi gzhob: yugs sa'i dor rta bsregs pa'i thal ba: dme pho'i lham tshang bsregs thal: sran ma'i me tog rnams zhib par btul: sngags pa'i gsang chab dang sbyar nas ril bu sran 'bru tsam byas nas: yi ge bcu bzhis 'khor lor sngags stong tsho'am brgya rtsas ngar blud nas: nangs ma re la khong du gtong zhing dud pa bdug pas gza' nad sos par the tshom med: gza' nad 'joms pa'i man ngag khyad par can no: ྀatsha: yang srin bya'i klad pa zangs rdo gri khrag: rma bya'i mdongs rnams phye mar byas te: dri chu dang sbyar nas rag sder gyi nang du sran ma tsam dril te: yi ge bcu bzhi pas sngags stong btab ste: rang gzhan bsrung na zla ba 'byung ngo cog gi tshes gcig la re re bza' na: gza' klu'i gtad pa sogs drag las ci byas kyang rang la 'khu ldog mi 'byung zhing srung bar nges so: nad pa la nangs re bzhin tu re re dus gsum du byin na nad las grol bar 'gyur ro: shin tu zab bo: ྀatsha: gu hya: brda thim: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: dur khrod gsang chen 'bar ba ru: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal dngos mthong : gsang ba'i bdag pos gtad rgya gnang : gter gyi lde'u mig mang du bstsal: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i chos rnams rnyed: mu stegs laṅka'i bdag po sogs: ston pa sde drug rang mthus phung : nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas: bdag nyid drin du mi che'am: ma 'ongs don du yi ger btab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal gyi dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // tsha) ༈

ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las: za yig bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho nyes pa zhi bar byed pa bzhugs so: ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ḍākkir 'dud: sa ma ya: nyes pa zhi bar byed pa yi: za yig bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bstan: srung bzlog man ngag rin po che: bya sla don che'i las mtha' 'di: nus med sngags btsun don du bstan: da lta mnga' bdag yab sras kyis: sku srung nus pa'i man ngag yin: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: thog mar srung ba'i za yig ni: nang 'gras byung na srung zlog thabs: gser ram sindhu ra yis 'bri: 'bri mar du btum yar dril la: tshes brgyad gsum gyi dus de la: byad ma'i phyogs la lan dgu g.yug: yig mgo phyir bstan dril la za: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: btsun pa dam ldan dang 'gras na: srung ba'i za yig ni: zhes dngul gyis bris la bco lnga zla ba shar dus yig mgo phyir dril: byad ma'i phyogs la lan nyer gcig g.yon bskor byas te za'o: ྀatsha: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bande dang 'gras na srung ba ni: yi ge mtshal gyis bris la dgra phyogs su g.yon bskor dgu bya: mgo nas mar dril la za'o:

zhes so: ྀatsha: sngags pa nus can dang 'gras na: srung ba mtshal dang padma'i raktas bris nas dgra phyogs su g.yug cing chos bskor nyer gcig byas te dril la za'o: yi ge bcu bzhi tshar nyer gcig bzla'o: shin tu zab bo: ྀatsha: bon po'i byad gtad srung ba ni: ra khrag dang phag khrag gis bris te nyi ma shar ma thag tu dgra phyogs la lan dgu chos bskor byas nas g.yug: yig mgo phyir bstan nas dril: yi ge bcu bzhi pa bzla'o: zab bo: ྀatsha: bon po'i sngags byad srung ba la: ra khrag dang phag khrag gis bris la mgo nas dril: byad ma'i phyogs la bon bskor dgu byas la za'o: bon sngags byad gtad srung ba zab: ྀatsha: rang gis gzhan klu gtad byed pa dang : gzhan gyis rang la gtad byed pa sogs: gtad kyi nyes pa thams cad srung ba ni: sindhu ra dang gi waṃ gis bris la: nyi zla'i zer la yig mgo phyir bstan chos bskor nyer gcig byed la za'o: ces gtad srung zab bo: ྀatsha: yang bzlog za yig mgo non ni: rin chen gser dngul dag gis 'bri: mjug nas yar dril te za'o: 'di ni srung bzlog bsad gsum dril ba'i yang bzlog log non yin pas zab bo: de dag kun gyi las sbyor dus: yi ge bcu bzhi stong phrag gam: brgya phrag bar du gang 'grub bzla: 'di yis mi srung mi bzlog med: shin tu zab rgya snying la chongs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྀatsha: brgyad par bzlog bsad las tshogs za yig ni: rgya shog rgya snag sha shun dang : 'gro ba'i phru ma dag la 'bri: sde brgyad lha 'dre'i gnod pa dang : nad rigs gdon rigs thams cad bzlog cing 'joms pa'i za yig 'di: sindhu ra dang gi waṃ gis bris nas phyed yar dril phyed mar dril te: rang bar snang du bltas te za'o: ྀatsha: byad rigs rmi lam ngan dang than ltas ngan: nad rigs gdon rigs nyes pa'i rigs thams cad zlog pa'i za yig rdo rje pha lam 'di: rgya shog la sindhu ra dang rin po che gi waṃ gis bris nas rten 'brel snying po nyer gcig gis rab gnas byed:

mjug nas yar dril la bon bskor dgu byas nas dgong mo za'o: zab bo: ྀatsha: gza'i gnod pa spyi 'joms kyi za yig ra khrag gis 'bri: zhes yi ge bcu bzhi pa stong gis rab gnas bya: gza' brgyad spyi dril yar dril: rā hu mar dril za'o: zab bo: ྀatsha: pho gza' rigs kyi za yig 'di ra khrag gis bris nas yar dril: yig mgo phyir bstan nas yi ge bcu bzhis rab gnas byas te za'o: ྀatsha: yang na ma ning gza'i yi ge 'di'ang gong ltar byas te za'o: shin tu zab bo: ྀatsha: gza' nad spyi'i za yig 'di: ra rog po'i khrag dang gri khrag dang gri sha gu gul gyis bris la: de rnams rdzas byugs shing rgya snag gis bris kyang rung ngo : zab rgya: ྀatsha: ma 'ongs rgyal po 'gong po dang : bsen mo 'dre mo rlung ltar 'tshub: de yis mi 'dod sna tshogs byed: de yis gnod cing 'tshe ba na: srung bzlog bsad gsum gdams pa bstan: dang po srung ba'i za yig ni: gza' spyi bcos za yig yin: 'di rgya shog la ra dkar khyi dmar gyi khrag dang spre'u'i sha gu gul dri mas khyab par byug: rgya snag gis bris la za'o: dang po srung ba'i za yig 'di 'jug nas yar dril la: yi ge bcu bzhi stong phrag bzlas nas snga dro za'o: ྀatsha: rgyal po bzlog pa'i za yig 'di mgo nas mar dril la: yi ge bcu bzhi pa bzlas la dgong mo za'o: ྀatsha: bsad pa'i za yig ni: yar dril te dgong mo za: yi ge bcu bzhi pa stong tsho bzla'o: de ltar rgyal po spyi'i srung bzlog bsad gsum shin tu zab bo: ྀatsha: gu hya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyan dang lhog pa'i za yig 'di: gla rtsi gu gul shu dag gsum dang bcas: klu nad can dang nad ro can la sman chen bsnan nas za'o: ྀatsha: gnyan dang lhog pa'i za yig gong gi rdzas dang bcas nas yar dril te: yi ge bcu bzhi brgya phrag bzla la za'o: ྀatsha: gza' gnyan klu rigs gdug pa can: kun thub chen po'i za yig 'di:

mar gyi zhun mar bsregs la thal ba khong du gtong : lus kyi na sar byug go: ྀatsha: sman mo'i za yig yung ba dang lhan cig dril ste: yi ge bcu bzhi brgya phrag bzla la za'o: zhes yar dril la za'o: ྀatsha: dam sri ya ma'i za yig 'di: mjug nas yar dril yi ge bcu bzhi pa brgya phrag bzlas la srod du za'o: ྀatsha: khyi dang gcan gzan thub pa'i za yig 'di: mjug nas yar dril la yi ge bcu bzhi pa brgya phrag bzla la za'o: ྀatsha: chung sri 'gog pa'i za yig 'di: gi waṃ ngam kha che'i chus bris la mjug nas yar dril la za'o: yi ge bcu bzhi pa stong phrag bdun bzlas nas phu btab bo: ྀatsha: ltas ngan dang mtshan ngan rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa'i za yig 'di yar dril: yi ge bcu bzhi brgya rtsa bzlas la de ma thag za'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gos grib srung ba dang sel bar byed pa'i za yig 'di yar dril la: yi ge bcu bzhi pa lnga bcu bzlas la tho rangs skar chu rta byas la za'o: ྀatsha: zas grib srung ba'i za yig gong ltar byas la: ྀatsha: dug srung ba dang nad rnams la phan pa'i za yig ni: rma bya'i mdongs dang sha bcas yar dril la: yi ge bcu bzhi brgya phrag bzlas la za'o: ྀatsha: nad rigs thams cad dang bgegs rigs lha srin sde brgyad thams cad thub pa'i kun thub chen mo'i za yig 'di: byang sems dkar dmar ram sindhu ras byugs la: phyed yar dril phyed mar dril nas mar gyis btum la za'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ gzhan phan srung ba'i za yig 'di: phyi rabs skal ldan don slad du: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbas: dam med lag tu ma shor rgya: mang du ma spel yid la chong : sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal gangs kyi mgul dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs pa'o// // dza) mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo las: them med las tshogs kha bsgyur bzhugs so:

bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong la 'dud: de'ang dbyings kyi dpal mo seṅge'i gdong can gyi gtor zlog gi las tshogs zab mo bstan pa ni: mtha' dag dus 'khrug bzlog pa dang : gdon chen 'dre rgod 'dul ba dang : smyo 'bog rgyal nad 'dul ba dang : ltas ngan yul sdig bzlog pa dang : bstan pa'i ru tra bsgral ba dang : pha rol rbod gtong bzlog pa dang : de ltar kha bsgyur bdun gyis bstan: sa ma ya: dang po dal yams bzlog pa ni: gtor zlog gzhung bzhin bshams nas ni: thal chen khrag sna dug sna dang : yungs dkar rgyal po rdo phye dang : lcags phye zangs phye de rnams la: drag sngags brgya stong skabs bstun bzla: a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ sarba ḍākki nī zlog: ha he mo ha hṝ dā ya: sa ri ha ri ta ya: kha ling ta ya: mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya: bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: a la pra mo he bhyo bhyoḥ a ti pra mo zlog: nad kha zlog: dal kha zlog: yams nad zlog: de ltar thun gtor drag po'i sar: zor kong bcu ru dug khrag blug: bon po'i srid pa'i lha gsol brdar: bu mo gtsang ma lnga yis ni: me long khrus chu mda' dar g.yab: skyes pas go mtshon rgyan gos gzab: de nas grong yul gang bsrung ba'i: phyogs bzhi mtshams nas gtor 'phen skabs: skyes pa gshed bzhi lo pa bzhi'i: gdong la khrag thig sol ba byug: zor kong steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'phang : srung yul thal rgyas bskor nas kyang : phyogs mtshams skyer phur sor bzhi gdab: bdud 'dul drag mo rigs bzhi bsgom: gong gi thun rdzas drag po rnams: dbang mo nyer brgyad bzlog sngags 'di: drag tu bzlas shing phyogs bcur gtor: oṃ bam̐ ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ oṃ ma nu raksha si bhyoḥ prahma ṇi bhyoḥ rau trī ma bhyoḥ bha na bhe bhyoḥ ku mā ri bhyoḥ ind+ra ma bhyoḥ ka la ma bhyoḥ badzra bhi ka la ma bhyoḥ a mṛ ta bhyoḥ su u me bhyoḥ

da dha ha bhyoḥ raksha si bhyoḥ bhaksha si bhyoḥ tsa ka la ma bhyoḥ badzra ra tri ma bhyoḥ re ti re ma tri bhyoḥ e ka tsa ra ma bhyoḥ ma nu ha ra ma bhyoḥ si dha ka bhyoḥ bha ya bhya bhyoḥ ku la ma bhyoḥ badzra ma ra ṇa bhyoḥ agna ye bhyoḥ bha ra hi bhyoḥ tsa mun tri bhyoḥ urdha ma bhyoḥ bā ru na bhyoḥ lambho dhā ra bhyoḥ bzlog bsgyur bhyo bstun thal rdeb bya: dmag chas mtshon rtags bswo sgra sgrogs: me chu'i rgyas kyis bskor bar bya: nang du log nas bkra shis brjod: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor: dam ldan sngags pa nus ldan gyis: 'di yi las sbyor 'bad pa na: 'di yis mi bzlog mi srid do: shin tu gnyan zab snying dang 'dra: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: (2) mtha' dmag dus 'khrug bzlog pa ni: de'ang gtor zlog gzhung bzhin la: dmar chen gtor zor drag po bzhengs: dam ldan sngags pa mang du 'tshogs: shar du rab byung lnga'am bdun: gzungs sgrub bya zhing bkra shis brjod: lho nas khye'u bkra shis bdun: glu gar bro sogs rol mo bya: nub tu sngags pa dam ldan bdun: dam brdar chos skyong las la bskul: byang nas bu mo lnga sogs kyis: me long mda' dar khrus chu thogs: hrī ma ha ri ni sa hūm̐: ra tsa hri ya ging ka ra ā yurdzñā na siddhi hūm̐: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis dzap tu bzla: brag nag chu 'gram rdo nag la: dug khrag sbyar ba'i snag tsha yis: bhyo bzlog mtha' dmag g.yul 'khrug zlog: bris nas re nag steng du bzhag: mda' la gshin rje'i zlog sngags bri: zor kong bcu la dug khrag blugs: yungs dkar tshe zor dag kyang btsugs: bon po'i lha gsol gsas g.yang brdar: zhag ni gsum lnga bdun sogs bsgrub: de nas nyi ma'i grib so la: skyes pa dmag chas go yang brgyan: gtor ma phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'phang : gang gi thun zor rdzas rnams la: mkha' 'gro'i gtor zlog sham bu ru: brtan ma bcu gnyis zlog sngags bzlas:

badzra ni 'bar: badzra ma 'bar: badzra du pri har: badzra sha yer: badzra daṃ shi: badzra tur paṃ: badzra man te: badzra daṃ le: badzra sur da: badzra li li: badzra ra li: ma ma hring hring : sa ma ya: mtha' dmag dus 'khrug dal kha thams cad bzlog bzlog: bhyo bhyoḥ zor mda' zor kong phyogs mtshams 'phen: rdo nag zlog sngags bris pa rnams: yugs sa'i skra shad 'ur rdo la: zhing lpags mthil byas phyogs mtshams 'phen: bhyo zlog bswo sgrogs thal mo brdab: de nas nang log gtso gtor gyi: dbang blang dngos grub rol bar bya: du ru ka yi dmag g.yos kyang : bzlog par 'gyur bar the tshom med: zab phyir rin chen gter du sbas: sa ma ya: (3) gdon chen 'dre rgod 'dul ba ni: gtor zlog gzhung bzhin byas nas kyang : shu dag gu gul mu zi dang : shing kun sdong rol dug khrag dang : gla rtsi rta bon khyi spyang brun: mdzo dre'u spu gzhob ra gzhob rnams: cha snyoms rdo thun khrag snar sbyar: dud pa khyim nang mi phyugs bdug: gtor ma gtong dus khyim nang dang : nad pa la sogs thun gyis brab: sde brgyad dmag gi dpung tshogs kyang : 'dug par mi nus yul 'byin nas: gdon rnams la ni smos ci dgos: 'di lta bu yi las sbyor kyis: sde brgyad la sogs mi thul med: zab phyir rin chen gter du sbas: (4) smyo 'bog rgyal nad 'dul ba ni: gtor zlog gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang : nad pa smyo 'bog gang yin la: gong gi rdzas kyi dud pa bdug: rdzas rgod bug pa dgu ru byug: rdzas sngags thun gyis drag tu brab: des ni thub par gdon mi za: shin tu thu na ka ba la: spyi gzer bkyig te du bas bdug: rlung gsang tshigs mtshams dbyug pas brdung : des ni gdug pa'i snying 'gas 'gyur: 'di ltar sbyor ba gnyan cing zab: me lce'i kha yi sbrang bu 'dra: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: (5) ltas ngan yul sdig bzlog pa ni: gtor zlog gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang :

khams pa dag la ltas ngan gzugs: pho rog 'ug pa bzhon pa dang : pu shud srin bya bzhon pa dang : spre'u wa la bzhon pa dang : rta g.yag stag dang sre mong 'thab: gzhan yang dngos su rmi ltas sogs: rnam rtog gang skyes ltas ngan gzugs: bzlog pa 'bul khar ltas ngan bca': phyi ru kha bsgyur rdzas thun gyis: brab na drag sngags 'di yis brab: a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ braṃ braṃ ma ra tri: ka la ru pa sha rbad phye nṛ bhyoḥ ma ma ra tsa ya thun bhyoḥ ma ma snying kha rag ra tsa ya thun bhyoḥ ma ma tro ma ra shad shad: hed hed: thun bhyo zlog: ma ma ka thun pra ma ye: na sha ya ya bhyoḥ kro ma ri sha sha: trag thun bhyo zlog: e ka ma ra na hring hring : du kha tshe du kha tshe bhyoḥ oṃ ka ru ṇa tsa le phaṭḥ oṃ kro ma ri bha tsa te: hu ya hu ya: su ta re su ta re hūm̐ phaṭḥ ra lpags gyon zhing ral gri phyar: gdong la sol nag byugs nas ni: rgya gram lam mam chu gzhung ngam: thebs dang bstun te 'phen par bya: phyi ru rta bro dam sri mnan: nang du log la dkyil 'khor bsdu: tshe 'gugs dbang len bkra shis brjod: gtsug tor 'bar ma'i stong bzlog bya: 'di ltar las sbyor byas pa yis: mi bzlog pa ni gang yang med: zab phyir thugs kyi sras dang sprod: sa ma ya: (6) bstan pa'i ru tra bsgral ba ni: gtor zlog gzhung bzhin byas nas ni: dgra bo'i zag rdzas liṅga bya: bdun nam bcu bzhi nyer gcig tu: gzhung bzhin gtor sgrub dag la 'bad: brub khung nang du liṅga gzhug: yungs dkar dug khrag thun rdzas brab: dus bzhir drag sngags 'di la 'bad: stong tshig bar du thal mo brdab: lag mthil bar du dgra bo ni: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam: oṃ badzra bha ra hī: ru tra tsitta rbad: kro ta li nṛ tri sa ma ya: dgra bo'i snying shag shag: ha ri ni sa snying khrag tshal pa: badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ tsi ri mi snying la tsa tsa: dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ bswo pa shig: nṛ snying la khrag du ya:

nṛ mā ra ya: stod pa ya: srog pas mi ta hūm̐ dzaḥ nṛ ro shan thum ya dzaḥ ro shan nṛ snying la dzaḥ shantiṃ ku la tri nṛ dza dzaḥ cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ nṛ mā ra ya rbad: mi tshig ma chod 'di bzlas pas: rtags dang cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab: thams cad lta ba'i gyad kyis btsan: rjes su liṅga gsar pa dang : dgra bo'i zag rdzas ling ro bcas: klu gnyan dag la gtad khram 'bad: 'di ni las kyi spu gri yin: rdo rje 'dzin yang 'jigs na ni: dgra srog tsam la smos ci dgos: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i spu gri 'di: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: (7) pha rol rbod gtong bzlog pa ni: gtor zlog gzhung bzhin byas nas kyang : ban bon sngags nag byad ma mkhan: pha rol dgra bo gang yin gyi: rjes sa dreg pa nges par dgos: zag rdzas dag la dgra gzugs bya: mis rus bla dwags snying khar gzhug: kha ru ra khrag dug chu blug: sna lnga'i skud pas byad thag bcing : seng ldeng phur pa snying khar gdab: mal 'og gru gsum nang du khug: rang nyid mkha' 'gro seng gdong bsgom: sngags 'di nyin mtshan brgya stong bzla:

oṃ badzra singha mu kha ha ri ni sa: sarba duṣṭāṃ zlog: oṃ ya ma me pra khro pha sa: lo ga bha ta ma: cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ hūm̐ hūm̐ bzlog bzlog: de nas rang gshed kho rang bzlog: 'di yi nus pa bsam mi khyab: ban dgra stong gis tshugs mi srid: rgyun du drag sngags 'di la 'bad: a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ snga dro'i rigs la drag sngags bzla: phyi dro'i skabs la zlog sngags bya: phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka a: the tshom mi 'tshal snying la chong : thems su ma bshad gud du sbas: zab phyir thugs kyi sras la sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: rig 'dzin lo ha badzra gyis khol du phyung ba'o// // wa) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las: bza' btung gnad kyi them yig sdig pa snying 'dzin bzhugs so: sa ma ya: byad ma glag snying zhe nag pa: grong gcig gam ni gral gcig tu: mnyam par gtad dgos byung ba ni: rang nyid seng gdong ma gsal ba'i: sku las khro chu'i char phab ste: pha rol gzas po gang de nyid: bya sgro me yis tshig pa ltar: khro chu khol mas bsregs par bsam: ngag tu 'byung ba dkrug sngags dang : las sngags go ldog sngags kyang bzla: man ngag srog gi snying po'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: pha rol po'i bza' btung rang gi bza' btung byed dgos byung na: rang nyid ye shes ḍākki seng gdong nag mo: srog gcod kyi shan pa g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa: gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan can du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ mthing nag me'i tshwa tshwa can lci zhing 'thas pa zhig spros: kho'i kha nas snying gar slebs pa'i bar zhugs pas gri gug nag po spu gri lta bur gyur nas: kho'i snying rtsa srog rtsa rbad kyis bcad de tshur zhugs nas: gri gug gi cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ kho'i bza' btung de cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan

character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ'i srog gi nṛ dmar ljang spu ris bris pa 'dra ba yod pa de dang : rnam shes nya mig lta bu de gri gug gis btub cing dkrugs te: thod khrag gi nang du btab cing ḍākki nag mo'i zhal du chol chol du gsol bar bsam: ngag tu las sngags bcu bzhi pa'i mthar: cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ nṛ tri a karsha ya dza dzaḥ mthar hūm̐ de rang gi thugs kar bstim: yid kyis ma yengs pa gsal zhing las sngags lam lam du bzla'o: zhib par lag len gzhan du gsal: bza' btung gi cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ srog 'phrog u pa kha thaṃ: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang rang gi bza' btung kho la ster dgos byung na: kho'i bza' ba dug gi sdig pa snying 'dzin gyi gdams pa bstan: rang nyid ḍākki las byed nag mo khong ltar bsgom: bza' btung gang yin pa de: yi ge dza nag po gcig tu gyur nas: 'od zer nag po lci zhing 'thas pa 'jig rten khams su spros: 'jig rten srid pa'i dug sbyar klu dug btsan dug thams cad tshur 'dus dza la thim pas: dza de dug gi sdig pa nag po mgo dgu par gyur nas: khos za dus snying nang du zhugs nas: snying khrag sib kyis 'jibs par bsam: sdig pas kha rlangs kyi dug pha rol por btang pas: lus kyi nang khengs par bsam: rang nyid ḍākki nag mo'i nga rgyal gyis: ngag tu tha la ka sogs las sngags mthar cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ'i srog la mā ra ya dza dzaḥ ha ha he: hūm̐ phaṭ dza dza dzaḥ bza' btung tshe la dug gi sdig pa snying 'dzin u pa: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: ྀatsha: ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong can ma las: dug mda' srung ba'i man ngag zab rgya can bzhugs so: sa ma ya: ḍākki seng gdong drag mor 'dud: mu stegs dug mda' srung ba khro chu ltar: dug mda'i char pa phab kyang nyams nga med:

rang sngags dus tshod tshes grangs brtsi mi dgos: da lta bri zhing da lta za bas chog: rdzas ni thog grag gzhar ba'i dus mi dgos: the tshom ma mdzad thugs kyi dkyil du sbos: zab bo: ྀatsha: yang dug mda' srung ba'i rdzas thog grag byugs la mtha' nas yar dril: rang nyid dam tshig mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mor bsgoms la: las sngags bdun gyi bar bzlas nas za'o: ྀatsha: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i snying zhun las: pha rol log lta gdos gzugs can: skye bo bsam ngan log pa'i rigs: skal ldan bu la 'tshe gyur na: de yi gdams pa zab mo nyid: dug mda' srung ba'i man ngag 'di: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zha) ༈ lam yig gsal ba'i sgron me mthong ba don ldan mi nub rgyal mtshan bzhugs so: na mo gu ru: yon tan snying rje btsan zhing nus rtsal ldan: rdzu 'phrul thogs med 'gro ba'i dpal du shar: bya ba dang bral rje btsun gu ru yi: zhal nas gdams te phyi rabs don du bkod: mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar bka' yi rgyas kyis btab: klu rgyal dbang lag brag ri'i logs su sbas: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: ma 'ongs dus mtha' yang snyigs rtsod ldan la: mi rnams tshe thung nad mang dbul phongs ldang : dam chos lung med sa steng dmag chas brtson: tshe la long med bdud kyis bar chad sdang : bstan pa'i gtso bo rnams kyang mtha' ru spyugs: chos kyi rgya zhig zob chos mi mgo bskor: khrims kyi rgya zhig rgyal khams phan tshun 'thab: yul gyi rgya zhig mi nor nad mug ldang : lam gyi rgya zhig dgra rkun chom pos gang : zhing gi rgya zhig sad ser 'bu srin sdang : mi yi rgya zhig dus min glo bur 'chi: bden pa'i rgya zhig kha bshad chos min ston: bsod nams rgya zhig dbul phongs rku 'phrog brtson: dad pa'i rgya zhig sgom sgrub bogs mi thon: de phyir bar chad chos kyis bzlog nus phyir:

sbas yul bco brgyad gangs gnyan nyer gcig rnams: ma 'ongs sems can dmu rgod 'dul slad du: las kyi ḍākki mkha' 'gro seng gdong gis: gu ru rje la bka' gnang legs zhus te: chos bdag rim bzhin rten 'brel sbyor te gtad: las 'phro skal ldan smon lam ldan pa bcu: chos kyi rgyan 'dogs gnas kyi che ba ston: lam gyi 'phrang sgrol mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzugs: bdud kyi sde bcom gzigs snang gtan la 'bebs: thar pa'i lam zin mchog thun dngos grub thob: mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin lung bstan myur du 'byung : skal ngan sngon gyi smon lam log pa yis: bdud kyis snying bslu ma rungs ma bzhi 'byung : phyogs bzhir 'byung ste dam chos snying nas smod: de yi rkyen gyis log lta'i 'dam du tshud: 'brel tshad ngan song gnas su 'khrid par nges: pe dkar snying bslus thol byung lung bstan pa'i: bud med bzhi 'byung ma rgyud skad ngan smra: de ni mtha' phud glo yi yul du rdzongs: gri bos snying bslus stag shar mi bdun 'byung : phan tshun sdang zhing 'thab rtsod ngan bcom byed: de ni mthar phud srin po'i lag tu zhog: ma mos snying bslus the'u rang mngon shes can: gnas dang chos la gshe skur 'debs pa yi: ser gzugs bzhi 'byung tho co'i spyod pa skyong : ma rungs de ni kun gyis tshar chod cig: rgyal 'gong sprul pa dge bshes gsum 'byung ste: des ni gshe skur rtsod pas kun gyis kha ma slogs: de la 'brel tshad ngan song gnas su 'khrid: ru tra'i sprul pa sdig las brtson pa yi: mi nag gnas kyi ri dwags gsod pa 'ga': tshan re 'byung ste de la bstan pa yi: mi nad nor nad yul gru mi bde 'byung : de ni bka' srung kun gyi sde dpon te: srog bdag btsan rgod shwa ras tshar chod cig: de bas bar chod bdud kyis bslu ba yi: gnas kyi phyogs bzhir tshong dus khrom mang 'byung : de la brten nas mgo skor sdig las spyod:

de ni yul gru rgyal pos tshar chod cig: de nas rim bzhin smon lam ldan pa yi: byang chub sems dpa' bdun cu rtsa lnga 'byung : gnas kyi gzigs snang gtan la phab pa'o: lam yig bdun 'byung kun las 'phags pa yi: mkha' 'gro'i lam yig gcig 'byung kun gyis gsal: de nas rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin mi gsum 'byung : gnas kyi che ba nyi shu rtsa lnga bstan: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad cing smon lam 'debs: de la bu nor chos kyi dngos grub 'byung : de nas dzam bha lha yi ming can gyis: sde dpon byang chub mchog tu grub pa 'byung : de la smon lam dngos grub rnam bzhi 'byung : de nas shar phyogs logs kyi phyogs mtshams su: tshangs pa'i sprul pa mgo bo che zhig 'byung : de yi mod la kun gyis mchod gnas byed: de nas phyogs bzhir mchod khang bzhi 'byung ste: mchod khang gang rgyas phyogs su bsod nams rgyas: rgya bod kun gyi smon lam gcig bsdus pa: grub pa'i skyes mchog skal ldan stobs ldan ni: gzhogs g.yas 'jam dpal mtshan rtags tshang ba 'byung : rtsod med grub mtha' bzung zhing gnas bdag skyong : blo bzang smon lam 'grub pa'i lam yig 'byung : gnas der sleb pa tsam gyis byang chub thob: mgrin par nor bus brgyan pa'i sngags 'chang tshul: smon lam stobs dang ldan pa'i gnas bdag 'byung : de yis rten 'brel legs phyogs bco lnga ston: smon lam bstan pas 'dzam gling bkra shis 'byung : gnas der mos pa'i gnod sbyin gzugs can ni: sme ba'i ga shal brgyan pa'i sde dpon 'byung : de yang rdo rje tshe bum thogs pa 'byung : gnas der sgrib sbyong bsod nams brtan pa'i mthus: bar chod bdud las rgyal zhing rten 'brel mdzod: chos bdag ming can sde skyong rgyal po 'byung : gnas kyi che ba ston zhing smon lam 'grub: kun las 'phags pa'i ming can gsang mdzod gcig: ri bo mchog las grub pa'i chos srid skyong :

gnas kyi che ba lam yig bcas pa 'byung : de ni smon lam grub pa'i skyes bu yin: bkra shis smon lam grub pa'i ming can ni: dad rgyud lhan skyes bzhin du 'grub pa 'byung : gnas kyi che ba ston zhing smon lam 'grub: mgon po sde bzhi phyogs bzhir ming can 'byung : gnas kyi che ba ston cing smon lam 'grub: rnam par khang bzang rgyal ba'i ming can 'byung : smon lam 'grub cing mchog mthun 'grub par nges: 'brel thogs don ldan ratna'i ming can 'byung : rten 'brel byin rlabs smon lam 'grub cing 'gyur: theg pa mchog la grub pa'i mi lnga 'byung : dad ldan 'gro 'dren mtshungs med dpal du shar: ye shes lha la grub pa'i ming can 'byung : smon lam stobs ldan rgyas pa'i rten 'brel te: bzang po yon tan drug ldan ming can bzhi: las stobs sngon sbyangs chos srid 'brel ba 'byung : de la 'brel thob gnas kyi rgyal mtshan 'dogs: bstan 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mtshan rnam bzhi 'byung : bsod nams smon lam sbyin stobs rgyas pa 'byung : pad dkar grub pa'i ming can rnam bzhi 'byung : gnas la rgyan 'dogs lam yig don ldan 'byung : grub pa'i dbang phyug nā ga shrī'i mtshan: gnas 'dir grub thob stong phrag sa bon 'debs: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma ṇi dha ra'i mtshan: gnas kyi che ba ston zhing smon lam 'grub: gzungs mchog rgyal srid skyong ba'i ming can 'byung : de ni bsod nams grub cing las smon ldan: de sogs lung las ma grags 'brel thogs ni: grangs med gsum 'das mngon sangs rgyas pa 'byung : ḍākki ha ri ni sa mkha' 'gro ni: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa lnga 'byung : de dag kun gyis gnas kyi che ba ston: dge bas 'brel thogs mkha' spyod myur lam 'dren: ya ma zung gi bstan chos bcu drug 'byung : de ni ma rig sgrib chen mi yin no: gnas kyi phyogs phyogs bka' srung sprul pa'i sras:

mtshan rtags bzhi 'byung gnas kyi bar chad sel: las mkhan bzhi 'byung srog gcod las la 'byung : de dag grub pa'i las thab sbyor ba yin: las bzhi 'grub cing rten 'brel rnam lnga 'byung : de sogs bzang ngan 'bring sogs 'brel thogs 'byung : de nas mkha' 'gro seng gdong gis zhus ngor: gu ru'i zhal nas: e ma gdod ma'i mkha' 'gro ma: gnas kyi che ba bcu drug bstan: ye nas grub pa'i gnas mchog ni: gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig yin: ti tshe gangs ri sku yi gnas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las tshang : la phyi gangs ri gsung gi gnas: rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel tshang : tsā ri gangs ri thugs kyi gnas: lta sgom spyod gsum chos bzhi tshang : gze rgyal gangs ri yon tan gnas: sde snod lung rigs rgyud sde tshang : rong btsan gangs ri phrin las gnas: gzhi rig lam sel dam chos tshang : de phyir dag pa mkha' spyod gnas: gtan 'khyil dngos grub len pa'i mtsho: padma nga yis byin brlabs pa'i: dngos grub nges 'byung mtsho lnga ni: ma pham g.yu mtsho sku yi mtsho: la phyi g.yu mtsho gsung gi mtsho: tsā ri g.yu mtsho thugs kyi mtsho: gze rgyal dung mtsho yon tan mtsho: rong btsan mtsho dmar phrin las mtsho: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i mtsho lnga'o: rgyal khams mtsho ri grangs 'das kyang : kun las khyad 'phags 'di lnga'o: 'di nyid grub pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad: ti tshe gangs ri rgyal po ni: sngon dgra bcom kun gyi byin gyis brlabs: la phyi gangs ri rgyal po ni: dbang phyug mi las byin gyis brlab: tsā ri rgyal po gangs ri ni: 'khor lo sdom pas byin gyis brlabs: zhes bya 'byung : gze rgyal rgyal po gangs ri ni: padma nga yis byin gyis brlabs: rong btsan rgyal po gangs ri ni: bai ro tsa nas byin gyis brlabs: rnam grangs mang por bstan lags kyang : phyi 'byung byin rlabs 'di bzhin brjod: gangs ri chags pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan:

byang sems thig le'i 'phro 'du las: chu shel las grub haṃ gyis mtshan: bsil byed yin pas gangs ri chags: de phyir bde chen 'khor lo'o: de phyir sku yi gnas mchog tshang : 'byung 'jug rlung gis 'phro 'du las: mgrin pa las byung chab chu 'khyugs: de phyir longs spyod 'khor lo'o: de phyir gsung gi gnas mchog tshang : ma bcos sems kyi 'phro 'du las: zad med rgyun gyi dung mtsho 'khyil: de phyir chos kyi 'khor lo'o: de phyir thugs kyi gnas mchog tshang : nye 'du kun tshang gtum mo las: ri rlung kun gyi lte bar grags: de phyir sprul pa'i 'khor lo'o: de phyir yon tan gnas mchog tshang : tshan dho thams cad rgyu ba'i lam: nags tshal ljon rgyas gcig tu dril: de phyir bde skyong 'khor lo'o: de phyir phrin las gnas mchog tshang : 'khor lo lnga bsdoms grub pa'i gnas: bde mchog sprul pa'i zhings khams so: gnas kyi sku lnga ngo sprod bstan: gangs ri me long mngon dga'i zhing : ri bo mnyam nyid dpal ldan zhing : nyi zer sor rtog bde chen zhing : chu rlung bya grub las rab zhing : dung mtsho chos dbyings 'og min zhing : de phyir sku lnga lhun grub zhing : phrin las rnam lnga 'di ltar ro: zhi ba zlum pa'i gangs khrod chags: rgyas pa ri rab gling bzhir grub: dbang gi sa gzhi dmar la rngam: drag po g.ya' spang nag la rgyas: kun 'dus chos dbyings rang sgra sgrog: de phyir phrin las rnam lnga tshang : sku yi tsā ris sprul sku 'thob: gsung gi tsā ris dbang thang skye: thugs kyi tsā ris ting 'dzin 'char: yon tan tsā ris 'gro drug 'dren: phrin las tsā ris dgra bgegs sgrol: de phyir sku lnga yon tan tshang : bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor bdud kyis 'jig: 'di ni rang byung dkyil 'khor tshang : bskal pa 'dus byas ma zhig bar: gnas 'di 'pho 'gyur 'byung mi 'gyur: de phyir mi g.yo rdo rje gdan: rang byung mchod rten rin chen 'di:

gsang sngags 'bras bus gnas yin phyir: padma bdag gis legs par bshad: jo mo mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma rtsod ldan la: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

hūm̐ ka la artsig gis jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod brag ri dug sbrul 'dra ba nas gdan drangs shing 'dzam gling rgyan du phab pa'o/ 'di lam yig 'bring po'o: shog ser tsha las zhal bshus so// // za) yon tan tsā ri'i lam yig gsal ba'i sgron me mthong ba don ldan 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag tu grags pa bzhugs so: bla ma yi dam dang mkha' 'gro zhing skyong ḍā ki gter srung tshogs la bstod: na mo gu ru ḍā ki nī ye: o rgyan lam yig gsal ba'i sgron me 'di la rgya bod kyi gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig gangs ri brgya dang so lnga ste: ma bzhengs pa lhun gyis grub pa'i rtsa gsum 'khor lau lnga'i pho brang : stod du sgra che zhing yon tan dang ldan pa ti se gangs ri seng gdong ma dkar mo sku'i gnas: de la dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i zhabs rjes dang bcas pa yod: ti se sgra che ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags: bar du khyad par du 'phags pa la phyi chu bar stag gdong ma khra mo gsung gi gnas: de na dbang phyug mi la ras pa rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob ste ras pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yod: la phyi khungs btsun pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags: dbus su 'gran zla dang bral ba lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri: phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas: de la mkha' 'gro bye ba sa ya 'bum dang bcas pa dngos su 'du: tsā ri 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags: smad du 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag tu grags pa jo bo gze rgyal dom gdong ma mthing nag yon tan gyi gnas: de la padma nga yis byin gyis brlabs shing zab gter bcu gsum dang bcas pa sbas pa sbas shing ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro ma nges par 'du ba'i gnas: gze rgyal 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag tu grags pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags: rong btsan khungs btsun zhing drag rtsal dang ldan pa spyang gdong ma sngon mo phrin las kyi gnas: slob dpon chen po bai ro tsa nas sbas yul padma bkod kyi sgo srung du bskos shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten 'brel yod:

rong btsan khungs btsun pa'i lo rgyus de ltar lags: gnas kyi rtsub 'gyur gyi pho nya bzhi yod pa la: phyi'i pho nya rma rgyal spom ra: lho sku rgyal she ne: nub mkhar nag rgyal po: byang thang lha chen po: nang gi pho nya bzhi yod pa las: shar gyi ske rgyal ne bro: lho'i dmag dpon 'dzi rgyal: nub kyi pe ne ri bkra: byang gi sme rgyal rta rna: nang gi pho nya bzhi yod pa la: shar gyi srog bdag shwa ra: lho'i gnod sbyin sbrul mgo: nub kyi a mye mu khri: byang gi mtsho nag dge bsnyen ste: de rnams kyi gnas mchog 'di'i rdzu 'phrul las la bskur ba'i pho nya drag po'i tshul la zhi ba gnas kyi cha lag bka' skyong rnams te'o: de rnams pho nya las byed kyi gter re sbas yod pa la rdo rje yang rtse'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi skor rnams ni skye 'gro'i bskor rten du gnas kyi sku lnga'i lo rgyus ni de ltar lags: skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i zhing yin phyir gnas 'di la dkyil 'khor tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan ni: rgya gar skad du: ri bo a ma la: bod skad du: dag pa shel ri: o rgyan skad du: ri bo bha mi tang ta: bod skad du: mchod rten bkra shis brtsegs pa chen po: phyi nas bltas na gangs ri rtse gsum gyi tshul du gnas pa: nang nas bltas na rgyu nor bu chu shel las grub pa mchod rten bkra shis 'od ldan zhes bya ba: rtse mo lha'i gnas su zug pa: lha rnams kyis phyag dang mchod pa bskor ba byed pa: sked pa bkra shis 'od mi'i gnas su zug pa: klu rnams kyis phyag dang mchod pa bskor ba byed pa: ḍākki seng gdong gi zhal nas kyang : bu snying rus dang ldan pa'i rjes 'brang rnams: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas kyi gnas mchog yin: 'di nas shar phyogs dbyings kyi gdong : dbang phyug dpal ldan mkha' 'gro ma: sha dang chang gi mchod pa'i gnas: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang yod: skal yod kyi skal ba len sa yod:

skal med kyi tshe srog stongs sa yod: zog po rlung la bskur sa yod: g.yeng ba can bdud kyi 'khyer sa yod: log lta can tshe srog bkums sa yod: sdig po che mngon sangs rgyas sa yod: dad pa can dngos grub thob sa yod: las 'phro can chos dang 'phrad sa yod: smon lam can gnas lugs skyong sa yod: bsod nams can tshogs 'khor 'bul sa yod: las stobs can zab gter dang 'phrad sa yod: dbul phongs can nor dang 'phrad sa yod: 'dun pa can bu dang 'phrad sa yod: bar chod kyi tshe 'phrang sgrol sa yod: bzang ngan gyi 'khri ba gcod sa yod: ma mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'tshogs gnas 'di: mkha' spyod zhing dang dgongs pa mnyam: 'di mjal bas ngan song skye sgo chod: 'dir bgrod pa rnams ni lta ci smos: dpal he ru ka dang dgongs pa mnyam: lam rim 'byor mi dgos dgongs sangs rgyas: zhes gsungs: gu ru'i zhal nas: rang byung mchod rten chu shel las grub pa'i: dpag tshad bcu gsum rgya khyon tshad dang ldan: pad gdan seng khri bang rim stong phrag ste: bum pa bre dang chos 'khor so bdun ni: rta babs rgyan dang cod pan du ma 'phur: gdugs dang gan ji ra ni tog gis spras: ye shes 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i gur phub mdzes: ma bkod zhing khams rang byung mchod rten la: 'ja' gur rig 'dzin grub thob brgyad cu bzhugs: phyi rim ma dang mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs: bar khyams bka' brgyud bla ma zer ltar 'khrigs: tog la rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor tshang : nyi zlar gsang sngags lha tshogs khrom ltar dpung : gan ji ra la rdor 'chang sangs rgyas stong : gdugs la snang srid khro bcu 'ja' ltar shar: chos 'khor zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gsal snang dag: rta babs bde gshegs dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs rgyas: bum par snang mtha' bde chen zhing khams bzhugs: bre la zhing skyong ḍā ki ma lus tshang : steng gi bang rim mkha' 'gro'i pho brang gsal: 'og gi bang rim dpal mgon bdun cu tshang :

seng khri nor bdag 'dzam lha ma lus tshang : logs bzhir gdong can mkha' 'gro bka' bstan skyong : phyogs bzhir rgyal chen sde bzhi sgo srung tshul: mtshams bzhir las mkhan pho nya glog ltar 'khyugs: zur bzhir bam ro skye bdun dur khrod tshang : pad 'dab klu gnyan sa bdag mchod gtor 'bul: de ltar ma bsgoms dkyil 'khor rang byung 'di: phyag mchod bstod cing bsnyen sgrub las la sbyor: mchog thun dngos grub thob 'gyur the tshom med: las can smon lam ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams: lam yig sgron me 'di dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de'ang lam yig sgron me 'od gsal las: klu bdud rtswa'i rnam dbye bshad par bya: ḍā ki rgya khro+-im̐ atsha kha thaṃ rgya: klu bdud rdo rje zhes bya ba rtswa rin chen 'di: sgo che ba pho brang gling dgu shar: cong zhi'i brag mi reng langs pa 'dra ba: gong du chu mig rdo rje ris su yod pa'i khrod: sman ljongs klu rgyal skyed pa'i tshal bong nga dkar po'i khrod du: me tog dril bu 'dra ba: lo ma rgya dar 'dra ba: 'bras bu bra bo 'dra ba: tshig pa mda' smyug 'dra ba: rtsa ba la phug 'dra ba: sdong po sro ma 'dra ba: dri ma spos dri 'dra ba: bro ba rgya tshwa 'dra ba: dbyar gsum kha shar du blta ba: ston gsum kha lhor blta ba: dgun gsum kha nub tu lta ba: dpyid gsum kha byang du lta ba: nyin mo du ba 'thul ba: mtshan mo me 'bar ba: dus rtag par byang chub bdud rtsi 'bab pa: de'i g.yas g.yon du 'ja' 'od kyi gur gyi rgyun ma chad pa: mthong na yul spro ba skye ba: ro brgya dang ldan pa me tog mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba skye ba'i yul der gnas pa'i skye 'gro byang chub 'thob: de'i bdud rtsi chu la phog pas nyungs dkar 'bras bu tsam skye 'gro su'i kha la sleb kyang 'ja' lus 'grub cing de'i bdud rtsi 'thor ba'i chu lus la reg pas pha rol byad dang rgol ba 'joms shing sdig sgrib sbyang :

e ma yon tan kun tshang me tog 'di: rgya bod mkhas pa padma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs ma 'ongs rjes 'jug skye rgu la: sbas pa gsal bkod nyon mongs nad 'joms sman: skal ldan las 'phro can gyi don du bstan: ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar mgo tshugs tshe: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgyas pa ri bshad thar lam dkar po ni: sngon ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas mdo rgyud man ngag gi rnam dbye mang du mdzad de: ston pa dgra bcom bye ba sa ya sde snod kyi chos la 'khod gtsug lag khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs: sku gdung ring bsrel mchod khang rnams dang bod kyi gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas brgyad sha za 'du ba'i dur khrod brgyad: bram ze'i sku sha tshang ba'i bam ro brgyad: mi zad pa'i g.yu mtsho bcu gsum dung mtsho nyi shu rtsa lnga: sbas yul che ba bzhi chung ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rong chen sum cu rtsa brgyad: tsā ri zhes pa lnga de'ang phyi nang gsang gsum: gangs ri gtan chags mtsho mo gtan 'khyil rnams la rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis me tog gi char phab pas rab gnas kyi rten 'brel 'grigs te: rang byung mchod rten du mar dus ma 'ongs pa'i dus su lung bstan: de'i ci'i phyir zhe na: kun dga' bo'i zhus ngor: bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa: 'o skol da lta rten 'brel dang smon lam dang phrin las gang bcol 'grub ste mchis: phyi rabs ma 'ongs rjes 'jug bod 'bangs rnams: bdud kyi sprul pa dpag med sa steng khengs: gtsug lag chos 'khor dben gnas 'jig pa 'byung : da lta rdo rje gdan 'di'i gtsug lag yang : mu stegs log chos dmag gis 'jig pa 'byung : de bzhin rgya bod gtsug lag khang rnams kyang : mu stegs rnams kyis 'jig cing bcom pa 'byung : de dus gang gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig dang :

rang byung mchod rten rnam dag 'di rnams la: thog bcas ma rungs bdud las rgyal bar shog: de phyir phyi rabs sems can dad ldan rnams: nga yis ji ltar legs par bka' stsal bzhin: nga ni dgongs pa mya ngan 'das 'og tu: pad 'byung zhes pa mkhas pa 'byung : de'i lung bstan smon lam bzhin: 'brel tshad don ldan gter la dbang : byin rlabs smon lam thob nas su: sku lnga tsā ri gnas mchog 'byung : gsungs pa ltar rin chen rgyal ba'i sras mchog padma 'byung gnas bdag gis byin brlabs shing smon lam rgyas btab pa'i lo rgyus gsal bar bya'o: de la dang po gnas rnams tsā ri zhes grub pa'i rgyu mtshan te: phyi'i tsā ri nang gi tsā ri gsang ba'i tsā ri'o: de la dang po phyi'i tsā ri ni: ri ni dag pa chu shel ri: rtswa ni klu bdud rdo rje'i rtswa: de phyir phyi'i tsā ri'o: 'byung ba bzhi grub ma tshang na: tsā ri zhes byar mi 'dogs so: de la nang gi tsā ri ni: mkha' dbyings snang ba chos sku'i rtsa: ting 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i ri: de phyir nang gi tsā ri'o: snang stong gnyis med ma gyur na: nang gi tsā ri mi 'dogs so: de la gsang ba'i tsā ri ni: rtsa ni dbu ma dhu ti la: rang lus rdo rje bzhi bsdus ri: de phyir gsang ba'i tsā ri'o: ma lus dkyir 'khor rang ngo ma 'phrod na: gsang ba'i tsā ri mi 'dogs so: tsā ri'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags: da ni gze rgyal tsā ri bstan: yon tan tsā ri zhes bya ba: 'di ni gsang sngags tsā ri'o: dus la ma bab gsang ba 'di: dus snyigs ma lnga la bsngags pa yin: yon tan tsā ri yin pa'i rgyu: gsang sngags dus la ma bab par: gnas kyi yon tan gsang ba 'di: yon tan tsā ri de ltar lags: gnas kyi tshang ba rnam bzhi bstan: shar phyogs sangs rgyas stong sku'i dkyil 'khor tshang : sangs rgyas par 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor: lho na sman lha sku'i dkyil 'khor tshang : nad las thal bar 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor:

nub na tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor tshang : tshe ring bar 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor: byang na byams pa sku'i dkyil 'khor tshang : gzugs kha dog 'tsher bar 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor: shar lho dzam lha stong phrag gi dkyil 'khor tshang : longs spyod bsod nams 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor: lho nub rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor tshang : rtsa rlung rgyas par 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor: nub byang ma hā de ba'i dkyil 'khor tshang : dbang sdud khye'u 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor: byang shar shan pa dmag gi dkyil 'khor tshang : mthu rtsal che bar 'dod na gze rgyal tsā ri bskor: phyi bskor tshogs kyi 'khor lo lam zhugs tshang : bar bskor sbyor ba'i lam zhugs sngags skor tshang : rtse skor dkyil 'khor mjal bas mthong lam tshang : rang zhal ngos sprod thob pas sgom lam tshang : 'dun pa rtse gcig 'byung bas byang chub thob: theg pa rim dgu gnas 'dir tshang bar bstan: phyi'i bskor lam gsum ni nyan thos gsum: gnas kyi dkyil 'khor ngo sprod kṛ yog gsum: gnas 'dir rang byung rang shar a ti gsum: de phyir theg pa rim dgu grags pa'o: gnas kyi gzigs snang gtan la phab pa yin: gnas mdun chen por phyag mchod maṇḍal bstod pa bya: rgyal ba'i lam de'i logs la bde mchog gi lha drug cu rtsa bzhi dbus nor bdag chen po zhal gzigs: mdo la mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'di'i bye brag la 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor tshang bas bum par reg ste de ru khrus bya: de'i 'og tu dngos grub kyi bam ro yod: de la smon lam btab pas mchog thun 'grub: de'i phar khar bgrod pas bsil ba tshal dang rngam pa sgra sgrogs kyi dur khrod tshang : der sha za mkha' 'gro'i bshas gdan yod pas lus sbyin bya: bya rgod gcan spyang rang byon yod: 'od 'bar sgang la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gzhong yod: der tshogs dang mchod pa 'bul:

thar lam rta sga la zhon: de nas sgrol ma ri la byon: de la sindhu ra'i sgo yod: mtsho 'og ma la sgrol ma mtsho: gong ma thub pa'i mtsho pha ri thub pa gangs ri na thub pa gangs mtsho 'dra mtsho rgyal rang byon la thub pa rigs drug gis bskor nas yod: de mjal bas rigs drug gi skye sgo chod: rdza khrod nag por mi la ras pa la grub thob brgyas bskor ba yod: de'i lung phugs la lha mo dung skyong ma'i sku dang : 'phags ma dbu can ma dang bdud mgon gyi bla rdo yod: de nas mkha' 'gro'i snying phug la tshe'i gter kha yod: ma brtsigs pa'i khri yod: de nas zhing skyong rang byon na bdud 'dul gyi rdzas yod: de nas zhi khro rigs lnga dang zhing skyong 'phrang yin: der zhing skyong la thug dang dar lcog bshags pa 'bung dgos: de nas rdza khrod la me lce 'bar ma nas byon: de'i logs rnams skya brgyad 'og tu rdo rje'i khri yod do: de'i phyir rdo rje'i 'phrang lam de nas dngos grub kha la bam ro yod der dam can rdo rje legs pa sogs kyi dkyil 'khor te: dam can la der bla rdo dang mgar tshang bla mtsho der dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i pho brang yod dam can 'phrang sgrol de nas mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma'i bla mtsho la mkha' 'gro'i snying gter yod: de'i logs la mgon po phyag bzhi'i skor dang rang byon bla rdo de'i rtser bya rog mgon po'i bla mtsho mkha' 'gro dar lam sgang zhes thar lam steng la: nyi ma mtsho klu rgyal dbang lag thang dge bsnyen sku mkhar gza'i sku rang byung pho long dbang ldan skar ma mtsho zla ba mtsho mkha' 'gro thang de'i logs la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro gsang lam 'phrang du mtshan gsol: bde ba kha de nas mkha' 'gro la de'i logs la phyag na rdo rje'i sku rang byon: bar do 'phrang lam sgrol lam mkha' 'gro la'o: der dngos grub gang dgos smon lam gdab: de nas khra mo gzi mtsho la mtsho bran brgya dang brgyad yod:

de'i log la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs tshang : de nas sba ba'i mtsho sbrum thang de'i logs la byams pa rang byon der ma rig mun sel gyi dkyil 'khor dang bla mtsho de nas yi dam la la drag po dmar chen dang phyag rdor klu 'dul: de'i sgang la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor de'i logs la drag po kī la ya'i sku rang byon de nas nor bu khar bu rdo dang dngos grub yod: der smon lam btab pas mchog thun 'grub: de nas blo bde sgang la 'bir ba pa dang thang ston gyi skyes bu yod: der sindhu ra'i sgo yod: lha mo gzi ldan ma'i pho brang yin: de nas maṇḍal gling la phyin dus smon lam gyis brda sbyor: de'i logs la sgron ma dkar sngon gyi rang byung dang : grub thob byang thang pa'i sgyed pu yod: de la smon lam gyi lam ga yod: bud med rnams ni mthol bshags la nas phyin: skyes pa rnams sgrol ma la nas phyin: de'i logs la spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshang : phyogs bzhir lha chen tshogs bdag gi sku mkhar: der ka la dung mtsho yod rong du grub thob sha ba ri pa yod: der rta mgrin lcags kyi sgrub thabs dang dkyil 'khor yod pas de phyir rta mgrin rong zhes zer: de nas mtsho dkar zhes mtsho dngul gzhong 'o mas bkang 'dra yod: de na mkha' 'gro 'bum thig dang mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gter yod: g.yas kyi logs la 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang : de na ma brtsegs pa'i khri yod de'i gong la dmar nag rakta zhes sngags srung e ka tsa ti'i bla mtsho de'i mtsho rdel lus la 'chang na mtshon dang thog dang gcan gzan gyi gnod pa bcas thub: spyir mtsho rdel rnams kyis pha rol gyi byad kha dang dus min gyi 'tshe ba dang mnan gtad gang yin yang thub nges: der mtsho 'bul bya zhing khrus dang smon lam gdab: mtsho skor phyin pas ngan song skye sgo chod: bskor tshad nyer lnga 'bum gter tshang :

dkar tog thang la maṇḍal phul: de'i logs la gshin rje tshe bdag gi dkyil 'khor mjal rgyu 'od: gab rgya: de nas dpa' bo dpa' mo'i thang la phyin: de nas dbang phyug mdo la rten 'brel mdzad de'i logs la skal bzang stong gi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o: rta mgrin dmar po rang byon zhal mdun bstan phyogs nas grub thob brgyad cu tshur zhal gzigs pa'ang yod: de nas bkra shis thang la de nas gnas brtan pha bong : de nas 'dzam gling rgyan gyi chos khrir phyin der skal bzang smon lam tshe: 'di nas dngos grub 'gugs pa'i mtsho bzhi: bar chad sel ba'i mtsho bzhi: dbang thang rgyas pa'i mtsho bzhi: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtsho bzhi: dngos grub len pa'i lung bzhi: zhing skyong gi 'phrang bzhi: ma bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bzhi: drag rtsal ldan pa'i btsan bzhi: gzhi bdag tshangs pa dung thod: gshin rje'i pho brang du gshin rje la thod gyon pa bzhi: chu bo rba drag pa bzhi: tshal chen po bzhi: ma brtsigs pa'i khri bzhi: grub pa thob pa'i phug pa bzhi: lung bstan gyi phug gcig: gdong can bzhi'i gter kha las kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis: dam sri'i skye ba gcig: gri bo zhugs pa gsum: longs spyod gter ba'i mkha' 'gro gcig de rnams ma chad pa yod: bram ze sha khrag dmar la mi dga' ba re re de rnams gnas 'di la tshang zhing bkod pa kha byang gsal ba'i sgron me mthong ba don ldan thar lam dkar po'o: 'dir gnas mchog chen po gze rgyal tsā ri yon tan gyi gnas 'di la bskor ba gcig bskor na sgrib pa sbyang : lan gnyis bskor na tshogs rdzogs: lan gsum bskor na bar chad sel: lan bzhi bskor na longs spyod 'du: lan drug bskor na mchog thun 'grub: lan bdun bskor na rten 'brel phyogs med 'char: lan brgyad bskor bas 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub: lan dgu bskor bas theg pa rim dgu'i sa thob: lan bcu bskor bas sa bcu sprin gyi sku mngon par rdzogs te sangs rgyas zhing :

skor lam gsum ni dung mtsho rtse skor dang g.yu mtsho bar skor mtsho chen padma bla mtsho rong skor dang gsum mo: rtse bskor dang bar skor gnyis la ram zla che chung gsum la bar skor lam 'byed de ma yin par snga drags na ma mkha' 'gro mtshams bsdams pas byin rlabs chung : dus la bab pas bar chad 'byung : spyir rtse skor gsum 'bum gter: bar skor lnga rong skor la bcu gnyis 'byung : rong skor ram zla'i nang nas tshes bco lnga phyed du brtsi ba'i zhag bco lnga la kun las 'phags pa'i 'gyur yod: zla ba bcu gnyis la snga bskor gsum: lo bcu gnyis la rong bskor che ba'o: gzhan rong bskor chen po dus ni khyad med kyi phan yon: rong chen dus ma yin na bskor ba gsum rong chen che ba'i dus dang mnyam: de ci'i phyir zhe na: dgra dang bar chad med pas sgrib pa mi sbyong ba'o: 'o na gnas khyad med kyang yang dag chos sgrub pa byed tshe yun ring sdug bsngal myong dgos: dka' ba til rdung tsam zhig ma bcad na: 'bras bu til mar 'byung ba'i go skabs med: sdug bsngal tsha gdung mkha' ltar ma bzod na: snying po reg par mi 'gyur gyis: de phyir sdig sgrib ma sbyong sangs rgyas ci ltar 'thob: de phyir sgrib sbyong lam mchog 'bung mdzod gsungs: mtsho rgyal gyi zhus pa: gzhan las khyad 'phags yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci ltar lags: gu ru'i zhal nas: jo bo la rin po che sna tshogs kyi gter yod pas mdo khams sgang drug gi bla rten dang bskor rten yin pas dngos grub thob: 'byung ba'i dwangs ma yin pas gzhan las ya mtshan che: yul gyi gtso bo yin pas dbang thang yon tan rgyas: sa rdo sems can don byed sangs rgyas yin: zhes gsungs: de phyir gnas kyi phyi la sgrub pa las nang du bsgrub na bogs skyed dang yon tan gzhan las che ba'i smon lam yod: phyi la sgrub pa lo gsum bsgrubs pa las gnas nang du zla gsum bsgrub pa bogs skyed che:

phyi la zla gsum sgrub pa brgyab pa las gnas nang du zhag gsum bsgrub pa bogs skyed che: gnas gzhan bla ma dang gang zag gis phar la byin gyis brlab ste: 'di ru gnas kyis bla mar tshur byin rlabs 'jug: gnas phran gzhan rnams zhag brgya bskor ba las: gnas mchog 'di ru zhag bdun bskor bas yon tan che: chos byin rlabs bogs skyed gzhan las che: phyi rabs rjes 'jug don du gter du sbas: 'brel thogs sangs rgyas thob par lung bstan te: rin chen zab shog gsang ba'i logs su bris: brag ri dug sbrul 'dra ba'i mgul du sbas: rdza'i bum par mi nub a thaṃ rgya: klu rgyal dbang lag bka' 'di thub par srungs: ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar yang mtha' la: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

hūm̐ ka la artsig gis jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod brag dug sbrul 'dra ba nas gdan drangs shing 'dzam gling rgyan du phab pa'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // 'a) zur 'gebs sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ longs sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ sprul sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams brgyad zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ rig 'dzin dpa' bo seng sgrogs zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ phrin las sgo ma rigs bzhi'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ yang sprul ḍākki bye ba 'bum gyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gter srung rdo rje 'bar ba'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gter srung zangs btsan beg rtse la sogs gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /deng 'dir bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ om̐ kā ya wakkā tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa sngags btsun kun dga' blo gros kyis bris p-i atsha/ ya) bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'i/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bsnyen dmigs bzhugs so/ de la dang po phyi sgrub bsnyen dmigs ni/

phyi lus snang stong mkha' 'gro'i sku/ /nang ni rtsa gsum 'khor lo lngar/ /rdo rje rin chen padma dang*/ /sangs rgyas las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gsal 'bar/ /thugs kar haḥniḥhūm̐ḥriḥsaḥ /rang mdog srog gi snying po gsal/ /chos dbyings sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /thugs dbus hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng*/ /mthing gsal g.yon du 'khor ba las/ /'od 'phros dus gsum bde bar gshegs/ /yi dam dpa' bo ḍākki'i tshogs/ /dpag med kha char 'tshubs pa ltar/ /spyan drangs gnas lnga'i lhar thim pas/ /bkrag mdangs gzi 'bar rang 'od kyi/ /rtsa gnas drwa ba'i ris su khyab/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ /slar 'phros snod bcud kun la phog /thams cad ye shes mkha' 'gro yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam par sad/ /nus 'byin 'ub kyis 'dus pa las/ /sku yi gzi byin stong gsum g.yo/ /gsung gi sngags sgras 'jig rten khyab/ /thugs ni dbyings rig ka nas dag /snang srid ye grol kun bzang mo/ /ma bcos rdzogs chen ngang du bzla/ oṃ muṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ gnyis pa nang sgrub la/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i gnas lnga'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyi srog yig sor bzhag la/ gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lo ru/ /rigs bdag thugs kar nyi ma'i steng*/ /hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba las/ /'od 'phros srid zhi'i dwangs bcud bsdus/ /thugs srog sngags phreng la thim zhing*/ /'od zer bdud rtsi rgyun babs te/ /'khor lo lnga yi mkha' 'gro mnyes/ /kun kyang bde ba'i nyams rgyas te/ kha ṭwāṃ yab tu gyur pa dang*/ /bde ba sbyor ba'i mkha' lam nas/ /byang sems dkar dmar rgyun babs pas/ /'dzin med bde stong phri li li/ /brjod med rang sgra 'u ru ru/ /dbyings rig dbyer med byang chub sems/ /bde stong mkha' 'gro'i rang zhal blta/ bde stong gi ngo bo la rig pa gtad pa'am skabs su bum can nam/

bar rlung dang sbyar nas rlung bzlas kyang bya/ om̐ gu ru singha swa ra gaṇḍe hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gsum pa gsang sgrub ni/ gnas lngar mkha' 'gro gsal ba yi/ /thugs srog 'od kyi phyogs mtshams kyi/ /mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sgo skyong sogs/ /thugs srog bskul ba'i 'dar g.yos kyi/ /rnam pa dang bcas 'od spros pa'i/ /snang srid thams cad 'dar phril phril/ /'ja' dang 'od du ltem ltem zhu/ /bdag nyid gtso 'khor la thim pas/ /bkrag dang gzi byin cher rgyas pa'i/ /gzugs snang thams cad lha skur gsal/ /sgra grags ha ri ni sa'i sgra/ /dran rtog 'od gsal chos sku'i klong*/ /snang cha ma 'gags bkra lam mer/ /'dzin cha ma grub stong sang nge*/ /rig stong blo 'das rdzogs pa che/ /chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang mdangs skyong*/ zhes chos nyid gnyug ma'i rang mdangs 'bol shig ge'i ngang nas/ om̐ badzra ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ ratna ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ padma ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ karma ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ bi shwa ḍākki tsa tur baṃ hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bzla'o/ de ltar phyi nang gsang sgrub grub rjes/ las sbyor phas kyi byad zor rbod gtong sogs phyir bzlog drag sngags su bsgrub pa ni/ bdag nyid rdo rje drag mo yi/ /spyi mgrin thugs dang lte gsang lngar/ /rdo rje padma sangs rgyas dang*/ /rin chen las kyi mkha' 'gro gsal/ /so so'i thugs srog a kaḥdang*/ /de bzhin saḥmaḥraḥdang tsaḥ shaḥdaḥraḥsaḥzung re dang*/ /dpung pa gnyis dang pus g.yas g.yon/ /stag phag dom dang spyang gdong bzhis/ /thugs kar māḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥmatshan/ /de las 'od zer me tshwa dang*/ /rdo rje'i thog rgod mtshon char gyis/ /pha rol byad ma lha srung bcas/ /gzhob thul bsregs shing ming med brlag /tshe bsod rang la thim pa yis/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i skur gyur nas/ /bdud dgra tshar gcod las grub dmigs/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ces bzlas mthar spro na thal brdeb bya zhing*/

dmigs med ngang la bzhag par bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang rong smyon chen po'i mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig gi dgongs don 'don sgom sbrags bde'i slad nyung dril tshigs bcad du spel ba 'di'ang*/ gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis mon kha bum thang sku rjes su sbyar ba'o// // ra) mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i las byang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi tshogs mchod bzhugs so/ ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro mar/ /btud nas zag med bde chen gyi/ /ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bsod nams tshogs mchod rim pa spro/ de la tshogs rdzas phun sum tshogs pa bshams la chu gtsang gis bran zhing*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'khor 'das chos dbyings rol pa'i ngang : du ma ro gcig lta ba yis: gtsang sme'i sgrib pa ka nas dag: ye nas rang byung mchod pa'o: om̐ sarba dharma dhā tu dzñā na ātma ko3 haṃ: gis byin gyis brlab/ tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ maḥ yum chen thugs kyi rnam sprul ma: ma gcig drag mo seṅge'i gdong : ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas khang 'di la byin chen phob: tshogs gtor 'di la bcud chen spel: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ maḥ mchod pa'i lha mo gar sgyur mo: yid 'ong lang ling mdzes ma 'phro: phyag na rin chen gzhong pa bsnams: zhal zas longs spyod tshogs kyis bkang : dgyes pa'i 'khrul 'khor gar bsgyur nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : chos skyong gter bdag dam can la: 'bul lo mchog gi dgyes pa bskyed: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba ḍākki nī sarba sa ma ya ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bskang ba ni/

hūm̐: snang srid khyon ltar rab tu 'geng ba yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla med rdzas: spyan gzigs la sogs kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: rigs bdag seṅge sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong thugs dam bskang : ye shes mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong shugs 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bka' gter skyong ba rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : las byed sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang zhing dgongs pa dgyes gyur nas: nyams chag sor chud mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: oṃ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: oṃ ḍākki sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya sogs gang rung gis kha skong bya/ de nas bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: mdun du tha ma tshogs kyi liṅga la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po myur du khug: lha dang phyes shig bdud dang sprad nas su: bsgral zhing gtub pa'i phrin las dus la babs: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri dzaḥrbad sod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: tshogs la rol ba ni/ hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: sogs?pad kor bcas nas blang*/ hūm̐: lhag nyul ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: snying thig chos 'di'i mel tshe mdzod: bcol ba'i las 'di sgrub tu gsol: om̐ bha ka si bhakṣa si bha lingta kha kha khā hi: thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug khros pa'i drag mo seng gdong ma: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi shugs 'gro phra men tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mthu rtsal dus la bab bo sa ma ya: om̐ ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta khā hi: dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e sa bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

chad mdo gtong ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /'og min bsam yas gze rgyal gangs ra ru/ /sku gsum mkha' 'gro pad 'byung yab yum dang*/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog gter bdag gling pa yis/ /rgyud gsung gter la sbas dang gdan drangs tshe/ /dbyings kyi ḍākki dregs sde gter srung rnams/ /so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ om̐ kro ta kro ti rā hu la ma tri shu la tsa tri nā ga ti pa ra tsa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta khā hi/ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring chen mo'i tshogs: ma mo bcu gnyis sman phran bye ba 'bum/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le tring tring spreng spreng kha kha khā hi/ rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐ maḥ kun gzhi lhun grub dkyil 'khor du: phrin las gang 'dul brda 'gros yis: so so'i gar gyis bro brdungs pas: nga bdag mtshan ma'i ru tra bcom: gnyis med ye shes lhun gyis grub: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: ru tra nan: mā ra ya nan: laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor snod kha gyen du phyogs la/ mchod pa gang rung gis rgyas gdab/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: ḍākki gsang ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: deng 'dir bdag gis thob gyur cig: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wākka tsitta gu hya ghu na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes sku lnga'i rdzas: khams gsum yongs sgrol bla med mchod pa 'di: ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas la 'bul:

thugs dam bskang zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dzaḥ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ?shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: phyag bstod ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag sku gsum rang bzhin can: snying rje dgyes pa'i dpa' mo rngam pa'i zhal: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas la: mi 'bral yid kyi gdung bas phyag 'tshal bstod: spro na yang bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sna tshogs sku bzhi lhun grub ngang nyid las: bde chen yongs rdzogs spros bral brda yi sku: gsang ba ḍākki ye shes lha tshogs la: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os p sogs/ lhag chad bzod gsol ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang dang : ma 'byor dam nyams 'di phyi'i sgrib g.yogs rnams: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzla/ brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ dkyil 'khor ngo bo 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ yig gyen ldog mi dmigs chos skur āḥ gsal stong gdod ma'i dbyings phyug mngon 'gyur shog: a a āḥ bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ ma sring mkha' 'gro gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: bskyed rdzogs phyi nang dge bcu nyams len rnams: brtson 'grus zab mos lhur blang bgyis pa'i tshogs: ma gyur srid pa'i 'gro sgrol ched du bsngo: smon lam ni/ hoḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: ma sring ḍākki srog ltar bsgrubs pa yis: dam tshig g.yel ba med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du: zab lam rjes bzung mchog gi dga' ston gyi: 'bras bu smin nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: ces bsngo smon gyis legs par rgyas gdab nas 'khor gsum mi dmigs ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la rab tu gnas par bya'o/

bkra shis bya ba ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum mkha' 'gro ma sring rgya mtsho'i mthus/ /gnas lugs ngo shes cir snang sgyu mar rtogs/ /'bras bu lhun grub phrin las mtha' ru phyin/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob pa'i bkra shis shog / mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i las byang dregs pa tshar gcod sogs gyi tshogs mchod 'di bzhin spros med bsnyen sgrub la gzhol ba'i skabs dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'i sta gon sogs su dgos pa mthong nas gter gzhung gi bcud bsdus te dpal ldan 'brug gzhung chos kyi rgyal po'i khab shar phyogs 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ces ne ring seṅge rdzong dang 'khan pa ljongs sogs gu ru'i gnas chen du mas bskor ba'i nang gses/ bkra shis g.yang rtse gnas mchog oṃ brgya brag dang 'dab 'brel ba'i khyi nyal dge 'og slob khang du gter kha gong 'og sgrub chen gsar 'dzugs skabs bar gseng du rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing sprel lo zla 11 pa'i tshes 1 la gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis grub par bgyis pa'o// // la) ye shes ḍākki seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog chog bsgrigs su bkod pa gnam lcags spu gri byad ma snying 'byin bzhugs so/ na mo: badzra singha mu kha ye: kun tu bzang mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ /snying rje rab 'phros gdul ka 'dul ba'i ngor/ /dbyings phyug drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can/ /rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro gtso dang yang sprul bcas/ /gus pas 'dud de snying po'i phrin las gzhung*/ /gnam lcags thog mda' dregs pa tshar gcod la/ /brten nas pha rol byad zor phur kha sogs/ /log 'dren rmang med zlog thabs 'di na spro/ /de la 'dir ḍākki singha mu kha'i dbang khrid thob cing bsnyen sgrub las gsum drod tshad dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ de nyid kyi sgo nas gtor zlog bgyis par spro bas/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes so/

dang po gzhung las/ zhing lpags thog tu dkyil 'khor 'bri byas la/ zhes pas srog chags gang rung gi g.yang gzhi'i steng ma traṃ mgo bo lho nub rkang pa byang shar bstan pa'i lte ba rdul tshon bkye ba'am/ ma 'byor na bag phyes bris pa'i chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar gri gug gis mtshan pa'i mthar rdo rwa rdo rje'i me phreng gis bskor/ dbus su lcags kyi mañdzi'am/ ri sna gsum gyi rdo la thod skam bris pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ lcags zangs snod du 'bru nag bag phye la dza gad kyis sbrus pa'i gtor ma'i gdan chos 'byung gru gsum mam 'thug po'i steng du/ dmar gyi gtor ma gnam lcags thog mde'u lta bu'i logs gsum chos 'byung rgyun lam can che ba gc-ig la/ 'khor rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ mdun du dmar gtor zur gsum gtso bo'i phyed tsam sleb pa gcig dang*/ gdan gyi g.yas su khram shing mig dgu pa dang*/ g.yon du nad rkyal sho rdel/ g.yas su mda' bkra/ g.yon du 'phang khra/ rgyab tu rgyang bu/ rtse mor nam mkhar dar gdugs can/ lha'i mngon rtogs dang mthun pa'i sku tsaka sgron/ mtha' skor du o kyu bcad kha phyir bstan gyis bskor ba la bsnol rtsang rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba tshe yungs rtsang sogs rngam brjid dang ldan par bya/ chos 'byung zur drug la dmar gtor dbal can re la mda' 'phang nam rgyang rtsang yungs dkar sogs kyis brgyan/ mtha' skor ram mtha' mchod du khrag gi mchod yon/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog /sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi zhun me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus zhal zas rnams bkod/ gong phugs su rtsa gsum gtor ma nye 'dabs su dam can chos srung spyi sgos kyi mchod gtor/ gzhan yang sman raka nyer spyod/ chad brtan thun gtor nya bo tshogs kyi yo byad sogs/ ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gzhung bzhin zhes gzhan du zhal 'phang 'dug mod/

'dir rong smyon chen po'i zin bris bzhin sdeb cing gab 'khrugs med par nar 'don chog par bya ba la/ bdag bskyed las gzhung gnam lcags thog mda' ltar bzlas pa yan chad bya/ de la srung bzlog bsad gsum tshang dgos phyir/ bzlog pa'i sngon du srung ba shin tu gtso che ste/ mkha' 'gro nag po'i bzlog rgyud las/ srung ba med par zlog byed pa/ /dgra kun nang tshud ma mthong bar/ /mel tshe phyi nas byed dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pas gzhung nas dmigs bsal srung ba'i las rim ni/

hoḥ rang nyid skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong pa can sku mdog sngon mo dbu la thod skam gyi rigs lnga gsol zhing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyangs pa dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod pa: g.yon pas bhandhar nyon mongs kyi snying khrag zhal du gsol ba: mchan du mkhar phur rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa: spyi gtsug tu gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs sku yi gnas lngar gdong can rigs lnga: yan lag lhu tshigs bzhir shugs 'gro ma mo: ba spu'i bu gar yang sprul grangs med spros pa: sku la ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su gsal ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje'i lte bar zla nyi'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gis klad skor nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma: ha khog tu bsrung bya pho mo: 'og tu yul mkhar la sogs gsal ba'i ngang la srung sngags bzlas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sna tshogs grangs med 'phros pas: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung gter bdag rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus rtsal thams cad bsdus nas: bdag dang bsrung bya la thim pas cis kyang mi shigs pa rdo rje'i go cha ru grub par bsam mo: hūm̐ bhyoḥ skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas: 'gags med hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: 'khrul med dran rtog chos nyid ngang : gnyis med bhyo dang phaiṃ ka ra'i: rang bzhin me dpung tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs srung 'khor gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ om̐ mūṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ nṛ bhrūm̐: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces brgya phrag bdun gsum lnga bdun gang 'byor dal brel dang bstun/ mthar rten 'brel snying po yang bzla'o/

zhal shes su/ bdag nyid gtso mo'i thugs srog gi nang du bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud par gsal gdab cing*/ 'od zer spro bsdus gzi byin bskyed cing sgo gsum mi shigs pa ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs su nges par bya dgos la/ mdun bskyed las byang dregs pa tshar gcod ltar/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ snang srid snod bcud chos 'byung e yi mkha': 'byung ba rim brtsegs ma bcos pho brang ni: tsha grang snang srid dkar dmar brtsegs pa yi: shin tu rab 'jigs dur khrod me rlung dbus: mu stegs bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i baṃ gdan steng : sogs spyan 'dren mchod pa bstod pa'i bar rdzogs par byas la/ bzlas pa'i skabs bdag nyid dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros steng phyogs 'og min zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ 'og phyogs srid pa'i ri rab gtsor las kyi mkha' 'gro dang*/ gling bzhir gdong can bzhi/ ri rab kyi rtsa bar khrag gi rgya mtsho klong du ma mo khrag ral ma dang*/ gzhan yang khor yug kun tu/ snang srid kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ste brgyad/ dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bka' nyan las sgrub kyi tshul du gsal/ bdag nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje'i shugs kyis las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi thugs dam drag tu bskul bas/ de rnams kyi zhal nas drag sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam du sgrogs shing sku rngam pa'i stangs stabs kyi gling bzhi ri rab bcas yom yom 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyom zhing phyur bas/ snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad skrag cing 'dar te byad ma rang gshed du phab sku las gnam lcags thog dang mtshon cha'i char/ dug rlangs nad sprin ltar gtibs pas/ srid pa gsum gyi bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad nas rjes shul med par las kyi rlung gis lcags ri'i phyi rol du gtor/ tshe bsod rnam shes bdag nyid la thim pas/ dbyings mi shigs rdo rje'i skur rgyas gdab ste/

de nas rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ mūm̐ḥḍākki singha mu kha dza dzaḥ sgrub sngags ni/ oṃ baṃ badzra ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha ma ma siddhi dza dzaḥ badzra ratna padma karma ḍākki ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ las sngags ni/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces sngags gang 'os dang / de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ bdag nyid drag mor gsal ba yi: sku las spros pa'i khro mo dang : yang sprul khro tshogs dpag med kyis: dgra bgegs bdud sde'i tshogs rnams la: sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char phab ste: dgra sde dpung bcas rdul du rlog: rnam shes chos nyid zhing du spar: dmigs med chos sku'i klong du zlog: phaṭḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces bdun gsum nyer gcig tu bzla zhing dmod bcol thal brdeb bya ba ni/ seng gdong gnam lcags ur mo'i dmigs rim ltar las/ dmigs pa ni: rang nyid drag mor gsal ba'i lag g.yas pa zla ba chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po: g.yon pa nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gsal ba'i bar pha rol ban bon byad ma dgra bgegs lha srung dang bcas sbrang ma mes tshig pa ltar ram thal mo'i bar du bcar ba ltar gnam sa nyi zla cha lang brdabs pas ming med du brlags par bsam mo: kho yi tshe dang bsod nams bkrag mdangs gzi byin thams cad tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas gzi brjid cher 'bar te che btsan kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam: lnga bsdus phung po sha khrag rus pa nang rol rnams ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis zhal du gsol bas:
