dug lnga dug gsum gyi bag sgrib dbyings su dag nas rnam smin las sgrib byang ste: dgra bgegs de dag thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa chos sku yum chen mo'i go 'phang thob ste rgyal yum gyi sras su skye bar bsam la/ lag g.yas zla ba chu'i dkyil 'khor/ lag g.yon nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor bcas gsal te/ lag brdeb sngags dang sbrags nas me chu'i bar du dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad 'thums nas bskal pa 'jig pa'i me chu 'phrad pa'i bar du/ brgyal zhing ming shul med par bsams te/ rdul du gyur ba de'ang sngags spur ba las kyi rlung gi 'tshub ma lta bur gyur bas/ mtha' yi rgya mtsho pha mthar lcags sreg gi ri la gtor bar dmigs te/ lag gi tshigs mthud nas sor rtse dgra la gtad nas spur/ de yis byad ma 'bum stong gi nus pa yang bzlog par the tshom med/ 'joms byed me chu go ldog ces bya'o/ zhes pa'i sngags ni/ khaṃ e ka tsa na e sa bhyo zlog: raṃ dza tri rmug thum bhyo zlog: yaṃ sha ma sha na du shan bhyo zlog: ces bdun lnga gsum sogs dmigs pa rtsal ma rdzogs kyi bar du lag rdeb bya'o/ gong ma las zlog dmigs grub na/ ma bcos de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ngang la mnyam par bzhag hūm̐ bhyoḥzung gi gur khang mos te nyal/ zhes gsungs pa de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi snying po'o/ ༈ de nas bsad las kyi rim par 'jug pa ni/ bka' srung dang chos srung gi gsol ka spyi ltar bya/ de nas rang gzhung gi tshogs byin rlabs nas skong bshags yan grub rjes gzhung las/ mngon spyod drag po'i thun rdzas ma lus bsags: zhes pa dang*/ bsgral chas thun rdzas sogs gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bsags la mdun du 'khod/ rang nyid rdo rje slob dpon zhwa nag ber phod khro pang sogs dpa' chas kyis brgyan zhing rdo rje dril bu lag tu thogs te/ lta ba gyad dang gnyen po ye shes lha:

sprul pa las byed lha yi go cha ni: zhes pa bzhin seng gdong khro mo'i skur gsal zhing*/ phaṭḥ rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma drag tu khros pa bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong pa can: shin tu gtum pa'i dur khrod chas brgyad dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas srog gcod las kyi gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing : g.yon pas kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum thog ltar 'bebs pa: zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs can: chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus su gnas pa: mdun du phrin las kyi sprul pa drag mo spyang gdong ma nag mo gcer mo mi lpags g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon nas nu ma gyen mthur du 'khyil ba: phyag g.yas spu gri dang g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa: dgra bgegs kyi srog la dbang ba'i rnam par gsal: ma mo gsod byed ma'i g.yas g.yon du bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong can dgra bgegs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas thun nag po thogs pa mdun du bla 'gugs las kyi ma mo srog 'phrog gsum ni: dmar mo seng gdong can: sngon mo chu yi mdog can: nag mo mun pa'i mdog can: thams cad lag tu bla 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu: bla 'ching ba'i zhags pa: bla 'dzin pa'i drwa ba: bla dwags kyi ring cha: bla 'bod kyi gri rkang : g.yab mo 'debs pa'i rnga ma dmar nag bcas thogs nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can 'gugs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'o: bhyo baṃ singha ḍākki kro ti ka li ma ma bhyo bhyoḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ma tri ma thun ma bhyo trag rakmo bhyoḥ kha la rakmo e ka tsa ti bhyoḥ khā kha hu lu ma mo bhyoḥ tri dza tri dza baṃ shag shante bhyo bhyoḥ ma mo tri rakmo dza tri ma bhyo bhyoḥ thun thun bhyo bhyoḥ zhes drag sngags bzla zhing gzi byin bskyed de/ ma nyes gzu dpang gser skyems yus gdab bya/ 'gugs gzhug pho nya bkye ba dang lha dang dbye ba sogs thun gyis gzir/ zhes rong smyon chen po'i gzhan du kha 'phang bar mdzad pa las gzu dpang gser skyems mi bzhugs pas 'dir rang lugs dkyil 'khor gzhan nas blang la kha bsgyur byas pa ni/

hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes brtse gzigs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam che mchog phyi nang gsang ba'i lha: bdud 'dul drag mo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: dam can gter srung las kyi rdzu 'phrul can: drag rtsal 'chang ba'i myur mgyogs pho nya rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: ma 'ongs mkhyen gsol dgra la bka' chad phob: sdang zhing gdug pa'i byad ma dgra bo 'di: yi dam lha yis mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: bka' yi chad pa le lan drag por phob: deng 'dir 'gugs nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sarba pañtsa pū dza khā hi: de nas phyogs bcur mchod nas drag mo'i nga rgyal gyis/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku: snang srid 'di ru gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral: nga nyid drag mo khros ma seṅge'i gdong : nga las che ba med do kun gyis nyon: maḥ nga nyid pho brang gnas chen u tsa la: dur khrod chen po rngam chen 'bar ba'i rong : ri bo rus pa 'bab chu khrag dang zhag: rtsi shing thams cad mda' mdung mtshon cha gzengs: sgra skad thams cad rgyob sod 'brug ltar sgrog: ro langs keng rus gcan spyang nyi li li: ngan sngags 'brug sgra gnam lcags sha ra ra: sha za srog gcod dbugs len rongs se rong : 'chi bdag phra men srog len zhungs se zhung : me 'bar mun rab sprin nag 'u ru ru: sprin gseb gnas nyul ma mo glog ltar myur: srid pa'i ri rab yom yom shig shig 'gul: de 'dra'i gnas nas bzhengs pa'i dbang mo che:

che ba'i lha rnams thams cad nga yi 'khor: chung ba'i dregs pa sde brgyad nga yi bran: srid pa 'dir gnas nga yi las mkhan te: nga yis dmod pa'i las 'di gnyer ba'i phyir: phyi nang lha dang srung ma sku bskyod 'tshal: dbyings la gnas shing 'gyu ba'i lha tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: kun kyang bdag nyid las bcol dpung la bzhengs: dmigs pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces dang brub khung dmigs bya bskyed pa ni: mdun du gnam lcags las grub hoṃ khung nag po zur gsum kha dog la mthil yangs pa bang rim dgu kha khyer gsum dang ldan pa: kha khyer dang po la sgrol byed shan pa nag mo glog ltar 'khyugs pa: gnyis par lha bdud nag mos gshin skad 'o dod drag tu 'bod pa: gsum par bla 'gugs dus kyi pho mo srid gsum gling bzhi yud kyis bskor zhing dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes skad cig la 'gugs pa: las kyi brub khung chen po de la mngon spyod kyi rtags kun tshang ba gshin rje'i bsad khang bdud kyi bsha' ra: sde brgyad kyi 'du sa: pho nya'i 'gyu lam: klu bdud kyi gre ba: gza' bdud kyi lto ba: srog gcod nyi khri dgu 'bum 'tshogs pa'i gling chen po: gshin yul zangs thang dmar po'i rnam par mngon sum du bkod pa'i mthil du: nṛ tri dmar nag gnyis las bskyed pa'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs: byad ma sdig can de nyid lus sngo zhing ham pa mig shi mig can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzags pa: yan lag mya ngan gyi cha byad can la lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bsdams pa: gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas phyur ba la grang dmyal brgyad kyi ngad dang ldan pas rab tu gzir nas smre sngags kyi skeg bu 'don pa'i dbyibs su bskyed pa'o: bsad khang nag po de'i nang las kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru 'tshubs pa: phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: nang na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba:

bar du gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa: logs na phra dog gi thog dang ser ba'i bu yug 'tshubs pa: las kyi bdud mo dam sri ma dang dus mtshan ma mtshan mo rgyu ba: srod la nyul ba sreg ma 'phrog ma skem byed ma bcas bdud mo thams cad cho nge lhang lhang byed pa ste: las kyi pho nya rnams kyis bzung nas thar pa med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: bka' bden pa'i stobs kyis 'gugs shing dmigs pa'i rten la dbab pa ni: na moḥ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags gsar rnying rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par nyi ma nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can rigs lnga: u tsa la'i dur khrod chen po nas sku sprul seṅge'i gdong pa can: gsung sprul stag gi gdong pa can: thugs sprul phag gi gdong pa can: yon tan gyi sprul pa dom gyi gdong pa can: phrin las kyi sprul pa spyang ki'i gdong pa can: sgrol byed nag mo lcags kyi gdong pa can: phra men ma bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong pa can: dus kyi pho nya mo dmar mo srog gcod btsan gyi bu mo: sngon mo dbugs len klu yi bu mo: bla 'gugs nag mo bdud kyi bu mo: lo zla zhag dus za ma chu tshod dus kyi pho nya mo: drug cu rtsa bzhi: srid pa'i nag mo shwa thogs rgyan thogs khram thogs rtsis thogs bdud mo bcu gnyis: skye 'gro gling bzhi'i srog bdag mo srin mo khrag gi ral pa can brgyad: ma bhyo dzaḥgasum las 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag ma mo gsum: ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i phra men ma bcu gnyis:

dgra lha'i rmu tsa mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad: gzhan yang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro srid pa'i ma mo dus bdag ma gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa dmod pa'i rig sngags drag po 'di la brten nas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma ming nas smos te 'gugs pa'i las su bcol ba ni: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa: dge 'dun gyi chos sde bcom pa: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i dben ri gnyan po gtor ba: khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag bstan pa'i bdag po rig 'dzin: padma 'byung gnas kyi brgyud 'dzin dpal ldan rnying ma'i chos grwas mtshon pas 'dus sde rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: tshad btsugs pa ya bor bzung ba: do bsdo ba: phod btsugs pa: 'gran btsal ba: 'gras 'tshol ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: chos skyong srung ma'i nus pa gshe ba: gzhan yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: tshe srog la bar du gcod pa: mtho dogs dma' dga' byed pa: sngon 'gugs rgyab 'ded byed pa: shag ngan gyi sna 'dren byed pa: ngos bstod lkog nas smad pa: kha dkar zhing khog nag pa: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: dgra kha dang mi kha zug pa: nad kha dang yams kha 'tshubs pa: ri rgya dang rlung rgya bshig pa: gdan sa mchod zhing 'phrog mi: khyad par du'ang dgra sgo dang gyod sgo 'byed pa: che sri dang chung sri dar sri god sri langs pa: ban byed bon byed skye bo'i mda' zor bud med dmod zor: yugs sa'i thal zor: rig sngags kyi thun zor: zhang zhung gi mthu zor: la sogs pa bdag cag sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum khyim sgo lam gsum: gzhi lam byis gsum thams cad du gnod cing sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi mi rabs bdun rgyud dang bcas pa thams cad:

gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gling phran gling bar mun bar ban bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga la bkod pa: bla shog bu la bris pa: rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ

zhes rol mo drag rdung dang bcas nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: dza bhyoḥ snang srid ma mo srog bdag har len ma: pho nya mi bsrun bdud kyi dbang mo che: nag mo srod la nyul byed dus la bab: dam nyams byad ma'i bla srog khug la shog: keng keng me 'bar gseb nas rgyug byed ma: dmar mo zangs 'phar gdong can dus la bab: byad ma'i bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: sngo dmar rlabs phyur 'phyo ma mun par gtibs: gcan spyang lag ring gdong can dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dgra bo bla 'khyams khug la shog: bhyoḥ bla 'dzin lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: bla 'ching zhags pa nag pos sdoms la shog: bla 'dzin drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: bla 'ded bya gcan rnams kyis chum la shog: dgra bo'i bla dwags ming byang 'di la phob: byad ma gdug pa'i bla tshe rten dang phrol: gzugs byang 'di la khug cig mā ra ya: tri tri nṛ tri aṅku sha ya dzaḥ thun thun ma tri ma tri dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti thun dza dzaḥ zhes rol mo drag rdung dang bcas nas khug rtags ma byung bar bkug: gu gul yungs dkar thang phrom sha chen bsreg: bya rog 'ug pa'i dang rus lha dang dbye: bhyo dzaḥ mun pa nag po khā kha mu kha ma: dgra bgegs ban bon byad ma lha dang phyes: sdig can brnag pa'i dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha skyes lha phyes: dgra lha srung skyob ban bon rnams dang phyes: bhyoḥ hu lu nag mo dug 'debs 'ug gdong ma: ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra bgegs bdud dang sprod: dmigs pa'i byad ma 'chi bdag bdud dang sprod: dmod pa'i dgra bo srog bdag bdud dang sprod: byad ma sdig can phung bdud nag por sprod: satwar thogs bdud kyi bu mo'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs lha dbye bdud sprad dus la bab: mngon spyod mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: bhyo bhyo khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: tri tri nṛ tri dgra bo shag phyes:

bsad sngags bzla zhing thun gyis gzir ba ni: dzaḥ las byed chen po'i dus la bab: dgra bo phung po bshig pa'i phyir: dmod pa nag po'i thun gyis gdab: dzaḥ yungs thun drag sngags dmod pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: rdo thun rbab rgod hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: dug thun smyo 'bog thibs se thib: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: chu thun sbos 'gas 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: khrag thun nad rlangs chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mtshon thun rno ngar zengs se zeng : dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mda' thun thog rgod sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: gnam lcags phur thun hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ thun bhyo bhyoḥ rig sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs dang ldan pas mkhar phur gri gug thogs la/ hūm̐ bhyo dzaḥ las la khros pa'i sha za mo: phra men nag mo lcags gdong can: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba bsnams: yar rtse rdo rje rtse lnga yis: ye shes mkha' 'gro las la bskul: 'chang bzung zlum skor chu srin kha: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas: dbal so zangs gri 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bo'i sgo dgur dzaḥkhram ya: phyag g.yon gnam lcags mkhar phur bsnams: mar rtses dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: 'chang bzung gza' bdud pho nya 'gyu: chu srin mtshon cha'i zi ra khol: zur gsum gnam lcags thog rgod 'bebs: srog bdag ma gsum dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can gyi: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chod kyi: dbang po sgo dgur kī la ya: rtsa mdud lnga la kī la ya: dbang po drug la kī la ya: rnam shes brgyad la kī la ya: 'byung bdud gzugs la kī la ya:

pho rgyud mo rgyud kī la ya: rigs rgyud bcas par kī la ya: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: srog gcod dbugs sdud phung po shig: mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra lokka ma tri ya sarba ka ra ti ka ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: badzra kī li kī la ya tri shu la dgra bo'i snying rtsa myog myog mā ra ya phaṭaḥ ces tshe khrus dgongs pas phur bu gzir/ zhes pas phur bu'i dbal zur gsum las/ 'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams gsum dang*/ rgya mdud 'og mar las byed pho nya rnams kyi 'gyu lam gshin rje'i lto ba/ rgya mdud gong mar chos dbyings gzhal yas khang chen por gsal ba dang*/ gdab pa'i tshe phur bu sras mchog kī la ya/ sku smad phur bu'i rnam pa can no/ dgra bo'i snying khar gdab la/ tshe rten bil rgya btums pa 'dra ba'i de'i nang*/ bla rten byi'u leb pa'i mgo tsam/ khrag gi sbal pa 'dra ba de'i nang*/ srog rten bya ma sar gyi sgo nga tsam dbugs kyi rta la zhon nas/ yungs zhi 'dril ba lta bur ltem ltem yod pa de la/ phur rtse bsnun pas/ snum la til 'byar ba lta bur phur bu'i khong seng nas brgyud de/ dug lnga dug gsum shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral/ bla rten tshe rten srog rten rnams rang la thim pas gzi brjid ches cher 'bar bas/ che btsan kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam/ rnam par shes pa'i thig le 'od bskor drwa ba bya ma sar sgo nga tsam pa de rgya mdud nas thon te ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas brgyud/ spyi bo nas thon gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs ky-i thugs kar bstims te/ phyir mi ldog pa kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong du mnyam par bzhag pas/ gnas lugs don gyi zhing khams ngo sprod gdab bo/ gri gug snying khar btab nas gnas spar ba ni: hoḥ rnam shes ngo bo āḥdakar de: phung po bshig nas klong du thim: phaṭḥ spu gri chu gri ral gri sogs gang rung thogs la:

bhyoḥ gdug pa'i dgra bo byad ma la: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha char pa phob: ming shul tsam yang med par gyis: gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: lha'am 'os kyang brlag par byed: gcod cing gtub pa'i dus la bab: gtubs nas rdo rjes gtun du brdung : rig sngags dmod pa'i byad ma rnams: phye mar shig cig mā ra ya: om̐ badzra ka ra ti ka dgra bo gtub gtub: kha ra ka dgra bo shig shig: a yu dha dgra bo myog myog: badzra kī li kī la ya byad ma bhyo bhyoḥ rbad rbad nan nan chod chod bhandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de nas spu gri ral gri chu gri sogs gang rung gis/ pho g.yas skor mo g.yon skor ske nas brtsam ste bla gnas gar bab tu bsnun cing dum bur gtubs te/ raktas bran/ dgra bgegs kyi sha rus ri bo dang khrag rgya mtsho ltar/ dmar nyil gyis yod pa de la/ bdud rtsi bran pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin brlabs te/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: gnam sa'i zhal gdongs gangs ri'i dbal mche gtsigs: dgra bo byad ma'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rnams: lhag med zhal du bzhes la ming med mdzod: om̐ ḍākki singha mu kha baṃ ha ri ni sa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dbang po lnga dang bcas pa la kha kha khā hi: zhes lhag med bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs par bsam mo/ de'ang rgyud las/ dam nyams dgra bgegs gzhi dbyings grol bas 'tshengs/ /ye shes 'jig rten sha khrag mchod pas 'tshengs/ /bdag nyid ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas 'tshengs/ /'tshengs pa rnam gsum mngon spyod khyad chos so/ zhes so/ gnam sprul gsum pa'i chog bsgrigs su zhal bstab yan grub rjes zhes gzhan du kha 'phang la sku sprul rong smyon smad las phyogs bsgrigs su kha gsal bar gnang yang 'don cha rnams 'gres khongs su bzhag 'dug pa las/ sogs khongs bshangs la ma bu gab bsdebs su spel ba'o/

snga 'gyur lugs srol phal che bar skabs 'dir tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bsngo/ las bskul grub nas bzlog gzhung la 'jug srol 'dug mod/ 'dir rang lugs rong smyon zhabs kyi dgongs pa bzhin sor bzhag byas so/ de nas bzlog pa'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni/ sha chen gyi gsur dang rnga gling rol mo rngam brjid dang ldan par bya zhing gtor mdos sman raka gis bran la gtor chung 'bul/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang bcas pas 'di skad gyer ro/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na: u tsa la yi dur khrod nas: me rlung 'tshubs pa'i gnas mchog nas: ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri: rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung : 'bab chu khrag rnag dmar chen 'khyil: sgra skad hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong ldir: khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing : rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas skyi g.ya' ba: phyag na rdo rje 'jigs pa'i sa: rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas: yum chen phar phyin gshegs su gsol: rdo rje phag mo gshegs su gsol: bdud 'dul drag mo gshegs su gsol: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi gshegs su gsol: bka' skyong ma mo gshegs su gsol: gter srung klu bdud gshegs su gsol: yang 'khor gnas nyul gshegs su gsol: om̐ baṃ singha ḍākki badzra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa dzaḥ rakṣi ta na ga phe sha dza dzaḥ dgra bo byad ma'i sha khrag la kha kha khā hi: gsum pa bzlog mdos la spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims/ de nas bzlog pa'i phrin las bskul ba ni/ zor gtor gtso 'khor dgu pa sha khrag gis sbags pa skyems dang bcas pa bshams la/ na moḥ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha: khyad par ye shes ḍākki seṅge'i gdong : bka' 'khor las byed pho nya'i bden pa'i mthus: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: dge 'dun spyi dgra rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgra: tshe dang srog la bar du gcod pa'i rigs:

gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi tshogs: sri skag byad zor rbod gtong bdag po sogs: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa gang yin pa: stong gsum srid pa'i 'dzin khyon gar gnas kyang : lcags kyus snying zungs zhags pas ske nas chings: yan lag lcags sgrog sdoms la dril bus myos: skyob pa'i lha dbye srog gcod bdud dang sprod: las rlung rgyab ded mun nag mdun nas bsus: skad cig yud tsam gtor rdzas 'di la khug: om̐ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyis bstims rjes/ bstod bskul ni gtor ma bshams la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: aiḥ chos dbyings rnam dag khro chu khol ma'i klong : ye shes las grub ma gcig seng gdong ma: bdud 'dul drag mo'i tshul gyis skur bzhengs shig: khrag zhag rba klong 'khyil ba'i dbus nyid nas: sha za mkha' 'gro sde lnga skur bzhengs shig: dug rlangs rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i nang shed nas: srog gcod ma mo dmar nag skur bzhengs shig: phyogs mtshams drag rtsal rngam brjid dur khrod nas: zhing skyong las kyi ma mo skur bzhengs shig: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong nas bzhengs: gti mug mun rum 'thibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: nga rgyal ri rgod nyil ba'i klong nas bzhengs: phrag dog spu gri brtsegs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: gdug rtsub char sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: ki kang mkha' la rgyu bzhin myur du bzhengs: gnam lcags thog 'bebs ji bzhin myur du bzhengs: drag mo las la bskul bzhin bzhengs pa'i tshe: chos nyid bde stong khro mo sha ra ra: gsal stong drag mo'i dmag tshogs thibs se thib: bde stong bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro nyi li li: snang stong las kyi ma mo spungs se spung : rig stong sha za khro mo khro lo lo: shes rab mtshon cha'i dbal kha si li li: stong nyid seṅge'i nga ro 'u ru ru: tshogs drug bdud bcom nyams dbyangs khra la la:

shar grol me yi tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: shes rig mkha' la gar stabs khyugs se khyug: rang byung srid pa'i rgyal mo yams se yam: las la thogs med chos dbyings mkha' 'gro ma: rdzu 'phrul gnas lugs rtsal ston ma tshogs rnams: de ring skye med drag mo'i skur bzhengs shig: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: dug lnga log par 'dren pa'i dgra bo 'di: mtshan ma rang grol ngang nas myur du sgrol: ma dag log lta 'chang ba'i skal ngan tshogs: chos nyid ting 'dzin bden pas myur du sgrol: nga bdag 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyal 'gong rigs: ye shes rang rtsal rig pas myur du sgrol: 'khrul snang log 'dren dgra bo byad ma rnams: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis myur du sgrol: dkar po dge ba'i bar chad lha yi bdud: 'khrul med mi g.yo rdo rjes myur du sgrol: nag po kha 'byams slu 'brid 'khrul pa'i bdud: shes rab mi g.yo ral gris myur du sgrol: slu 'brid nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra bo 'di: ngo bo gang shar rig pas myur du sgrol: rnam g.yeng 'khrul ngor shar ba'i dgra bo 'di: skad cig drag rtsal khro mos myur du sgrol: ma dag log lta pha rol byad ma'i tshogs: bla mar smad cing sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig: dam 'gal 'gras ya byed cing slob dpon dkrugs: sde dgon gtor zhing dben ri gnyan po bcom: sngags 'chang bdag la sdang zhing dgra ru langs: gsang sngags bstan pa bshig cing sdang ba yi: dmag jag chom po dar zhing dgrar langs pa'i: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di: bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mos myur du sgrol: ma dad log par 'dren pa'i dgra bo 'di: stag gdong drag mo'i tshogs kyis myur du sgrol: dam sri gsang sngags bsnubs pa'i byad ma 'di: phag gdong srog gcod mkha' 'gros myur du sgrol: rdo rje slob dpon bdag la sdang ba rnams: dom gdong snang srid bdag mos myur du sgrol:

gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: spyang gdong sha za mkha' 'gros myur du sgrol: bka' gsang zab gter 'di la gnod byed rnams: bka' srung khrag ral ma mos myur du sgrol: byad ma log par lta ba'i dgra bo 'di: bstan srung ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis sgrol: stobs ldan bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro las la chos: sha za snang srid bdag mo las la chos: sprul pa'i las byed ma sring bstan srung rnams: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: ma rungs log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs rnams: khyod kyi khong nas nad rlangs dug phyungs la: 'du ba rnam bzhi'i dbugs thag chod la shog: pho gdon mo gdon rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog rnams: sha zo khrag 'thung dbugs longs mtshan ma stong : 'dre rgod dal yams phung thab sna dgu rnam: pha rol byad ma log lta'i steng du bhyoḥ ma rungs gdug pa'i mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs rnams: bzlog bsgyur phrin las drag rtsal sa ma ya: gling bzhi'i mi kha rgyangs glu ltas ngan rnams: pha rol g.yul ngo byad ma'i steng du bhyoḥ snang srid bka' yi las byed ma mo'i tshogs: sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i bka' ma bcag: skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dam ma bkral: sngon sbyangs las stobs smon lam tha ma gnyer: da lta sngags 'chang bskul ba don ma chung : dam tshig rdo rje'i mna' la bka' ma 'da': de bas ma sring ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs rje thogs med dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma thogs da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzod: phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma'i sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: rus la rbad rbad: tsitta la rbad rbad: myog myog thum ril rbad rbad ha tri nag po dgra bo byad ma la bhyo bhyoḥ ru tri nag po dgra bo byad ma la bhyo bhyoḥ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa nṛ tri trig nan nan:
e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: oṃ baṃ ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa raksha kro ti dgra bo byad ma'i don snying la kha raṃ khā hi:

zhes thal mo brdab cing gtor ma 'bul/ bzhi pa bzlog pa'i gzhung bsrang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phyir bsgyur nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ gtor chen la ling chung dang gtor ma 'bul/ rakta sbreng la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod u tsa la: rab 'jigs me rlung 'khrugs pa e yi klong : shin tu ya nga sha za'i gnas mchog nas: bdud 'dul snang srid bdag mo dbyings nas bzhengs: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: ye shes sgrib cing dug lnga sdang ba'i rlung : gzi brjid mdangs chen g.yo ba'i stobs kyis zlog: ye shes dbyings kyi ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha dmod tshig rkyen ngan dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: seng gdong dmar mo 'jigs pa'i sgra chen sgrog: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: pho rgyud khro bo'i byad dang skag chen rnams: rab 'jigs bskul ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'jigs byed srog bdag ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dbu skra dmar nag dbyings khyab thod brgyan ma: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: mo rgyud ma mo'i dal yams cho 'phrul rnams: dpa' gtum gshe ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: drag rtsal dbugs sdud ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phyag g.yas gri gug dug lnga rtsad gcod ma: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i byad: rngam byed gzhom pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: sha za gnas nyul ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur:

thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: g.yon pas thod khrag gdug pa'i snying 'byin ma: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: pha rol ban byad bon byad mnan bsregs rnams: gtum drag tshar gcod stobs ky-is bzlog tu gsol: khrag 'thung zhing skyong ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rus rgyan kha ṭwāṃ me long rgyan ldan ma: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'd-i bzhes la: sngon las 'phral rkyen byad zor phur kha rnams: 'gying rtsal 'khril ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: las byed khram thogs ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: thal tshon khrag zhag zhing glang rgyan ldan ma: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nad mug mtshon kha dal yams than ltas rnams: khro 'gying zil gnon stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: las byed gnas nyul ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dar dpyangs thod phreng stag sham rol stabs can: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: gtad ser ngag mnan phung shing rdzas sbyor rnams: drag cing gzir ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'gyu byed sman btsun ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: pad nyi ro gdan me dpung rab 'khrigs ma: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: snga dgra phyi dgra sgos dgra chom rkun rnams: drag rtsal gshe ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol:

las byed ma mo yang sprul dgra la bhyoḥ mi kha rkyen ngan dmod tshig dgra la sgyur: thugs dam dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : bhyo bhyo zlog zlog byad ma sna dgu zlog: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: shar phyogs gtum drag tshal gyi dur khrod nas: me long rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: dri za grul bum gnod pa dgra la sgyur: srog lus dbang thang nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: lho phyogs gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: mnyam nyid rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: gshin rje me lha'i gnod pa dgra la sgyur: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: nub phyogs padma 'khyil ba'i dur khrod nas: sor rtog padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: klu dbang srin po'i gnod pa dgra la sgyur: tshe chos snyan grags nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: byang phyogs kī li sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: bya grub las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: gnod sbyin dbang ldan gdon tshogs dgra la sgyur: mthu stobs nus rtsal nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: dbus phyogs mkha' spyod dag pa'i dur khrod nas: chos dbyings sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: gza' gdon sa bdag gnod pa dgra la sgyur: rtsa rlung thig le nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa yis: mkha' dbyings rakta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rlung lnga bgegs kyi gnod pa dgra la zlog: bka' chad 'khu ldog ma lus zhi ba dang : mi mthun bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: shar sgo rdo rje shugs 'gro myur mgyogs mas: zhe sdang lha bu'i bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: lho sgo rin chen shugs 'gro rdzu 'phrul mas: nga rgyal phung po'i bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: nub sgo padma shugs 'gro mi pham mas: 'dod chags nyon mongs bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: byang sgo las kyi shugs 'gro nus 'byin mas: phrag dog 'chi bdag bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol:

rigs bzhi shugs 'gro sgo ma chen mo'i tshogs: chos rnams rab rdzogs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag khros pa'i tshul: g.yas na rang rtags g.yon na bhan dmar 'dzin: ti ra baṃ steng brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs: las dang ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag dang yon mchod 'khor bcas la: grib dang mi gtsang rkyen tshogs zhi ba dang : rtsa rlung dbang thang nyams pa yar la gsos: dam tshig nyams chag ma lus sor chud nas: bla srog rten 'dzugs tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sun kha dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gtso mo'i spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od thig le'i dbus: nyi zla padma 'bar ba'i gdan gyi steng : rigs kyi bdag po gu ru seṅge'i sgra: mthing nag rab khros sdo rje sdigs mdzub can: seng lpags stag sham brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: thugs dam bskul lo chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs rjes mthu stobs rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: pha rol mu stegs ban bon byad ma yis: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rbad 'dre rbod gtong sogs: byad kha phur kha rlung sgrub gtad mnan rnams: bzlog go byad ma rang gshed rang nus zlog: bsgyur ro rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: shar phyogs stag gdong sku sprul bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i sgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag phung sri 'dre rgod rnams: bzlog go pha rol byad ma'i steng du zlog: bsgyur ro mi mthun rkyen tshogs dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

hūm̐: lho phyogs yon tan phag gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag phung sri 'dre rgod rnams: bzlog go pha rol byad ma'i steng du zlog: bsgyur ro mi mthun rkyen tshogs dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ḥ nub phyogs gsung sprul dom gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag phung sri 'dre rgod rnams: bzlog go pha rol byad ma'i steng du zlog: bsgyur ro mi mthun rkyen tshogs dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: byang phyogs phrin las spyang gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag phung sri 'dre rgod rnams: bzlog go pha rol byad ma'i steng du zlog: bsgyur ro mi mthun rkyen tshogs dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ rakta'i rba rlabs 'phyo zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus: gtso mo'i thugs sprul srog bdag srin gzugs ma: stong gsum ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo mdzad: dmar nag ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgrengs: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs: phyag g.yas khram shing g.yon pas nad rkyal 'dzin: nu 'bur gnyis nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: mtshan ma rab bsgrad dgra la dmar yams gtong : chibs su phung stag dmar mo srog gzan chibs: khrag zhag dug rlangs 'tshub ma'i klong nas bzhengs: dam rdzas khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe:

snga dgra phyi dgra 'chang zhing gdug rtsub can: slob ma dam log yon bdag gzhungs ngan dang : dam tshig bka' bcag nyan thos snying ngan can: rkun 'phrog bcom zhing g.yab dar shag 'debs rnams: khro mo'i mngon spyod drag pos sgrol bar mdzod: glo bur ye 'drog dus min 'chi ba dang : byad kha phur kha sde brgyad spyi g.yo ba: rgyal po'i smyo 'bog ma mo'i kha rlangs dang : lo zla zhag dus skag rigs ngan pa sogs: dus kyi chad pa thams cad dgra la zlog: bzlog go rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po phyi khyams mu ran nas: gtso mo'i bka' sdod phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: dbang mo nyer brgyad zhing skyong phra men ma: gnas nyul dur khrod mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: ma bdud sring bzhi pho nya 'bar ma bzhi: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sha za ma mo'i rigs: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i gtso dang yang sprul tshogs: 'jigs pa'i lus la rngam pa'i cha lugs can: phyag mtshan phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams: sku mdog ma nges rnam pa ci yang bsgyur: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi: chag chen nyam nga thams cad dgra la sgyur: rmi ltas mtshan ngan thams cad bzlog tu gsol: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor nas: rdo rje g.yar dam skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po seṅge'i gdong : yum chen bdud kyi gtso mo si na ra: las byed baṃ chen bka' 'khor dregs sde brgyad: shan pa zangs btsan rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal: gza' klu dus drug ma mo btsan sde drug: yang sprul bya gcan sha za'i tshogs bcas rnams:

sha khrag dmar chen 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan bshig bstan 'dzin sku la bsdo: gsang sngags chos la dmod cing bdag la 'tshe: lta log dam nyams khrims ral spun la 'khu: byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zlog: byad kha phur kha dmag 'khrug yams nad dang : dam sri 'gong po rgya 'dre'i gnod pa'i 'phrul: mtha' bzhis rgol ba skye 'gro'i nyer 'tshe rnams: sdang ba'i dgra yi steng du mā ra ya: gnod pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bhyo bhyo zlog: mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun bhyo bzlog cig: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: 'di bar du byad khrol nas byung ba'i yang bzlog thog mda' dgu skor gyis gsung bar snang yang deng yod par ma mngon/ rang gzhung las byung ba'i yang bzlog thog mda' dgu skor bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig ma sring dbyings nas bzhengs: bdud 'dul drag mo dbyings nas bzhengs: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men stag gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men phag gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men dom gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: phra men spyang gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: bka' skyong khrag ral dbyings nas bzhengs: dbang mo nyer brgyad dbyings nas bzhengs: gnas nyul mkha' 'gro dbyings nas bzhengs: bzhengs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mu stegs 'dul ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: dam sri bsgral ba'i mtshon cha thogs: mtshon cha rdo rje mda' thogs la: 'bar ba rtse gsum thogs pa mo: g.yul las rgyal ba'i gri thod 'dzin: dur khrod rus rgyan g.yang gzhi thogs: khro gnyer mche gtsigs zhal gdang ma: ma mo'i lus la gzi brjid 'phro: mo ni srid gsum g.yo ba mo: dug mtshon me chu'i byad kyis ni: 'jigs par mi nus gtum pa mo: nyid kyi sprul pa'i rol rtsal las: bka' sdod dbang mo nyer brgyad ma: gnas nyul phra men srin mo'i gzugs:

lha mo khrag ral mthu mo che: yang 'khor sde brgyad las la gtso: srod la rgyu zhing sha la za: mu stegs khrag la dgyes pa mo: dzaḥ phra men chen mo'i dus bab: srid pa'i ma mo glog ma sprin: dza mun gshin rje'i las byed ma: gsod la dga' zhing gcod la rngam: phyag na gnam lcags thog mda' bsnams: byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: ban de sngags pa'i hoṃ sbar yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mu stegs rnams kyi ngan sngags yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sde brgyad dregs pa'i rbad 'dre rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: lha srin yongs kyi rbod gtong rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: drang srong rnams kyi dmod pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: nag po klu la gtad pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sa bdag gnyan la bcol ba rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: rigs sngags zor kha 'debs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sa nas dug mda' g.yos pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog:

bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: phyogs nas dmag chen langs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dam sris phyi nang dkrugs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: phung sri'i gyod kha 'phen pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: 'gong po rbad 'dre thams cad rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: lo dang gza' skar mi mthun rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gshed bzhis dur kha 'debs pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gzugs med gshin skad 'don pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dur nas bla 'bod byed pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: srid kyi phywa g.yang nyams pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dbul sri phugs su tshud pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: 'byung pos mgo skor byed pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: than dang cho 'phrul 'gyed pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: srung rta'i rgya ma chag pa rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sme ba rlung rta nyams pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: pho skag mo la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mo skag pho la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog:

bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: che skag chung la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: chung skag che la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: sgas skag gzhon la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: gzhon skag sgas la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: nor skag mi la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: mi skag nor la rtsub pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: rgyal skag blon la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: blon skag rgyal la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: rje skag 'bangs la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: 'bangs skag rje la yo ba yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dus skag na skag 'chi skag yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: tshe zad za 'grang thebs pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: brgya dang gos grangs them pa yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog:

bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: dar sri god sri thams cad yang : bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro byad kha dgra la sgyur: pha rol byad ma sdig can gyi: rang mthu rang nus steng du zlog: dgra bo'i lha srung gshed du phob: sde brgyad za kha dgra la ston: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e ka du na e sa bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e ka du ru bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ma tri ya tri re ma ti bhyo zlog: na sha tsa tu du ma ya āḥ trig khroṃ bhyo zlog: ma ṇi ma ra bhyo zlog: mā ra ya du bhyo zlog: rbad sa ma ya bhyo zlog: ha la ha la hal ta hal ta bhyo zlog: sarba ka khor du mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces lag rdeb bya bar du sbyar/ de nas dbang mo nyer brgyad sngags bzlog yang spro na sbyar/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ oṃ nu raksha si bhyoḥ prahma ni bhyoḥ rau trī ma bhyoḥ biṣṇa bhya bhyoḥ ku mā ri bhyoḥ ind+ra ma bhyoḥ sing gha laṃ bhyoḥ a mṛ taṃ bhyoḥ sau hu mye bhyoḥ daṇṭa ha bhyoḥ raksha si bhyoḥ bhaksha si bhyoḥ ra tri badzra bhyoḥ re tri re ma ti bhyoḥ e ka tsa ti ma bhyoḥ ma nu ha ra ma bhyoḥ si taṃ ka ya ma a bhyoḥ bha ya bhya bhyoḥ ma hā ma ra ṇa bhyoḥ agne ye ma bhyoḥ bha ra hi bhyoḥ tsa mant+ri bhyoḥ su ta ni bhyoḥ wa ru ṇa bhyoḥ ma hā kā li bhyoḥ tsa ka la ma bhyoḥ ma nu ma na bhyoḥ lambho dhā ra bhyoḥ bzlog bsgyur bhyo gdab dal mor bya: de nas rtsang bzlog bya ba ni/ bzlog pa'i dmigs rim bcas pas/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ye shes ḍākki seṅge'i gdong pa can: myur mgyogs pho nya shan pa 'tshogs pa'i rten: rno dbal drag po'i rtsang phur ldan pa ni: zur gsum sku gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: mtho dman srid gsum rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings: mang nyung grangs med tsha ngar me yi zer: myur mgyogs thog rgod drag po rlung gi shugs: gzi byin nyi zla myur mgyogs glog gi 'gyu: rno dbal spu gri sgrol 'debs ki kang myur: rtse mo zhe sdang gdug pa'i me ri 'bar: sked pa rgya mdud gti mug mun rim gtibs: rtsa bar 'dod chags srid pa'i khrag mtsho khol: drwa mig las mkhan nga rgyal ri ltar nyil: zur gsum phrag dog gdug pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs: bzlog med las kyi drag po'i rtsang phur tshogs: bskul lo bzhengs shig myur mgyogs mthu bo bskyed: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: phrag dog g.yul ngo gdug pa'i dmag tshogs rnams: dug mda' gzer phur nag po khyod kyis zlog: chag che nyam nga rmi ltas mtshan ngan rnams: dam nyams dgra bo byad ma'i steng du zlog:

mi kha gleng gzhi gshe skur smra ngan byur: phung shig kha sbyor pha rol dgra la zlog: rtsang la gnas pa'i chos skyong pho nya dang : las dang ye shes sha za ḍākki'i tshogs: bskul lo rbad do tha tshig dam ma g.yel: dgra bgegs byad ma'i rten mkhar yul khang shigs: srung skyob ban bon lha srung bcas pa rnams: gnam lcags ri bo brgyab myos bsregs byas nas: bskal pa'i rlung g.yos thal ba bun gtor bzhin: lhag ma rjes med brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ḍākki nī singha mu kha ha ri ni sa ru tra tshindha ya tshindha ya bhandha ya bhandha ya mā ra ya trag raksha ha la ha la hu lu hu lu na sha ya ru tra bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: mā ra ya rbad rbad: zlog byang ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: pha rol byad kha rbod gtong zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ zlog sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ༈ bzlog pa grangs bsag ni/ hūm̐ bhyo?ḥ rnam thar sum ldan stong nyid e klong nas/ /rnam kun mchog ldan drag mo 'phrog byed zhal/ /rnam mang rol rtsal 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs la/ /rnam rtog dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes/ /chags sdang byad phur skye med klong du zlog /gzung 'dzin ru tra ye shes mtshon chas gtubs/ /'khrul snang 'khor ba gzhi grol dbyings su sgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ zhes pa 'di'ang e wam̐ bsam gtan gling du gnam lcags gu hyas so// // mthar thal brdeb ni/ phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ

khaṃ e ka tsa na e sa bhyo zlog: raṃ dza tri mun tri rmug thun bhyo zlog: yaṃ sha ma sha na du shan bhyo zlog: ces bzlas mthar/ hūm̐: rang nyid khyab bdag bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku: g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis gnam sa nyi zla'i dal: tsha grang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i e dbyings su: dgra bgegs byad ma yul mkhar mngon du gsal: rig sngags dmod pas gnam sa brdabs pa'i tshe: dgra gdon phye mar rlog cig mā ra ya: las ngan bag chags gtor cig hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭḥ lhag med dbyings su btab bo satwaṃ bha ya: 'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor cig a a āḥ zhes thal rdeb bya/ thal mo brdab pa dang bcas zlog sngags bgrang ngo*/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bsngo ba dang*/ gtor 'bul chad brtan bro brdung grub nas mchod bstod gzhung ltar dang rten bzhugs bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis gzhung ltar bya'o/ nyin tha ma 'phang ba'i skabs gzhan du shes so/ de ltar ye shes ḍākki singha mu kha'i gtor zlog chog bsgrigs gnam lcags spu gri byad ma snying 'byin 'di yang sngar nas brtsam 'dun yod pa'i steng nye char rang gi zhang po bla ma bkra shis rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ gnam lcags sprul phreng gsum pas gter gzhung rtsa ba'i tshig la cung zhig phri bsnan kha 'gengs bgyis te rang gnas bdud 'dul sngags gling du sbyar ba'o/ zhes ye shes ḍākki singha mu kha'i gtor zlog zlog gzhung chog bsgrigs gnam lcags spu gri byad ma snying 'byin gnam lcags thugs sprul sku phreng gsum pa gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dang*/ ye shes bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog gi zin bris gnam lcags sku sprul sku phreng dang po rong smyon gyis mdzad pa gnyis gung bsdebs zhal 'phang ba rnams dkyus su bcug /sogs khongs su bzhag pa nar gyis bshangs te/ gter gzhung gzhir bzhag 'don chog tu bgyis pa 'di'ang padma'i rgyal tshab 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer sogs dam pa du mas lugs 'di'i srog rtsa chad mthud kyi byed por dbang bskur zhing*/

dbang yig gis mtshon pa'i gter gzhung 'di rnams la chog khrigs zhig kyang dgos par 'dug ces bka' stsal thob mod/ 'on kyang cha tshang gsar spros bya ba la dgos pa ma mthong zhing gnam lcags sprul phreng gsum pa'i chog khrigs sor gnas thog kha 'gengs bgyis te/ bdud 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i zab gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus sgrub chen thun gseng rnams su zhib bsdur dang bcas 'brug bkra shis g.yang rtse khyi nyal sge 'og rig slob rgyab skyor lte gnas su/ shing sprel zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes dga' ba dang por gnam lcags rdo rje'i rig sngags 'chang ba'i gzugs brnyan pa sprang smyon gu hyas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // sha) zlog byang ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: pha rol byad kha rbod gtong zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ zlog sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ a hi kā l̥ na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: grangs mang po bsog na 'dir dgos so/ phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ khaṃ e ka tsa na e sa bhyo zlog: raṃ dza tri mun tri rmug thun bhyo zlog: yaṃ sha ma sha na du shan bhyo zlog: ces bzlas mthar/ hūm̐: rang nyid khyab bdag bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku: g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis gnam sa nyi zla'i dal: tsha grang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i e dbyings su: dgra bgegs byad ma yul mkhar mngon du gsal: rig sngags dmod pas gnam sa brdabs pa'i tshe: dgra gdon phye mar rlog cig mā ra ya: las ngan bag chags gtor cig hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭaḥ lhag med dbyings su btab bo satwaṃ bha ya:

'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor cig a a āḥ zhes thal rdeb bya/ yang bzlog sngags 'di seng gdong byad khrol nang nas bris pa'o// // sa) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong can las/ 'phen pa zor las lhan thabs dang bcas dkyus gcig tu bkod pa rdo rje'i thog mda' nag po bzhugs so/ ḍākki bde chen mtsho rgyal khros ma'i lha/ /rab khros bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mo yi/ /gdug pa'i g.yul 'joms dmod pa nag po las/ /'phang ba zor gyi las rim 'di na spro/ sel med rang gzhung zab gsang gter gcig 'di/ /rgyud dang mthun pa'i mngon spyod brtsam pa'i phyir/ /mar ngo'i dgu dang pha rol gshed gza' bab/ /yang na phung skar la sogs 'jigs nyi'i dus/ /tshad mar ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rnal 'byor dmod pa'i chas su zhugs byas te/ khro mo'i stangs stabs stag mo mchong ba'i 'gros/ /rig sngags gdengs ldan rngam brjid drag mo'i tshul/ /bstan 'gro'i sems bskyed dpa' stobs snying rje ldan/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /ma nyes dpang gzugs dran dang gser skyems 'bul/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs dpang du gzugs/ /yi dam rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor dpung du bskyed/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs las chas phyir/ /chos skyong dam can srung ma ra mdar sbran/ /rdo rje'i 'od ldan gsal ba gsum ldan ngang*/ /phyogs med phyogs mtshams kun la zor chen 'phang*/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ nyin tha ma zor 'phang ba'i skabs yin na gong gi bzlog pa grangs gsog grub ma thag mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i mchod bstod ni/ om̐ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dzaḥ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ?shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bzlog pa'i mtha' bskor gyi mchod pa rnams bzlog par stob/ hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag sku gsum rang bzhin can: snying rje dgyes pa'i dpa' mo rngam pa'i zhal:

dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas la: mi 'bral yid kyi gdung bas phyag 'tshal bstod: yul phyogs 'gar bzlog dbang zhu srol yod pa ltar bya na skabs 'dir byas na legs par mngon/ de'ang rtsa sngags sham dngos grub sngags sbyar bas chog par sems so/ de nas gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs pa ni/ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kyis dbye ba'i rgyas: skad cig mdun bskyed gtor ma'i ye shes pa: nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang mdzad par gyur: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ gis bsdu rgya bcas/ mdun bskyed dmar chen gtor ma'i dam tshig pa: bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur: sa ma ya dgra bgegs ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ slar yang sngar bzhin gtor chen skad cig gis: khro gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba: 'phang ba tsam gyis stong gsum brlag nus pa'i: ha la ha la'i sdong po chen por gyur: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ sa ma ya ha la ha la zor ya zor ya thun ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad sod phaṭḥ thun dang zor rdzas rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus la gral gsham nas bzung rim gyis slob dpon bar ljags sngags kyi rno ngar btags/ sde brgyad spyi chings kyi 'khor lo gdags/ spro na sde brgyad gser skyems yang 'don/ gzu dpang gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong drag mo'i tshogs: rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: ma nyes ma lan gzu dpang dkon mchog bzhugs: drang shan phye ba'i sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams log 'dren byad ma 'di nyid la: drag sngags rdo rje phur pa'i thun brdegs pas: ko long ru nga phra dog ma mdzad par: mngon spyod bka' yi chad pa drag po ni: de ring dam nyams log 'dren 'di la phob: las mkhan dus la bab bo sa ma ya: de nas sgo dbye bya ba ni/

rin chen snod du khrag chang arghaṃ sbyar/ /rin chen brdar phye 'bru sna sman phud bcas/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor phyag tu thogs/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i phyogs bcu na: bzhengs bskul mkhyen gsol gzigs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: byad gtad ru tra sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ bdud 'dul ḍākki'i 'khor tshogs gnyan po rnams: thugs dam chen mo dus las mi 'da' phyir: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gzi byin nus pa'i rtsal dang zor dpung skyed: hūm̐: las byed phra men chen mo yang 'khor sprul: mi bsrun dgra bgegs gshed dang 'bebs pa'i tshogs: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: myur mgyogs mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la phob: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro shar gyi las byed rnams: ḍākki stag gdong byad ma sgrol byed ma: dri za grul bum gnod sbyin sha za 'bum: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dri za'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro lho yi las byed ma: ḍākki phag gdong dgra bgegs sgrol byed ma: gshin rje me lha khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro 'bum: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro nub kyi las byed ma: ḍākki dom gdong bar chad zlog byed ma: srin po klu dbang 'khros byed rus 'cha' 'bum: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: srin po'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro byang gi las byed ma: ḍākki spyang gdong byad gtad 'grol byed ma: rlung lha dbang ldan srog gcod bye ba 'bum: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: sha za'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs:

ham̐'u: bdud 'dul seng gdong ḍākki dbyings nas bzhengs: ma tshogs bdud 'dul lha tshogs dpung skyed la: lo zla dus dang tshes grangs chu tshod kyis: srid par rgyu ba'i las byed ma lus kun: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: zor lam phyes shig phyogs su da byol cig: om̐ baṃ ḍākki singha badzra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ lo ka pā la ya pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā: zhes gser skyems phyogs bzhir mchod cing sgo dbye ba ni/ dzaḥ shar phyogs stag gdong zhi byed sgo skyong ma/ /dkar mo rdo rje lcags kyu thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /lcags kyu'i lde mig thogs mdzad shar sgo phyes/ /'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ha badzra ḍākki dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ lho phyogs phag gdong rgyas pa'i las mdzad ma/ /ser mo rin chen zhags pa thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /zhags pa'i lde mig thogs mdzad lho sgo phyes/ /'byor drug rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ri ratna ḍākki hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nub phyogs dom gdong dbang gi las mdzad ma/ /dmar mo padma lcags sgrog thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /lcags sgrog lde mig thogs mdzad nub sgo phyes/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ni padma ḍākki baṃ baṃ/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs spyang gdong drag po'i las mdzad ma/ /ljang mo ral gri dril bu thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /dril bu'i lde mig thogs mdzad byang sgo phyes/ /dgra bgegs tshar bar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ saḥkarma ḍākki ho hoḥ

las gzhung bskul 'don/ spro na srin mo za lam dang glud rab bcas 'dir bya/ de nas chad mdo gyer la gtor ma bzlog par stob/ dkar lam sbreng zhing*/ ru mtshon sogs kyis sna drangs 'phen sar bslebs pa dang*/ thog mar 'bru sna btab pa'i gser skyems rdor slob kyis thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yang 'khor bcas: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'dir gnas yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum por gser skyems 'bul/ de nas yus gdab gzu dpang bya ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong drag mo'i tshogs: rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: ma nyes ma lan gzu dpang dkon mchog bzhugs: drang shan phye ba'i sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams log 'dren byad ma 'di nyid la: drag sngags rdo rje phur pa'i thun brdegs pas: ko long ru nga phra dog ma mdzad par: mngon spyod bka' yi chad pa drag po ni: de ring dam nyams log 'dren 'di la phob: las mkhan dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bden stobs brjod cing dmigs bya rten la dbab pa ni/ na moḥ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang :

sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags gsar rnying rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par nyi ma nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can rigs lnga: u tsa la yi dur khrod chen po nas sku sprul seṅge'i gdong pa can: gsung sprul stag gi gdong pa can: thugs sprul phag gi gdong pa can: yon tan gyi sprul pa dom gyi gdong pa can: phrin las kyi sprul pa spyang ki'i gdong pa can: sgrol byed nag mo lcags kyi gdong pa can: phra men ma bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong pa can: dus kyi pho nya mo dmar mo srog gcod btsan gyi bu mo: sngon mo dbugs len klu yi bu mo: bla 'gugs nag mo bdud kyi bu mo: lo zla zhag dus za ma chu tshod dus kyi pho nya mo: drug cu rtsa bzhi: srid pa'i nag mo shwa thogs rgyan thogs khram thogs rtsis thogs bdud mo bcu gnyis: skye 'gro gling bzhi'i srog bdag mo srin mo khrag gi ral pa can brgyad: ma bhyo dzaḥgasum las 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag ma mo gsum: ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i phra men ma bcu gnyis: dgra lha'i rmu tsa mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad: gzhan yang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro srid pa'i ma mo dus bdag ma gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa dmod pa'i rig sngags drag po 'di la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa: dge 'dun gyi chos sde bcom pa: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i dben ri gnyan po gtor ba: khyad par du rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: tshad btsugs pa: ya bor bzung ba: do bsdo ba: phod btsugs pa: 'gran btsal ba:

'gras 'tshol ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: chos skyong srung ma'i nus pa gshe ba: gzhan yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: tshe srog la bar du gcod pa la sogs pa bdag cag sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum khyim sgo lam gsum: gzhi lam byis gsum thams cad du gnod cing sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi mi rabs bdun rgyud dang bcas pa thams cad: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gling phran gling bar mun bar ban bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ de nas zor du bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig mi mngon chos sku'i klong nas bzhengs/ /bdud 'dul gtso mchog seng gdong dbyings nas bzhengs/ /sras mchog ma mo mched bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /myur mgyogs khrag ral bdud smin dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar dug mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs/ /dug rlangs bu yug 'tshubs pa'i klong nas bzhengs/ /srog gcod mun ltar gtibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /sngags 'chang bdag la brnag pa'i dgra bo la/ /dmag dpung bskyed la dgra yul rten gnas rlog /las la bskul lo bdud 'dul rtsal ma zhan/ /bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad phyogs skyong dang*/ /gdong la gnas pa'i dregs chen zo dor rnams/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes g.yas g.yon phyogs su bzur/ /rtog med dbu chum 'dzin med zhabs skums shig /bsgrub pa'i lha srung bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod/ /drag po'i zor 'di dgra bo'i steng du drongs/ /zor ya log rdugs 'byams su ma bcug cig

/srung ma pho nya rgyug log ma byed cig /chos skyong dam can mthu med mi srid kyi/ /nyes can dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re/ /gnam sa gling bzhi gling bar lcags ri'i mtha'/ /ban bon srung gur skyabs 'og gar gnas kyang*/ /da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ de nas shar gyi stag gdong ma'i zor thogs la shar phyogs su gzir la/ hūm̐: shar phyogs stag gdong sku sprul bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: shar phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: om̐ baṃ singha ḍākki badzra bha ra hi ha rakṣe ta na ga phe sha mā ra ya bhyoḥ lho'i phag gdong ma'i zor thogs la/ lho phyogs su gzir la/ hūm̐: lho phyogs yon tan phag gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: lho phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: om̐ baṃ singha ḍākki ratna bha ra hi ri rakṣe ta na ga phe sha mā ra ya bhyoḥ nub kyi dom gdong ma'i zor thogs nas/ nub phyogs su gzir la/ hūm̐: nub phyogs gsung sprul dom gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : pha rol mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra:

rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: nub phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: oṃ baṃ singha ḍākki padma bha ra hi ni rakṣe ta na ga phe sha mā ra ya bhyoḥ byang gi spyang gdong ma'i zor thogs nas byang phyogs su gzir la/ hūm̐: byang phyogs phrin las spyang gdong bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs glo bur ye 'drog ltas ngan dang : byad zor mi kha dmod tshig g.yo ba'i dgra: rgyal 'gong bse rag dbul sri 'dre rgod rnams: dug rdzas tshe zor mda' 'phang nam rgyang gis: bzlog go pha rol log lta byad ma choms: snang srid las kyi ri rab zor thun 'di: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: byang phyogs byad ma'i dpung tshogs rdul du rlog: om̐ baṃ singha ḍākki karma bha ra hi ni rakṣe ta na ga phe sha mā ra ya bhyoḥ de nas khrag ral ma'i bskul zor thogs la/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ rakta'i rba rlabs 'phyo zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus: gtso mo'i thugs sprul srog bdag srin gzugs ma: dmar nag khrag gi mdog can skur bzhengs shig: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: dkon mchog bka' chad sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: snga dgra phyi dgra 'chang zhing gdug rtsub can: slob ma dam log yon bdag gzhungs ngan dang : dam tshig bka' bcag nyan thos snying ngan can: rkun 'phrog bcom zhing g.yab dar shag 'debs rnams: lo zla zhag dang za ma chu tshod la: ring par ma bzhag srog rtsa chod la shog: snying khrag rngubs shig 'dus byas sdus la shog: rnam shes srog dbugs rten dang phrol la shog: bskul lo bka' skyong ma mo mthu ma chung : dug zor nag po zhe sdang ru tra'i snying :

dbal zor dmar po myur mgyogs khro mo'i rdzas: rngam 'debs nag po srog bdud zhags pa 'khyugs: bzlog zor dmar po ma mo'i khrag nad zor: dam nyams dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing la: btab bo klu bdud nag po'i mdze nad bzhin: dgra la skar stong bye ba bdun brgyar thob: rtsad chod yul 'joms lhag rjes med par thongs: rag mo du ling nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ har ling kaṅka ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ mu kha mi bdud nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ e ka ru lu nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ ru ra li shi nag mo dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la dmar nag snying gzer khrag bshal ya: 'go nad rgyug 'gyel sha khul 'dar ling ya: sbos 'gas rlangs 'thab dug mda' rgyug 'gyel ya: chos chos zor zor ma mo mthu ma chung : dgra bo gnam sa go ldog 'gyu bzhin du: nad rlangs dug dang dbyer med phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma mo rakmo raksha tri tri sha ru tra ma waka tsi nṛ tri chod chod rbad tsitta snying la bhyo bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas gter srung zangs btsan gyi zor gtor thogs la: hūm̐: gter srung zangs btsan 'bar ba'i tshogs: bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: las kyi sde dpon dmag la chos: srog bdag nyi khri rlung ltar 'tshubs: zangs btsan shan pa dgra la bhyoḥ smyo 'bog steng grib chu ltar khol: gza' bdud nag po dgra la bhyoḥ mdze nad lhog yams mun ltar gtibs: klu yi bu mo dgra la bhyoḥ shan pa'i dmag tshogs nyi li li: yang 'khor sprul pa dgra la bhyoḥ mi sdug ltas ngan char ltar phob: bya gcan stong sde dgra la bhyoḥ sangs rgyas bstan dgra rtsad nas chod: dkon mchog spyi dgra rdul du rlog: rnal 'byor sgos dgra cham la phob: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: lo zla zhag dus ma bzhag par: sha khrag dmar gtor 'di nyid dang : dbyer med mnyam par bzhes byas te: lhag ma ming shul med par mdzod: om̐ shu la tri tsa tri ki kang tri tri nā ga ti pa ra tsa tsa tri ya ma du ru ya dgra la zlog zlog:

ces 'phang ngo : de nas zor chen 'phen pa ni: me hoṃ sbar la 'di skad do: hūm̐ bhyoḥ bzhengs shig mi mngon chos sku'i klong nas bzhengs: brgyud ldan rig 'dzin grub thob dbyings nas bzhengs: bdud 'dul gtso mchog seng gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: srog gcod ma mo mched bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: myur mgyogs khrag ral bdud smin dbyings nas bzhengs: bskal pa'i me 'bar dug mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs: dug rlangs bu yug 'tshub ma'i klong nas bzhengs: srog len mun ltar gtibs pa'i dbyings nas bzhengs: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: sngags 'chang bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig cing rtsad nas bcad: dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad cing kha yog bkal: dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i thugs dkrugs dbyen phyung brtson: dge bcu khyad gsod mi dge dwang du blangs: mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: chos skyong sngags kyi srung mar do bsdo ba'i: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams sdig can 'dis: steng nas gza' nad char ltar 'bebs su chug: bar nas btsan gzer rlung ltar 'tshub tu chug: 'og nas rlung nad mun ltar gtib tu chug: bskul lo rbad do mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : g.yab bo chos shig sha za rtsal ma zhan: nyes can bstan pa'i ru tra nag po 'di: lo zla zhag dang za dus 'da' ma byed: da lta skad cig bla srog chod la shog: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha zo khrag la 'thung : mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal skom skye rgyud chod: mthun grogs yul khyim rten gnas chags yul rnams: gnam lcags thog gis ri rab bshig pa ltar: thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ baṃ singha ḍākki bai ro tsa na badzra bha ra hi kro ti ka li ha ri ni sa ma mo raksha kha kha mu kha ru lu mu kha nag mo bhe tri nag mo dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e sa bhyo zlog: ces zlog sngags dang bcas dgra phyogs su 'phang*/

dgra bo'i pha sde nang tshan lha srung yul zhing dang bcas brlag par bsam mo/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas: 'gags med hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: gnyis med bhyo dang phaiṃ ka ras: rang bzhin srung ba'i gur khang gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ om̐ muṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ nṛ bhrūm̐: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ nṛ bhrūm̐ tsakra rakṣa hūm̐: srung 'khor bsgom zhing rang rig gnyug ma'i ngo bo skyongs/ de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ bdag nyid drag mor gsal ba yi: sku las spros pa'i khro mo dang : yang sprul khro tshogs dpag med kyis: dgra bgegs bdud sde'i tshogs rnams la: sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char phab ste: dgra sde dpung bcas rdul du rlog: rnam shes chos nyid zhing du spar: dmigs med chos sku'i klong du zlog: phaṭḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces bdun gsum nyer gcig tu bzla zhing dmod pa bcol/ tho mtshams gcod pa ni: rdo g.yam la khrom̐ bris shing :

khrom̐: tho ni khyung nag rab 'bar 'jigs pa'i gzugs: sku la zangs khrab sder sen lcags kyu bgrad: sgro gshog brgyangs shing rngam mche gtsigs pa yis: sgab 'dre 'byung po 'gyu ba'i skabs med do: om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de nas sgo drung du sleb pa dang*/ gtor snod bshal chu dang bcas brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs: gnas nyul las kyi ma mo bcu gnyis ni: zhi dang rgyas dang sgeg pa'i cha lugs can: lhab lhub rgyan ldan g.yer kha si li li: dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: rin chen rgyan ldan thor tshugs lcang lo can: glu len gdangs glu'i bshugs sgra tse re re: so so'i bran g.yog sman phran bye ba 'bum: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe ru: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le tring tring spring spring kha kha khā hi: zhes brtan ma skyong zhing dam sri bkug la gtor gzhong sbub cing bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐ maḥ yum chen dbyings kyi pho brang chen mo nas: snang stong zung 'jug gnyis med khro mo'i lhas: bde ba'i ma pang stong pa'i bu rgyug ltar: cig car shar grol ye rdzogs bro brdungs pas: bdag 'dzin dgra gdon ka dag dbyings su grol: ma bsgoms phyag rgya chen po'i ngang gnas gyur: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: laṃ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes bro brdungs te mngon spyod drag po'i g.yon bskor du brdung*/ gtor snod kha yar bzed la/ hūm̐/ yum chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs la/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod lha mos/ /dpag yas spros pa'i dpag med mchod pa 'bul/ /sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig / ces dang*/ hoḥ chos sku yum chen rnam rol drag mo'i lha/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen bag sgrib 'khrul gzugs rnams/

/rten 'brel rig sngags drag po'i tshar bcad de/ /rgyal khams bdag 'gro bde ba'i bkra shis shog dharma swa bhā a āḥ zhes mchod 'bru 'thor zhing*/ ༈ rtsa gsum srung ma'i dmag tshogs kyis: dgra bgegs thal bar brlag mdzad nas: phyin chad ldang bar ma gyur cig: mthu rtsal stobs ldan lha rgyal lo: phye mar skyems phud la rol/ de nas nang du slebs ma thag tshe 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro tshe yi bdag: mda' dar shar du bskyod pa'i tshe: khrag nyams gsos la tshe bcud bsdus: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro tshe yi bdag: mda' dar lho ru bskyod pa'i tshe: sha nyams gsos la sa bcud bsdus: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: padma mkha' 'gro tshe yi bdag: mda' dar nub tu bskyod pa'i tshe: drod nyams gsos la me bcud bsdus: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo tshe yi bdag: mda' dar byang du bskyod pa'i tshe: dbugs nyams gsos la rlung bcud bsdus: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: steng phyogs rigs kyi tshe bdag ni: dmar ljang gsal stong mkha' 'gro ma: nyi zla'i bcud bsdus rtsa rlung bskyed: mkha' dang steng 'og tshe 'gug go: ces rtsa sngags kyis 'gugs: om̐ mūṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ sgrub pa dang las sbyor ni: om̐ badzra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bhrūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ om̐ tshe bhrūm̐ g.yu bhrūm̐ g.yu tshe bhrūm̐: ā yurdzñā na g.yu tshe bhrūm̐ḥ zhes dang tshe brtan pa'i gzungs ring bzla'o: tshe ril tshe chang la rol: de nas tshe sba ba ni: oṃ: bde gshegs rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi: yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas thob cig: tshe dang srog 'di khyod la gtad: khyed kyis rgya 'di thub par srungs: bcol lo gnyer ro ye shes lha:

gtad do 'khor dang srung ma'i tshogs: tshe srings srog skyobs dpal skyed la: smin grol dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra kā ya tsitta rakṣa hūm̐: mda' dar g.yab nas rgyas gdab bo/ rang gzhung ltar dbang blang nas rjes chog mchod bstod man dkyus ltar shes par bya'o/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ e ma kho bo pad 'byung ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: zor bzlog dug gi 'khor lo bzhag: phyi nang rkyen bzlog phrin las myur: 'di nyid rbad bskul drag bcol bas: tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yul yang 'joms: rkyen ngan dgra sogs lta ci smos: yang bzlog spu gri nag po 'di: ma 'ongs sum cu'i yang mtha' la: bar chod sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: snying thig ma mo khrag ral mas: ma yi brda 'di thub par srungs: da lta'i ye shes dpal chen 'di: ma 'ongs las 'brel gling zhes grags: gsang mtshan hūm̐ gi mtshan can la: sprod cig sngags bdag lcam gcig ma: dam nyams byad ma'i snying khrag 'thung : 'gong po'i lag tu ma shor rgya: drag mo brda skyong tha tshig rgya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ phung 'tshengs nus mthu gzhan zla dang bral ba'o/ yang zab bdud 'dul drag mo'i mngon spyod las/ /ji ltar khungs ldan phyag len mi nyams phyir/ 'khrugs sdeb gsal zhing gzhung chog kho na bzhin/ /spros pas nyams dgra'i tshogs rnams tshar chod cig /ces ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong can las/ 'phen pa zor las lhan thabs dang bcas dkyus gcig tu bkod pa rdo rje'i thog mda' nag po zhes bya rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnam rol rong smyon rtsal gyis mdzad pa la/ gzhung bzung kha skong dgos rigs gzhung dang rang lugs gzhan las kyang kha bsab cing*/ gab dkrug med par chu 'bab kyi tshul du bklag chog tu bgyis pa 'di'ang rig sngags 'chang ba'i gzugs brnyan/ bdud 'dul ror pa rtsal gyi bgyis pas yi ge pa ni 'phan sprul nas bgyis pa 'gro kun byad gdon gyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/

// ha) rtsang bzlog ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ye shes ḍākki seṅge'i gdong pa can: myur mgyogs pho nya shan pa 'tshogs pa'i rten: rno dbal drag po'i rtsang phur ldan pa ni: zur gsum sku gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: mtho dman srid gsum rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings: mang nyung grangs med tsha ngar me yi zer: myur mgyogs thog rgod drag po rlung gi shugs: gzi byin nyi zla myur mgyogs glog gi 'gyu: rno dbal spu gri sgrol 'debs ki kang myur: rtse mo zhe sdang gdug pa'i me ri 'bar: sked pa rgya mdud gti mug mun rim gtibs: rtsa bar 'dod chags srid pa'i khrag mtsho khol: drwa mig las mkhan nga rgyal ri ltar nyil: zur gsum phra dog gdug pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs: bzlog med las kyi drag po'i rtsang phur tshogs: bskul lo bzhengs shig myur mgyogs mthu bo bskyed: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol g.yul ngo gdug pa'i dmag tshogs rnams: dug mda' gzer phur nag po khyod kyis zlog: chag che nyam nga rmi ltas mtshan ngan rnams: dam nyams dgra bo byad ma'i steng du zlog: mi kha gleng gzhi gshe skur smra ngan byur: phung shig kha sbyor pha rol dgra la zlog: rtsang la gnas pa'i chos skyong pho nya dang : las dang ye shes sha za ḍākki'i tshogs: bskul lo rbad do tha tshig dam ma g.yel: dgra bgegs byad ma'i rten mkhar yul khang shigs: srung skyob ban bon lha srung bcas pa rnams: gnam lcags ri bo brgyab myos bsregs byas nas: bskal pa'i rlung g.yos thal ba bun gtor bzhin: lhag ma rjes med brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ḍākki nī singha mu kha ha ri ni sa ru tra tshindha ya tshindha ya bhandha ya bhandha ya mā ra ya trag raksha ha la ha la hu lu hu lu na sha ya ru tra bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces thal mo brdab pa dang bcas zlog sngags bgrang ngo*// // a) bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro drag mo seng gdong las/

gser skyems gling bzhi sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: thog mar gser skyems bya ba'i rim pa ni: rnga gshang g.yab dar sogs legs par bsgrengs nas dngos gzhi ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i phyogs bcu na: bzhengs bskul mkhyen gsol gzigs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: byad gtad ru tra sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ bdud 'dul ḍākki'i 'khor tshogs gnyan po rnams: thugs dam chen mo dus las mi 'da' phyir: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gzi byin nus pa'i rtsal dang zor dpung skyed: hūm̐: las byed phra men chen mo yang 'khor sprul: mi bsrun dgra bgegs gshed dang 'bebs pa'i tshogs: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: myur mgyogs mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la phob: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro shar gyi las byed rnams: ḍākki stag gdong byad ma sgrol byed ma: dri za grul bum gnod sbyin sha za 'bum: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dri za'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro lho yi las byed ma: ḍākki phag gdong dgra bgegs sgrol byed ma: gshin rje me lha khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro 'bum: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro nub kyi las byed ma: ḍākki dom gdong bar chad zlog byed ma: srin po klu dbang 'khros byed rus 'cha' 'bum: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: srin po'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: hūm̐: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro byang gi las byed ma: ḍākki spyang gdong byad gtad 'grol byed ma: rlung lha dbang ldan srog gcod bye ba 'bum:

rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: sha za'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: ham̐'u: bdud 'dul seng gdong ḍākki dbyings nas bzhengs: ma tshogs bdud 'dul lha tshogs dpung skyed la: lo zla dus dang tshes grangs chu tshod kyis: srid par rgyu ba'i las byed ma lus kun: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: zor lam phyes shig phyogs su da byol cig: om̐ baṃ ḍākki singha badzra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ lo ka pā la ya pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā: zhes gser skyems phyogs bzhir mchod cing sgo dbye ba ni/ dzaḥ shar phyogs stag gdong zhi byed sgo skyong ma/ /dkar mo rdo rje lcags kyu thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /lcags kyu'i lde mig thogs mdzad shar sgo phyes/ /'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ha badzra ḍākki dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ lho phyogs phag gdong rgyas pa'i las mdzad ma/ /ser mo rin chen zhags pa thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /zhags pa'i lde mig thogs mdzad lho sgo phyes/ /'byor drug rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ri ratna ḍākki hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nub phyogs dom gdong dbang gi las mdzad ma/ /dmar mo padma lcags sgrog thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /lcags sgrog lde mig thogs mdzad nub sgo phyes/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ni padma ḍākki baṃ baṃ/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs spyang gdong drag po'i las mdzad ma/ /ljang mo ral gri dril bu thogs pa yis/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /dril bu'i lde mig thogs mdzad byang sgo phyes/ /dgra bgegs tshar bar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ saḥkarma ḍākki ho hoḥ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig mi mngon chos sku'i klong nas bzhengs/ /bdud 'dul gtso mchog seng gdong dbyings nas bzhengs/ /sras mchog ma mo mched bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs/
