/myur mgyogs khrag ral bdud smin dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar dug mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs/ /dug rlangs bu yug 'tshubs pa'i klong nas bzhengs/ /srog gcod mun ltar gtibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs/ /rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /sngags 'chang bdag la brnag pa'i dgra bo la/ /dmag dpung bskyed la dgra yul rten gnas rlog /las la bskul lo bdud 'dul rtsal ma zhan/ /bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ zhes pas mdos sman raka gis bran/ gtor ma stegs bu'i kha ru dpag /sa ma ya/ de'ang bdud 'dul ḍākki'i lha tshogs zhal phyi la gzigs nas/ gtad khram byad gtad pha rol dgra la bzlogs par bsam/ zhes pa 'di yang seng gdong gser skyems sgo dbye thabs shes mtshon pa dgra bgegs gzir gtad bya ba/ rtsa gsum sprul phreng gsum pa gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ki) yang phur las za lam khol phyung ni/ za lam srin mo'i bzlog pa ni: lcags snod dam ni gang rung du: gtor chen gcig la 'khor brgyad bya: rtsang dmar nyi shus legs par brgyan: byung na bud med khros ma'i gzugs: dmar gtor brgyad dang kong zor brgyad: legs par bskor zhing rtsang gis brgyan: rakta mchod cing mdos rdzongs bya: sa ma ya: dang po byin gyis lan gsum brlab: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ stong pa'i ngang las gnam lcags 'khor yug steng : de dbus dmar chen gtor ma khro mo'i mkhar: phyi ni mtshon cha nang ni thod pa'i dal: de dbus ma mo 'khor bcas gsal bar gyur: oṃ rakmo ma tri bhyo bhyo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya tiṣṭha lhan: sa mā ya dzaḥ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi: oṃ rakta pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bhyoḥ las kyi ma mo 'khor dang bcas pas rakta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar thams cad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig:

ces gtor ma dpal 'bar btsugs te raktas bran: hūm̐ bhyoḥ srin mo za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na: zangs ri zangs thang dmar po rngam la 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog nas: sha za srog bdud las kyi ma mo chen po bzhugs pa ni: sku mdog dmar nag srin mo'i gzugs 'chang ma mo 'bum gyis bskor: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin cing zangs mche dmar po gtsigs: mdos zor stong gi sna 'dren mdzad cing dgra dpung phye mar rlog: srog bdag stong gi gtso mos dgra la dmag dpung zor sna drongs: deng 'dir ma mos bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ srin mo shugs 'chang rdo rje mo yi lcam rakta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bhyoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang rin chen mo yi lcam rakta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bhyoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang padma mo yi lcam rakta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐ bhyoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang las kyi mo yi lcam rakta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: dus la bab bo las byed phra men dmag tshogs dgra la bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: bhyo bhyoḥ rakmo ma tri raksha ya dgra la zlog: hūm̐ bhyoḥ srin mo'i shugs 'chang mtshams bzhi mo yi lcam rakta'i mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod cig zor sna dgra la drongs: dus la bab bo las byed phra men dmag tshogs dgra la bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog drag po'i phrin las gnyan po 'grub par mdzod: bhyo bhyoḥ rakmo ma tri raksha ya dgra la zlog:

de nas zor btegs la bzlog pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ las kyi ma mo chen mo 'khor bcas kyis: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs thams cad kun: bkug cing bsgral nas lhag ma med par bzhes: zor mda' dam nyams dgra bgegs snying la rgyob: dus la bab bo ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog byad ma nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐ bhyoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: phyogs skyong yongs kyi sun ma zlog: ma mo yongs kyi sun ma zlog: sde brgyad yongs kyi sun ma zlog: sha za sman mo'i sun ma zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur ro mā ra ya: ma tri ma mo ya tri zlog: zor ltar 'phen na: hūm̐ bhyoḥ las kyi ma mo'i tshogs: bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: steng 'og phyogs bcu yi: dgra bgegs cham la phob: khro bo khro mo yi: drag sngags dgra la zlog: snang srid sde brgyad kyi: byad kha dgra la zlog: phyogs skyong bcu po yi: bsam sbyor dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba yi: phur kha dgra la zlog: lo zla zhag dus kyi: skag rigs dgra la zlog: mi kha dmod tshig gi: sdang sems dgra la zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan tshogs: bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: zor bhyo ya: rbad bhyo yaḥ raṃ bhyo ya: dā bhyo ya: hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma mo dgra la chos: sha za dgra la chos: zor mda' dgra la ya: dgra srog myur du chod: raṃ zor ya: bhyo zor ya: rbad zor ya: mā ra ya bzlog ya: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces zor ltar 'phen na gtor ma bya: mdos ltar rdzong na ma mo bya: 'di nyid snang srid kun gyi bdag mo phyir: bzlog pa kun la 'di nyid gtso: sa bdag brgya la gdong thug kyang : ma mo 'di yis bzlog par 'gyur: de bas zor sna kun la gces: zhes so// // khi) ༈ bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon nas sku glud khol phyung ni/ sku glud rgyan ldan/ mar me bcu/ g.yas na gtor ma bcu/ rgyab tu ting lo bcu/ g.yon du 'brang rgyas bcu/ changs bu grangs mang*/

dar tshon na bza' nam mkha' rgyang bu thun rdzas rdzong 'debs sogs bsags la/ om̐ ā hūm̐: gsum dang : ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bag chags sbyang : rang nyid rigs 'dus lhar gsal nas: hoḥ rang nyid che mchog yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun: bhrūm̐ las dbang chen sa bzhi gru chad ldan pa de yi dbus su: yi ge kṣa sngo nag yongs su gyur pa bgegs kyi rgyal po bī na ya ka sku mdog kham nag g.yas changs bu dang g.yon dkar me 'dzin pa: de la bgegs chen bcu dang lan chags pho gdon mo gdon gyi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur: om̐ ṭākki rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ: bhū ta rā dza aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bkug cing bstim: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog kun 'dus sku: nga ni dus gsum gsang ba'i mdzod: nga ni snang srid yongs kyi gtso: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs rigs lan chags mgron: skye ba tshe rabs snga phyi nas: sha 'khon bu lon ma 'khor rigs: de ring sbyang phyir yas stags 'bul: sku yi glud du 'brang rgyas bsngo: gsung gis glud du ting lo bsngo: thugs kyi glud du dkar me bsngo: yon tan glud du changs bu bsngo: phrin las glud du yas stags bsngo: tsha ram sgog tsong la phug 'di: de ring bgegs rigs khyod la bsngo: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: gnod 'tshe sdang bar ma ston cig: hūm̐: dang po glud byung gang nas byung : lha yi dbang po brgya byin la: 'byung bzhi nyams pa'i nad kyis thebs: lha bu snang ba 'od ldan gyis: rin chen ngar gyi mi pho bcos: sku glud rgyan ldan yas stags bsngos: lha dbang brgya byin snyun las grol: de nas ngar glud gang nas byung : btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan la: 'byung 'khrugs snyun gyi zin pa'i tshe: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis: sku glud rin chen rgyan can bcos: yas stags sna tshogs bsngos pa'i tshe: khri srong lde'u btsan snyun las grol: de nas ngar glud gang nas byung :

de ring sgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: tshe rabs snga phyi'i lan chags rnams: sbyang phyir sku glud rgyan can bsngo: hūm̐: bgegs kyi tshogs rnams tshur nyon dang : mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan ldan: mthing gi skra lo nyi li li: 'jam 'bol mdzes ldan shigs se shig: mu tig bsil ma'i klad pa 'di: dbu ma thar lam sha ra ra: gzi yi spyan mig 'od ldan 'di: lta stangs 'dzum mdangs ya la la: dung gi tshems phreng dkar po 'di: bzhad gad skar tshogs spungs se spung : byi ru'i ljags mar leb chen 'di: smra brjod glu dbyangs sha ra ra: gser dngul thabs shes rna ba 'di: sgra snyan grags stong lhangs se lhang : lag gnyis mu men ma na hoḥ phyag rgya pad kor kyi li li: don snying zho sha rnam lnga 'di: tshogs brgyad ma 'gags sangs se sang : gsang ba baiḍūr grub pa 'di: bde stong dga' bzhi lams se lam: rkang pa bden gnyis zangs lcags 'di: zhabs bro gar sgyur khrigs se khrig: na bza' dar tshon sna lnga 'di: rlung gis bskyod cing pu ru ru: spyi bor nam mkha' sna tshogs 'di: 'ja' gur yid 'phrog spungs se spung : sku rten 'brang rgyas ri ltar nyil: gsung rten ting lo 'bras ltar spungs: thugs rten sgron me nyi ltar gsal: yon tan changs bu khyon yangs khengs: phrin las yas stags phun sum tshogs: de phyir sku glud rgyan dang ldan: sbyin bdag 'di yi glud du bsngo: hūm̐: shar phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: sprin gyi shugs 'chang 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: shar phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: lho phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: rlung gi myur can 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig:

lho phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: nub phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: me yi zin phung 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: nub phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: byang phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: glog gi myur 'gros 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: byang phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: shar lho bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: lo yi pho nya 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: shar lho dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: lho nub bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: zla ba'i pho nya 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: lho nub dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: nub byang bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: zhag gi pho nya 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: nub byang dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: byang shar bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: dus kyi pho nya 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: byang shar dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: dbus phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: bī na ya ka 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig:

dbus phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: steng phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: 'brug gi mgo can 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: steng phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: 'og phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: dur phag mgo can 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: 'og phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: phyi nang bgegs rigs lan chags rnams: bsngos pa bzhin du tshim gyur cig: re ba bzhin du skong gyur cig: bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub gyur cig: khyod kyi lan chags byang byas nas: da ni khyod la lam bstan no: chas la myur du 'gro bar gyis: de nas kha phyir bstan nas rdzong 'debs byas shing : hūm̐: shar phyogs lha yi yul du bsngo: dri za'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs gshin rje'i yul du bsngo: grul bum gnod pa khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: nub phyogs ma mo'i yul du bsngo: klu dbang skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: byang phyogs bdud kyi yul du bsngo: gnod sbyin skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: shar lho shel ging yul du bsngo: me lha'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: lho nub btsan gyi yul du bsngo: srin mo'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig:

hūm̐: nub byang gnod sbyin yul du bsngo: rlung lha'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: byang shar klu bdud yul du bsngo: dbang ldan skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i yul du bsngo: lha min skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: 'og phyogs sa bdag yul du bsngo: dmu yi skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: da ni khyod la lam bstan pa: snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul: dge bshes glud du chas pa'i tshe: 'dren ston chos bshad mkhan chen 'dra: pho glud rgyan can chas pa'i tshe: dpa' bo rgyan gyis phyug pa 'dra: mo glud rgyan can chas pa'i tshe: mo btsun bag mar brdzangs pa 'dra: rgas pa'i glud du chas pa'i tshe: sde dpon yul la phyogs pa 'dra: byis pa'i glud du chas pa'i tshe: lha phrug rtse ra mthud pa 'dra: de bas glud bzang ya mtshan ldan: bsngo'o 'bul lo tshim gyur cig: tshims shing rang rang gnas su dengs: de nas thun gyis brab cing : hūm̐: nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ nga ni khrag 'thung khro bo rgyal: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: rdo rje me yi char chen 'bebs: mtshon cha dum bu skar ltar 'khrug: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: om̐ badzra he ru ka kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ om̐ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ sogs hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces phyi rol dor ro// // gi) bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje 'chang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma'i me mchod bsdus pa bzhugs so/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/

mdun du me snod dam mar me gang rung til nag bcas bsham/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /byang chub sems mchog rab tu bskyed/ /rang nyid lhar gsal mdun du ni/ /zhi ba'i thab khung chu shel ltar/ /rab dkar dwangs shing zlum po'i nang*/ /ye shes me lce dkar gsal 'bar/ /de dbus hūm̐ las khro mo ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mu men mdog /rdo rje dril 'dzin zhal rab gdangs/ /dpa' mo 'khor los sgyur ba'i chas/ /rdo rje'i yan lag me'i rang bzhin/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med thim/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dbang lhas dbang bskur mi bskyod mtshan/ /rang gi sum mdor rlung g.yos pas/ /lte 'og tsand+ra lī cher 'bar/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun/ /nag po kaṃ yig rnam pas bdug /de nyid sdig pa mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam par sna bug las thon te/ /til la thim pa ye shes kyi/ /ḍākki'i zhal du lhag med sbyangs/ /sdig ltung nyes tshogs kun bral gyur/ zhes mos te/ oṃ badzra ḍākki kha kha khā hi khā hi: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi tshe rabs thog med nas bsags shing mchis pa'i/ sdig ltung gdon bgegs bkra mi shis pa thams cad dang*/ lha ma gsal ba sngags ma dag pa/ mkha' khyab ting nge 'dzin las g.yel ba sogs nyes sgrib shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ spel tshig btags pa til dang bcas nyer gcig brjod cing mer bsreg /mthar puṣpe nas shabda 'i bar du nyer spyod lnga mchod/ rnam kun mchog ldan stong chen ma/ /rang rtsal rdo rje 'chang chen ma/ /rang rtsal rdo rje 'chang gi rigs/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung zhi mdzad ma'i/ /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma chen mor bstod/ / ces bstod/ yig brgya lan gcig brjod la kha skong*/ oṃ badzra mu/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas lte ba'i a thung la bstim/ me ro gtsang sar gshegs so/ mar me yin na lha sogs mchod/ rdo rje ḍākki'i sbyin sreg myur bde 'di/

/bsam gtan dpal 'byor nye gnas dam pa des/ /bskul ngor blo gros shes rab 'od po che/ /mi shes rmongs mun pha mthar byed pa yi/ /chos rje gling pas rtags bdun bdag por byas/ /blo gsal padmo yod na mkha' rgyas 'gyur/ /phyogs lhung ku mud rnams la ci byar yod/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ngi) ༈ ye shes bdud 'dul drag mo'i seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog gi zin bris bzhugs so/ na mo badzra singha mu kha ye/ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma'i gtor zlog bya ba ni/ tshul la gsum mo/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so/ dang po ni/ zhing lpags thog tu dkyil 'khor 'bri byas la/ zhes pas srog chags gang rung gi g.yang gzhi la/ rdul tshon skye ba'am/ ras kyi g.yang gzhi chu tshon gyi chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar gri gug gis mtshan pa/ yang na re phyar gyi steng du lcags zangs la sogs mañdzi khar gtor ma bsham/ gzhung las/ drag po lcags snod dam ni gang rung du: 'bru nag phye mar dmar gyi gtor ma ni: che ba gcig la 'khor dgus bskor ba bya: yungs zor dang ni dmar nag rtsang gis brgyan: khrag kyu sha dum rdzas dang mchod rdzas bsham: zur gsum ri rab lta bu'i logs gsum la: khram shing sho kha nad rkyal nam rgyang gzugs: zhes pas/ 'bru nag gi phye ma khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i gdan gru gsum mam 'thug po'i steng du/ gtor ma gru gsum dbal can che ba gcig la 'khor brgyad dang*/ mdun du dmar gtor zur gsum gtso bo'i phyed tsam sleb pa gcig dang gdan gyi g.yas g.yon logs su/ khram shing mig dgu pa dang*/ g.yon du nad rkyal dang*/ mdun du sho rdel/ mtha' skor du o kyu bcad kha phyir bstan pa yis bskor ba la/ bsnol rtsang dang rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba/ g.yas su mda' khra g.yon du 'phang khra rgyab tu byang bu/ rtse mor nam mkhar dar gdugs can dang*/ tshe yungs rtsang sogs rngam brjid dang ldan par bya/ gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar srung bzlog gi 'khor lo rgyab sprod dang*/

sku tsaka bcas 'dzugs/ che chung zur drug tu dmar gtor dbal can la/ mda' 'phang nam rgyang tshe rtsang yungs dkar gyis brgyan te bsham/ mtha' bskor ram/ mtha' mchod du/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog sha chen spos/ tshil chen gyi zhun me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ drag po'i zhal zas rnam bkod/ thod rnga gri rkang gling bu sogs 'bud bya/ gzhan yang mchod gtor sman raka nyer spyod dam can chos srung gtor ma chad brtan thun gtor nya bo tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bsag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi las gzhung las sngon 'gro mtshams gcod dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang nas/ zhes dang de nas gang gi las rim grub rjes su/ zhes pas bdag bskyed las gzhung gnam lcags thog mda' ltar bzlas pa yan chad bya/ de la srung bzlog bsad gsum tshang dgos phyir/ bzlog pa'i sngon du srung ba shin tu gtso che ste/ mkha' 'gro nag po'i bzlog rgyud las/ srung ba med par zlog byed pa/ /dgra kun nang tshud ma mthong bar/ /mel tshe phyi nas byed dang mtshungs/ zhes gsungs pas gzhung nas dmigs bsal srung ba'i las rim ni/

hoḥ rang nyid skad cig gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong pa can sku mdog sngon mo dbu la thod skam gyi rigs lnga gsol zhing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyangs pa dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod pa: g.yon pas bhandhar nyon mongs kyi snying khrag zhal du gsol ba: mchan du mkhar phur rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa: spyi gtsug tu gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs: sku'i gnas lngar gdong can rigs lnga: yan lag lhu tshigs bzhir shugs 'gro ma mo: ba spu'i bu gar yang sprul grangs med spros pa: sku la ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su gsal ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje'i lte bar zla nyi'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gis klad skor nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma: ha khog tu bsrung bya pho mo: 'og tu rta phyugs la sogs gsal ba'i ngang la srung sngags bzlas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sna tshogs grangs med 'phros pas: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung gter bdag rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus rtsal thams cad bsdus nas: bdag dang bsrung bya la thim pas cis kyang mi shigs pa rdo rje'i go cha ru grub par bsam mo: hūm̐ bhyoḥ skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas: 'gags med hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: 'khrul med dran rtog chos nyid ngang : gnyis med bhyo dang phaiṃ ka ra'i: rang bzhin me dpung tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs srung 'khor gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ om̐ mūṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ nṛ bhrūm̐: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces brgya phrag bdun gsum lnga bdun gang 'byor dal brel dang bstun: mthar rten 'brel snying po yang bzla'o:

zhal shes su/ bdag nyid gtso mo'i thugs srog gi nang du bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud par gsal gdab cing*/ 'od zer spro bsdus gzi byin bskyed cing sgo gsum mi shigs pa ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs su nges par bya dgos la/ mdun bskyed las byang dregs pa tshar gcod ltar/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ snang srid snod bcud chos 'byung e yi mkha': 'byung ba rim brtsegs ma bcos pho brang ni: tsha grang snang srid dkar dmar brtsegs pa yi: shin tu rab 'jigs dur khrod me rlung dbus: mu stegs bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i baṃ gdan steng : sogs spyan 'dren mchod bstod pa'i bar rdzogs par byas la/ bzlas pa'i skabs bdag nyid dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros steng phyogs 'og min zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ 'og phyogs srid pa'i ri rab gtsor las kyi mkha' 'gro dang*/ gling bzhir gdong can bzhi/ ri rab kyi rtsa bar khrag gi rgya mtsho klong du ma mo khrag ral ma dang*/ gzhan yang khor yug kun tu/ snang srid kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ste brgyad/ dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bka' nyan las sgrub kyi tshul du gsal/ bdag nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje'i shugs kyis las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi thugs dam drag tu bskul bas de rnams kyi zhal nas drag sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam du sgrogs shing sku rngam pa'i stangs stabs kyi gling bzhi ri rab bcas yom yom 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyom zhing phyur bas/ snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad skrag cing 'dar te byad ma rang gshed du phab sku las gnam lcags thog dang mtshon cha'i char/ dug rlangs nad sprin ltar gtibs pas/ srid pa gsum gyi bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad nas rjes shul med par las kyi rlung gis lcags ri'i phyi rol du gtor/ tshe bsod rnam shes bdag nyid la thim pas/ dbyings mi shigs rdo rje'i skur rgyas gdab ste/

oṃ baṃ badzra ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha ma ma siddhi dza dzaḥ badzra ratna padma karma ḍākki ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ de nas srog sngags ni: om̐ mūm̐ḥḍākki singha mu kha dza dzaḥ las sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces sngags gang 'os dang / de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni: bdag nyid drag mor gsal ba yi: sku las spros pa'i khro mo dang : yang sprul khro tshogs dpag med kyis: dgra bgegs bdud sde'i tshogs rnams la: sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char phab ste: dgra sde dpung bcas rdul du rlog: rnam shes chos nyid zhing du spar: dmigs med chos sku'i klong du zlog: phaṭaḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces bdun gsum nyer gcig tu bzla zhing dmod bcol thal brdeb bya ba ni/ seng gdong gnam lcags ur mo'i dmigs rim ltar las/dmigs pa ni: rang nyid drag mor gsal ba'i lag g.yas pa zla ba chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po: g.yon pa nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gsal ba'i bar pha rol ban bon byad ma dgra bgegs lha srung dang bcas sbrang ma mes tshig pa ltar ram thal mo'i bar du bcar ba ltar gnam sa nyi zla cha lang brdabs pas ming med du brlags par bsam mo: kho'i tshe dang bsod nams bkrag mdangs gzi byin thams cad tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas gzi brjid cher 'bar te che btsan kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam: lnga bsdus phung po sha khrag rus pa nang rol rnams ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis zhal du gsol bas:

dug lnga dug gsum gyi bag sgrib dbyings su dag nas rnam smin las sgrib byang ste: dgra bgegs de dag thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa chos sku yum chen mo'i go 'phang thob ste rgyal yum gyi sras su skye bar bsam la/ lag g.yas zla ba chu'i dkyil 'khor/ lag g.yon nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor bcas gsal te/ lag rdeb sngags dang sbrags nas me chu'i bar du dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad 'thums nas bskal pa 'jig pa'i me chu 'phrad pa'i bar du/ brgyal zhing ming shul med par bsams te/ rdul du gyur ba de'ang sngags spur ba las kyi rlung gi 'tshub ma lta bur gyur bas/ mtha' yi rgya mtsho pha mthar lcags sreg gi ri la gtor bar dmigs te/ lag gi tshigs mthud nas sor rtse dgra la gtad nas spur/ de yis byad ma 'bum stong gi nus pa yang bzlog par the tshom med/ 'joms byed me chu go ldog ces bya'o/ zhes pa'i sngags ni/ khaṃ e ka tsa na e sa bhyo zlog: raṃ dza tri rmug thum bhyo zlog: yaṃ sha ma sha na du shan bhyo zlog: ces bdun lnga gsum sogs dmigs pa rtsal ma rdzogs kyi bar du lag rdeb bya'o/ gong ma las zlog dmigs grub na/ ma bcos de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ngang la mnyam par bzhag hūm̐ bhyoḥ zung gi gur khang mos te nyal/ zhes gsungs pa de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi snying po'o/ de nas bsad las kyi rim par 'jug pa ni/ bka' srung dang chos srung gi gsol ka spyi ltar bya/ de nas rang gzhung gi tshogs byin rlabs nas skong bshags yan grub rjes gzhung las/ mngon spyod drag po'-i mthun rdzas ma lus bsags/ zhes pa dang*/ bsgral chas thun rdzas sogs gzhung nas 'byung bzhin bsags la mdun du 'khod/ rang nyid rdo rje slob dpon zhwa nag ber phod khro pang sogs dpa' chas brgyan zhing rdo rje dril bu lag tu thogs te/ lta ba gyad dang gnyen po ye shes lha:

sprul pa las byed lha yi go cha ni: zhes pa bzhin seng gdong khro mo'i skur gsal zhing*/ phaṭaḥ rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma drag tu khros pa bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdong pa can: shin tu gtum pa'i dur khrod chas brgyad dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas srog gcod las kyi gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing : g.yon pas kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum thog ltar 'bebs pa: zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs can: chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus su gnas pa: mdun du phrin las kyi sprul pa drag mo spyang gdong ma nag mo gcer mo mi lpags g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon nas nu ma gyen mthur du 'khyil ba: phyag g.yas spu gri dang g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa: dgra bgegs kyi srog la dbang ba'i rnam par gsal: ma mo gsod byed ma'i g.yas g.yon du bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong can dgra bgegs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas thun nag po thogs pa mdun du bla 'gugs las kyi ma mo srog 'phrog gsum ni: dmar mo seng gdong can: sngon mo chu'i mdog can: nag mo mun pa'i mdog can: thams cad lag tu bla 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu: bla 'ching ba'i zhags pa: bla 'dzin pa'i drwa ba: bla dwags kyi ring cha: bla 'bod kyi gri rkang : g.yab mo 'debs pa'i rnga ma dmar nag bcas thogs nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can 'gugs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'o: bhyo baṃ singha ḍākki kro ti ka li ma ma bhyo bhyoḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ma tri ma thun ma bhyo trag rakmo bhyoḥ kha la rakmo e ka tsa ti bhyoḥ khā kha hu lu ma mo bhyoḥ tri dza tri dza baṃ shag shante bhyo bhyoḥ ma mo tri rakmo dza tri ma bhyo bhyoḥ thun thun bhyo bhyoḥ zhes drag sngags bzla zhing gzi byin bskyed de/ ma nyes gzu dpang gser skyems yus gdab bya/ 'gugs gzhug pho nya bkye ba dang lha dang dbye ba sogs thun gyis gzir/ gser skyems gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku:

snang srid 'di ru gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral: nga nyid drag mo khros ma seṅge'i gdong : nga las che ba med do kun gyis nyon: maḥ nga nyid pho brang gnas chen u tsa la: dur khrod chen po rngam chen 'bar ba'i rong : ri bo rus pa 'bab chu khrag dang zhag: rtsi shing thams cad mda' mdung mtshon cha gzengs: sgra skad thams cad rgyob sod 'brug ltar sgrog: ro langs keng rus gcan spyang nyi li li: ngan sngags 'brug sgra gnam lcags sha ra ra: sha za srog gcod dbugs len rongs se rong : 'chi bdag phra men srog len zhungs se zhung : me 'bar mun rab sprin nag 'u ru ru: sprin gseb gnas nyul ma mo glog ltar myur: srid pa'i ri rab yom yom shig shig 'gul: de 'dra'i gnas nas bzhengs pa'i dbang mo che: che ba'i lha rnams thams cad nga yi 'khor: chung ba'i dregs pa sde brgyad nga yi bran: srid pa 'dir gnas nga yi las mkhan te: nga yis dmod pa'i las 'di gnyer ba'i phyir: phyi nang lha dang srung ma sku bskyod 'tshal: dbyings la gnas shing 'gyu ba'i lha tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: kun kyang bdag nyid las bcol dpung la bzhengs: dmigs pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces dang gser skyems gzu dpang gsal bar bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes brtse gzigs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam che mchog phyi nang gsang ba'i lha: bdud 'dul drag mo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: dam can gter srung las kyi rdzu 'phrul can: drag rtsal 'chang ba'i myur mgyogs pho nya rnams:

rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: ma 'ongs mkhyen gsol dgra la bka' chad phob: sdang zhing gdug pa'i byad ma dgra bo 'di: yi dam lha yis mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: bka' yi chad pa le lan drag por phob: deng 'dir 'gugs nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sarba pañtsa pū dza khā hi: de nas phyogs bcur mchod nas brub khung dmigs bya bskyed pa ni: mdun du gnam lcags las grub hoṃ khung nag po zur gsum kha dog la mthil yangs pa bang rim dgu kha khyer gsum dang ldan pa: kha khyer dang po la sgrol byed shan pa nag mo glog ltar 'khyugs pa: gnyis par lha bdud nag mos gshin skad 'o dod drag tu 'bod pa: gsum par bla 'gugs dus kyi pho mo srid gsum gling bzhi yud kyis bskor zhing dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes skad cig la 'gugs pa: las kyi brub khung chen po de la mngon spyod kyi rtags kun tshang ba gshin rje'i bsad khang bdud kyi bsha' ra: sde brgyad kyi 'du sa: pho nya'i 'gyu lam: klu bdud kyi gre ba: gza' bdud kyi lto ba: srog gcod nyi khri dgu 'bum 'tshogs pa'i gling chen po: gshin yul zangs thang dmar po'i rnam par mngon sum du bkod pa'i mthil du: nṛ tri dmar nag gnyis las bskyed pa'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs: byad ma sdig can de nyid lus sngo zhing ham pa mig shi mig can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzags pa: yan lag mya ngan gyi cha byad can la lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bsdams pa: gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas phyur ba la grang dmyal brgyad kyi ngad dang ldan pas rab tu gzir nas smre sngags kyi skeg bu 'don pa'i dbyibs su bskyed pa'o: bsad khang nag po de'i nang las kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru 'tshubs pa: phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: nang na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba: bar du gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa: logs na phra dog gi thog dang ser ba'i bu yug 'tshubs pa:

las kyi bdud mo dam sri ma dang dus mtshan ma mtshan mo rgyu ba: srod la nyul ba sreg ma 'phrog ma skem byed ma bcas bdud mo thams cad cho nge lhang lhang byed pa ste: las kyi pho nya rnams kyis bzung nas thar pa med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: bka' bden pa'i stobs kyis 'gugs shing dmigs pa'i rten la dbab pa ni: na moḥ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags gsar rnying rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par nyi ma nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can rigs lnga: u tsa la'i dur khrod chen po nas sku sprul seṅge'i gdong pa can: gsung sprul stag gi gdong pa can: thugs sprul phag gi gdong pa can: yon tan gyi sprul pa dom gyi gdong pa can: phrin las kyi sprul pa spyang ki'i gdong pa can: sgrol byed nag mo lcags kyi gdong pa can: phra men ma bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong pa can: dus kyi pho nya mo dmar mo srog gcod btsan gyi bu mo: sngon mo dbugs len klu yi bu mo: bla 'gugs nag mo bdud kyi bu mo: lo zla zhag dus za ma chu tshod dus kyi pho nya mo: drug cu rtsa bzhi: srid pa'i nag mo shwa thogs rgyan thogs khram thogs rtsis thogs bdud mo bcu gnyis: skye 'gro gling bzhi'i srog bdag mo srin mo khrag gi ral pa can brgyad: ma bhyo dzaḥgasum las 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag ma mo gsum: ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i phra men ma bcu gnyis: dgra lha'i rmu tsa mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad: gzhan yang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro srid pa'i ma mo dus bdag ma gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa dmod pa'i rig sngags drag po 'di la brten nas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma ming nas smos te 'gugs pa'i las su bcol ba ni:

spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa: dge 'dun gyi chos sde bcom pa: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i dben ri gnyan po gtor ba: khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag bstan pa'i bdag po rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyi brgyud 'dzin: dpal ldan rnying ma'i chos grwas mtshon pas 'dus sde rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: tshad btsugs pa ya bor bzung ba: do bsdo ba: phod btsugs pa: 'gran btsal ba: 'gras 'tshol ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: chos skyong srung ma'i nus pa gshe ba: gzhan yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: tshe srog la bar du gcod pa: mtho dogs dma' dga' byed pa: sngon 'gugs rgyab 'ded byed pa: shag ngan gyi sna 'dren byed pa: ngos bstod lkog nas smad pa: kha dkar zhing khog nag pa: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: dgra kha dang mi kha zug pa: nad kha dang yams kha 'tshubs pa: ri rgya dang rlung rgya bshig pa: gdan sa mchod zhing 'phrog mi: khyad par du'ang dgra sgo dang gyod sgo 'byed pa: che sri dang chung sri dar sri god sri langs pa: ban byad bon byad skye bo'i mda' zor bud med dmod zor: yugs sa'i thal zor: rig sngags kyi thun zor: zhang zhung gi mthu zor: la sogs pa bdag cag sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum khyim sgo lam gsum: gzhi lam byis gsum thams cad du gnod cing sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi mi rabs bdun rgyud dang bcas pa thams cad: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gling phran gling bar mun bar ban bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga la bkod pa: bla shog bu la bris pa: rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ:
karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ

zhes rol mo drag rdung dang bcas nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: dza bhyoḥ snang srid ma mo srog bdag har len ma: pho nya mi bsrun bdud kyi dbang mo che: nag mo srod la nyul byed dus la bab: dam nyams byad ma'i bla srog khug la shog: keng keng me 'bar gseb nas rgyug byed ma: dmar mo zangs 'phar gdong can dus la bab: byad ma'i bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: sngo dmar rlabs phyur 'phyo ma mun par gtibs: gcan spyang lag ring gdong can dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dgra bo bla 'khyams khug la shog: bhyoḥ bla 'dzin lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: bla 'ching zhags pa nag pos sdoms la shog: bla 'dzin drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: bla 'ded bya gcan rnams kyis chum la shog: dgra bo'i bla dwags ming byang 'di la phob: byad ma gdug pa'i bla tshe rten dang phrol: gzugs byang 'di la khug cig mā ra ya: tri tri nṛ tri aṅku sha ya dzaḥ thun thun ma tri ma tri dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti thun dza dzaḥ zhes rol mo drag rdung dang bcas nas khug rtags ma byung bar bkug: gu gul yungs dkar thang phrom sha chen bsreg: bya rog 'ug pa'i dang rus lha dang dbye: bhyo dzaḥ mun pa nag po khā kha mu kha ma: dgra bgegs ban bon byad ma lha dang phyes: sdig can brnag pa'i dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha skyes lha phyes: dgra lha srung skyob ban bon rnams dang phyes: bhyoḥ hu lu nag mo dug 'debs 'ug gdong ma: ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra bgegs bdud dang sprod: dmigs pa'i byad ma 'chi bdag bdud dang sprod: dmod pa'i dgra bo srog bdag bdud dang sprod: byad ma sdig can phung bdud nag por sprod: satwar thogs bdud kyi bu mo'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs lha dbye bdud sprad dus la bab: mngon spyod mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: bhyo bhyo khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: tri tri nṛ tri dgra bo shag phyes:

bsad sngags bzla zhing thun gyis gzir ba ni: dzaḥ las byed chen po'i dus la bab: dgra bo phung po bshig pa'i phyir: dmod pa nag po'i thun gyis gdab: dzaḥ yungs thun drag sngags dmod pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: rdo thun rbab rgod hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: dug thun smyo 'bog thibs se thib: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: chu thun sbos 'gas 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: khrag thun nad rlangs chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mtshon thun rno ngar zengs se zeng : dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mda' thun thog rgod sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: gnam lcags phur thun hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ thun bhyo bhyoḥ rig sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs dang ldan pas: gri gug gam ni mkhar phur thogs rtsa bar/ ṛg sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs dang bcas pa'i: zhes mkhar phur gri gug thogs la/ hūm̐ bhyo dzaḥ las la khros pa'i sha za mo: phra men nag mo lcags gdong can: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba bsnams: yar rtse rdo rje rtse lnga yis: ye shes mkha' 'gro las la bskul: 'chang bzung zlum skor chu srin kha: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas: dbal so zangs gri 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bo'i sgo dgur dzaḥkhram ya: phyag g.yon gnam lcags mkhar phur bsnams: mar rtses dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: 'chang bzung gza' bdud pho nya 'gyu: chu srin mtshon cha'i zi ra khol: zur gsum gnam lcags thog rgod 'bebs: srog bdag ma gsum dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can gyi: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chod kyi: dbang po sgo dgur kī la ya: rtsa mdud lnga la kī la ya:

dbang po drug la kī la ya: rnam shes brgyad la kī la ya: 'byung bdud gzugs la kī la ya: pho rgyud mo rgyud kī la ya: rigs rgyud bcas par kī la ya: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: srog gcod dbugs sdud phung po shig: mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra lokka ma tri ya sarba ka ra ti ka ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: badzra kī li kī la ya tri shu la dgra bo'i snying rtsa myog myog mā ra ya phaṭaḥ / ces khrus dgongs pas phur bu gzir/ zhes pas phur bu'i dbal zur gsum las/ 'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams gsum dang*/ rgya mdud 'og mar las byed pho nya rnams kyi 'gyu lam gshin rje'i lto ba/ rgya mdud gong mar chos dbyings gzhal yas khang chen por gsal ba dang*/ gdab pa'i tshe phur bu sras mchog kī la ya/ sku smad phur bu'i rnam pa can no/ dgra bo'i snying khar gdab la/ tshe rten bil rgya btums pa 'dra ba'i de'i nang*/ bla rten byi'u leb pa'i mgo tsam/ khrag gi sbal pa 'dra ba de'i nang*/ srog rten bya ma sar gyi sgo nga tsam dbugs kyi rta la zhon nas/ yungs zhi 'dril ba lta bur ltem ltem yod pa de la/ phur rtse bsnun pas/ snum la til 'byar ba lta bur phur bu'i khong seng nas brgyud de/ dug lnga dug gsum shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral/ bla rten tshe rten srog rten rnams rang la thim pas gzi brjid ches cher 'bar bas/ che btsan kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam/ rnam par shes pa'i thig le 'od bskor drwa ba bya ma sar sgo nga tsam pa de rgya mdud nas thon te ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas brgyud/ spyi bo nas thon gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs ky-i thugs kar bstims te/ phyir mi ldog pa kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong du mnyam par bzhag pas/ gnas lugs don gyi zhing khams ngo sprod gdab bo/ gri gug snying khar btab nas gnas spar ba ni: hoḥ rnam shes ngo bo āḥdakar de:

phung po bshig nas klong du thim: phaṭaḥ spu gri chu gri ral gri sogs gang rung thogs la: bhyoḥ gdug pa'i dgra bo byad ma la: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha char pa phob: ming shul tsam yang med par gyis: gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: lha'am 'os kyang brlag par byed: gcod cing gtub pa'i dus la bab: gtubs nas rdo rjes gtun du brdung : rig sngags dmod pa'i byad ma rnams: phye mar shig cig mā ra ya: om̐ badzra ka ra ti ka dgra bo gtub gtub: kha ra ka dgra bo shig shig: a yu dha dgra bo myog myog: badzra kī li kī la ya byad ma bhyo bhyoḥ rbad rbad nan nan chod chod bhandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de nas spu gri ral gri chu gri sogs gang rung gis/ pho g.yas skor mo g.yon skor ske nas brtsam ste bla gnas gar bab tu bsnun cing dum bur gtubs te/ raktas bran/ dgra bgegs kyi sha rus ri bo dang khrag rgya mtsho ltar/ dmar nyil gyis yod pa de la/ bdud rtsi bran pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin brlabs te/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: gnam sa'i zhal gdongs gangs ri'i dbal mche gtsigs: dgra bo byad ma'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rnams: lhag med zhal du bzhes la ming med mdzod: om̐ ḍākki singha mu kha baṃ ha ri ni sa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dbang po lnga dang bcas pa la kha kha khā hi: zhes lhag med bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs par bsamo/ de'ang rgyud las/ dam nyams dgra bgegs gzhi dbyings grol bas 'tshengs/ ye shes 'jig rten sha khrag mchod pas 'tshengs/ bdag nyid ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas 'tshengs/ 'tshengs pa rnam gsum mngon spyod khyad chos so/ zhes so/ de nas zor bzlog gzhung dang*/ gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub dang yang bzlog sogs kyang las rim bzhin dang*/ lhag ma yan chad grub nas/ sgo dbye lam bstan ni/ dmar byang gi zhal bstab sogs kyang bya/

glud sogs gzhung nas mi 'byung zhing*/ sngon las kyi dgra yin na/ sku glud sbyin pa sogs de gal che bar gsungs pas/ rtsa bar/ sngon las shugs kyi dgra yin na/ phar la mi thub tshur la logs/ zhes pas/ glud brgya dang tshar gcig sogs gang 'os do gal che chung dang bstun no/ de nas 'phang ba'i sar/ dur khrod kyi sa sna sogs kyi stegs bu mda' gang gi steng*/ bsad pa zangs sgrom ltar gyi rdul tshon kyang bri/ de'i steng dug shing tsher ma can sogs drag po'i shing snas me hom gru gsum du brtsegs par bya'o/ zor rdzas gtor chen sogs rim pa ltar dang*/ 'phang ba'i sar sleb par/ mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: sogs kyi gser skyems dang bstod bskul khrag mtsho khol ma nas chos dbyings rnam dag khro chu khol ma'i klong : sogs bskul lo/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi zor 'phen ni/ phyogs med phyogs mtshams 'phen pa ma gtogs dmigs rten mdun du liṅga sogs kyi dgos phyir/ dang po shar gyi stag gdong ma nas/ rim bzhin lho nub byang phyogs rim par 'phen te/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kyi/ bdud dang dam sri gang yin pa'i steng du/ ye shes dang 'jig rten pa las la chas pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za srog gcod rnams kyis/ gnam lcags kyi thog dang rdo rje'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab pas/ gnod byed ming yang med par byas par bsam/ de nas khrag ral ma'i bskul zor dgra phyogs su gdeng zhing*/ dgra bo'i yul khams thams cad la bskal pa'i me dang khrag gi rgya mtsho dug mtshon nad rlangs mtshon cha'i char phab ste pha rol byad ma bdud sde dpung tshogs ming shul med par bsam/ slar me hom ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong gtso 'khor du bsam zhing*/ gtor chen dgra bgegs sha khrag rus par bsgyur te/ zhal bstab kyi tshul du bya'o/ the tshom gcod pa dang*/ 'byung ba me chu go ldog gi sngags bzla zhing thal mo brdeb par bya'o/

slar zhal kha nang du gyu ste/ brtan ma skyong zhing gtor bro brdungs pas/ bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs kyis kyang*/ dgra bgegs 'byung po'i steng du bro brdungs pas/ dug lnga dug gsum gyi sgrib pa dang bral nas/ dgra bgegs rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te/ slar phyir bzlog cing mi ldang ba rgyas gdab/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas nang du phyin nas dngos grub len/ bkra shis bsngo smon sogs rgyas pas mtha' rgyan no/ zhes zin bris brjed thor bkod de bris pa'i rim pa 'di yang gter gzhung gis gtsor bton te zur rgyan dgongs tshig gi gnad dang mi 'gal ba/ gter ston nyid kyi bka' gnang bzhin/ slar yang spro ba sad de/ rong smyon pas bsgrigs pa 'di yang bstan dgra bdud sde'i tshogs bcom ste rgyal khams bstan pa phyogs bcur dus kun tu dar zhing 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ci) ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong can gyi bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa'i zin bris bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru ḍākki nī ye/ bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i phyi nang gsang sgrub kyi dmigs rim zin bris su bkod pa la/ dang po phyi sgrub ni/ dbu ma chos longs sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa/ gtum mo gzhung khrid ltar/ gsal ba'i spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo'i thugs kar zla gdan la haḥdakar po/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis la/ padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo'i thugs kar zla gdan la niḥdamar po/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo'i thugs kar nyi gdan la riḥser po/ gsang gnas su rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/ las ky-i mkha' 'gro ljang khu'i thugs kar nyi gdan la saḥljang khu/ snying ga'i rtsa brgyad la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar nyi gdan la/ hūm̐ mthing ka'i mthar sngags phreng mthing gsal g.yon bskor du kyi li li 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

dus gsum gyi bde gshegs zhi khro gnas yul gyi dpa' bo ḍākki'i tshogs dpag tu med pa/ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar spyan drangs gnas lnga'i lha tshogs rnams la thim pas/ bkrag mdangs gzi byin ches cher rgyas pa'i rang 'od zer mdangs lnga ldan gyi rnam pas/ rtsa gnas thams cad drwa ba ris su khyab pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te/ mdangs gsal sgrib pa dang bral ba/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang gnas lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs srog las/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ snod kyi 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs bcud dang*/ bcud kyi skye 'gro lha 'dre mi gsum gyi tshe bkrag dbang thang thams cad 'ub 'ub bsdus te/ gnas lngar bstims pas/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi mthu stobs nus rtsal skad cig la rdzogs te/ sku'i gzi byin gyis stong gsum zil gyis gnon cing sngags kyi rang sgras 'jig rten thams cad rmang nas ldeg pa/ khyad par gnas lnga yi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi srog yig la/ shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad de/ de nas phyi rol gyi yul snang la/ skad cig kyang mi yengs par mchu sbyor cung zad dang ldan pas/ om̐ muṃ dzñā na ḍākki singha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes bye ba gcig bzla'o/ gnyis pa nang sgrub la/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i gnas lnga yi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi srog yig sor bzhag la/ gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lor rig 'dzin bla ma 'dus pa'i dbus su/ gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs kyi thugs kar nyi gdan la/ hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng mthing gsal/ g.yas bskor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas zhing khams lnga sogs rgyal ba'i mthu byin/ snod bcud 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te/ thugs srog la thim pas 'od du 'bar te/ thugs srog gi sngags phreng las 'od zer bdud rtsi lnga ldan gyi rgyun babs pas spyi bor rdo rje mkha' 'gro sum brgya drug cu la thim pas/

bde ba'i nyams rgyas te/ kha ṭwāṃ rnams yab tu gyur nas/ bde sbyor mdzad pa'i mkha' lam nas/ byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun dpag med babs pas/ rtsa khams thams cad bde khril gyis gang ste/ ma shong par lud nas 'og tu rim pa ltar mgrin snying lte gsang gi bar du 'geng zhing*/ rtsa gnas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gang phyur ba ltar bde sbyor mdzad pa'i bde stong gi ngo bo la rig pa gtad pas bum can nam/ bar rlung sbyangs nas/ om̐ gu ru singha swa ra gaṇḍe hūm̐: zhes thun rer yid bzlas stong phrag re bzlas pa byas pas zhag bdun du bsgrub bo/ gsang sgrub ni/ gnas lngar mkha' 'gro gsal ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs srog las/ rang mdog gi 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bzhi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang*/ mtshams kyi shugs 'gro sde bzhi thugs srog ha ri ni sa rnams 'dar yed yed du gyur pas/ sku la rang 'dra'i mkha' 'gro 'bum sde rang mdangs kyi 'od zer dang ldan pa 'phros pas/ sgo skyong sde bzhi dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong rnams kyi thugs srog la phog nas de thams cad 'dar zhing rab tu g.yo ba'i rnam pa dang snang srid snod bcud thams cad 'dar phri li li/ 'ja' 'od du ltem ltem zhu ba bdag nyid gtso 'khor la thim pas/ gzi byin ches cher rgyas shing*/ mdor na gzugs snang thams cad lha skur gar nyams khyug khyug /sgra grags thams cad ha ri ni sa'i rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam du sgrog pa/ dran rtog thams cad bde gsal kun khyab chen po snang bas gar khyab rig pas khyab pa/ rig pas gar khyab thugs rjes rang bzhin/ snang cha ma 'gags par bkra lam mer/ 'dzin cha ma grub pa stong sang nge*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med snang stong bde ba chen po chos nyid gnyug ma'i rang mdangs 'bol shig ge'i ngang nas/

om̐ badzra ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ ratna ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ padma ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ karma ḍākki baṃ hūm̐: om̐ bi shwa ḍākki tsa tur baṃ hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'bum phrag gcig bzla'o/ de ltar phyi nang gsang sgrub mthar phyin par grub rjes/ phas kyi byad zor rbod gtong sogs bzlog phyir las sgrub drag sngags su bsgrub na/ spyi bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar a kaḥ mgrin par padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar sa maḥ snying gar sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ra tsaḥ lte bar rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar sha daḥ gsang nas su las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ra saḥ dpung g.yas stag gdong dkar mo'i thugs kar māḥ dpung g.yon phag gdong ser mo thugs kar raḥ pus mo g.yas su dom gdong dmar mo'i thugs kar yaḥ pus mo g.yon du spyang gdong sngon mo'i thugs kar phaṭḥ ces pas sngags 'bru rnams las 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa khol zhing phyur bas/ stong khams rdo rje'i mtshon cha'i char gyis gang bas/ pha rol ban bon byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa gzhob thul gyis ming med du brlag /byad ma'i tshe bsod nus mthu thams cad bdag nyid la thim pas gzhom med rdo rje'i skur gyur/ sa gzhi thams cad khro chu khol ma'i dba' la me yi zer 'khyugs pa/ dbyings thams cad bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gzi byin gyis srid pa spyi nas gzhom zhing*/ 'byung lnga'i khams thams cad rdo rje'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'khrug cing ngar ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ srid pa gsum gyi bdud dang dgra bgegs thams cad nam yang ldang ba med par dbyings rig dbyer med kyis rgyas gtab pa'i gsal snang gi ngang nas/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ces bzlas mthar spro na thal brdeb bya zhing*/ dmigs med ngang la bzhag go /de nas drag mo las chas ma'i sgrub pa ni/ las byang dregs pa tshar gcod gzhung bsrang la/ bzlas dmigs ni/

bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka'i nyi ma'i gdan la thugs srog hūm̐ mthing nag gting mdangs dmar la me 'od tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor ba'i shugs las/ rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa bar ma chad par 'phros pas lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ lus thams cad lcags zhun ltar dmar hang nge ba/ rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa khol zhing phyur bas/ snang srid thams cad sreg nus pa gcig tu gsal bas/ om̐ ma ḍākki singha mu kha dzaḥdzaḥ zhes 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa'i sgra ltar/ zi lhong lhong du 'bum phrag gcig bzlas/ de nas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi gling bzhir gnas pa'i gdong can bzhi sogs/ snang srid kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad rnams dbang du bsdus shing las la btsud de/ dgra bgegs thams cad brlag par dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin ngar dang ldan pas/ om̐ baṃ badzra ḍākki singha mu kha ma ma siddhi dza dzaḥ badzra ratna padma karma ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ zhes gtso 'khor spyi dril 'di nyid khri phrag drug bzla'o/ thun mtshams su las sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas mthar/ thun gtor dang bcas te/ bstod bskul dang thal brdeb bya/ de ltar phyi nang gsang ba drag sgrub gang la'ang thun mthar mchod bstod dang*/ dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po zhabs btags ma tshar gsum re bzla/ bsnyen sgrub rdzogs nas kha skong dang las kyi ngar 'don su/ me mchod tshogs bskang brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub 'bad par bya'o/ de ltar ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang las sgrub phyir/ /dmigs pa'i zin tig bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin/ /'khrul med yi ger ma bkod phangs lags pas/ /mthar thug zab mo'i gnad don 'phyugs dogs dang*/ /nye lam dad ldan karma dar rgyas kyis/ /sgo gsum sri zhus lhur blangs bskul ba'i ngor/ /mkha' 'gro'i rjes bzung rig sngags 'chang bas so/ rong smyon pas sbyar ba'o// // chi) ༈ bdud 'dul drag mo'i brgyud 'debs bsdus pa ni/

na mo gu ru dhe ba ḍākki nī ye/ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku snying rje'i gter/ /sprul sku pad 'byung rgyal yum sā ra dza/ /gnubs chen dzñā na gter chen rtsa gsum gling*/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ khro bo 'chol ba gsang bdag seṅge'i sgra/ /rig sngags lha mo bdud 'dul drag mo dang*/ /zab gter bka' yi srung ma dam can sogs/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bdud bzhi g.yul ngo las/ /rnam rgyal dpa' mo bdud 'dul ḍākki ma'i/ /go 'phang dam pa tshe 'dir thob gyur cig / ces pa'ang rdo 'brong btsun pa zung gis bskul ngor khyung po sngags pas bris// // ji) ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi cha lag /gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo'i phrin las snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku la 'dud/ de la 'dir mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod par/ stegs kyi khar mchod gtor gru gsum dmar po gtso 'khor dgu pa dar gdugs dang dkar dmar gyi rgyan can/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mdun du nyer spyod lnga sogs bshams la/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal yum 'gro ba'i mgon: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bdag gi dge des ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: 'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do: dkar gtor sngon du song nas/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ bgegs gtor ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong : dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang 'byung po'i tshogs:

mchod sbyin 'di longs gzhan du phyir dengs shig: 'khu zhing 'da' na brlag par gdon mi za: ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i phyag mtshan 'bar ba'i mes: steng 'og bar mtshams med pa dum gcig dang : rab tu 'khrigs pa'i gur khang cher gyur nas: nam yang glags lta 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra dzwa la karma tsakra hūm̐ rakṣa ye swā hā: gtor mchod byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla bhandha'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang : gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba a haṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: om̐ ru tra mā ra ni ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ byin dbab pa ni/ āḥ gzhi dbyings spros bral chos sku'i pho brang nas/ /gzhi snang lhun 'grub longs sku mkha' 'gro'i sprin/ /gang 'dul der ston sprul sku seṅge'i gdong*/ /gnas yul zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro dang ni shugs 'gro phra men sogs/ /ye shes 'jig rten tshul 'chang sprul 'khor bcas/ /'dir byon gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob/ /rdo rje'i sku yi gar stabs lams se lam/ /lus la byin phob rtsa yi mdud pa khrol/ /'gags med gsung gi nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru/ /ngag la nus spel bde drod bskyed du gsol/ /'khrul med thugs ni bde stong ya la la/ /sems la nyams rtogs ye shes spor du gsol/ /sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du smin pa dang*/ /snod bcud ye shes 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs/

/rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dgyes zhal ston/ /'brel tshad byang chub thob pa'i dngos grub stsol/ dzñā na ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bhrūm̐: thod pa dmar smug brtsegs pa'i pho brang dbus: chos 'byung dmar nag gdengs ka gyen du phyogs: de nang pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du: bdag nyid mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog mthing nag seng zhal khros pa'i gdong : g.yu ral gseb nas seng chung sprin ltar gtibs: rab brjid thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: phyag g.yas gnam lcags gri gug mkha' la phyar: phyag g.yon bhandhar rakta bcud bzang gtams: gru mor kha ṭwāṃ brten pas dug gsum 'joms: ḍākki rgya rtags rus rgyan me long spras: thod rlon mgo phreng ga sha dar dpyangs 'phur: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang baṃ ro'i gdan la 'gying : gtso mo'i phyogs bzhir drag mo gdong can bzhi: stag dang phag zhal dom gdong lce spyang mgo: rigs bzhi gtso mthun phyogs mdog rang rtags spras: gzhan yang sgo skyong srung ma nyid sprul bcas: snang la rang bzhin bral ba gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros ma sring mkha' 'gro spyan drangs nas: bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thun stsol: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod rang byung gdod ma'i klong : chos dbyings drag po e yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: bla med dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki nī baṃ siṃ ha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes pas spyan drangs dbyer med bsgom/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: chos dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: rigs lnga bde chen lhun grub rang bzhin 'bar: dbyings las ma g.yos rnal 'byor ḍākki'i tshogs: gus pas phyag bgyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol:

om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum bha ling 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bam ri 'bar ba ni/ bhyo bhyoḥ baṃ ri thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug seṅge'i gdong : g.yu ral sprugs pas stobs bcu'i phrin las rdzogs: khro mo'i gdong ni za byed 'jigs la rngam: dmar la 'khyil ba'i spyan rtsa sdang mig bgrad: rno ba'i 'od ldan 'bar bas phyag mtshan gdengs: mdangs ldan 'od ris dmar chen bhandha gtams: mkhar phur las mtshon rtse gsum gyen du gzengs: ma rgyud 'bum gyi gtso mos rus rgyan gsol: me long 'od ldan lhag lhag ma sring sdud: nu ma bha ga rgyas pa'i bde drod 'phel: 'khor ba stong phyir mgo phreng tshal du dngar: brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i dga' bzhi'i gar dang ldan: 'bar zhing sreg pa'i me dpung sku la 'khril: ye shes mkha' la rol pa seṅge'i dpal: dur khrod rgyan drug spras la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sku yi sprul pa bde chen mkha' 'gro ma: nad gdon zhi mdzad dkar mo seng gdong ma: dza landha ra'i gnas kyis dbang mo che: badzra ḍākki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ gsung gi sprul pa brda sgrogs mkha' 'gro ma: tshe bsod dbang sdud dmar mo stag gdong ma: lam pā ka yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: padma ḍākki'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ thugs kyi sprul pa ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: gnas lugs mngon gyur phag gdong mthing nag ma: a tsi rta yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: buddha ḍākki'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

bhyoḥ yon tan sprul pa dga' bzhi mkha' 'gro ma: 'byor drug rgyas mdzad ser mo dom gdong ma: tri sha ku na'i gnas kyi dbang mo che: ratna ḍākki'i yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ phrin las sprul pa rab g.yo mkha' 'gro ma: dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad sngon mo spyang gdong ma: tshandho ha yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: karma ḍākki'i phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sgo skyong sgrol byed dus kyis pho nya mo: lo zla zhag dus phra men drug cu bzhi: bdud mo srin mo 'chi tshe srog bdag ma: ye shes las grub 'khor dang bcas la bstod: dzap bskul ni/ bhyo: bskul lo bzhengs shig ma sring ḍākki tshogs: thugs rje'i sku mchog mngon sum mtshon pa dang : rig sngags sgrub pa'i nus rtsal shugs phyungs la: bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol: bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng mthing la gting mdangs dmar ba'i ngad chags pa sgra gdangs di ri ri sgrog pa g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa cher 'phros pas/ nang gi gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bskul/ de thams cad las kyang 'od zer ches cher 'bar zhing mched pas/ las nyon sdig sgrib pha rol gyi byad grib sogs nyes ltung thams cad dag ste/ sku mdog mthing 'od bkrag mdangs gzi brjid cher 'bar bas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod/ 'byung lnga'i bcud thams cad shugs kyis bsdus te 'khor 'das kun na 'gran zla dang bral khyab bdag dpa' mo chen mor nga rgyal bskyed la/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ om̐ badzra ratna padma karma buddha ya ha ri ni sa ḍākki sa ma ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes las sngags bzlas pa'i tshe khyad par gdong can lnga la sogs pa'i spro bsdus las bzhi mchog dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i ting 'dzin gang 'dod du bsgyur shes par bya'o/

yang bzlog ni/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ces lus kyi gnas drug tu bkod pas/ ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro phra men shugs 'gro thams cad kyi srog snying drag tu bskul ba'i shugs kyis/ sngags 'bru rnams las 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa drag tu khol zhing phyur ba las/ srid gsum thams cad drag sngags thog rgod kyi char phab pas pha rol byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa bsregs bcom rjes shul med par brlag /slar yang thugs rje'i shugs las bskal ba'i 'thor rlung g.yos pas 'dzin snang bag chags dang bcas pa dbyings su gtor te sbyangs/ snang srid thams cad du khro mo'i sprin rab tu 'khrigs pa'i rta bros gzir bas/ dgra bgegs byad gdon log 'dren thams cad nam yang ldang med thugs rjes dbyings su rgyas btab par mos la/ phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ de'ang sgrub pa'i skabs su rtsa sngags dang*/ las phran skabs drag sngags bcu bzhi/ zor las sogs kyi tshe yang bzlog ste zlog sngags rnams 'dir bzhugs pas skabs 'dir bsnyen sgrub kho nar bya ba la dgos pa chung phyir zur yang bar byas so/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams bzlas rjes mchod pa ni/

hūm̐ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum bha ling 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza kha kha khā hi: zhes mchod la sngags bstod ni/ bhyoḥ rgyal kun rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs: drag mo khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: nam mkha'i mdog can me 'od 'phros: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: mthar thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma skyes rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: 'gro ba'i don mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: nam mkha'i mdog can dbu ni seṅge'i gdong : ye shes me ris ma rig mun pa gsal: thugs rje'i me dpung srid gsum ma lus sreg: 'jigs byed chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsgral ba'i phung po lhag med zhal du gsol: dug gsum sha khrag sku gsum klong du rol: sgo gsum mi mthun bar chad med par mdzod: stong nyid bya bral gnyug ma'i ye shes che: mtha' bral ro gcig phyag rgya chen por gyur: ka dag 'od gsal chos sku 'du 'bral med: mnyam rjes dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig: de nas bsnyen sgrub sogs rgyun khyer gyi skabs rjes chog 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas pas chog skabs 'gar tshogs mchod sogs spro bar 'dod na/ gsol mchod rgyas bsdus gang rigs sngon du song nas bshags skong bya/ rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig lhug mthar/ tshogs mchod dngos la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar byin gyis brlab pa la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon dpag med pa: 'khor 'das yongs la mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ de nas tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod rang byung gdod ma'i klong : chos dbyings drag po e yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes la thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid du stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: skong bshags ni/ bhyoḥ khyad par mnyes shing mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dur khrod pho brang rgyan spyod bkod pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: thod pa ltag sprod zhing lpags g.yogs pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: mchog chen gri rkang gling bu'i dbyangs ring 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhandha lcang lo rakta rnam lnga'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: sha chen tshil chen dri gsur ngad ldan 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dmar chen dpal chen dar nag ba dan can: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dgra bgegs sha khrag ri ltar spungs pa'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: zhing lpags rgyal mtshan dar nag g.yab mo phyar: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: phyag mtshan rnon po mtshon cha 'khor lo'i rtsibs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: ging pa gar pa dpa' mo'i gar bsgyur tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gnas nyul dus mtshan ma mo gcer bu 'bum: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul:

gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes pa'i phud: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: 'bod pa'i gdangs chen 'brug ltar ldir ba bcas: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhyoḥ mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas sna tshogs kyis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong thugs dam bskang : padma mkha' 'gro stag gdong thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phag gdong thugs dam bskang : rin chen mkha' 'gro dom gdong thugs dam bskang : phrin las mkha' 'gro spyang gdong thugs dam bskang : las byed lcags gdong nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : las bdag mtshan mo sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa ma mo mched gsum thugs dam bskang : yang sprul srin mo stong sde'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam dngos grub stsol: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du: mchod pa lor zlar 'das pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs dang bskang mchod chag pa mthol lo bshags: sbyor sgrol gnad du ma khel mthol lo bshags: dus sgrub dus su 'das pa mthol lo bshags: dus min las la sbyor ba mthol lo bshags: bcu nya stong bzhi chag pa mthol lo bshags: rten 'brel sna tshogs chags pa mthol lo bshags: thabs shes kha 'byed spyod pa mthol lo bshags: bde stong zung du ma 'jug mthol lo bshags: dam tshig spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje'i sngags dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: 'gyod tshangs dge bas mnyam nyid la gnas shog: ces yig brgya bzla/ bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: sras mchog gyad kyi phur bu kī la ya: gdeng zhing 'dril nas gzir 'debs dus la bab: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: auṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad bhyo bhyoḥ gtubs te 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dam nyams dgra bgegs ru tra bsgral ba yi: sha khrag don snying dbang po sna tshogs 'di: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul:

bzhes nas nam yang bgegs srin mi ldang mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: tshogs la rol/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: gnas yul dus bdag phra men ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe sgrubs par mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag e yi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki skur bzhengs la: mthu rtsal stobs kyi thugs dam bskul: las bzhi kun 'grub phrin las bcol: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag byang chub mchog thob ste: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par mdzod: ces tshogs gtor 'bul: de nas chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus: snying thig sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: khas blangs bzhin du gtor ma bzhes: yang zab bya ra 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya i daṃ bha lingta la khā hi: brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong ma sring bcu gnyis kyis: mthun rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yul srungs lo legs bkra shis spel: dus 'khrugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ti ma ma khā hi: rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: phyi nang bar chod thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: bgegs srin dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: zab dbyings ye shes 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: bdud 'dul ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dbang bzhi ye shes thob par mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: gu na siddhi hrīḥ gu hya sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum bha ling 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza kha kha khā hi: zhes mchod la bstod pa ni/ bhyoḥ rgyal kun rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs: drag mo khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: nam mkha'i mdog can me 'od 'phros: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang dang : ma 'byor dam nyams 'di phyi'i sgrib g.yogs rnams: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya bzla/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar dang*/ bsdu ldang ni/ dkyil 'khor ngo bo 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ yig gyen ldog mi dmigs chos skur āḥ gsal stong gdod ma'i dbyings phyug mngon gyur shog: a a āḥ zhes bsdus la/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ slar ldang zhing go cha'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ go bgo zhing lus srung*/ bsngo smon ni/ hoḥ ji snyed phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdag: brtse bas dgongs phyir smin mdzad smon lam tshogs: grub ste ci lta'i bdag gi dge tshogs kun: mtha' yas ma gyur byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo: bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i yum: ye shes mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i 'od: rab dga'i dpal ldan g.yo ba mo: seng gdong ḍākki'i bkra shis shog: de ltar byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub ur mo'i gzhung ci bzhin las/ sngon rjes sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas mi 'gal bar brgyan te bkod pa 'di'ang mnga' bdag nyang chen gyi gdung*/ sprul sku nam mkha' 'gro 'dul gyi dbon rigs su gyur pa/

rig sngags 'chang ba dbang chen mthu stobs 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis bskul ba ltar/ zab rgya mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod cha shas tsam 'dzin pa dus mtha'i sngags 'chang skyid grong smyon pas kong yul sa yi thig le/ kra ti drag sngags rol pa'i yang dben sku gsum rdo rje'i gzhal med khang chen du sbyar ba 'dis bdud rigs log par 'dren pa dmigs med du gzhom zhing*/ gsang chen gyi theg pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /de ltar rig 'dzin chen po'i chog khrigs las mdun bskyed byad bzlog dang 'brel ba'i cha shas rnams bsdus nas/ bsnyen sgrub dkyus mar 'jug bde bar byas pa dang chad brtan bskul gsum rta bro sogs kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams gsang ye sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas bsnan te/ go rim cung zad 'khrugs bsdebs dang bcas gu hya shā sa na dhā ras bgyis pas/ 'gro kun byad phur gtad gsum gyi g.yul las rgyal ste bdud 'dul ḍākki'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // nyi) lha mo khro gnyer can gyi byad khrol gser gyi lde mig rgyun gyi nyams len dril sgrub bzhugs so/ de'ang 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma dang gzhan gyis mi thub pa gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo ngan sngags kyi g.yul bzlog drag mo khro gnyer can ma ste/ rig sngags kyi lha mo rtsa ba sum dril zhes pha rol gyi byad rgol dam sri pho mo'i gnod pa zhi bar byed pa'i man ngag zab mo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: 'khor ba dong sprugs sems bskyed do: 'gro kun byad phur g.yul rgyal phyir/ /rig sngags lha mo bsgrub par bgyi/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: swa bhā wa shuddho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbus su/

paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma a las zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid bam̐ dmar po tām̐ ljang gu mūm̐ dkar po ste yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ri khrod kyi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ljang mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma zhabs bzhi dang ldan ma/ g.yas zhal gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo 'dzum bag dang ldan ma/ rtsa zhal ljang mo 'phags ma ri khrod ma rgyas par bzhad ma/ g.yon zhal dmar mo drag mo rdo rje khro gnyer can ma mche ba gtsigs ma/ phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gdugs dkar dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin ma/ bar pa gnyis kyis dgra satwa dang zhags pa thogs ma/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs ma/ dbu la rin chen rgyan cha rnam par spras shing shing lo'i cod pan rnam par spras ma/ sku stod dar ljang yug gos gsol nas nor bu dang rin chen rgyan drug spras ma/ sku smad dar dmar ang rag gsol nas zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs ma/ sku la ye shes kyi 'od zer dang 'ched pa'i me dpung 'bar bas bskor nas bdud dang mu stegs tshar gcod ma/ snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ma'i skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum dang*/ thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar nyi dkyil la baṃ tām̐ mūm̐ gyi mthar sngags phreng dmar nag me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro bzhin rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar drag tu 'khor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas nus stobs gzi byin cher 'bar/ slar sngags phreng las 'od zer me chu rlung gsum thun mtshon gyi rang bzhin srid gsum khyab par 'phros pas/ snang srid 'byung lnga'i byad 'dre gtad bdag thams cad byad ma rang gshed du dbab nas mnan bsreg gtor bas rjes med du brlag cing mi dmigs par rgya yis btab/ snang grags rig gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du lam gyi gsal bar

dmigs la/ rtsa ba gsum dril gyi nye snying ni/ om̐ badzra bi dho bi dho bhi dza ya a dzi ti ma a par dzi te ma ma tshindha ya ha ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub mthar/ pha rol rig sngags kyis byad du bcug pa dang mnan pa bcings pa bskrad pa gzir ba thams cad byer byer khrol khrol shig shig bhandha bhandha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa sarba tsu ru tsaṇḍa tsaṇḍa sarba maṇḍa maṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ sogs dang spro na gzungs ring yang ci nus bzla/ de nas 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ: ye shes lha mo 'od rab 'byin: nyon mongs kun gyi sman pa mchog: sdug bsngal nad las grol mdzad ma: thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo: byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren: mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing : nyon mongs sgrib pa sbyong mdzad pa: rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bstod: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od: lha mo'i sku yi gzi brjid kyis: gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags dang : dug dang nad mtshon chu la sogs: pha rol rgol ba'i byad gtad rnams: lha mo khyed kyis zhi bar mdzod: rgyal yum sgrol ma khyed sku? sogs shlau ka gnyis brjod/ gzhan yang bsngo smon shis brjod sogs spyi ltar dang rjes shes mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rang gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor khyer bde ru gter gzhung las cung zad btus pa'o/ rab byung ri zla'i shing bya lo'i dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs su khyung nag sngags pas btus shing rdo ban gyis bris so// //

ti) khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi/ bum sgrub khrus kyi rdzing bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bstan g.yo kun bdag srid gsum 'gro ba'i mgon/ /padma thod phreng thugs bcud zab mo'i don/ /rig sngags bcing grol zhal lung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dri med khrus kyi rdzing bu 'di na bskyil/ 'dir mi pham rdo rje gtum mo g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i bum sgrub bstan pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so/ dang po ni yid mthun gyi gnas stegs bu kheb kyis bkab par 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu gcig la nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba'i khar/ las bum che nges bsgrub bya du yod 'dang ba rgyun babs kyi chu dang*/ chos sman dri bzang gis gtams pa la dar dmar ljang gi mgul chings/ ku sha'i kha rgyan dang tsakra gzung thag rdo rje/ sku phyi dar sna lnga mdun du dug sbrul nag po stong thub kyi 'khor lo bkram pa'i khar mañdzi la brten te zor gtor gtso 'khor gsum mtheb skyu liṅga tshe yungs sha tshil gyis brgyan pa/ mchod yon sogs nyer spyod kyis bskor/ gnyis pa ni/ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa sogs dang tshogs mchod dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro ba'i/ mdun bskyed mchod pa byin rlob ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dpag med nam mkha'i khyon rtse las: bla med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: mchod yon me tog bdug spos dri: mar me dri chab zhal zas bshos: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: blo yis sprul lam lhun gyis grub: t-ing 'dzin mnyam nyid chen por gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum bya: mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang? om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las bum pa ye shes kyis gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma āḥlas zla ba ste gdan sum brtsegs kyi dkyil 'khor steng du baṃ dmar po tāṃ ljang gu mūm̐ dkar po ste yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las bskyed pa'i rje btsun ri khrod kyi rnal 'byor ma:

sku mdog ljang mo zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs can: g.yas zhal gtsug tor rnam rgyal dkar mo 'dzum bag dang ldan pa: rtsa zhal ljang mo 'phags ma sgrol ma ri khrod dgyes mar bzhad ma: g.yon zhal dmar mo rdo rje khro gnyer can mche ba gtsigs pa: phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gdugs dkar dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin ma: bar ma gnyis kyis dgra satwa dang zhags pa thog ma: mtha' ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'geng ma: dbu la rin po che rgyan drug gis spras ma shing lo'i cod pan rab tu g.yo ma: sku stod la dar ljang gi yug gos gsol nas nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan drug gis spras ma sku smad dar dmar gyi ang rag gsol nas: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis bzhugs ma sku la ye shes kyi 'od zer dang me dpung 'bar mas bskor bas bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bar gcod ma: khor yug tu gdugs dkar lha mo nyer gcig: rdo rje'i pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi gnas nyul bye ba 'bum sde: steng du gdugs dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor ba la: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sprin gtibs pa ltar: snang la rang bzhin bral ba'i skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin rtogs med dbyings nas mkha' 'gro ma: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med dpa' mo'i tshul: 'phags ma bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan drangs dbyer med bzhugs par gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: a be sha ya ā a swa tī sarba satwaṃ: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal zhing : hūm̐: ye shes pho brang nyams re dga': padma dri med mdangs dang ldan: nyi zla spel ma 'od re gsal: thabs shes spel ba'i khri 'phang mtho: ḍākki rgya mtsho dgyes par bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis lha phyag 'tshal:

dam tshig gdung bas rab tu 'dud: om̐ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gtum mo g.yul las rnam par rgyal: sha za 'bar ma gnas nyul ma mo 'bum: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la: mchod yon 'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi 'bul: bzhes nas dug mtshon byad zor zhi bar mdzod: zhabs bsil dag gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan 'bul: bzhes nas 'byung ba'i byad zor zhi bar mdzod: me tog sna tshogs yid mtshar dpag med 'bul: bzhes nas me chu'i byad zor zhi bar mdzod: dri bsung phyogs bcu'i zh-ing khams kun khyab 'bul: bzhes nas rig sngags byad zor zhi bar mdzod: snang gsal nyi zla gzi 'od 'bum 'khyil 'bul: bzhes nas gtad khram rbod gtong zhi bar mdzod: dri chab sman mchod ngad ldan gtams pa 'bul: bzhes nas sngon las byad zor zhi bar mdzod: zhal zas bcud bzang ro brgya'i dpung 'khyud 'bul: bzhes nas 'phral rkyen byad zor zhi bar mdzod: sgra dbyangs theg chen chos rnga 'bir ba 'bul: bzhes nas pha rol byad zor zhi bar mdzod: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gdugs mdzes lta na yid sdug tshul bzang 'bul: bzhes nas rgyal po'i chad pa zhi bar mdzod: sgra snyan gar ma sgeg mo dbyangs can 'bul: bzhes nas mi kha dmod tshig zhi bar mdzod: dri mchog sman spos 'thul ba'i ngad ldan 'bul: bzhes nas chom rkun 'jigs pa zhi bar mdzod: ro mchog sna tshogs byed las rnam 'phrul 'bul: bzhes nas zas ngan dug sbyor zhi bar mdzod: reg mchog lha yi yug gos sna tshogs 'bul: bzhes nas reg dug mdze lhog zhi bar mdzod: phyag rgya gsum ldan chos kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi bar mdzod: ma nges mchod sprin gling bzhi'i khyon bkang 'bul: bzhes nas 'khor 'das byad zor zhi bar mdzod: om̐ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma dhā tu pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā:
