bstod pa bya ba ni: om̐ ye shes lha mo 'od rab 'byin: nyon mongs kun las sman pa mchog: sdug bsngal nad las grol mdzad ma: thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo: byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren: mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing : nyon mongs sgrib pa sbyong mdzad pa: rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bstod: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od: lha mo'i sku yi gzi brjid kyis: gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags dang : dug dang nad mtshon chu la sogs: pha rol rgol ba'i byad gtad rnams: lha mo khyed kyis zhi bar mdzod: de nas rig sngags bzlas pa ni/ gzung thag blangs la/ gtso mo'i thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje gsum mtshon rgya gram 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du nyi dkyil la baṃ yig dmar po'i mthar/ badzra mūm̐ ka ra'i sngags phreng dmar nag me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba g.yas su 'brug stong ldir ba ltar drag tu 'khor shing baṃ yig lte bar zla gdan la mūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar/ om̐ sarba uṣṇi ṣa'i sngags phreng dkar gsal 'od zer 'bar ba g.yas su 'khor ba mūm̐ gyi khong seng du dwangs ma lnga ldan gyi 'od gur 'khyil ba'i nang du tāṃ yig ljang gsal ring cha tshig drag rtsal dang bcas pa'i khong seng nṛ yig gis mtshan pa'i mthar/ om̐ pi sha tsi'i sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba ste/ srog yig gsum po gcig nang gcig zhugs kyis sngags phreng so sor bskor bar bsam/ om̐ pi sha tsi parṇa sha ba ri sarba u pa smra ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā: zhes pas bzlas pas/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed tram̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad de gsal brtan thob pa dang : de las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod: thugs rje'i byin rlabs bsdus bdag gi nus stobs bskyed gzi byin cher 'bar bas: 'od kyi dkyil las mūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer lnga ldan gsal ba 'tsher ba ka gdung tsam dang nyi zer gyi rdul ltar grangs med 'phros pas:

snang srid 'byung lnga'i byad 'dre gtad bdag thams cad ldang med du mnan cing tsha zer rno ngar kyis lus srog dum bu stong du gas pa'i khong snying nas: bsgrub bya'i bla tshe srog rten thig le dkar po dngul chu'i mdog ltar 'tsher ba 'od kyi sbu gus 'ub 'ub drangs te srog rten nṛ yig la drangs pas bla tshe nyams pa thams cad sor chud srog mi 'gyur mi shigs pa'i ngo bor gyur par mos la: gong gi sngags sham du/ om̐ sarba uṣṇi ṣa bi ma le pra tyam̐ ghṛrṇa birṇa tsakra na maḥs mānta a dzi te dzwa la te dzwa pra dzwa la khandha khandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ om̐ dzambha ni satwaṃ bha ni laṃ bha ni mo ha ni ha ha phaṭḥ he he phaṭḥ tshindha tshindha phaṭḥ da ha pa tsa phaṭḥ ma tha ru na phaṭḥ shri ghri badzra sarba ka ri hūm̐ druṃ hriṣṭaṃ kriṣṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces btags la bzla/ de ltar gsal brtan du gyur pa dang thugs srog sngags phreng nang rim bzhin ye shes kyi stobs bskyed pas/ thugs rje'i gzi byin cher cher 'bar ba'i shugs kyis baṃ mthar sngags 'khor ba las 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa dus mtha'i zhugs me lta bu 'khor ba ltar 'phros pas/ sku'i cha thams cad na me zer gnam lcags thog gi bu yug 'tshubs pas 'khor gyi lha tshogs khro bcu sprul pa yang sprul bcas rnams kyang sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug stong ltar ldir zhing*/ rig sngags dmod pa'i stobs bskyed pas stong khams tshwa zer dang mtshon cha'i char gyis gang bzhin drag tu 'khrugs pas/ pha rol byad zor rbod gtong gtad 'dre thams cad gzhob tu btul zhing snod bcud 'byung ba'i gzhi 'dzin gnam sa rus sbal kha sbyor gyi rnam par 'khod pa'i 'og nas snang srid kyi lha 'dre sa bdag klu gnyan sde rigs dang bcas pa 'jig rten gnyis med du gnas pa la/ ye shes thugs rjes phyag rgya mi 'gyur mi shigs pa mkha' 'gro'i srog yig dgu dgus rab tu mnan cing rgyas gdab pas/

srid pa'i byad gdon gang gis kyang 'da' bar mi nus pas dam tshig shugs la gnas pa'i nges shes brten pa'o/ gong sngags gnyis kyis sham bur/ badzra mūm̐ kā ra: badzra bai ro tsa na: badzra yo gi ni badzra ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ badzra ma tri ṇi phaṭḥ badzra sa ma ya phaṭḥ badzra sa ma ye phaṭḥ om̐ badzra ra tri ye phaṭḥ badzra ta tri ye phaṭḥ badzra ko au ma ri kun landha: badzra siṃ ha mu kha bhyo bhyoḥ badzra na mo dha ra ya: baṃ ka ra phe ka ra bhyo bhyoḥ gzhan gyi rig sngags dang byad du bcug pa khrol khrol: mnan pa dang bskrad pa dang gzir ba dang dmod pa dang mu stegs kyi ngan sngags: ban bon gyi hom sbar sogs gnod pa thams cad shig shig 'ur 'ur om̐ badzra me thun satwaṃ bha ya byer byer hrī karma ku ru kī la ya dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rig sngags gsum dril brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bzla zhing thun mtshams su/ hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed yum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: 'dzab kyi phrin las bskul phyir mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos sgrub stsol ba'i phyir: ye shes lha mo'i tshogs la bdag bstod do: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: 'dod don gsol ba ni/ na mo: 'phags ma bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dus 'dir bdag la nye bar dgongs su gsol: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od zer gyis: 'gro rnams skyong zhing byang chub lam la 'god: thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: 'dul bya mthar phyin mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyi: tshe rabs las kyi bag chags sdig sgrib dang : nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor rba rlabs gzhom du gsol: gnas skabs nad gdon dgra bgegs glau bur rkyen: dug mtshon me chu byad zor 'jigs pa brgyad: bdud kyi cho 'phrul yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams: thugs rje dpung gis ma lus zhi bar mdzod:

ces gzhol zhing*/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas 'khor lo dang bum chur dbyer med du gyur par mos la/ om̐ badzra uṣṇi ṣa uṣṇi ṣa a na le bhi shuddhe bai ro badzra pā ṇi sa mā ya badzra dzwa la dzwa la pra dzwa la sarba pi sha tsi parṇa sha wa ri u pa dzwa la pra sha bī ma tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya rtsa dang dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnas so/ gsum pa ni/ gtad sprug nag po'i 'khor lo me long gi ngos su 'char ba bya zhing sngags 'di brgya tsam bzla nas bum chus khrus bya/ om̐ badzra bi dho bi dho bhai dza ya a dzi ti ma a par dzi te ma ma tshindha ya ha ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gzhan gyis byad du bcug pa dang bcings pa thams cad khrol khrol shig shig sarba nā ga hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ku lu mi li tsi lu hu lu hu lu tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bhandha bhandha ha na ha na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pi sha tsi parṇa sha ba ri sarba u pa dhe sha bhurkhung ma hā pra ma ṇa ya bur tsi bu khi bhi ma na se u tsuṣma a kro te hūm̐ phaṭḥ pha rol rig sngags kyis byad du bcug pa dang mnan pa bcings pa bskrad pa gzir ba thams cad: byer byer khrol khrol shig shig bhandha bhandha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa sarba tsu ru tsaṇḍa tsaṇḍa sarba maṇḍa maṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla zhing rdzogs pa dang*/ sngags chu bum par sngags bzhin blugs la bzhag /las bum chung ba zhig kyang bsags/ gzhan yang sreg pa zangs sgrom dmar po las byung ba'i bsgral chas dang me hom byad stems sogs kyang tshogs byas nas byad khrol dngos la 'jug par bya'o/ de ltar khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi bum sgrub khrus kyi rdzing bu zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ mchog gi gang zag phyi nang rten 'brel gyis mtshams sbyor shes pa dag ni yul dang 'phrad pa'i thugs rje shugs bskyed phyir 'di la ma ltos kyang*/ bdag 'dra'i gang zag bskyed rim kho na don du gnyer ba rnams la phan re'i bsam pas nye bar bskul te khungs ldan gyi phyag khrid rgyun mi nyams pa'i slad du/

skyid grong smyon pas gsang ba brag gi yang rdzong du bkod pa kun tu dge ba nyid du gyur cig /bkra shis shog/ // thi) gter gsar byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ma gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub par byed pa la/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di nyid la rag las shing*/ de'ang rnyed par dka' la 'bral sla ba 'chi rkyen rags shing 'tsho rkyen nyung ste/ gling gzhan rnams kyi mi lus rin po che la ni tshe tshad nges pa can yod pa dang*/ rang cag dzambu gling pa rnams la ni tshe tshad nges pa can med cing*/ tshe'i dbang skal ji tsam yod pa de'ang gnas skabs 'phral rkyen dam sri 'byung po gdug pa can rnams kyis tshe rku ste 'khyer ba dang*/ 'phrog ste khyer ba dang*/ bcom ste 'khyer ba sogs 'chi ba'i rkyen shin tu yang mang la/ khyad par sngags pa nang rgyas pa dang*/ phyogs kyi gzhan mthus bskul ba dang*/ mi chen drag rim rnams mtho gnon chags sdang gis nye bar bskul ba'i ban bon mu stegs ngan sngags mkhan gyis mthu gtad zor gsum gyi sbyor bas/ rnal 'byor pa'i mi nor phyugs zhing yul mkhar gnyen srid dang bcas pa byad du gzhug cing ngan sngags kyi dmod pa 'dor ba dang*/ phur pa'i dbal bsor ba mtshon zor gyi rno rdeg pa sogs bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rten 'brel stobs su smin pas/ mi rnams tshe thung zhing bu tsha dang rigs rgyud mi 'phel/ mi kha dang gshed skur sdang*/ nor rdzas la gtor brlag mang*/ sgo phyugs la god yams ldang*/ khyim du dbul 'gong tshang ba dang*/ zas kyi bcud nyams gdong gi bkrag shor/ gos kyi mdangs yal yul gyi bcud nyams pas ri la rtswa mi skye/ me tog la 'bu srin dang sad ser ldang*/ med snang dang ltogs snang 'char/ nad kha dang rims kha zug /'phung gyod dang kha mchu mang*/

yan lag zha rengs dang*/ ngag lkugs lces lab mi shes par skrang ba dang*/ og ma mgul pa 'gags nas na ba dang*/ sngags bgrang mi shes pa dang*/ bgrangs kyang sgra mi dag pa dang*/ gdong sbos pa dang so na ba dang*/ lce la phur pa btab pa rmis pa dang*/ chos po ti dang mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan pa dang*/ dong gting ring du tshud pa dang*/ re ba nag pos btums pa dang*/ mun pa nag po'i phug tu tshud pa dang*/ brag khug khang stong yul stong du slebs pa dang*/ gcig nas gcig la 'dzul ba dang*/ khang stong rdib la khad kyi nang phyin pa dang*/ zam pa dang lam rgya gram gyi dkyil du nyal ba dang*/ ri rong dog po'i rtse nas rbab tu lhung la khad pa dang*/ ro khur ba'i gling du phyin pa dang*/ lha khang dang lder bzo 'gul ba gos mi gtsang ba gyon pa/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab tu phyin pa dang*/ nad pa lkug log pa dang*/ mtsho dang chu mig lha gling gi 'dam rdzab dang*/ grog po chen po'i gting du tshud pa dang*/ chus khyer la khad pa dang*/ ri nyil ba dang 'ja' tshon zug pa dang*/ brag khung gting ring du tshud pa dang*/ rdo'i char babs pa dang*/ thog dbab pa dang*/ sngags bon gyis bskor ba dang*/ mi ngo ma shes pa dang*/ mon pa dang*/ a tsa ras rang la gri mdung rgyab pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ rlung nag 'tshubs pa dang*/ ri gzar nas rdo byung ba dang*/ gcan gzan dang bya nag gis bskor zhing ded pa dang*/ bud med mang po dang*/ mdzo dang bong bu dang*/ dre'u sogs la sga stong gtad nas rang la sgo nyal ba dang*/ dmag gis bskor ba sogs rmi ba dang*/ dngos su'ang rang nyid nyams bshad chung ba dang*/ khro zhing tshig pa za ba dang*/ snying mi dga' ba dang*/ lus lci ba dang*/ 'thibs pa dang*/ shes pa mnal du mi phebs par yed yed pa dang*/ mi la 'thab 'dod pa dang*/ ca co 'bog snying 'dod pa dang*/ nang du 'thab mo mang ba dang*/ bskyed rim mi gsal ba dang*/ sgrub pa byas kyang chad lhag mang zhing nus pa zhan pa dang*/

ltas ngan gyi sems can sna tshogs byung ba dang*/ rang gi gos la don med gris rma byung ba sogs/ rtags de rnams byung na pha rol gyi mthu kha zug pa'i ltas yin pas de lta bu'i bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad bshig kyang 'grol bar byed pa la gang las byung ba brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po gang nas byung na sngon rgya gar bha ga la'i rgyal po a shwa ka zhes pa la mchod gnas mu stegs pa bhi ru sha bya ba nang pa'i chas su ste: rgyal po'i pho brang rdo bcal mthil du 'khar gsil gyi kha ru rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs par skad: de'i zhogs la rgyal po'i pho brang rtse nas khrus byas te gzigs pa dus mnyam du gyur: blon po rnams kyis pho brang rtser spyan 'dren zer: blon po'i kha bzhin rgyal po yang ya mtshan skyes nas zhabs tog bsgrubs nas bla mchod bgyis pas: sras mos de'i 'thad rmi ltas la legs tshogs kyi rgyur mthong : mu stegs de kha che ho phen ta bya ba'i bla mchod yin te: nang pa'i rgyal sa bcom la mngags pa'o: zla ba bdun gyi ring du mu stegs rlung gi spu gri klu nā ra chu 'thung bsgrubs nas grong khyer 'bum tsho bdun liṅgar bkod pas: rgyal po rmi lam 'khrugs pa'i tshe nyin gcig rgyal po pho brang shar phyogs logs kyi ri siṅga la mthong ba'i rtser bud de bltas pas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul nas sprin nag po zhig byung nas de'i nang du: mu stegs phra man ral pa dmar ser yod pa ma he nag po la bzhon nas lag tu thog ser gyi sgrom bu tshwa tshwa khol ba zhig 'brug sgra ha cang che ba dang bcas byung bas: rgyal pos mu stegs kyi byad kha zhig yin nam bsams te cung bred pa dang nang du log par chas nas o rgyan la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa'i mod la: siṅga la nas 'ja' dmar ser zhig lhag ge shar ba'i steng du gu ru nyi ma 'od zer mngon sum du mdun du byon:

khyod bred mi dgos gsungs nas mdung rtse gsum pa de'i phyogs su gdeng bas 'brug gi skad chags mu stegs kyi dmu rtsa mo de shin du bred te rang log tu song : rgyal pos gsol ba lan bdun btab pa dang : lung bstan te sang nyi ma rtse shar gyi skabs su khyod kyi sras mo lha lcam rin chen gsal sgron gdams ngag len du thongs shog siṅga la'i brag phug rasmi ko ṭi la'o: de ltar ma bgyid na: mu stegs bhi ru shas khyod kyi mnga' thang stong nges so: zhes sgra de thos ma thag tu nang du log pas: mu stegs pas rgyal po byon pa'i shul du ri rlung thams cad byad kyi gtad bkram nas rang yul bros thabs kyis song ngo : rgyal pos phyi bsnyags pas rting ma zin par gyur to: phyi nangs snga zhogs rin chen gsal sgron bya ba de rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i sprul pa mkha' 'gro seng gdong gi rnal 'byor ma yin pas: rgyal pos rin chen sna tshogs maṇḍal bskur te: khol mo zhig bcas siṅga lar brdzangs: rje btsun nyi ma 'od zer mjal maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab: slob dpon la zhus pa: kye hoḥ mu stegs bla mchod bgyis nas ngan sngags mthu dang 'grogs: mchod gnas brtag gzhig med pas bar chod bdud kyis bslus: rgyal sna blon gyis bsgyur bas phung gtad sa gzhi gang : gnod rdzas phug tu bzhag na god kha rgyun mi 'chad: mi ngan grogs su bsten na gtam ngan rgyun mi 'chad: rdzas ngan lus la btags na dri ngan rgyun mi 'chad: phung shig yul la gtor na 'thab rtsod rgyun mi 'chad: des na nged kyi rgyal po blon 'bangs la: zhang zhung ngan sngags mkhan gyis tshad btsugs pas: dam pa rig 'dzin nyid kyis rjes bzung nas: 'di las grol ba'i gdams pa stsal du gsol: ces zhes bas gu ru'i zhal nas: lha lcam rin chen gus pas rtser son la: khyod nyid rgya gar ḍākki'i gnas mchog tu: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chas 'dzin nas:

lo ma mun pa'i nags la gnas pa'i tshe: g.yul las rnam rgyal 'bar ba zhes su grags: res 'ga' sha za mo yi cha lugs 'chang : gdams pa 'di ko 'od zer dpal mos 'chang : zhag gsum bsgrubs nas rgyal blon 'bangs rnams la: khrus bstsal dbang bskur srung ba 'di ltar 'chang : yul gru sa gnad ri mtho skyed mos tshal: byad du gang bcug gzungs chus 'khru bar gyis: lha khrus gtsang khrus byad khrus rnam pa gsum: 'grub par bgyis na grol nges the tshom med: byad kha rig sngags kho rang steng du 'gro: lha 'dre mi 'khu bar chad sel bar byed: klu gtad nag po'i shog bu rul ba'am: byad khang nang du sdod kyang ya mi nga : de bas gud du sbos shig sa ma ya: khyod kyis gdams pa 'di ri ri dhi pa la sprod nas dbang lung bgyid de rgyal po'i mchod gnas gyis: zhes gsungs shing man ngag de lha lcam rin chen gsal sgron la gdams pa bzhi skor shog dril ma bu gsum bgyis nas snyan brgyud gter rgya gnyis yod pa: gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal la gdams pa bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi them med skor ro: sa ma ya: de ltar gu ru'i bka' bzhin rje'i drung du zhag gsum bsgrubs pas dngos su yi dam gyi zhal gzigs: gsang mtshan la lha mo 'od zer can btags: rjes byin rlabs dang rab tu gnas nas rgyal po'i rang yul du brdzangs: rgyal po la sngar bzhin rje'i zhal gdams bshad pas shin tu dad pa thob: sras mor phyag 'tshal khri brtsegs nas khri gdan kha ru bzhag: yul der bram ze ri ri dhi pa zhes bya nags la gnas pa spyan drangs: rgyal po dang drang srong nang blon rnams la rin chen gsal sgron gyis gdams pa byin: de'i tshe drang srong bla mchod bgyis: rtag tu phan pa'i srung ba btags: lha lcam dang drang srong dpon slob kyis byad zor zlog pa'i lag rdeb yi ge bcu bzhi dang gdugs dkar g.yul bzlog sngags phra men ma tri ma'i sngags sbrags pas:

kha che'i grong khyer bdun stong nus pa'i gdeng tshad thob: des mu stegs pa'i dmag byad zor thams cad rgyal po'i mnga' 'og lo stong phrag bdun la mi 'byung ba'i rten 'brel byung : de nas slar yang siṅga la bha ga la shambha la bcas gsum la gu ru nyi ma 'od zer rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs: rgyal pos pho brang du gdan drangs: lha lcam rin chen gsal gyis brtsams pa'i maṇḍal gyi phung po bsam las 'das pa phul: rgyal po smon lam bzang pos rgyud smin par mdzad: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer dang lha lcam rin chen yab yum dur khrod so sa gling du spyod pa la gshegs nas lo gsum bzhugs: slar rin chen gsal siṅga la'i shar phyogs shrī bha tra'i gnas la spyod pa la gshegs: lhar skye ba'i tha ma bod khams kyi dpung gnyen du 'byung bar lung bstan pa'o: de ltar gsang ba'i man ngag gdams pa bzhi skor la shog dril ma bu gsum bgyis nas/ snyan brgyud dang gcig brgyud gter rgya gnyis yod pa las/ gcig rin chen gsal gyi sprul pa mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gdams pa shin tu zab pa rtsa ba gsum dril/ phra men zangs 'bar gdong gi bsad las gdugs dkar g.yul bzlog gi 'phang ba sogs/ rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i cha lag tu bsam yas mchims phu'i brag mar ke'u tshang du mi snang bar rgyas btab ste bzhugs pa la/ tshe lo nyi shu pa'i rtags dang 'dul zhing dus la bab pa'i tshe/ nges don rgyal ba sku gsum bdag nyid rig 'dzin padma thod phreng dang dbyer med rung*/ drang don du gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i thugs rje'i rnam rol du byon pa/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i skyes mchog o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i dam pa de nyid kyis sku gsung thugs kyi zab gter ji snyed cig spyan 'dren par mdzad pa'i nang tshan bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi yum ka phrin las rab 'byams kyi cha lag

/lha mo khro gnyer ma rtsa ba gsum dril gyi las tshogs mchog tu gyur pa'i 'di nyid la rgyud lugs dang*/ bram ze'i lugs kyang zer/ spyir ni bram ze'i lugs te/ rgya gar du nang pa rnams kyis bram ze'i rnal 'byor ma zer/ phyi pa mu stegs pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor grub thob ma zer yang*/ don la phyi nang gnyis ka'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa ste ri khrod mar grags so/ de nas nags ma'i khrod du bsgoms pa'i ming yin/ zas su 'tsho ba shing 'bras/ skom du ram shing gi khu ba/ gos su shing lo gyon cing*/ grub pa brnyes ma'o/ 'di ni 'byung lngas bsdus pa'i bar chad kyi rigs thams cad kyi mthong thos dran rig dang snying po bzlas pa tsam gyis mchog par 'gyur zhing*/ byad ma 'bum thub sngags pa khri thub mu stegs stong thub/ bsam gtan nyal chog gi gdams pa/ lha srin gdug pa kun sgrol ces shin tu dam lci'o/ gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos la/ zhi ba sbyin pa btang ba/ dmod pas rig sngags khru zhing phyi ba/ skyob pa'i srung ba 'dogs pa drag po zor 'phen pa sogs phrin las rnam pa bzhir 'gyed pa las/ thog mar las byed ma mo khrag ral ma'i rgyud nas byung ba phra men zangs 'bar gdong gi las tshogs/ sreg pa zangs sgrom dmar po'i sgo nas pha rol gdug cing sdang ba'i byad zor gyi bdag po thams cad rang gshed rang la phab ste tshar gcod pa mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las brtsam pa la/ rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag gis ji ltar dmod pa'i bden tshig de kho na bzhin du/ khyed rang rnams kyis kyang sdang dgra gnod byed log 'dren thams cad dmigs yul du bkod la khyed shes kyi thugs 'dun mi g.yel bar mdzad pa zhu lags/

zhes mtshams sbyar la bsgral las zhal bstab kyi bar bya/ de nas dngos gzhi rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa 'khru zhing sbyang bar byed pa la/ 'byung ba phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen byed las mtshungs phyir/ pha rol dgra bo byad mas khyed rang rnams rig sngags kyi dmod las drag pos byad du bcug pa la gnyen po'i gshed ma dang chas su gnad la dbab pa'i tshul ni/ 'phang hom gyi steng tsha nag byad kyi ri bo 'byung po'i bla rten nag po dang*/ mda' hom gyi steng du tsha dkar srid pa'i gangs chu ye shes 'khor lo'i chu rgyun lugs 'byung yas bab kyi rten 'brel ting 'dzin drag pos mtshams sbyar ba'i nus pas/ tsha nag byad kyi ri bo 'phung rdzas lhag rjes med par sbyangs shing*/ bdag nyid bdud 'dul drag mo'i phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi ral gri 'bar bas 'byung lnga'i byad thag gis bcings rgya rnams dum bur gtubs pas/ 'byung bzhi rang byung gi klong du thim zhing dmod pa'i phung rdzas ban bon mu stegs byad ma mkhan gyi bla rten dang gnyis su med pa srog bdag ma mo 'bum gyi zhal du bstabs pas/ snang srid kyi byad zor phur kha ldang med ye shes kyi 'khor lor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ byad thag bcad cing hom du bsreg /tsha khrus bya/ de nas rig sngags kyis 'khru zhing phyi ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par ye shes 'od lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ khro gnyer gtum mo ye shes kyi gzi 'od 'bar nas 'byung lngas bsdus pa'i byad zor mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad cig car sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i sku las/ ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad thams cad rnag khrag /gdon thams cad srog chags/ byad grib thams cad 'ja' tshon sngo dmar gyi rnam par dbang po'i sgo dang*/

ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs sangs thon cing*/ lus shel sgong g.ya' bral ba lta bur gyur/ srid pa'i rus sbal kha sbyor gyis dbang bskur zhing byabs pas/ 'byung lnga'i gtad 'dre thams cad dmigs med du bcom/ rtswa mchog ku sha g.yab pas dug lnga'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa lhag med du phyags nas ngar glud la sib kyis thim/ lha mo lnga'i rang bzhin dar gyis phyis pas dug lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor rgyas thebs te phuung khams lha'i 'khor lo gsal rdzogs su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la spyi bor bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: rdzu 'phrul bum pa gzhal yas lha: rig sngags 'dzin ma sku gsum dngos: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dbang bskur de bzhin khrus bstsal nas: rdzas mchog ku sha'i rlung spros te: 'byung lnga lha mos sku phyis pas: byad gtad zhags pa khrol gyur cig: om̐ sarba bhi dha ya hūm̐: badzra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra sho dha sho dha hūm̐ hūm̐: kā ya wākka tsitta satwaṃ bha khrol khrol: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ ha he badzra phaṭ swā hā: zhes bum pa'i chu rgyun sbreng zhing bkru bas gzungs ring thung tshar re nyung mtha' byas pa brjod cing kha yang bshal lo/ oṃ ā dhe was lha'i byad du bcug pa mnan pa bsdams pa rig sngags kyi dmod las byad zor phur kha'i gnod pa thams cad shig shig khrol khrol: om̐ bhi dza ya ma hā bha la a dzi te tsitta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces byab cing glud la bstim pa sogs glud bsngo sreg pa tsha khrus srung 'khor spel ba rnams yongs rdzogs grub nas/ tsakra gri lcags kyi gwa'u'am thum pos g.yogs te dmigs bya'i lus la gdags/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ des khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs rgyud kyi byad kha/ slob dpon rgyud kyi byad kha/ pha mes rgyud kyi byad kha/ yul ris sa phyogs kyi byad kha/ tshe 'di'i mngon zhen mtho gnon gyi byad kha las gyur pa dang*/

phyag rgya las gyur pa dang*/ bsam gtan las gyur pa dang*/ sbyor ba las gyur pa dang*/ stobs las gyur pa dang*/ smon lam las gyur pa dang*/ rang bzhin las gyur pa dang*/ rang gi sbyor ba dang rang nyid la log pa sogs/ mdor na phra man ngan sbyor gyi byad gdon thams cad/ 'dod yon glud gtor gyi za kha khengs shing*/ skye ba dang tshe rabs kyi lan chags thams cad byang bas 'byung po'i za lam gtong ste/ pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa rang log tu gyur pa/ bum pa'i dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas byad sgrib nyes tshogs thams cad sangs te lus lha'i gzhal yas su tshud/ dug sbrul nag po stong thub kyi tsakras khyab cing srid pa'i byad rgya thams cad ting 'dzin ye shes kyi sngags rgod drag po'i rgyas btab pas gtad 'dre byad gdon gdug pa'i lto ba dkrugs shing*/ tshe srog bla rten byad du bcug pa thams cad dbang med du skyugs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'byung ba'i stobs rtsal bskyed cing gzi mdangs 'bar/ lha mo lnga'i rang bzhin dar gyis phyis pas 'byung ba sor chud cing ye shes kyi 'khor lor rgyas thebs/ tsakra lus la bcings pas srid pa'i byad gdon phung 'dre gang gis kyang bltar mi bzod cing 'da' bar mi nus te/ srid gsum gyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba de nyid rtag brtan mi shigs pa rdo rje'i sku 'grub phyir ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor 'di ltar sgoms 'tshal zhing*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gzugs phung gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa che zhing brjid pa khro chu zhun ma ltar tshwa tshwa 'bum phrag 'phro ba'i lte bar/ rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing nag cig tu sgoms/ rdo rje'i steng gi nam mkha' 'od snang las grub pa'i gdugs dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa la/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis bdud 'dul gyi rgya can srung skyob kyi tshul du gsal/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba go mtshams med par gtams pa las mtshon cha sna tshogs 'khrugs shing mched pas/

srid mtha' sdud pa rdo rje'i rwa gur gyi lte ba rnams su khro mo kha dog sna tshogs pas bhyo bhyo dang phaṭ phaṭ kyi sgra bsgrags pas srid gsum zil gyis gnon cing*/ ma rungs bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces brda sbyar la/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas: 'gags med hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: gnyis med bhyo dang phe ka ra'i: rang bzhin me dpung tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs srung 'khor gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyo bhyo bhyo: hūm̐ nṛ bhrūm̐ badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya phrag tsam bzla/ de ltar gyur pa la de nyid la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang spyan gzigs bde gshegs stong rtsas mnga' gsol ba bde legs bstsal de gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces me tog 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ byang chub snying rjer gshegs pa ni/ /sa rnams rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*/ /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byad/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*/ /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ brgya byin tshangs pa lha dang ni/ /'byung ba kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sems can byad las rab grol zhing*/ /nus pa mchog dang ldan gyur cig / ces dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ me hom bsdu/ de dag ni zhogs pa nyi ma rtse shar nas nyin gung yan gyi phrin las so/ dgong mo nyi ma nub mtshams me hom du zor dgra phyogs su bstan de 'phang*/ me thal dang khrus chu rnams gzhung ltar chu bo chen po sogs gshegs la srung 'khor bsgoms shing byin 'bebs bya/

de nas bsgrub bya stan dkar g.yung drung gi mtshan ma can gyi khar bzhag la gos dkar bskon/ tshe dbang rtags tshad phebs par bskur rjes/ dam tshig bsgo ba ni/ de ltar byad khrol gyi dam tshig tu/ zhag bdun gyi bar 'khrig pa'i las dang*/ sha dmar sogs grib la 'dzem/ them skas rim pa bdun 'das nas mi 'bab/ gdugs dkar gyi gzungs khri rdzogs par 'don/ rtag tu srung 'khor lus drod dang mi 'bral/ gzhan dag la rku 'phrog mi brtsam/ yugs sa mor mi spyad/ dge ba can gyi thugs rgyud mi dkrugs pa sogs mdor na mi dge ba'i las rags pa mtha' dag spangs shing dge bcu dwang du len par bya'o/ zhes go bar bsgrag go /gter gsar byad khrol gser gyi lde mig dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gangs mtsho zhabs drung ngag dbang kun dga' dpal bzang po'i bkas bskul ba ltar/ skyid grong smyon pas 'brug 'od gsal chos sdings su bkod pa la/ slar yang zhu dag gis phri bsnan bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // di) ༄༅/ byad khrol gser gyi lde mig bcas chog nag po phyag len 'gro shes su bkod pa thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal lung bzhugs so/ gdod ma'i mgon po mi yi brdzur zhugs te/ /yin lugs sems kyi rang ngo bcar phog tu/ /ston nas skal ldan thar pa'i mthong lam cher/ /'jug nus pad 'byung gnyis pa bla mas skyongs/ de'ang bdag bskyed seng gdong gi 'phang hom tsha nag byad kyi ri bo dang*/ mda' hom tsha dkar ye shes 'khor lo chabs cig tu sgrub pa dang*/ mdun bskyed lha mo khro gnyer can gyi bum sgrub me long gyi khrus sogs ci bzhin grub rjes/ byad khrol dngos la 'jug pa ni/ bsgrub bya rnams stan nag hom khung bris pa'i khar bsgrigs la/ ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dmigs yul du bkod la/ khyed shes kyis thugs 'dun mi g.yel bar zhu lags/

gser skyems bshams la/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos rdzu 'phrulas drag mo'i sku: sogs khā hi khā hi: nya bo dum bu me hom du bsregs la/ 'joms byed chen mo srog bdag ma mo gsum: sogs myog myog rbad rbad: byad thag gcod pa'i spu gri gri gug gang rung thogs/ bhyoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: sogs bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nya bo dum bu dang byad thag dum bu me hom du bsregs la/ bhyoḥ ma tri mu ram̐? ram̐ ram̐ ye swā hā: de nas dngos gzhi rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa phyi zhing sbyangs par? ye shes kyi 'khor lor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tsha khrus ni/ 'di ni rig sngags kyis 'khru zhing phyi? 'di bzhin du mdzod/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma a las zla ba ste gdan sum brtsegs kyi khar baṃ dmar po sogs lha bskyed dang*/ hūm̐: rang bzhin rtog med dbyings? sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ khyed rang rnams la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas lha yi gzhal yas khang du tshud/ khrus bstsal bas gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags sde brgyad kyi byad kha las grol/ rtswa mchog ku sha g.yab pas mthu gtad dang rig sngags dmod pa'i dbal kha la sogs zhi bar 'gyur ro: bum pa'i chu rgyun tsha dkar la sbrengs nas tsha nag bshig par byas te/ ye shes seng gdong dkar mo yi/ /thugs rje 'od zer bdud rtsi yis/ /byad kyi ri bo nag po shigs: dmod pa'i phung shig nag po gtor/ om̐ mu mu ma saṃ dha mu khaṃ mu raṃ mu yam̐ ye swā hā/ bsgrub bya so sor bskur zhing khrus la/ hūm̐: rdzu 'phrul bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang : rig sngags 'dzin ma sku gsum dngos: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dbang bskur de bzhin khrus bstsal nas: rdzas mchog ku sha'i rlung spros te:

'byung lnga lha mo'i sku phyis pas: byad gtad zhags pa khrol gyur cig: om̐ sarba bhi dha ya hūm̐ badzra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra shwa dha shwa dha hūm̐ hūm̐ kā ya wākka tsitta satwaṃ bha yam khrol khrol: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ ha he badzra phaṭ swā hā/ om̐ pi sha tsi sogs sngags ring brjod/ tsha khrus lha khrus glud bsngo mtshams gcod bstab pa sogs rgyas pa gal che'o/ rigs la gter gzhung ltar dang phral sel 'jug bder/ 'khor lo rma mdongs dar tshon gyis phyi bzhin glud la dkrug tshul byas la/ tsaṇḍa tsaṇḍa sarba maṇṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad phyogs skyong dregs pa pho mo ma ning gi sde tshogs thams cad kyis byad du bcug pa dang : mnan pa dang : bsdams pa rig sngags kyi dmod las byad zor phur kha'i gnod pa thams cad shig shig khrol khrol: bhi dza ya ma hā bā la a dzi te tsitta hūm̐ phaṭḥ glud la chab bran dpal 'bar sbar/ om̐ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan sna lnga dang ldan par gyur/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis brlab/ hūm̐: snang zhing srid pa'i khams 'di na: ma gshin pho mo ma ning sogs: srid pa'i gdon chen bsam yas kyang : bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyis: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i tshogs rnams la: 'dod yon yas glud 'di bsngos pas: tshe rabs lan chags sbyangs pa dang : dus kyi chad pa grol bar gyis: gzhan gyis byad du bcug pa dang : rig sngags dmod pas rbad pa sogs: 'dod yon glud 'dis 'khor bar gyis: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: phyin chad gnod pa ma mdzad cig: sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong : mkha' la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong : sa la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la:

byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong : chu la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong : me la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la gtong : rlung la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: rus pa'i glud 'di rdo la gtong : rdo la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: rtsa rgyus glud 'di shing la gtong : shing la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: nang rol glud 'di lam la gtong : lam la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: pags pa'i glud 'di thang la gtong : thang la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: gos kyi glud 'di sprin la gtong : sprin la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig: bla med byang chub reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: a ā badzra mu swā hā:

rgya gram gyi phyag rgyas/ hūm̐: rdo rje gcod pa'i ral gri las: 'phros pa'i rang bzhin steng 'og khyab: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: bgegs dang 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra tsakra hūm̐ hūm̐: slar yang tshar grangs phyir bstab pa ni: bhyoḥ za byed 'bar ba las kyi ma mo'i tshogs: gnam lcags sdig rgod 'bar ba'i zhal gdangs par: dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed zhal du bstab: rig sngags byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: om̐ badzra ma tri rakmo bhyo lo ha biṣatsha ṣa byad ma a pa ya ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: gong gi tsha khrus nas bzung bskyar te tshar gsum bar bya: de nas tsha khrus bgyis pa'i chu dang tsha nag bshig cing bsgrubs pa'i bkrus khu rnams chu bo chen por dor la/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos mā ma kī: 'byung ba chu yi gsher brlan la: byad ma bsregs gtor bkrus nas su: skye med dag pa'i klong du thim: chu yis khyab pa'i sems can rnams: byad dang gtad las grol gyur cig: om̐ badzra dharma buddha ye muṃ sa ma ya mā ma kī ye swā hā: me hom bshig pa ni/ hūm̐: bsreg bya sreg byed rang bzhin me: dgra bo'i phung khams ma gtogs pa: pho nya mo rnams skye med hoḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ling ro bsregs pa'i me ro 'gyu lam lta bur dong brus par mnan la/ dza bhyoḥ rim pa dgu yi sa 'og nas: sa srin nag mo lcam dral ma: lag na sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs: srid pa las kyi kha gdangs nas: 'gyu byed dbal gyi lce rkyongs shig: dam nyams dgra bgegs khyod la gtad: zhal du bstabs pas kha bsdams te: bskal pa stong du ma shor cig: nag mo ti pa sha ka li dung dung tri mun thun thun satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: zhes pas g.yogs la gnon/ yang na me ro mnan pa ma byas par dgra phyogs su 'phang yang rung 'thus/ tsha dkar dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas la srung sgo'i steng du bzhag /dus drug sbrul nag po stong thub kyi tsakra rdzas ldan lteb kyang dar gyi thum du bsgril zhing btags/

bsgrub bya mang zhing tsakra ma lcogs tshe/ 'gyu lam zhig gi gong du bzhag kyang 'thus so/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs rgyud kyi byad kha/ slob dpon rgyud kyi byad kh om̐ ye dharmā sogs brjod/ de nas bsgrub bya stan dkar g.yung drung gi mtshan ma can gyi khar bzhag la gos dkar bskon/ tshe dbang sogs bkra shis pas mtha' rten byas rjes/ byad khrol gyi dam tshig bsrung ba ni/ zhag bdun bar 'khrig pa mi spyad/ sha dmar sogs grib la 'dzem/ them skas rim pa bdun 'das nas mi 'bab/ gdugs dkar gyi gzungs khri phrag 'don/ srung 'khor 'chang ba sogs dam tshig bsgrag go /bcas pa'i cho ga byad khrol ches zab cing*/ /da dung bla ma'i phyag bzhes 'di 'dra yang*/ /dbang dman rnams nas 'jug par ma nus par/ /slar yang man ngag mthong rgyun gcig kho na/ /bsgril ba'i nag po 'gro shes spu gri 'di/ /lho phyogs 'brug yul dge slong phyag cha ru/ /shin tu spro ba'i 'bul yul kong nag pas/ bgyis shing nyes pas gos pa rdul tsam med/ de ltar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus them med skor gyi byad khrol 'di bzhin rig 'dzin chen po thugs mchog rdo rje'i chog bsgrigs snga phyi lan tshan mang bas nyams su blang bar dbang dman rnams rtogs dka' bas slar yang lho phyogs 'brug yul gyi dge slong chen pos nag 'gros kho nar ces bskul bar brten/ rig sngags pa kong smyon nus ldan rdo rjes lha ldan ghandho la'i nye 'dabs su bkod pa 'gro kun mthu gtad kyi sbyor ba las nye bar grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ni) byad khrol bca' chog phyag len/ swā ti bhe/ byad khrol gyi bca' bsham ni/ stegs bu'i khar bdag bskyed seng gdong ma mkha' 'gro'i dpal gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa/ mdun du zor rdzas gtso 'khor bcu gnyis pa/ khrag kyu gsum gyi nang du ling chung gsum bsnan tshe nyungs sha khrag gis brgyan pa/

g.yas su sman g.yon du rakta nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga sogs bsham/ mdun du zangs gzhong lta bu'i khar 'phang hom steng phung sa rdo sol bye nag skyer sol bsregs pa'i tsha nag dang*/ de steng mda' hom steng cu gang*/ cong zhi/ ka ma la bcas bsregs pa'i tsha dkar byad thag gis dkris pa/ nya bo ling kheb ldan pa/ bya rog dang 'ug sgro/ gu gul/ thun rdzas sgrol phur/ gri gug ral gri sogs kyang 'du bya/ gzhan yang rdor dril rnga rol bcas dang*/ dkar bgegs tshogs 'khor bcas ji ltar dgos pa 'du bgyis pa dang*/ mdun bskyed bum sgrub ni/ stegs bu'i steng ras dkar dri med g.yogs pa'i khar 'bru tshom bkod pa'i thog bsgrub bya mang nyung gi lding tshod shoms pa'i bum par rgyun ldan gyi chu la dri bzang chos sman blugs/ mgul chings dar ljang dang kha rgyan ku sha rma bya'i mdongs kyi khrod dug sbrul nag po stong thub kyi 'khor lo yig rgod kyi lte bar khyad par gyi pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis dpe bris bzhin la/ gla rtsi/ shu dag /spru nag /thang khrom/ gu gul/ shing kun bcas byugs/ thog lcags/ sbal sha/ nya sha/ sbrul sha/ sdig sha/ lcags sdig sha/ lcung ka'i snying*/ pho rog gi snying*/ glag gi snying*/ spyang ki'i snying*/ stag gzig dom dred rnams kyi mche ba dang sder mo/ dur bya'i mchu/ khrung khrung gi rgyus pa/ g.yag rgod kyi rwa/ phag rgod kyi mche ba bcas dar nag gis thum bu bgyis pa 'khor lo'i lte bar bzhag cing dar tshon sna lnga'i chings rgyan spras pa dang*/ de'i mdun du nyer mchod phyi nang sogs kyang bsham/ rgyas pa gter gzhung ltar glud kyang tshan pa bcu gnyis dang*/ chog bsgrigs bzhin la sku glud tshar gsum gyis 'thus shing*/ glud rdzas ting lo dpal 'bar changs bus brgyan pa yang bsham/ dur rdo gsum mam ri gnyan gsum nas btsal ba'i rdo la thod skam bris pa'i sgyed pu'i steng du lcags slang du/

drag shing gis me hom gru gsum brtsegs pa'i nang byad ma'i liṅga dug shog la bris pa'am zan ling rkyang pas kyang rung ba bcas 'di dag rnams ni/ med du mi rung ba'i bsham 'god lags shing bsgrub bya mdun du sgrub skabs stan nag chos 'byung gis mtshan pa'i khar dgod pa dang*/ gzhan yang las kha bsgyur gyi lde kha sogs gter gzhung du gsal ba ltar bya/ sbyor ba'i chos la rtogs pas nying mtshams sbyor bas gang byas chos nyid kyi rol par shar bas rten 'brel rmad du 'byung ba'o/ mthong rgyud byad khrol bca' shom 'di/ 'ol tshod rig pas dpyad min par/ /thugs mchog badzra hūm̐ ka la'i/ /zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa po/ /kong smyon rig sngags 'chang ba'am/ /chags pa rdo rje gang de yis/ /lha gdan grong khyer chen po ru/ /bris pa dge tshogs 'gro la smin// // pi) byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi lag len zin bris/ na mo gu ru/ dbyings las ma g.yos kun tu bzang mo'i thugs/ /rang byung rol gar sprul pa'i snang byed pa/ gdul bya'i snang ngor gang 'dul shes rab 'phrul/ /rab grags yid 'ong mkha' 'gro'i sku la 'dud/ byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi lag len zin bris bkod pa ni/ sgrub khang gi phugs su stegs bu'i kheb gdan steng la gnod sbyin gyi mchod gtor sman rakta chos srung spyi dang bye brag gi gtor ma/ nyer spyod lnga sogs bkod/ lcags snod du zor gtor 'khor gsum pa sha dum liṅga tshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa drag po'i nyer spyod lnga bcas ji ltar babs par stegs bu kheb ljang nag gis bkab par/ 'bru tshom pad 'dab brgyad kyi khar rnam bum rgyun 'bab kyi chus sum gnyis bkang ba'i bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings ljang gu can dang sman raka bcas bkod/ g.yas su nag po stong thub kyi 'khor lo/ g.yon du me long khrus dar sogs dang*/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bsham/

mdun nam gang babs su lcags zangs kyi snod du 'phang hom gyi khar tsha nag gzhung ltar btab pa bkod/ de'i mda' hom la brten pa'i byad thag dkris shing steng du tsha dkar rab gnas can bzhag /mdun du gri lcags kyi gri gug gam ral gri sogs dang*/ me cha spra ba sogs gzhung ltar dang*/ rin chen la sogs pa'i snod du ngar glud pho mo bsgrub bya'i yul dang bstun pa'i che ba bcu gnyis/ re re la glud chung bcu gnyis dang changs bus bskor/ glud rdzas spyi mthun bsham/ ri gsum gyi rdo gsum la thod skam bris pa'i sgyed pu'i khar lcags snod du shing tsher ma can gyi hom gru gsum du brtsegs/ brub khung bskyed byang ngam dug shog la liṅga bris par dug khrag gis byugs pa'i steng du zan ling bzhag dbye sgro/ thun rdzas/ gdab phur sogs gzhung nas 'byung ba'i rdzas mtha' dag kyang mngon par 'du byas la/ gzhung la 'jug pa ni/ seng gdong ma'i cho ga las gzhung bsrang zhing bdag nyid dang zor gtor bskyed bzlas bya/ zlog sngags kyis bsgrub/ chos srung gi bskang gso sogs spyi 'gro lta bur bgyid/ tshogs bskang ba yan grub nas/ mdun gyi bum sgrub khrus kyi rdzing bu las/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: sogs nas/ tsaṇḍa tsaṇḍa maṇḍa maṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ yan byas/ rtsa gsum dril ba'i gzungs ring dang nye snying om̐ badzra bhi dho bhi dho sogs brgya rtsa'i mthar las bum sngags 'khor lo/ om̐ badzra uṣṇi ṣa a na le bhi shuddhe sogs nas brtan bzhugs rab tu gnas/ de nas me long la 'khor lo'i gzugs brnyan 'char bar bum chus khrus bya zhing*/ om̐ badzra bhi dho bhi dho badzra ya bhi dza sogs? brgya rtsa gcig gi mthar khrus chu rnams bum par blugs la mdun du brub ling thun rdzas sogs bkod/ thugs dam bskul zhing gser skyems btang ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos sgyu 'phrul drag po'i sku: sogs? brub khung dmigs bya bskyed pa 'gugs gzhug pho nya 'gyed pa nan tan du bya zhing*/

lha dbye thun rdeg bsgral ba zhal bstab kyi bar gzhung ltar grub nas de nas bkru bya gang yin gral du 'khod la/ nges shes bskyed phyir dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun sogs lung 'bog cing*/ ma gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang sogs dang nas/ khyed shes kyis thugs 'dun mi g.yel bar mdzad par zhu lags/ las bum gyi chu 'thor la/ om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li nas bzung*/ a be sha ya ya a a swa ti sarba satwaṃ/ man dang*/ de nas bum pa thogs la/ khyed rang rnams la sogs nas badzra phaṭ swā hā: gzungs sngags/ om̐ pi sha tsi parṇa sha wa ri sarba sogs nas kī la ya dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gzungs ring thung gis bum pa'i dbang bskur/ 'khor lo g.yab ku shas byab/ dar tshon sna lngas dbyi ba ni/ glud la chab bran dpal 'bar sbar la/ om̐ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las glud sogs sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: zhes nas/ om̐ āḥdhe wa lha'i byad du sogs? byab phyis la khrus chu glud kyi nang du blugs/ gong gi gri lcags me rdo dur rdo'i me rdo gri khrag gis brlan pa'i spra bas me sbar ba'i me lce la/ ro shing la ro ras tshil zhun gyi dpal 'bar gyis me hom sbar la bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ mdun du drag po e yi me thab sogs nas rang bzhin can du gyur gyis me hom bskyed la/ bhyoḥ za byed 'bar ba las kyi ma mo'i tshul: sogs kyis ling dum dmar gtor 'bru sna sogs 'bul/ gri gug ral gri sogs kyis byad thag gcod pa ni/ bhyoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: sogs kyis byad thag bcad la/ bhyoḥ ma tri mu ram̐ sogs ram̐ ram̐ ye swā hā: sogs nas byad thag dum bu dar tshon sogs 'bul/ tsha dkar khrus gsol zhing*/ bhyoḥ ye shes seng gdong dkar mo yis: sogs mu raṃ mu laṃ ye swā hā: sogs pa'i khrus chu tsha nag gi steng la 'bab par bya/ de nas glud bsngo ba ni/ glud bcu tshan gcig bshams la/

bkru bya ku shas byab cing glud kyi nang du bstim tshul bya/ om̐ ā dhe wa lha yis byad du bcug pa sogs a dzi ti tsitta hūm̐ phaṭḥ byab phyis khrus chu glud kyi nang du blugs/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis brlab/ hūm̐: lha yi rgyal po 'khor bcas sogs nas badzra mu swā hā: zhes shar phyogs dang rim pa bzhin glud rnams phyogs su 'bul/ rdo rje gcod pa'i ral gri yis: sogs kyi yon bdag pho mo'i mgo thog rdo rje rgya gram bzhag nas rgyas gdab/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas rdzu 'phrul bum pa sogs nas dbang bskur bya ba zhal bstab bar/ kha tsha khrus sgrub byad thag bsregs na/ byab cing glud la bstim tshul byin rlabs sogs/ shar lho nub byang sogs gong ltar kun la 'gres shes par byas nas/ glud rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ 'joms byed chen po srog bdag ma mo gsum: sogs kyi 'og gi shog ling ngam zan ling mer bsreg /bsreg bya sreg byed sogs kyis me hom dug chus btul/ zor dpag la dpal 'bar 'dzugs sman raka sbran/ las gzhung gi bskul byas nas/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig ma sring dbyings nas bzhengs: ? mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces nas thal rdeb dang bcas dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ tsha nag dang khrus chu me ro sogs chu bo'i gzhung du dor/ dbyings las ma g.yos mā ma kīḥ sogs kyis sbyang*/ bdag bskyed nang ltar chad brtan rjes chog gzhung ltar bya'o/ las rjes mi mngon par bsdu/ zin tho nyung bsdus brjed tho rong smyon pas sbyar ba maṅga laṃ// //
